In this situation, try not to alert the employee that anything is out of the ordinary. When the host becomes agitated, the infection will speed up. If the skin begins to change, that means at least 30% of the host's brain has already been consumed. Any conversation at this point is the Abnormality's attempt to mimic the host's behavior, so don't pay it any mind.

key:
+ The following counseling log illustrates how $0’s ability to make any person slumber psychologically affects the employees. The results indicate that we cannot utilize this ability to reduce the mental corruption of our staff. Please refer to this record for further research.

      Vincent: Please, make it quick… I gotta sleep...

      Counselor: Is that because of the Abnormality?

      Vincent: Yeah, I remember seeing something that looked like a sheep pass by me, and… well, I fell asleep. Since then I’ve been like this.

      Counselor: Do you remember the dream you had back when that occurred?

      Vincent: Oh, I could never forget that dream…

      Counselor: Could you please tell me as much as you can about it?


      Vincent: It was a happy, wonderful, sweet dream. That’s all the words I need to describe it. Heck, I even felt glad to be working for this company. And I saw a guy who’s not with me anymore, he was right next to me…

      (Omitted)

      …Because of that I couldn’t get a hold on myself when I woke up.


      Counselor: I see. I’ve heard a little about you from the other employees recently. All of them say that the only thing you do outside of work hours is sleep. Could you please tell me why?

      Vincent: Don’t you understand what I’m talking about? I just want to have that dream again. That dream where I was there with him. Recalling those happy moments… But I couldn’t go back no matter how many times I slept. I slept, and slept, and slept, and slept, and slept, and yet…!

      Counselor: ... I see. I’d advise you to take some rest in your room.

      Vincent: ...They said everyone who woke up after hearing that Abnormality’s sound went mad. People think it’s because they all had a horrible nightmare they couldn’t handle, but it’s actually the other way around.

      The reality they had to wake up to was so terrible that the soul gave up on waking life.

      As you know, time flows differently in dreams. A mere instant of waking life constitutes an eternity in the dreamworld. 

      Maybe, if $0 were to put me to sleep once again, then I might just have that wonderful dream anew.

      Counselor: ... I’ll prescribe you some sleep medicine. I assure you that it’ll help you sleep. Please get some rest for now.

      Finally, you will be prohibited from entering the Abnormality’s Containment Unit from now on.
value:
+ 以下咨询记录展示了 $0 使任何人在沉入睡眠方面的能力对员工产生的心理影响。结果表明，我们无法利用这一能力来减轻员工的精神腐化。请参阅此记录以作进一步研究。

  /       咨询师：是因为异想体吗？
  /       Vincent：是啊，我记得有东西经过我身边，看起来像只羊，然后……我就睡着了。从那以后我就一直是这个样子。
  /       咨询师：你还记得当时做的梦吗？
  /       Vincent：哦，那个梦我永远也忘不了……
  /       咨询师：能请你尽可能详细地告诉我吗？
 
  /       Vincent：那是一个幸福、美好、甜美的梦。这些词就足以形容它了。说真的，我甚至为自己能在这家公司工作而感到庆幸。我还看到了一个已经不在我身边的人，他就在我身边……
  /       （省略）
  /       ……正因如此，醒来之后我完全无法控制自己。
 
  /       咨询师：我明白了。最近我从其他员工那里听说了一些关于你的事。他们都说，你在工作时间之外唯一做的事就是睡觉。能请你告诉我原因吗？
  /       Vincent：难道你不明白我在说什么吗？我只是想再做一次那个梦。那个他和我在一起的梦。重温那些幸福的时刻……可无论我睡多少次，都无法再回去了。我睡了又睡，睡了又睡，睡了又睡，睡了又睡，可还是……！
  /       咨询师：……我明白了。我建议你回房间好好休息一下。
  /       Vincent：……他们说，凡是听到那个异想体声响后醒来的人，都疯了。人们以为那是因为他们都做了无法承受的可怕噩梦，可事实恰恰相反。
  /       他们不得不醒来的现实太过残酷，以至于灵魂放弃了苏醒后的生活。
  /       如你所知，梦中的时间流速不同。现实中的一瞬，便是梦境中的永恒。
  /       也许，如果 $0 再让我睡一次，我就能再次做上那个美妙的梦了。
  /       咨询师：……我会给你开一些安眠药。我保证它们能帮你入睡。现在请先好好休息吧。
  /       最后，从今往后，你将被禁止进入那个异想体的收容单元。

key: Remember what was written in the employee manual? "Do NOT have personal feelings towards Abnormalities." At first, I didn't get what that was supposed to mean. Does it even make sense to develop any emotion toward those monsters in the first place? It's okay. They are monsters. Between the two of us, we can call them that. 'Happy Teddy Bear' was the second Abnormality you took charge of. I guess you must’ve thought that not all Abnormalities are monstrous after seeing it. The figure of an old, abandoned teddy bear may have brought up old memories of yours. Teddy seemed to like your hugs. Yeah, it would actually produce more energy when you were around. And in no time, they put you in charge of Teddy. You probably felt some kind of responsibility for it, right? I started getting worried as you visited Teddy's unit more and more often. <Employee Alex’s Notes>

      The human mind is too fragile to visualize something in its truest form. Did you know that mantis shrimp can see hundreds of colors that humans cannot? That simple fact is enough of an example to illustrate my point that it’s detrimental to believe and judge everything by relying solely on what you see.

      I don’t actually have many friends. Don’t misunderstand me now. I don’t want to make a friend, I choose not to make friends; it’s not that I can’t. It is because we don’t understand each other. A person thinks of himself as a completely isolated entity, making it impossible to fully understand others. But ironically, an inherent instinct of mob psychology has survived over the course of our evolution.

      We repeatedly play a game of risk, walking a tightrope, vainly trying to understand each other while staying out of our territories. In fact, I was long done with this pointless game. I volunteered to observe the giant mushroom for a similar cause. No one wanted to get close to that Abnormality. It must be because of some petty reasons such as how it looks disgusting to their eyes. The fact that its appearance was slightly alien wasn't going to stop me. In fact, I actually felt a bit superior when everyone seemed surprised when I said I would work with it.

      (Omitted) The Abnormality didn't show any notable activity. I recorded and observed the silence with patience. One day, after it spread powders of enchanting colors, I experienced a special change. I could perceive "hyper-reality," a plane higher than reality. This was a hand He gave to me. I took it and was rewarded with the invitation to such a special place. It was something only I could achieve. He talked to me telepathically.

      He welcomed me because I was the only one who could realize His essence. I had been imagining, yearning for the moment to converse through my mind. To be completely understood; the feeling of unification. It was so exhilarating, I could barely hide my joy.

      (Omitted) I wanted to get closer to Him. I wanted to be a part of Him. I always thought of Him. I wanted to belong to Him and understand His world. Like a flower bud about to bloom, my mind was pervaded... I was being tamed, little by little...

One peculiar thing about him was that he would volunteer to work on the mushroom chunk, an Abnormality everyone loathed to visit. It was also disturbing that he would spend an unusually long time in its Containment Unit.

       Who knows what kind of monstrosity might have grown on his body? When we decided to call the Abnormality the "Giant Mushroom Chunk" among ourselves, that guy spoke up for the first time. Saying he's the one who's seen it the most. He talked a lot of nonsense, like how it didn't deserve to be called a mushroom chunk. Everyone laughed at him.

       We decided he finally had gone bonkers when he started saying stuff about how he became friends with the damn thing. I mean, it’s a common enough thing around here, lots of stuff happens. One person going insane isn’t a big deal. We tried to give him a couple hints to take a psychiatric test but he just gave us this condescending look like he knew something we didn’t.

       And a few days later, he kicked the bucket, as we all know. Did I mention that it was me who recognized him in that spore-mold-creature's carcass? The birthmark on his forehead. If we hadn't found that birthmark on that lump of spores, we'd never have even guessed it was him. No one actually knew he had a birthmark except me. Since, you know, no one in the department was friends with him.

       After becoming that monster, he just wandered around near the mushroom’s Containment Unit. We tried to lure him somewhere less crowded ‘cause he was attacking everything in sight. But he wouldn’t move more than ten meters away from the chunk until he died. 

       This is why we decided to rename the Abnormality. Complex reasons, like pity for the guy who became friends with a mushroom of all things, and the remembrance of his tragic death.

       To tell you the truth, he needed a friend. That's why he let himself get infected, going crazy in hallucinations, not knowing that he was turning into a monster. The mushroom, it tamed the poor bastard simply to reproduce; it got Alex, whose name wasn't known by anyone...

      When I first heard that the ‘Nameless Fetus’ had to be fed, I thought we’d have to give it food with like, a spoon or something. It looked too weak to do anything, and its mouth isn’t fully developed either. Later when I found out that it ate meat, I thought it’d have to be chewed up by someone first so it would be soft enough to eat. When I asked my working buddy about it, he laughed and said: “No way, that’s ridiculous. We just need to leave the food in the unit and go.” I still thought about how in the world that fetus could eat stuff. I wondered if we served it some kinda succulent steak that’s not even available to us in the cafeteria. Out of curiosity, I decided to sneak a peek at the feeding process of the ‘Nameless Fetus’. Only level 3 and up employees are assigned to that process, but I was able to attend cause I made up an excuse that I was covering for someone. As I nervously watched, wondering if my lie would be worth it, some people came along with large plastic bags. Does it eat that much? And when they opened the bags, I could only gape in horror. They were human corpses. And the baby ate it. How? I don't even want to imagine it. It had a large scar on its stomach; I really thought it was some kind of scar. Like a large flower, its stomach would open, dripping with slimy liquid. It was the greediest creature in the world. That day onward, I was a vegetarian.

key:
<Excerpt of a Folk Tale from the province of (Redacted)>

      They say at night a mysterious sound can be heard around the pagodas and statues in the area of (Redacted). It is said that the source of this sound is a preta: a demonic creature with long arms, claws, and an unnaturally big mouth. Some say this creature carries a shattered japamala, however the exact details are unconfirmed. After this creature appears, people find that offered sarira boxes are forcefully opened with their contents removed.

      Furthermore, monks who stay in this province must not sleep alone. They should also visit a nearby temple to receive a talisman that wards off evil spirits and ensure that they carry it at all times.


This tale has become widespread across the region, and has led to the tradition of chanting certain lines at pagodas where sarira is stored when cremation takes place:

      亦僧子乎 (Yì sēng zi hū)
      亦僧子乎 (Yì sēng zi hū)
      今汝不必僧 (Jīn rǔ bùbì sēng)
      魔羅汝不極樂往生 (Móluó rǔ bù jílè wǎngshēng)

The chant translates into this:

      “Are you a monk?”
      “Are you a monk?”
      “You are no longer a monk.”
      “A demon shall never reach heaven.”

      This chant is orated to the monk who has not yet realized that he has become a demon.

<Notice of Advice>

      We’ve received reports about an alarming increase in the number of employees who want to view $0’s containment.

      This fervent rush of requests is likely due to the absence of natural scenery in our facility.

      However, I don’t think there is any need to make a rule against it. We’ve found that our staff’s mental contamination indices decreased when looking at $0.

      The reason behind this is unimportant. It could be “flora giving out a good aura” for all anyone cares.

      The only thing that’s certain is that $0 captivates our employees, and they don’t know what lies beneath its roots.

      Did you realize that the cherry blossoms are strikingly crimson, and its unmatched beauty is caused by its color?

      The more blood it has, the more beautiful it is. Our employees who are oblivious to it are drawn to it again and again…

      Just keep everything hush-hush for now. It’s how things work in this place.

<Observation record>
There are rare moments when it feels like the time just stopped. A brief instant of total silence. Every time this moment came, an employee died. Rick was a bit of coward, but it barely had anything to do with his heart attack. Justin was above average in his physical test. They had no exterior damage. Their heart just stopped beating. They did not overwork, and had no chronic disease. They just ceased, like a machine ran out of its battery. We couldn’t even guess the cause of this. After 10 deaths, we were sure that it was not just some unfortunate coincidence. We thought an abnormality must have something to do with this. 
 When a bell rang all across the facility, and when a scream followed, I thought that the nightmare made out of those terrible coincidences, has finally come. That abnormality which looks like a watch when it’s goal is not telling us what time it is, was like a streetlamp standing amidst hell. 
 I remembered about the phrase written on the abnormality’s back, even though I couldn’t remember what it was saying. I could still hear that hellish ring. I just ran to the watch’s containment chamber.
When the thirteenth ring, which I thought I would never hear, was heard, I frantically groped the watch to flip it. And I realized that the phrase was gone. Instead, something new was written, as if the ring was a cause of some change.
“I am aware of complete solitude. I take the price of my gifting of silence. When the original owner comes, I shall take the price. –P”'

  /       偶尔会有那么些时刻，仿佛时间就此停滞。一段彻底的寂静瞬间。每当这样的时刻来临，就有一名员工死亡。里克有点胆小，但这与他死于心脏病几乎没有关系。贾斯汀的体能测试成绩高于平均水平。他们身上没有外伤。只是心脏停止了跳动。他们没有过劳，也没有慢性疾病。他们就是那样戛然而止，如同一台耗尽电池的机器。我们甚至无法猜测其中的原因。在 10 人死亡之后，我们确信这绝非什么不幸的巧合。我们认为必定与某个异想体有关。
  /       当钟声响彻整个设施、紧随其后传来一声尖叫时，我以为由那些可怕的巧合编织而成的噩梦，终于降临了。那个看起来像手表、目的却并非告诉我们时间的异想体，像一盏矗立在地狱中的路灯。
  /       我记起了写在异想体背上的那句话，虽然我记不清它说了什么。我仍能听见那地狱般的钟声。我径直跑向手表的收容室。
  /       当我以为永远不会听到的第十三声钟响响起时，我疯狂地摸索着手表，想把它翻过来。我这才发现那句话消失了。取而代之的，是新的文字，仿佛那钟声正是某种变化的起因。
  /       “我知晓彻底的孤独。我为所赐予的沉默收取代价。当原主到来之时，我当收取代价。——P”

<Record of the Death of Employee Chomsky>

      There was no way to confirm if the Abnormality had left its Containment Unit or not. All of a sudden, Chomsky had stopped in the middle of the corridor and just stood there. The hallway was busy at the time with many a person passing by, and of course many of these people expressed their discontent for having part of the hallway blocked.

      Then, all of a sudden, Chomsky’s body suddenly rose over 3 meters into the air. His arms and legs were awkwardly stretched out just as if he were being crucified. If his legs had still been on the ground, he might have looked as if he were performing in an elegant play or doing ballet. Everyone in the hallway stopped to look at him. Then Chomsky started to scream. He screamed like a madman who had witnessed something horrifying. Nobody knew what to do. Some of our employees attempted to pull Chomsky down by the legs. He didn’t budge. After that, Chomsky stopped screaming. A short silence followed, and Chomsky opened his mouth, attempting to mutter something. The two employees who were trying to pull Chomsky down started to scream. Blood poured down from his body. His arms and legs separated, leaving his limbless body floating in the air. All hell broke loose in the hallway and everybody began running.

<员工乔姆斯基之死记录>
  /  /       无法确认异想体是否离开了它的收容单元。忽然间，乔姆斯基在走廊中央停了下来，就那样站着。当时走廊里人来人往，自然有许多人对有人挡了道表示不满。
  /  /       然后，乔姆斯基的身体忽然升到 3 米多高的空中。他的四肢怪异地向两侧伸展，仿佛正被钉在十字架上。如果他的双腿还在地面上，他看起来或许像是在表演一出优雅的戏剧或芭蕾。走廊里所有人都停下来看着他。接着，乔姆斯基开始尖叫。他像个目睹了恐怖景象的疯子一样尖叫。没有人知道该怎么办。一些员工试图抓住乔姆斯基的双腿把他拉下来。他一动不动。之后，乔姆斯基停止了尖叫。短暂的寂静之后，乔姆斯基张开嘴，想要嘟囔些什么。那两个试图拉他下来的员工开始尖叫。鲜血从他身上倾泻而下。他的双臂和双腿分离，留下没有四肢的身躯悬在空中。走廊里顿时乱作一团，所有人都开始奔逃。

      Many people have secretly wished for a hero.

      They say there once was something called soul therapy. What does it feel like to have an ill soul? We are all healthy. But maybe all of this is a tragic illusion.

      Once, there were people who tried to change the world. We all remember them. We remember how they met their downfall. Desires, I know of desires that ruin all things.

      We no longer believe in something, nor do we entertain a hope for a miracle.

      We don't think too much about why they've changed. And we don't blame them. For we have realized that endless desire brings despair.

      I sometimes feel a terrible dejection, but I do not know where the pain comes from.

      ...Many people have secretly wished for a hero.

<Survivor Testimony>

      Every single light in the facility went crazy. They kept flickering and flickering. I couldn’t even use my lighter. Then, this warm light shone through it all. It looked like a waning twilight, or a growing sunrise. Though, as we all know, sunlight can’t make its way into our facility. Everyone silently gazed at the light. Sudden darkness and a weird ray of light were enough reason to be frightened. It was scarier than anything gorey we’d seen here. It was a true fear of the unknown itself…

      (Omitted) …Something from afar was coming our way. Incandescent lights like stars from outer space were marching towards us. It looked like Big Bird’s eyes, but it wasn’t that Abnormality. I could hear these long arms scratching the floor.

      Someone broke the silence with a whisper: “That guy over there couldn’t run away in time...”

      There was an employee kneeling on the floor; perhaps he couldn’t sense the danger approaching behind him, and once he noticed, it was too late. He couldn’t even scream. Nobody would have been able to then. He just meaninglessly struggled to move his legs, desperate to run from the beast. There was no heroic act of someone standing up against the monster, not even a yell to warn him. Everyone was just watching him, waiting for the terrible thing that was about to happen.

      Each step sent a tremor through the whole facility. The monster was moving with such slow steps, but it seemed so fast.

      In the blink of an eye, it devoured the nameless employee in one bite, and right after that everyone started screaming in chaos. I had gone through handling countless suppressions, but that day, for the first time, I regretted ever joining the company. I was certain I wouldn’t get out of there alive. This helplessness overwhelmed me. I couldn’t even think about fighting back against the monster, and many others were feeling the same.

      I think I’m the only one who stayed sane enough to write this among all the survivors. The company will never tell our newbies about the existence of that monster. However, I wanted to leave them a warning at the very least. That’s why I’m writing this.

  /  /       设施里的每一盏灯都疯了。它们不停地闪烁、闪烁。我连打火机都用不了。然后，一道温暖的光穿透了这一切。它看起来像将尽的暮色，又像渐起的朝阳。不过，众所周知，阳光是进不了我们设施的。所有人都默默凝视着那道光。骤然降临的黑暗与一道怪异的光线，足以成为恐惧的理由。这比我们在这里见过的任何血腥场面都更可怕。那是对未知本身的纯粹恐惧……
  /  /       （省略）……有什么东西从远方朝我们而来。如同来自外太空星辰般的白炽光点，正列队向我们逼近。它看起来像大鸟的眼睛，但那并非那个异想体。我能听见那些长长的臂膀刮擦地面的声响。
  /  /       有人打破了沉默，低声说道：“那边那家伙，没来得及逃……”
  /  /       有一名员工跪在地上；也许他没能察觉身后逼近的危险，而等他发现时，已经太晚了。他甚至连尖叫都做不到。当时没有人能做到。他只是徒劳地挣扎着挪动双腿，拼命想逃离那头野兽。没有人挺身而出对抗怪物，甚至没有人喊一声警告他。所有人都只是看着他，等待着那件可怕的事情发生。
  /  /       每一步都让整座设施为之震颤。那怪物迈着如此缓慢的步伐，却显得那么快。

  /  /       我想，在所有生还者中，我是唯一一个还保持理智、能写下这些的人。公司永远不会告诉新人们那怪物的存在。但我至少想给他们留下一份警告。这就是我写下这些的原因。

<The Tale of the Black Forest>

Once upon a time, three happy birds lived in a warm and lush forest.

The birds had no names, though the creatures of the forest would call them Big Bird, Long Bird, and Small Bird.

Everyone lived freely and happily together in the peaceful forest. The birds wanted the forest to be safe more than anyone else, that way creatures from the outside could visit and have fun.

It was a warm and sunny afternoon when a stranger visited the peaceful forest. He was a traveler, pioneer, and prophet, but at the same time, he was a nobody. He wanted to enter the forest, but the birds found him suspicious, so they didn't let him in. The stranger, angered, told the birds as he left:

“Soon, a tragedy will befall the forest. It will be tainted with misdeeds and evil, and there will be constant conflict. The tragedies will only stop when a terrible beast appears and devours everything. The sun and moon will shine upon the forest no longer; the forest will never go back to what it was before.”

The birds worried about the prophecy. What if conflicts really break out and a beast shows up to harm the forest just like the man said? That's when the birds decided to become the guardians of the forest. They loved this forest more than anyone else did, so they wanted to protect the creatures living in the forest and keep the peace.

Big Bird, with its many eyes, decided to watch over the forest for intruders. For Big Bird's eyes could see very far, and see things we cannot see. Then somebody said, “But what if the beast shows up in the middle of the night, when the sky is dark and everyone is asleep?” Worried, Big Bird burned all of its feathers to make an everlasting lamp. Now the creatures of the forest were under Big Bird's constant watch, day and night.

To keep the forest's peace, Long Bird weighed the sins of those who entered the forest. For Long Bird's scale was fair and just, and could weigh any and all kinds of sin. Then somebody said, “But what if the scale doesn't tip in either direction someday?” Worried, Long Bird made a scale that always tipped to one side. That way every judgement would yield a clear verdict.

Small Bird decided to punish the creatures' wrongdoings with its beak. Then somebody said, “But your beak is so small, no one would find it hurtful.” Worried, Small Bird tore its mouth wide so it could swallow any creature in one bite.

No one could visit the forest anymore, and bad rumors about the forest began to spread outside. “I heard terrible things happen to any creature that enters the forest.”

      “The Big Bird is always watching the creatures of the forest, there's no freedom.”
      “The Long Bird's scale isn't fair at all.”
      “The Small Bird's punishment is so scary.”

The birds got upset. “We work so hard to protect the forest; why doesn't anyone appreciate our effort?”

Fewer and fewer visitors came to the forest, more and more creatures were complaining, fights broke out daily, and yet the birds continued to work even harder to make the forest peaceful again, but...

      “No, this forest is so vast and wide, the three of us aren't enough to protect all of it.”
      “But there is no creature to protect this forest but us.”
      “If we combined our power, we could be stronger.”

The day when Big Bird's eyes that could see hundreds of kilometers away, Long Bird who could judge any sin, and Small Bird's mouth that could devour everything united into one, darkness fell upon the forest. Creatures screamed in terror and fear at the sight of the bird, and the forest soon fell into mayhem.

Then, in the middle of all the chaotic cries, someone shouted:

“It's the beast! A big, scary monster lives in the black, dusky forest!”

The beast is here? The three birds, now as one, looked around but there was no one to be seen. The bird began to prowl the forest, looking for the beast. The forest would be in trouble if the beast really showed up.

But there was nothing. There were no creatures, no sun and moon, and no beast. All that was left was just a bird and the Black Forest.

Since then, there were only nights dark as pitch.

Rumor says there is a terrible beast in the Black Forest where no one lives.

<黑森林传说>
  /   
  /   从前，三只快乐的鸟儿生活在一片温暖而葱郁的森林里。
  /   
  /   鸟儿们没有名字，不过森林里的生灵会叫它们大鸟、长鸟和小鸟。
  /   
  /   大家在这片安宁的森林里自由而快乐地生活着。鸟儿们比任何人都更希望森林平安，这样外面的生灵就能来此游玩、尽情欢乐。
  /   
  /   那是一个温暖晴朗的午后，一位陌生人造访了这片宁静的森林。他是个旅人、开拓者，也是先知，但与此同时，他又是个无名之辈。他想进入森林，但鸟儿们觉得他形迹可疑，便没有放他进去。陌生人怒不可遏，离开时对鸟儿们说道：
  /   
  /   “很快，一场悲剧将降临这片森林。它将沾染恶行与邪祟，冲突永无休止。唯有当一头可怕的野兽现身、吞噬一切之时，悲剧才会终结。日月将不再照耀这片森林；森林再也回不到从前。”
  /   
  /   鸟儿们为这预言忧心忡忡。要是真的爆发冲突，出现野兽伤害森林，就像那人说的那样，该怎么办？就在那时，鸟儿们决定成为森林的守护者。它们比任何人都更爱这片森林，因此想要保护生活在森林中的生灵，维系这份安宁。
  /   
  /   大鸟拥有众多眼睛，它决定守望森林，警惕入侵者。因为大鸟的眼睛能望见极远之处，看见我们看不见的东西。然后有人说了：“可要是野兽在半夜现身，那时天空漆黑、人人沉睡，该怎么办？”大鸟忧心之下，烧光了自己所有的羽毛，制成一盏长明灯。从此，森林里的生灵在大鸟日夜不息的注视之下。
  /   
  /   为了维系森林的安宁，长鸟称量进入森林之人的罪孽。因为长鸟的天平公正无偏，能够称量任何一种罪。然后有人说了：“可要是哪天天平不向任何一边倾斜，该怎么办？”长鸟忧心之下，造了一架永远倾向一边的天平。这样一来，每一次裁决都能得出明确的结论。
  /   
  /   小鸟决定用它的喙惩罚生灵的恶行。然后有人说了：“可你的喙那么小，没人会觉得疼。”小鸟忧心之下，把自己的嘴撕得大大的，好能一口吞下任何生灵。
  /   
  /   再也没有人能造访森林了，关于森林的流言蜚语开始在外界传播。“听说任何进入森林的生灵都会遭遇可怕的事情。”
  /  /       “大鸟总是监视着森林里的生灵，毫无自由可言。”
  /       “长鸟的天平一点也不公正。”
  /       “小鸟的惩罚太可怕了。”
  /   
  /   鸟儿们很难过。“我们如此努力地保护森林，为什么没有人感激我们的付出？”
  /   
  /   来访的客人越来越少，抱怨的生灵越来越多，冲突日日上演，可鸟儿们依然更加努力地想让森林恢复安宁，但是……
  /  /       “不，这片森林如此辽阔广大，光靠我们三个保护不了全部。”
  /       “可除了我们，没有别的生灵在守护这片森林。”
  /       “如果我们把力量合而为一，就能变得更强。”
  /   
  /   当大鸟那双能望见数百公里之外的眼睛、能裁决一切罪孽的长鸟、以及能吞噬一切的小鸟之口合为一体之时，黑暗笼罩了森林。生灵们看到那只鸟，吓得惊声尖叫，森林很快陷入一片混乱。
  /   
  /   然后，在一片混乱的哭喊声中，有人喊道：
  /   
  /   “是野兽！一只巨大可怕的怪物，就住在黑暗幽深的森林里！”
  /   
  /   野兽在这里？三只鸟如今合而为一，环顾四周，却看不到任何身影。那只鸟开始在森林中四处搜寻，寻找那头野兽。要是野兽真的出现，森林可就麻烦了。
  /   
  /   但那里什么都没有。没有生灵，没有日月，也没有野兽。剩下的，只有一只鸟，和那片黑森林。
  /   
  /   自那以后，这里只剩下漆黑如墨的夜晚。
  /   
  /   传言说，在无人居住的黑森林中，潜伏着一头可怕的野兽。

<The corresponding document is only accessible by Employees Level 4 and higher>

      When Walter, who was under the care of the fairies, died in the room of another Abnormality, we noticed some anomalies. His stomach and face were ripped off, and his eyeballs and organs were damaged as if they were eaten by something. Moreover, the Containment Unit Walter was found in was for an Abnormality that uses psychological attacks. Meanwhile, the fairies had someone's blood and flesh smeared all over their mouths. We did not bother to examine them to find out whose flesh and blood it was.

      In our world, there are few outcomes that result from perfect kindness. Having fairies that live in a forest visit you just because they like you or that you've done many good deeds is only something that happens in fairy tales. Even though we know this truth, we still sometimes become deluded. Thinking that "The Fairies' Care" is happening because of all the good deeds we've done, or that the fairies are "favoring" us because there is something that makes us more special than the other employees.

  /  /       当受到精灵照料的沃尔特死于另一只异想体的房间时，我们注意到了一些异常。他的腹部和面部被撕掉，眼球和器官像是被什么东西啃食过。此外，发现沃尔特的那间收容单元，属于一只使用心理攻击的异想体。与此同时，精灵们嘴上沾满了某人的血肉。我们懒得去检验那到底是谁的血肉。
  /  /       在我们的世界里，出于纯粹的善意而得善果的事少之又少。仅仅因为喜欢你、或因为你积了许多善行，森林里的精灵就来拜访你——这种事只存在于童话之中。尽管我们明白这个道理，有时却仍会自欺欺人。以为‘精灵的照料’降临在自己身上，是因为我们积了善德；或者以为精灵是在“偏爱”我们，因为我们身上有什么东西让我们比其他员工更特别。

key:
<Time for the head to burst>

To be frank, life in this place isn't so great. The company says they provide healthy hobbies, but not many people engage in that notion. Everyone looks for their own escape; be it violence, gambling, gluttony... I thought I had strength in self-control and discipline compared to others. It did help me live a smoother life. Maybe that's the reason I was assigned to Porccubus' Containment Unit.

Yes, Porccubus. Where the lowest of the low employees visit.

I've heard a bit about what other employees do in that Containment Unit. They call it the "game of trust".

A game of trust, what an elegant thing to name it.
value:
<头颅迸裂之时>
  /   
  /   坦白说，在这种地方生活并不怎么美好。公司声称他们提供健康的娱乐活动，但没多少人真把这当回事。每个人都在寻找自己的解脱之道——无论是暴力、赌博，还是暴食……我曾以为，与其他人相比，自己拥有自控与自律的力量。这确实让我的生活顺遂了些。也许正因如此，我才被派往波库库斯的收容单元。
  /   
  /   是的，波库库斯。那个最底层的员工才会去的地方。
  /   
  /   我听说过一些其他员工在那个收容单元里做的事。他们称之为“信任游戏”。
  /   
  /   信任游戏，多么优雅的名字。

key:
<Urgent Report of the Incident related to Army in Pink>
We’ve filed this urgent report due to the drastic change in Army in Pink.
We’re still trying to grasp exactly what happened. A total of (Redacted) employees have passed away. The following audio is a recording of the assumed first casualty, employee Serena.

(Audio Recording)
      Serena: An Abnormality has broken out again in the (Redacted) section. I’d like to ask if you could help us out again.
      - Yes… we, the Army in Black… blend into the human heart… and drive away good thoughts…
      Serena: ...Hold on. What? That’s not your line.
      - The human heart… is black… we must… regularly… clean…
      Serena: What are you talking about? You’re creeping me out, man.
      - We’ll protect you with our black love.
      Serena: Stop, I’ll call the suppression team... If you move even an inch I swear…
      - We salute you, ma’am…
(The recording abruptly ends after the sound of a huge explosion.)

<Warning> Only employees Level 3 and higher are permitted to read this document.
(This recording is of a call from the Containment Unit’s emergency phone. Phone systems are installed in every room of Abnormalities of Risk Level HE or higher to enable quick threat response.)

      Employee 1: Please pick up, please pick up. This is the Containment Unit of ‘Nothing There.’
      The Emergency Response Department (ERD): Hello, this is the Emergency Response Team. What’s the problem?
      Employee 1: I need a stun gun right now! There’s an emergency happening right now!
      ERD: Can you please specify the reason?
      Employee 1: The Abnormality… (the sounds of something breaking can be heard) It’s ripping up the employee.
      ERD: Excuse me?
      Employee 1: It’s killing my colleague!
      ERD: We’ll respond immediately. Please identify the employee being attacked.
      Employee 1: It’s uh… wait one sec. Their name’s <Redacted>. Control Team. I’m, <Redacted>. Also Control Team.
      ERD: Confirmed. What’s currently happening to your colleague at this exact moment?
      Employee 1: Yeah, just please hurry. We need a weapon to control the Abnormality.
      (A loud noise can be heard, presumably the scream of the colleague)
      Oh god, this is…
      ERD: What’s happening?
      Employee 1: The Abnormality is attacking my colleague. It’s literally ripping them apart, I can’t do anything. I repeat, we need a weapon to control the Abnormality.
      ERD: The Emergency Response Team has been dispatched. They’ll arrive shortly.
      (Omitted)
      ERD: <Redacted>? What’s happening now? Is it still attacking your colleague?
      Employee 1: Yeah, oh no. I think it’s done now.
      ERD: Has it stopped attacking?
      Employee 1: No, I mean. My colleague’s… He’s dead. Yeah, he’s dead alright.
      ERD: How can you be so sure?
      Employee 1: Well it’s because he looks… he’s…
      ERD: Has he been ripped up somehow? What body parts are damaged?
      Employee 1: All of them.

key:
<Worker Bee>

      Its appearance is clearly different from Queen Bee's, other than its color. It is capable of flight, but can only hover about 1 meter above the ground. It lacks antennae or eyes. A long appendage that appears to be an intestine drags behind its rear on the floor.

      Worker Bees show only two forms of behavior: Delivering nutrients to the Queen, and proliferating. Upon encountering an employee, it uses its jaw to crush their head and then proceeds to inject a pupa into their body.
value:
<工蜂>
  /  /       除了颜色之外，它的外观与蜂后明显不同。它能够飞行，但只能在离地约 1 米的高度盘旋。它没有触角或眼睛。一条看似肠子的长长附肢拖在它身后，在地板上曳行。
  /  /       工蜂只表现出两种行为：向蜂后输送养分，以及增殖。遇到员工时，它会用下颚夹碎他们的头颅，然后将虫蛹注入他们的体内。

key: Caution is advised as this Abnormality possesses the ability to evoke one's curiosity to press it. Sometimes, it changes its shape in a cunning attempt to be pressed by mistake.
value: 请务必小心，因为该异想体拥有勾起人按下它的好奇心的能力。有时，它会狡猾地改变形状，诱使人误按。

key: (It was difficult to decrypt the contents of the diary from this point onward as the writing becomes heavily distorted) I don’t know how I wrote the observation report, all that’s certain is I just wrote what I felt about the tree: This beautiful plant is bringing happiness to every employee who visits its Containment Unit; it will soon greatly contribute to humanity’s quest for prosperity and advancement. But how could an Abnormality be such a good influence on humanity? ‘I just want to help you.’ A voice without a single speck of malicious intent echoed again in my head. Yes, you’re right. You’re just helping me. ‘And if you’re okay with it, could you bring all your friends who are having a hard time here? I believe I can help them.’ Yes, this tree will easily bring peace to their mind. Speaking of which, that newbie seemed to be pretty depressed lately. “Hey, I know a place that’ll make you feel better. Come along if you want to.” She followed me without any suspicion. It wasn’t hard to bring her to the tree’s Containment Unit. I offered her to the tree. She could get better; she will get better. ‘You’ve brought your friend. You are a good child. Let me gift you with something.’ I could feel something sprouting from my body. I couldn’t move my limbs. No, this isn’t a bad thing, I am being reborn with the tree... The tree has entered me, transfixed me. We proliferate and become whole. Ah, I can completely feel it now.
value: （从这一刻起，日记的内容难以解读，因为字迹变得严重扭曲） / / 我不知道自己是怎么写完那份观察报告的，唯一确定的是，我写下的只是我对那棵树的感觉：这株美丽的植物给每一位造访其收容单元的员工带来快乐；它很快将为人类追求繁荣与进步的伟业作出巨大贡献。 / 但一个异想体，怎么能对人类产生如此良好的影响？ / ‘我只是想帮你。’ / 一个不含一丝恶意的声音再次在我脑海中回响。是的，你说得对。你只是在帮我。 / ‘如果你愿意的话，能把在这里过得艰难的朋友们都带来吗？我相信我能帮到他们。’ / 是的，这棵树能轻易让他们心灵安宁。说起来，那个新人最近似乎相当消沉。 / “嘿，我知道有个地方能让你好受些。想来就跟我走吧。” / 她没有丝毫怀疑地跟着我。把她带到树的收容单元并不难。 / 我把她献给了树。她能得到救赎；她一定会得到救赎。 / ‘你带来了你的朋友。你是个好孩子。让我送你一份礼物。’ / 我能感觉到有什么东西从我体内萌发。我无法动弹四肢。不，这不是坏事，我正在与树一起重生…… / 树已进入我体内，令我着迷。我们不断增殖，融为一体。 / 啊，我现在能完全感觉到了。

key: Alriune, a lovely one; a doll yearned to be human. It was adored by people, its pupils soulful.
value: 阿里努，一位可爱之人；一个人偶渴望成为人类。它为人们所钟爱，瞳孔中饱含灵性。

key: Alriune, abandoned in a dark forest; its eyes stolen by crows lusting for glitter. Its mind, life, and heart slowly withered away.
value: 阿里努，被遗弃于黑暗森林；它的眼睛被渴求闪亮之物的乌鸦夺去。它的心智、生命与心灵，缓缓枯萎凋零。

key: Alriune, lacking eyes but all-seeing; a human yearned to be a doll. Bearing the hope to return to dust, it shall go back to the grave with all that desires to live.
value: 阿里努，没有眼睛却洞察一切；一个人类渴望成为人偶。怀着归于尘埃的希望，它将与一切渴望生存之物一同回到坟墓。

key: Dylan. I don't believe you turned Sophie and us over deliberately. I'm sure you were just worried about Sophie. She's locked up now. I heard that she repeatedly tried to escape, so they tied her to the bed. Tell me, is it wrong to have faith? We are all sinners, and our Blue Star is the only sanctuary that accepts us. We will be cleansed of our sins there. We all go back to that place someday. This is an instinct. You thought Emily died when she threw herself into the Star, but she simply returned to her rightful place. She's a martyr. She has become an eternal star. The rise of a star is a brand new beginning. Don't you hear the everlasting sound of the trumpet? When you stand close to the Star, you can hear the welcoming cheers and singing. If every employee returns to that place, only Blue Star will remain here. Let us meet again as stars.
value: 迪伦。 / / 我不相信你是故意出卖索菲和我们。我相信你只是担心索菲。她现在被锁起来了。我听说她屡次试图逃跑，所以他们把她绑在了床上。 / 告诉我，怀有信仰有错吗？ / 我们都是罪人，而我们的蓝星是唯一接纳我们的庇护所。我们将在那里洗清罪孽。 / 我们总有一天都会回到那个地方。这是一种本能。你以为艾米丽纵身跃入星辰时死了，其实她只是回到了她应属之处。她是一位殉道者。她化作了一颗永恒的星辰。 / 星辰的升起是一个全新的开始。你难道听不见那永恒的号角声吗？ / 当你靠近星辰时，能听见欢迎的欢呼与歌唱。 / 如果所有员工都回到那个地方，这里就只剩下蓝星了。 / 让我们以星辰之姿再会吧。

key: I can’t even imagine how painful it would be to cut your wrist. I found out that the only reason she could manage to do something like that was she cut hers straight through.
value: 我甚至无法想象割开自己的手腕有多痛。我发现，她之所以能做到那种事，唯一的原因是她横切了下去。

key: I eternally regret not realizing to ask her why she needed that industrial knife. I eternally regret not realizing that she was hiding her wrists with long sleeves. I eternally regret not realizing that she always took extra care to hide them whenever I spoke with her. I eternally regret not realizing that I never heard her cheerful laughter anymore, and that she roamed around the company with lifeless eyes more and more often.
value: 我永远后悔没有意识到该问她为什么要那把工业刀。我永远后悔没有意识到她一直用长袖遮掩手腕。我永远后悔没有意识到，每次与我交谈时，她总是格外小心地藏起它们。我永远后悔没有意识到，我再也没有听到过她欢快的笑声，而她越来越多地带着毫无生气的双眼在公司里游荡。

key: I remember the day we put her in the cryo-coffin with our own hands. At some point, her joyous laughter was gone. She just cycled through laughing and crying, and eventually she was found in a bathtub soaked in red with her wrists cut. We did not believe in death. I will have her reconstructed from the "machines" I have detested for my entire life, but have become the only answer. She would have been disgusted by me for this, dying in that bathtub. However, we were too far down the road filled with remorse and regret to feel any sort of guilt. …… One day, "it" spoke to me. “I remember you. You were a kindhearted person.” The moment I heard it, I was seized by the urge to destroy what I had created with my own hands.
value: 我记得亲手把她放进冷冻棺的那一天。不知从何时起，她欢快的笑声消失了。她只是反复地笑了又哭，哭了又笑，最终，人们发现她躺在浴缸里，割开了手腕，浸在血泊之中。 / 我们不相信死亡。我会用那些我憎恨了一辈子、如今却成为唯一答案的“机器”，将她重建。若她看到我这么做，想必会厌恶我——那个死在浴缸里的她。然而，我们早已在充满悔恨与遗憾的道路上走得太远，远到再也感觉不到任何愧疚。 / …… / 有一天，“它”对我说话了。 / “我记得你。你是个心地善良的人。” / 听到那句话的瞬间，我被一股冲动攫住了——想要亲手毁掉我所创造的一切。

key: It is no easy feat to cut one’s wrist with a sane mind. A strong will is needed with the resolve to make multiple attempts. Only when it is sliced as if one were simply cutting a mere slab of meat, can they achieve this. Only when one yearns for death that much, can they succeed.
value: 在神志清醒的状态下割开自己的手腕绝非易事。需要坚强的意志，以及反复尝试的决心。只有当那切口像切开一块普通的肉一样干脆利落，他们才能做到。只有对死亡渴望到那种程度，他们才能成功。

key: Similar to a child in size, and always maintaining a bright smile… A very very adoooorable little kid.
value: 体型宛如孩童，始终挂着明亮的笑容…… / 一个非常非常可爱的小孩子。

key: There is no detailed research into this Abnormality’s “music”, however, there is a hypothesis that it has a special characteristic that attracts humans in correlation to their specific behaviors or psychological counseling records. If one of our employees has been determined to be addicted to the music, they will need to be treated quickly to prevent any collateral damage.
value: 目前尚未对该异想体的“音乐”进行详细研究，不过有一种假说认为，它具有一种特殊特性，会依据人们的具体行为或心理咨询记录来吸引人类。一旦确定我们某名员工沉迷于这种音乐，就需要迅速对其进行治疗，以防造成任何附带伤害。

key: This Abnormality was created with the ideas provided by Tumblbug Backer llooll530. An Abnormality taking the form of a tree with plentiful leaves. The leaves are lush with a rich green color, creating a comforting ambience. A refreshing flowery scent is carried by a gentle breeze.
value: 本异想体的创意由 Tumblbug 众筹支持者 llooll530 提供。 / / 一个呈树形的异想体，枝叶繁茂。 / 树叶苍翠欲滴，营造出令人安适的氛围。和煦的微风中飘来清新的花香。

value: 本异想体的创意由 Tumblbug 众筹支持者 mul 提供。 / / 一滩融化的黏液，仔细观察与人颇有几分相似。它的收容单元覆盖着它分泌的黏液。

key: This Abnormality was created with the ideas provided by Tumblbug Backer 나준 (NaJun). In the (Redacted) century, a monk named (Redacted) from the province of (Redacted) walked a path of Buddhism, seeking liberation and true enlightenment. He was on the road to his home country to spread his philosophy, when he heard that an old monk was being cremated in the nearby town. He felt that he should go witness it, however, a man stopped him. “Excuse me, sir. There's a rumor that an evil spirit lingers in the town you’re heading towards.” The monk replied, “Evil spirits are naturally born from one’s heart. How could I miss the cremation of a great monk simply because a rumor has been spread?” He then continued on his way to the town of (Redacted).
value: 本异想体的创意由 Tumblbug 众筹支持者 나준（NaJun）提供。 / / 在（已编辑）世纪，一位来自（已编辑）省的名为（已编辑）的僧人，行走在求索解脱与真谛的佛法之路上。他在归国传播自己哲理的途中，听闻附近城镇正为一位老僧举行荼毗。他觉得应当前去观礼，然而一名男子拦住了他。 / / “打扰一下，先生。有传言说，您正要前往的城镇里盘踞着邪灵。” / / 僧人答道：“邪灵本就生于人心。我又岂能因一则流言，错过一位大德的荼毗？” / / 说罢，他继续踏上前往（已编辑）城镇的路。

key: This Abnormality was created with the ideas provided by Tumblbug Backer 문정호 (Moon Jeong-ho). This Abnormality takes the form of humanoid creatures in pink equipment. Its intellectual capacity is high enough that it can verbally converse with human beings. At the very least, it seems friendly during observation and work. It has identified itself as a special force from (Redacted) and uses the pronoun “we” when referring to itself. It has continuously shown positive intentions to help humanity.
value: 本异想体的创意由 Tumblbug 众筹支持者 문정호（文正浩）提供。 / / 这个异想体呈现为身着粉色装备的人形生物。它的智力水平很高，能够与人类进行言语交流。至少在观察与工作时，它表现得相当友善。它自称来自（已编辑）的特种部队，并自称“我们”。它持续表现出帮助人类的积极意愿。

key: This Abnormality was created with the ideas provided by Tumblbug Backer 에레 (Ere). An old woman with a piano at her side. Her eyes are usually closed. She only nods instead of speaking, but on rare occasions, she will faintly smile.
value: 本异想体的创意由 Tumblbug 众筹支持者 에레（Ere）提供。 / / 一位老妇人，钢琴就摆在她身边。她的眼睛通常闭着。她不说话，只是点头回应，但偶尔，她会露出淡淡的微笑。

key: This Abnormality was created with the ideas provided by Tumblbug Backer 이은희 (Lee Eun-hee). A super fluffy ultra-cute puppy with white fur like fresh snow. This Abnormality is so cute that just taking a short little glance at it will make you feel so much better. It has the eyes of an angel and is the purest thing in the world. (Further descriptions of this creature have been omitted for brevity’s sake. The rest of the sentences are essentially just saying “It’s so cute!” in various ways.)
value: 本异想体的创意由 Tumblbug 众筹支持者 이은희（李恩熙）提供。 / / 一只蓬松柔软的超级可爱小狗，毛发洁白如新雪。 / 这个异想体可爱至极，只需匆匆瞥上一眼，就会让你感觉好多了。 / 它有一双天使般的眼睛，是世间最纯净的存在。 / （为简洁起见，对该生物的描述此处从略。其余内容本质上只是以各种方式反复说着“它好可爱！”而已。）

key: This Abnormality was created with the ideas provided by Tumblbug Backer 정현교 (Jeong Hyeon-kyo). An old clock manufactured by an unknown company. Its vacuum tubes give off a vintage vibe. The manufacturer stopped making these clocks a long time ago.
value: 本异想体的创意由 Tumblbug 众筹支持者 정현교（郑贤教）提供。 / 一台由某家不知名公司制造的古老时钟。它的真空管散发着复古的气息。制造商早已不再生产这种时钟了。

key: We always popped open a bottle of wine every time we succeeded. It became one of our customs. She told us that it only takes one slight misstep to fall into indifferent habit if we get too used to success. Thus, we should always smile, rejoice, and celebrate every little thing in the wake of success. And we should never neglect failure, as success can be born from a pile of failures. When I saw the latticework of scars on her wrist, I was reminded of our wine cabinet. We had used up so many of the bottles; there was only one left. That day, I popped the cork off the last one.
value: 每当我们取得成功，就会打开一瓶葡萄酒庆祝。这成了我们的惯例之一。她告诉我们，如果太过习惯于成功，只需一步踏错，就会坠入麻木的习惯之中。因此，我们应当始终微笑、欢欣，庆祝成功之后的每一件小事。我们也绝不应轻视失败，因为成功可以从堆积如山的失败中诞生。 / 当我看到她手腕上纵横交错的疤痕时，我想起了我们的酒柜。我们已经喝掉了那么多瓶酒；只剩下最后一瓶了。 / / 那天，我拔掉了最后一瓶的软木塞。

key: We’ve just added some new rules to the company code of conduct: + If you ever spot a XXX mocking their coworker with alopecia areata, they will be labeled as a hirsute, and will be banned from using the lounge for an indefinite period. They will also be forbidden from joining the company’s debate club “Questioners of the absence of bald Barbies”, the gourmet meetup “Octopi over Squid”, and the environmental protection group “Save the Bald Eagles”. (These regulations will be lifted as soon as the rulebreaker’s hair strand count goes below 1.) Lastly, I dedicate this article to employee T.H. who is quietly taking balding medicine next to me right now.
value: 我们刚刚在公司行为准则中增添了一些新规则： / / + 若你发现某人在嘲笑患有斑秃的同事，此人将被标记为多毛者，并在无限期内被禁止使用休息室。他们还将被禁止加入公司的辩论社“秃头芭比质疑者”、美食聚会“章鱼优先于鱿鱼”，以及环保组织“拯救秃鹰”。（一旦违规者的头发数量降至 1 根以下，这些规定即刻解除。） / / 最后，谨以此文献给此刻正静静坐在我旁边服用生发药的员工 T.H.。

key: “Follow my teachings as I told thee. Thou wilt abandon flesh and be born again.”
value: “遵我所言，随我教义而行。汝将舍弃血肉，重获新生。”

key: “My disciples, whom I blessed, ye shall leave the way of evil that once ye were following and find me. When the time comes, I shall forgive your sins and descend to the earth ye are living on.”
value: “我蒙福的门徒们，你们当离开昔日所行的邪道，前来寻我。待到时机来临，我必赦免你们的罪愆，降临于你们所居的大地。”

key: “The time has come. Soon, the bell shall ring. A new world will come. Rise, my servants. Rise and serve me. I am death and life. Darkness and light.”
value: “时候已到。不久，钟声将响。新世界即将来临。起来吧，我的仆从。起身侍奉于我。我即是死亡与生命。黑暗与光明。”

key: A :   To die: to sleep; No more;(Collapses)
value: A：死亡，便是沉睡；一了百了；（倒下）

key: A :  Have my sins been shown in lines? (Lights off)
value: A：我的罪孽，是否已尽数刻在纹路之中？（灯光熄灭）

key: A :  OH GOD,  HELP ME SOMEHOW!  PLEASE TAKE THE PAIN AWAY! (dead still)
value: A：哦上帝啊，救救我吧！求求你让我摆脱这痛苦！（一动不动）

key: A : (Stage whisper) A: His despair has already rooted deep inside of his mind, slowly eating him away. He always smiles but deep down, he is drenched in burning self-hatred.
value: A：（舞台低语）他的绝望早已扎根于脑海深处，正一点点蚕食着他。他总是面带微笑，但在内心深处，他浸透在灼烧般的自我憎恨之中。

key: A : (Stage whisper) The Abandoned, I will grant him death. I deserve to. The unquenchable Thirst will come.
value: A：（舞台低语）被遗弃者，我将赐他一死。这是我应得的权利。那无法满足的渴求即将到来。

key:
A bath of a gloomy color, topped up with blood. The blood is always kept in equilibrium; it never overflows. Only despair can be found in its sunken depths. Unbearable depression overwhelms all who look into the bath.

In an instant, it can pull a nearby person into it. It bears no considerable strength, but those who suffer from its crushing depression do not resist. It devours the victim until nothing remains except for their wrists. All the hands which float in the bath are pale, exsanguinated; they stretch into the air and reach out as if asking for help.
value:
一池暗沉色调的浴水，注满了鲜血。血面始终保持平衡，从不溢出。在它凹陷的深处，只能寻得绝望。难以忍受的抑郁吞没了所有凝视浴池的人。
  /   
  /   它能在瞬间将附近的人拉入其中。它并无多大的力气，但那些被它那令人窒息的抑郁所折磨的人，并不会反抗。它吞噬受害者，直到除了他们的手腕之外什么都不剩。浴池中漂浮的所有手都苍白失血；它们伸向空中，仿佛在求救。

key: A bird that used to judge the living in the dark forest, carrying around an unbalanced scale.
value: 一只曾在黑暗森林中审判生灵的鸟，随身携带着一架失衡的天平。

key: A blessing more radiant than anything approaches employee #0.
value: 一道比一切都更璀璨的祝福，正向员工 #0 靠近。

key:
A body was found in the [Redacted] department. The culprit immediately admitted to the crime. Strangely, the one witness in the crime did not try to stop the crime from taking place or even call the authorities during A’s death. Furthermore, there was no apparent motive for the crime. No bad blood between them. The victim and the assailant were friends in the same department. Their testimony was so bizarre. The attacker did not realize that he was committing murder during that time when he was committing the crime.  He claimed to have thought it only as an act in a play. The witness C’s testimony was that C was aware that A would be murdered by B but claimed that it was inevitable in order to finish the play. 
One side argued that they were performing some kind of mysterious religious ritual while the other argued that they were both suffering from mental disorders. 
During an interrogation when counselor asked “You thought it was a play? Then who was it for?”, they both looked up simultaneously. This was not an actual testimony thus it was not officially recorded.
value:
在[已编辑]部门发现了一具尸体。凶手立即承认了罪行。奇怪的是，这场罪案中唯一的目击者，在 A 死亡期间既没有试图阻止罪行的发生，甚至没有报警。此外，这桩罪行似乎没有明显动机。两人之间并无仇怨。受害者和行凶者同属一个部门，还是朋友。他们的证词怪异至极。行凶者行凶时，竟没有意识到自己在实施谋杀。
  / 他声称自己只以为那是一场戏中的表演。目击者 C 的证词是：C 知道 A 会被 B 杀害，但声称那是为了完成这出戏而不可避免的。
  / 一方辩称他们在进行某种神秘的宗教仪式，另一方则辩称两人都患有精神疾病。
  / 在审讯中，当咨询师问道：“你以为那是戏？那戏是演给谁看的？”两人同时抬起了头。这不是正式的证词，因此没有被正式记录在案。

key: A bomb shelter that completely protects its interior from all hazardous influences of the outside world, including light.
value: 一个防空洞，能将其内部完全保护起来，免受外部世界一切有害影响——包括光——的侵扰。

key: A bracelet that gives off a soft turquoise light. Many unexplainable things have been discovered in the Outskirts.
value: 一条散发着柔和青绿色光芒的手链。在外围地区，人们发现了许多无法解释的事物。

key: A bud sprouted on the upper part of $0 when #0 finished work with it. #0 was blessed by $0 and enjoyed increased Work Speed and SP.
value: 当 #0 完成与 $0 的工作时，$0 的上半部分绽出了一颗新芽。#0 受到了 $0 的赐福，工作速度与 SP 均得到提升。

key: A colossal, towering tree burst out from the city of gray.
value: 一棵参天巨树，自灰色之城中拔地而起。

key:
A company of this size will always have a rumor or two floating around.
“I heard that you can hear someone’s bones breaking if you walk the hallways at night…”
“If you try and track down that sound, you’ll find a Yeti who’s eating one of our employees...!”
“However, we don’t have an Abnormality that looks anything like a Yeti…”
value:
像这样规模的公司，总会有那么一两则流言蜚语在流传。
  / “听说在夜里走过走廊，能听见有人骨头断裂的声音……”
  / “你要是循着那声音找过去，会看见一个正在啃食我们员工的雪人……！”
  / “然而，我们并没有长得像雪人的异想体……”

key: A conductor is a magician that brings forth life; a shaman who evokes spirits.
value: 指挥家是带来生命的魔术师；是召唤灵魂的萨满。

key: A corpse, I need a corpse…
value: 一具尸体，我需要一具尸体……

key: A dazzlingly bright lamp is held in front of #0, who turned away to avoid looking towards $0.
value: 一盏炫目的明灯举到 #0 面前，而 #0 转过头去，避开了 $0 的方向。

key: A demon must change its shape to deceive others. A demon must grant sweet dreams to deceive others. A crack appears in the human mind when it is shown the dream it yearns for. A demon will never miss this chance to bring one to their doom. Don’t say such complicated things, don’t say those scary words. I just want to grant people sweet dreams; Grant them the enrapturing dreams they want. Those who’ve had my dreams are destined to come back to me. So, just close your eyes…
value: 恶魔必须改变形态才能欺骗他人。 / 恶魔必须赐予甜美的梦境才能欺骗他人。 / 当人类看到自己渴求的梦境时，心中便会出现一道裂痕。 / 恶魔绝不会错过这个将人引向毁灭的机会。 / / 不要说那些复杂的事，不要说那些可怕的话。 / 我只想赐予人们甜美的梦境； / 赐予他们渴望的、令人心醉的梦境。 / 做过我的梦的人，注定会回到我身边。 / 所以，闭上眼睛吧……

key: A flower blooms in everyone’s heart.
value: 一朵花在每个人心中绽放。

key: A flowery scent lingers in #0’s nose.
value: 一缕花香萦绕在 #0 的鼻尖。

key:
A giant skull that is attached to a cross, it wears a crown of thorns.
It floats about 2 meters above the ground.
value:
一颗系在十字架上的巨大头骨，戴着荆棘之冠。
  / 它悬浮在离地约 2 米的空中。

key: A heart without an owner; it still beats even after being removed from its body.
value: 一颗没有主人的心脏；即使被从身体中取出，它仍在跳动。

key:
A hero of the past who used to be a guardian of justice. She dedicated her entire life to protect the king, the state, the city, and the weak.

The knight had to uphold the laws of God and the pursuit of valor, chivalry, and justice. However, after a long history fraught with hardship and conflict, the knight realized in retrospect that nothing was truly upheld on her watch. The truth changed a lot of people.

One who fought for good became evil upon realizing that there was no evil left in the world. One who dreamed of a world where everyone could be happy was tinged with greed and started to devour everything. Like them, so many things once thought to be forever constant faced changes and perished.
value:
一位昔日的英雄，曾是正义的守护者。她毕生致力于守护国王、国家、城市与弱者。
  /   
  / 骑士必须恪守上帝之法，追求勇武、骑士精神与正义。然而，在饱经艰辛与冲突的漫长历史之后，骑士回首往事，发现自己的任期内其实什么都没能真正守护。真相改变了许多人。
  /   
  / 一个为善而战的人，在意识到世间已无邪恶可战之后，变成了邪恶。一个梦想着人人幸福的世界的人，被贪婪浸染，开始吞噬一切。如同他们一般，许多曾被视作永恒不变的事物，都遭遇了变故，走向消亡。

key: A humanoid Abnormality that looks like it would go and fight villains for peace and justice at any moment.
value: 一个类人异想体，看上去随时都会为了和平与正义，前去与恶人战斗。

key: A large, many-eyed bird that patrols the dark forest with an everlasting lamp. Unlike regular birds, it lacks wings and has long arms instead with which it can pick things up.
value: 一只巨大的多眼鸟，提着一盏长明灯在黑暗森林中巡游。与寻常鸟类不同，它没有翅膀，取而代之的是一双能够拾取东西的长臂。

key: A legend of $0 says that once upon a time, those who came across its feather were granted with both blessing and ordeal.
value: 关于 $0 有一则传说：从前，凡是遇见它羽毛的人，都会同时被赐予祝福与考验。

key: A long, long time ago in a faraway forest there lived a magnificent bird. Its feathers were wonderfully incandescent, like the tongues of flames, and it was said that they could swallow the blackest of darkness.
value: 很久很久以前，在一片遥远的森林里，住着一只华美的鸟。它的羽毛如火焰的舌焰般绚丽炽白，据说能够吞没最深邃的黑暗。

key: A luz brilha diferentemente para o coração de cada pessoa. Nem todo mundo mudará de repente ou algo assim.
value: 光芒在每个人心中以不同的方式闪耀。并非所有人都会突然改变什么的。

key: A machine in the shape of a box with a tempting big red button. Old scribblings are written around it. They're mostly warnings, such as: "Don't push the button."
value: 一台盒子形状的机器，上面有一个诱人的红色大按钮。机器周围写满了旧涂鸦。它们大多是警告，比如：“不要按按钮。”

key: A majority of our employees are not fond of this Abnormality. Few are broad-minded enough to favor working with some giant mushroom that fills up half a Containment Unit, spewing out unknown spores; they have dozens of other things to worry about, including other Abnormalities to work with.
value: 我们的大多数员工都不喜欢这个异想体。很少有人心胸宽广到愿意与一只占据半个收容单元、喷吐着未知孢子的巨型蘑菇共事；他们还有一大堆别的事情要操心，包括其他需要工作的异想体。

key: A majority of the employees here are discontent; even the smallest blessing gives them great happiness.
value: 这里的大多数员工都心怀不满；哪怕是最微小的祝福，也能给他们带来莫大的幸福。

key: A majority of the time $0 acts like any other normal bird, flying here and there in the Containment Unit.
value: 大多数时候，$0 表现得就像任何一只寻常的鸟，在收容单元里飞来飞去。

key: A matchstick impales the girl's body like a stake. Usually, the match is always lit, while the Abnormality shows no sign of activity. Because of this, employees often speculate that the matchstick may be the Abnormality's true body. However, recently, the ashen figure was seen crying, according to witnesses.
value: 一根火柴像木桩一样贯穿了女孩的身体。通常，火柴始终燃烧着，而异想体则毫无活动的迹象。正因如此，员工们常常猜测，那根火柴或许才是异想体的真身。然而，据目击者称，最近有人看到那灰白的身影在哭泣。

key: A mechanical Abnormality capable of walking on its own.
value: 一个能够自主行走的机械异想体。

key: A mechanical Abnormality whose humanoid body is composed entirely of galvanized steel. It holds a giant axe with both hands, but does not show any activity, as if it's unable to move.
value: 一个机械异想体，其人形身躯完全由镀锌钢构成。它双手握着一把巨斧，却不表现出任何活动，仿佛无法动弹。

key: A meshing of flesh and scrap metal.
value: 血肉与废金属的啮合体。

key: A month later, we came to this conclusion: There was no such “beast” in the forest.
value: 一个月后，我们得出了这样的结论：森林里根本没有那样的“野兽”。

key: A music box with an impressive sculpture of a dancing ballerina.
value: 一个八音盒，上面立着一尊姿态优美的芭蕾舞者雕塑。

key: A mysterious marble which hangs in the Containment Unit.
value: 一颗神秘的弹珠，悬挂在收容单元之中。

key: A mysterious worn-out machine used for operations.
value: 一台用于手术的神秘破旧机器。

key: A nossa pobre Carmen... agora planta as sementes da luz, assim como ela desejava fazer.
value: 我们可怜的卡门……如今她播撒着光的种子，正如她一直渴望的那样。

key: A pair of elegant red women's shoes. The design is antique, but there is no telling where and how they were made.
value: 一双优雅的红色女鞋。设计古旧，却无从得知它们是在何处、以何种方式制成的。

key: A pale hand surfaced from $0 after it had absorbed an employee. As the number of hands increased, the number of PE-Boxes produced with it also increased.
value: $0 吞噬一名员工后，一只苍白的手从它体内浮出。随着手的数量增加，与其一同产出的 PE-Box 数量也随之增加。

key: A pristine white surface sleek with fine lines and short but efficient legs, $0 was created to help people.
value: $0 有着纯白的表面、光滑流畅的线条，以及短小却高效的腿，它被制造出来是为了帮助人类。

key: A promotion might come my way if I work hard.
value: 只要努力工作，晋升的机会也许会降临到我头上。

key: A queen lives alone in the frosty winter forest.
value: 一位女王独自生活在严寒的冬日森林中。

key: A refreshing scent gushes out of #0 instead of metallic blood as they fall asleep, covered in flowers.
value: 当 #0 沉沉睡去、身上覆满花朵时，从他们体内涌出的不是金属般的血腥味，而是一缕清新的芬芳。

key: A relationship is a chorus that blooms from the connection, the contact between beings.
value: 关系，是一支从生灵之间的联结与接触中绽放的和声。

key:
A researcher died. It would have been difficult to identify him without his ID card as his head was violently crushed. Lax security meant that the door was often left unlocked or unattended. The prisoner that everyone believed to be confined was moving around on his knees.

      “My head... turning into metal... folds in my brain, being flattened...”

He kept repeating strange words, and the final procedure was quickly put in place. Treatment was halted, and he was dissected so his brain could be used for research. How do I know? I sedated him myself. He kept muttering nonsense until the end.

      “Ends, begins, ends, begins, end”
value:
一名研究员死了。他的头颅被暴力压碎，若非那张 ID 卡，恐怕很难辨认出他的身份。松懈的安保意味着那扇门经常无人上锁、无人看管。那个所有人都以为被关押着的囚犯，正跪在地上四处挪动。
  /  /      “我的头……正在变成金属……大脑里的褶皱，正在被压平……”
  /  /       他不断重复着怪异的话语，最终处置流程很快被落实。治疗被中止，他被解剖，大脑被用于研究。我怎么知道的？是我亲手给他注射了镇静剂。他直到最后一刻都在嘟囔着胡言乱语。
  /  /      “终结，开端，终结，开端，终结”

key:
A self-loathing Abnormality that spends every day letting out miserable screams. It wishes to break the cycle of the curse, but there is no way to do so.

      Beauty was once a fair lady with charming green eyes. One day, this poor lady learns of a job opening at the manor of the count, with the promise of hefty payment.
value:
一个自我厌恶的异想体，每天都在发出悲惨的尖叫。它渴望打破诅咒的循环，却无计可施。
  /  /       美曾经是一位拥有迷人绿眸的秀丽淑女。一天，这位可怜的小姐得知伯爵庄园有一份工作空缺，还承诺给予丰厚的报酬。

key: A shepherd tends to the sheep for their wool and meat. It’s just like what we do here.
value: 牧羊人照料羊群，为的是它们的羊毛和肉。这正与我们在做的事一样。

key:
A silent Abnormality that understands the conflict between good and evil.
Its empty eye sockets stare at all those who encounter it.
value:
一个沉默的异想体，深谙善与恶的冲突。
  /       它空洞的眼眶凝视着每一个与它相遇的人。

key: A small and confident bird that punishes the evil, guilty, and all sorts of irreverent people. Some employees have said that it is cute when the bird mightily flutters its tiny wings.
value: 一只小巧而自信的鸟，惩罚邪恶、有罪以及各种无礼之人。一些员工说，当这只鸟威风凛凛地扇动它的小翅膀时，很是可爱。

key: A snail could go around the containment chamber faster than that.
value: 蜗牛绕收容室一圈都比这快。

key: A standing ovation is the most honorable gift the audience can bestow upon the conductor.
value: 起立鼓掌，是观众能献给指挥家的最荣耀的礼物。

key: A teardrop fell from the child's dewy eyes, as stars showered from the sky. The world falls into a slumber, trapped in an ecstatic lullaby.
value: 一滴泪珠从孩子水汪汪的眼中滑落，群星如雨般自天空倾泻。世界沉入梦乡，困在一支狂喜的摇篮曲之中。

key: A teddy bear is born from happiness, so it needs to be happy at all times.
value: 泰迪熊由幸福而生，所以它需要时刻保持幸福。

key: A thorny Abnormality that feeds on the gaze of others and sometimes stretches its wings.
value: 一个带刺的异想体，以他人的目光为食，有时会舒展它的翅膀。

key:
A tree that stands in the middle of the Containment Unit. It never withers even if it is not given any form of nutrition.
Some employees take time to rest near this tree.
Employees sometimes enter its Containment Unit for leisure.
value:
一棵矗立在收容单元中央的树。即使得不到任何形式的养分，它也永不枯萎。
  /       有些员工会在这棵树旁稍作休息。
  /       员工们有时会进入它的收容单元消遣。

key: A while back, I saw someone go crazy. Will I end up like them?
value: 不久前，我亲眼看着一个人发了疯。我会不会落得和他们一样的下场？

key: A white cleaning robot with distinct red eyes that look like a pair of buttons. It always keeps its surroundings neat and tidy.
value: 一台白色的清洁机器人，有着一对像纽扣一样鲜明的红眼睛。它总是把周围收拾得井井有条。

key:
A wide range of medicine and chemicals were injected into him. Some were used for the sake of humanity's future, while others were for new medical techniques. They all had the potential of changing the world.

The researchers were getting more and more excited. Although they didn't openly express so, it was almost palpable. They said they found a cure, but they never said what was cured.

The prisoner spoke less and less. His aggressiveness was suppressed, but at the same time, he lost himself. After an extensive review, he was permitted to have the straitjacket removed.
value:
各种各样的药物与化学物质被注射进他体内。有些是为了人类的未来，有些则是为了新的医疗技术。它们都有改变世界的潜力。
  /  /       研究员们越来越兴奋。尽管他们没有明说，但那几乎是显而易见的。他们说自己找到了治愈的方法，却从未说过治愈的是什么。
  /  /       囚犯说话越来越少。他的攻击性被压制住了，但与此同时，他也失去了自我。经过全面评估，他被允许解除束缚衣。

key: A: (Stage whisper) A: He is a coward who ran from failures. I cannot forgive him. I can bring you to heaven or hell, to wherever I like! I am the man mark my words well with whom you will share heaven or hell!
value: A：（舞台低语）他是个逃避失败的懦夫。我无法原谅他。我可以把你带往天堂或地狱，带往任何我想带你去的地方！记住我的话，与你共享天堂或地狱的人，就是我！

key: A: (Stage whisper) He is an arrogant fool who only thinks for himself. (Strokes the mask) I knew it from the beginning. The calamity will repeat itself endlessly.
value: A：（舞台低语）他是个只为自己着想的傲慢蠢货。（抚摸着面具）我从一开始就知道。那灾祸将无休无止地重演。
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

key:
ACT 3 
A: (Refusing to believe) I have been thinking that some sort of power this mask possesses was turning me into a killer. (Stands up and picks up the mask) But The Coward told me, it is merely a mask. 
 (Sits down while holding the mask) Then it is I who has been the killer. It was me who exhilaratingly laughed to the sound of dying breath. It was me who was shaking body in guiltiness while washing blood off of a cloth. (Sinks his face into his hands, sobbing) 
 (Manically laughs) No, no. It is just a mask, but not for me. Fools! From the beginning, I knew the power that this mask has!  
Omitted
value:
第三幕
  /       A：（拒绝相信）我一直在想，是这副面具所蕴含的某种力量，把我变成了一个杀手。（站起身，捡起面具）但那懦夫告诉我，这仅仅是一副面具。
  /        （手持面具坐下）那么，是我，一直是杀手。是我在濒死的喘息声中畅快地大笑。是我在清洗布料上的血迹时，因内疚而浑身颤抖。（把脸埋进双手，啜泣着）
  /        （狂笑）不，不。它只是一副面具，但对我而言并非如此。蠢货们！从一开始，我就知道这副面具所蕴含的力量！
  /       省略

key:
ACT 6 
 A: It is too terrible to be a mistake. I was the dirty, vicious killer. How could I blame it on the mask? Ah, the pain is tearing me into pieces. I have never wished for the existence of god this much in my entire life. If the god wills to punish me, I shall accept it. Even if he throws me into unquenchable hellfire, I will succumb to it. 
(Gunfire from a distance, A collapses)
 A: A death is nothing but a sleep. That is all.
(A sees someone pointing a gun at him. He gasps in surprise. Soon, he collapses to the ground and looks at the shooter. Everything seems to be stopped. In his fading consciousness, just before his eyes close, he sees the shooter’s face. The silence continues until the audiences exit. When no one is left, the curtain finally falls. )
value:
第六幕
  /        A：这太可怕了，绝非偶然。我才是那个肮脏、恶毒的杀手。我怎能怪罪到面具头上？啊，这痛苦正将我撕成碎片。我这一生从未如此渴望上帝的存在。若上帝决意惩罚我，我便接受。即使他将我投入永不熄灭的地狱之火，我也将屈服于它。
  /       （远处传来枪声，A 倒下）
  /        A：死亡不过是沉睡。仅此而已。
  /       （A 看到有人用枪指着他。他惊得倒吸一口气。很快，他倒在地上，望着开枪者。一切都仿佛静止了。在他渐趋模糊的意识中，就在双眼合拢之前，他看清了开枪者的脸。寂静持续到观众离场。当再无一人留下时，帷幕终于落下。）

 (Background music transition)
A: (Rapturously) How foolish and pathetic I was. For what had I talked about happiness? For what had I put up with all the meretriciousness?(Exit)

The Failed: Ah, the rest I yearned! It has finally come! (Collapses) 
 (Exit A)
