key: AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!! I’ve never felt better in my life!!!
value: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！！我这辈子从没感觉这么好过！！！
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

key: Abnormalities are the true essence of humans. Let us reach them and find redemption.
value: 异想体是人类真正的本质。让我们触及它们，寻得救赎。

key: Abnormalities can inflict four different Damage Types. RED: which decreases Health (HP), WHITE: which decreases Sanity (SP), BLACK: which decreases both HP and SP, and PALE: which decreases Health (HP) by a percentage based on the target’s maximum HP. Agents equipped with E.G.O can also utilize one of these four Damage Types.
value: 异想体可以造成四种不同类型的伤害。红色（RED）：降低生命值（HP）；白色（WHITE）：降低精神值（SP）；黑色（BLACK）：同时降低 HP 和 SP；苍白（PALE）：按目标最大 HP 的百分比降低生命值（HP）。装备了 E.G.O 的员工也可以使用这四种伤害类型之一。

key: Abnormalities don’t need to look vicious to be dangerous.
value: 异想体不必面目狰狞，才足以危险。

key: Abnormalities have existed for a long time. But it hasn’t been that long since we began containing them.
value: 异想体已经存在很久了。但我们开始收容它们，却不过是最近的事。

key: Abnormalities have souls, just like humans do…
value: 异想体也有灵魂，就像人类一样……

key: Abnormalities release Enkephalin when Agents work with them, and we collect this into what we call E-Boxes. Depending on how the Agent performs during the Work Process, the Abnormality will either respond Positively or Negatively. When it reacts positively, it will release Positive Enkephalin, which produces a green PE-Box.
value: 当员工与异想体进行工作时，异想体会释放脑啡肽，我们将它收集起来，称之为 E-Box。根据员工在工作过程中的表现，异想体会作出正面或负面回应。当它作出正面回应时，会释放正面脑啡肽，生成绿色的 PE-Box。

key: According to reports from employees who have been inside $0’s stomach, it is a dark, empty, lonely place.
value: 据曾进入 $0 腹中的员工报告，那里是一个黑暗、空旷、孤独的地方。

key: According to the exploration team, there were a large number of lifeforms around it with a scorched green tint. This was because the sap makes them satiated and contained potent healing agents.
value: 据探索队报告，它周围有大量带有焦灼绿色调的生命体。这是因为它的树液能让它们获得饱足，且含有强效的治愈成分。

key: Actually, there are little difference between mimicking emotions and expressing them.
value: 其实，模仿情感与表达情感之间，几乎没有差别。

key: Actually, you have no right to refuse this gift.
value: 事实上，你没有权利拒绝这份礼物。

key: Additional parts of the Basic Information are displayed in this window as well, which can be useful to a new manager. Why don’t you try ordering an Agent to perform Attachment Work?
value: 这个窗口还会显示基础信息的其他部分，对新手主管会很有帮助。何不试着命令一名员工进行依附工作？

key: After $0 has been ringing 12 times, once again the special ability of $0 was triggered, and as many employees as the bell died.
value: 当 $0 敲响 12 次之后，$0 的特殊能力再次被触发，与钟声次数相同的员工随之死去。

key: After 5 employees died within the facility, the Qliphoth Counter decreased. However, deaths caused by Execution Bullets were not recognized.
value: 设施内有 5 名员工死亡后，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。不过，由处决弹造成的死亡不计在内。

key: After a few experiments, we have concluded that the Abnormality desires to gain "music" from this interaction.
value: 经过几次实验，我们得出结论：该异想体渴望从这种互动中获得“音乐”。

key: After a series of experiments, it has been found that the spread of the slime can be controlled through Insight Work. If D-03-109-1 performs Insight Work and produces 24 or more PE-Boxes as a result, the slime will not infect other employees for 30 seconds. However, please be cautious as if less than 24 PE-Boxes are produced, every single D-03-109-2 may transform into ████████.
value: 经过一系列实验，我们发现可以通过洞察工作控制黏液的蔓延。若 D-03-109-1 进行洞察工作并产出 24 个或以上 PE-Box，黏液在 30 秒内不会感染其他员工。但请务必小心，若产出的 PE-Box 少于 24 个，每一只 D-03-109-2 都可能转化为 ████████。

key: After all the lights have been turned on, $0 can be activated. However, $0 can only be utilized once a day, so please use it wisely.
value: 在所有灯光都打开后，$0 即可被激活。不过，$0 每天只能使用一次，请妥善利用。

key: After completing the workday, any Agent who has performed work will have their status values increased according to the Work Types they performed. After these values pass a certain point, their corresponding Virtue Level will increase. The Agent’s level can also increase if their Virtues are high enough. Those who achieve this will be promoted, and shown in the list below.
value: 工作日结束后，任何进行过工作的员工都会根据其执行的工作类型获得对应的属性值提升。当这些数值超过一定界限后，相应的美德等级就会提升。若员工的美德足够高，其等级也会提升。达成这一点的员工将获得晋升，并在下方列表中显示。

key: After continuously attempting to select and converse with #0, who was allured, they seemingly returned to normal.
value: 在持续尝试与受蛊惑的 #0 进行选择和交谈后，他们似乎恢复了正常。

key: After continuously attempting to select and converse with #0, who was captivated, they seemingly returned to normal. When all captivated employees returned to normal, the Qliphoth Counter returned to its maximum.
value: 在持续尝试与陷入迷醉的 #0 进行选择和交谈后，他们似乎恢复了正常。当所有陷入迷醉的员工都恢复正常时，逆卡巴拉计数器恢复至最大值。

key: After dragging an employee in, when another employee commenced work with $0, its Qliphoth Counter returned to its maximum. Furthermore, the HP and SP of every employee in the facility was healed.
value: 在拖入一名员工后，当另一名员工开始与 $0 工作时，它的逆卡巴拉计数器恢复至最大值。此外，设施内所有员工的 HP 与 SP 都得到了治愈。

key: After escaping, $0 eventually willingly returned to its Containment Unit after a short while. $0 only displayed aggression after it was damaged, and the employee whose HP or SP reached 0 from its attacks died. When $0 was attacked, the eyes of those who injured it were scorched by the light emitted by the Abnormality. Blinded employees worked at half-speed. $0 cured #0’s eye injury when they finished the work process.
value: 出逃后，$0 过了一会儿最终还是自行返回了它的收容单元。$0 只会在受到伤害后表现出攻击性，被其攻击导致 HP 或 SP 归零的员工会死亡。当 $0 受到攻击时，伤害它的人的眼睛会被该异想体发出的光芒灼伤。失明的员工以一半的速度工作。当 #0 完成工作流程时，$0 治愈了 #0 的眼伤。

key: After listening to $0’s murmuring, one can assume that she is longing for someone.
value: 倾听 $0 的低语后，可以推测她在思念着某个人。

key: After other entities spawned from $0’s main body while escaping, reducing its HP to 0 did not fully suppress it. $0 will only be quelled by attacking the main body after continuously reducing its HP and defeating the other spawned entities.
value: 在出逃期间，$0 的主体分裂出其他实体后，将其 HP 降至 0 并不能完全镇压它。只有不断削减主体 HP、击破分裂出的其他实体后，再攻击主体，才能平息 $0。

key: After repeated Repression work, $0 collapsed with a weak moan onto the floor. Once it had passed, #0, who had carried out the work process, began to suffer unidentifiable symptoms. Soon, $0 was born anew.
value: 在反复进行压迫工作后，$0 发出一声微弱的呻吟，瘫倒在地。就在它咽气之后，执行了工作流程的 #0 开始出现无法辨明的症状。不久，$0 重获新生。

key: After running a few tests on the armor, we have come up with the following conclusions: If this armor is worn by a cowardly employee, their chances of fatal injury and death are drastically increased. Inversely, when an employee who holds no fear of death wears it, their chances of injury and death are exceedingly decreased.
value: 在对这件护甲进行几项测试后，我们得出了以下结论：若这件护甲由怯懦的员工穿戴，他们遭受致命伤与死亡的概率会急剧上升。反之，当一位不畏死亡的员工穿上它时，他们受伤与死亡的概率会极大降低。

key: After setting a radio’s frequency to 1.76 MHz, we waited. Following 12 minutes, a mysterious voice was heard through static. It was difficult to make out what it was saying, but it appeared to be in distress and was asking for help.
value: 将无线电频率调至 1.76 MHz 后，我们静静等待。12 分钟后，一阵静电中传来一个神秘的声音。很难听清它在说什么，但它似乎正处于困境中，正在求救。

key: After several experiments, it has been discovered that when one or more employees stare at the Abnormality, the condition becomes far worse.
value: 经过数次实验，我们发现当一名或多名员工凝视该异想体时，状况会变得严重得多。

key: After the explosion, only small bits of #0 can be found in the Containment Unit.
value: 爆炸过后，收容单元中只能找到 #0 的些许碎片。

key: After the maximum number of PE-Boxes was produced with $0, it restored the mental health of every employee in the department.
value: 在与 $0 的工作产出达到最大 PE-Box 数后，它恢复了部门内所有员工的精神健康。

key: After the popularity of the “All-Around Helper” skyrocketed, “We Can Change Anything” was released as the second installment of XX Inc’s home robot series.
value: 在“全能帮手”的人气飙升之后，“我们能改变一切”作为 XX 公司家用机器人系列的第二弹问世了。

key: After work has been completed with an Abnormality, you cannot send another Agent to work with it for a short period of time. Until you can work with it again, you can send your Agents to work with other Abnormalities, or let them heal up in the Main Room.
value: 与某个异想体完成工作后，在一小段时间内无法再派其他员工与它工作。在可以再次与它工作之前，你可以派员工去与其他异想体工作，或让他们在中央本部休养恢复。

key: Afterwards, unknown noises and hallucinations started to occur near the Containment Unit. This is a recording of the day we must never forget. It brings us to a chaotic place—forgotten by many—that must never be forgotten.
value: 此后，收容单元附近开始出现不明噪音与幻觉。这是一段关于我们永不能忘却之日的录音。它带我们来到一个混乱之地——一个被许多人遗忘、却绝不能被遗忘的地方。

key: Afterwards, we investigated the incident in the employee’s hometown to get a better picture. We learned that a boy named Justin was shot and killed in a deer costume by hunters during hunting season. Unlike the employee’s confession, Justin was repeatedly bullied by other kids. Witnesses said they heard the kids shout “Run Justin, run!" right before the gunshot. After the incident, the kids at the scene moved out of town, and deer hunting was banned in the area.
value: 此后，为了更清楚地了解情况，我们调查了该员工家乡的事件。我们得知，一个名叫贾斯汀的男孩在狩猎季穿着鹿装，被猎人开枪射杀。与该员工的供述不同，贾斯汀曾反复遭到其他孩子的欺凌。目击者称，他们在枪声响起前听到孩子们高喊“快跑，贾斯汀，快跑！”。事件发生后，现场的孩子们搬离了镇子，该地区的鹿类狩猎也被禁止了。

key: Again? Looks like I’m the only sane one here.
value: 又来？看来我是这里唯一一个还清醒的人。

key: Agents can be recovered from their panic when their SP is restored completely to 100%. SP can be restored with WHITE or BLACK E.G.O Weapons. Conveniently, all our current Agents are equipped with E.G.O that deal WHITE damage. Please select all available Agents and order them to suppress the panicked employee.
value: 当员工的 SP 完全恢复至 100% 时，他们即可从恐慌中恢复。SP 可以通过造成白色或黑色伤害的 E.G.O 武器来恢复。方便的是，我们目前所有员工都装备着造成白色伤害的 E.G.O。请选择所有可用的员工，命令他们镇压那名陷入恐慌的员工。

key: Agents with Temperance Level 3 or lower immediately threw themselves into $0 upon encountering the Abnormality.
value: 节制等级为 3 级或以下的员工，在遇到该异想体时会立即扑向 $0。

key: Agora que minha parte da peça teatral acabou, eu gostaria de experimentar finalmente estar fora do palco.
value: 既然我在剧中的部分已经结束，我想最终体验一下舞台之外的感觉。

key: Agora que o meu papel nesta peça terminou, eu gostaria de experienciar como é estar fora do palco.
value: 既然我在剧中的角色已经落幕，我想体验一下舞台之外是什么感觉。

key: Agora, como se não houvesse luz alguma…
value: 此刻，仿佛一丝光芒也无……

key: Agora, como se não houvesse mais luz,
Ainsi, A a mis un morceau de Carmen en moi.
value: 于是，A 将卡门的一片塞进了我体内。

key: Algo que eu apenas conseguiria obter depois de um milhão de anos…
value: 一样我唯有在百万年之后才能获得的东西……

key: Algo que eu só pude obter após um milhão de anos…
value: 一样我唯有在百万年之后才能获得的东西……

key: Algo que uma máquina não deve ter, mas algo que idiotas como vós tendes apesar de ser em uma forma distorcida.
value: 一样机器不该拥有的东西，但却是你们这样的蠢货以扭曲形态所拥有的东西。

key: Alguns serão seres como as Anormalidades com os seus egos colapsados, e outros serão seres que tornarão-se em algo grandioso.
value: 有些人将成为自我崩溃的异想体般的存在，另一些人则将化为某种伟大的存在。

key: All damage that would be dealt to the etched will be taken by another within the facility. (However, the effect of the Abnormality will not apply to damage that exceeds the maximum HP of the one who is shown on the canvas.) The etched will also receive increased damage.
value: 原本会施加给“被蚀刻者”的全部伤害，都将由设施内的另一人承受。（然而，若伤害超过画布上所示之人的最大 HP，则该异想体的效果不会生效。）被蚀刻者受到的伤害也会增加。

key: All of a sudden, $0 turns its head and gazes at #0 who has almost finished their work. There is no ill intention in its watch whatsoever, however, it is surely not the gaze of a creature that thinks of its eyed interest as “human”.
value: 突然，$0 转过头来，凝视着即将完成工作的 #0。它的注视中没有任何恶意，但那绝不是一个将目光所及之物视为“人类”的生物该有的眼神。

key: All of us have sublimated our flaws as we sprouted the Seed…
value: 当我们萌发那颗种子之时，我们所有人都已将自身的缺陷升华……

key: All parameters will return to normal after the negative phase passes, and the Abnormality will have no memory of the behavior it exhibited during that phase.
value: 负面阶段过去后，所有参数都会恢复正常，该异想体也不会记得自己在那一阶段所表现出的行为。

key: All that remains is the hollow pride of a weathered knight.
value: 所余之物，只有一位饱经风霜的骑士那空洞的骄傲。

key: All that remains is the unjust scale. The long bird continues on, doling out judgement.
value: 所余之物，只有那架不公的天平。长鸟继续前行，分发着它的裁决。

key: All that remains of #0 is a few pieces of flesh and bone, and their own composition that will never be heard again.
value: #0 所余下的，只有几片血肉与骨骼，以及他们那再也无人听闻的遗作。

key: All the employees here count on you. You should lead them all. The difference between here and the outside world is that in here there is always a chance. It is the chance to correct your mistakes, and a chance to redeem yourself.
value: 这里的所有员工都仰仗着你。你应该带领他们所有人。这里与外界的不同之处在于，在这里永远都有机会。那是纠正过错的机会，也是自我救赎的机会。

key: All the employees who turned into monsters by $0’s spores wander near its Containment Unit.
value: 所有被 $0 的孢子变成怪物的员工，都在它的收容单元附近徘徊。

key: All the good progress of #5$0 burned to ash in #2$0’s flame.
value: #5$0 的一切良好进展，都在 #2$0 的火焰中化为灰烬。

key: All those who look at it in this sunless place feel pure peace.
value: 在这不见天日之地，所有注视着它的人都感受到纯粹的安宁。

key: All thoughts are extinguished from #0. Agony and anxiety press upon them, with no outlet.
value: #0 的一切思绪都被熄灭了。痛苦与焦虑压迫着他们，无处宣泄。

key: All you need to do is go with the flow of the body and the mind when using a weapon.
value: 使用武器时，你只需顺应身体与心念的流动。

key: Allons archiver le monde morceau par morceau, aux côtés de tous ceux qui nous ont abandonnés.
value: 来吧，让我们与所有抛弃了我们的人一道，将这个世界一块一块地归档封存。

key: Allons, allons, arrêtons les bavardages et concluons donc cela.
value: 好了，好了，别再闲扯了，就此了结吧。
行了，你们还在叽叽喳喳什么？

key: Allow me to explain how a manager should deal with emergency situations. The number displayed here is the Qliphoth Counter. It will decrease if you happen to violate the Managerial Guidelines shown in the Abnormality’s Encyclopedia or fail to avert a Qliphoth Meltdown in time.
value: 请允许我解释一下主管应当如何应对紧急情况。这里显示的数字是逆卡巴拉计数器。如果你违反了异想体图鉴中显示的管理准则，或未能及时阻止逆卡巴拉熔毁，它就会下降。

key: Alone with the armor, #0 feels the Abnormality’s piercing gaze upon them. Of course, there is not a single living thing inside that armor.
value: 与护甲独处时，#0 感到那异想体锐利的目光落在自己身上。当然，那副护甲里没有任何活物。

key: Alors cet endroit sera une bibliothèque.
value: 那么，这个地方将成为一座图书馆。

key: Alors nous allons enfin être éteints ? Ah, nous pouvons enfin nous reposer !
value: 那么我们终于要被熄灭了吗？啊，我们终于可以安息了！

key: Although $0 has no eyes, it recognizes the presence of #0 in the room.
value: 尽管 $0 没有眼睛，它却能感知到 #0 在房间里的存在。

key: Although I won’t be able to bring you coffee or arrange your files for you, well,
value: 虽然我不能再为你端咖啡，也不能替你整理文件了，不过嘛，

key: Although it is slightly broken, this armor is in an unbelievably well-preserved state considering that it is an artifact forged hundreds of years ago.
value: 尽管略有破损，但这件护甲保存得难以置信地完好，考虑到它是一件数百年前锻造的文物。

key: Although withered, the branches and leaves are still growing.
value: 虽然已经枯萎，枝叶却仍在生长。

key: Always maintain focus. You never know what could happen.
value: 时刻保持专注。你永远不知道会发生什么。

key: Além disso, eu fui feita para perceber o tempo cem vezes mais devagar que vocês.
value: 此外，我被制造出来，是为了以比你们慢上一百倍的速度感知时间。

key: Among the employees, it was originally referred to as the ‘Giant Mushroom Chunk.’ It does appear to be a gigantic mushroom, and it bears some semblance to mold as well; overall, its appearance closely resembles fungi. It continuously releases spores into the air, visible to the naked eye.
value: 在员工之间，它最初被称作“巨型蘑菇块”。它看起来确实是一株巨大的蘑菇，同时也有些像霉菌；总的来说，它的外观与真菌极为相似。它持续向空气中释放肉眼可见的孢子。

key: An Abnormality in the shape of a training dummy used to train up-and-coming managers.
value: 一个以训练人偶形态呈现的异想体，用于训练新晋主管。

key: An Abnormality in the shape of a wolf with sparsely damaged fur. It is bipedal, and is capable of communication to some extent. It always attempts to devour employees or breach. Such actions are easily preventable, since it shows obvious signs in behaviour and conversation before doing so, making this Abnormality fairly easy to manage.
value: 一个呈狼形态的异想体，毛发稀疏破损。它双足直立，能在一定程度上进行交流。它总是试图吞食员工或出逃。这类行为很容易预防，因为在行动之前，它会在行为与言谈中表现出明显的征兆，使这个异想体相当容易管理。

key: An Abnormality in the shape of a woman against the wall. Over time, her unbearable sorrow grew into a mournful obsession, covered in countless, lengthy hairs.
value: 一个紧贴墙壁的女人形态的异想体。随着时间流逝，她那难以承受的悲伤化作一种哀怨的执念，浑身覆满了数不清的长发。

key: An Abnormality of despair that has gone through a repeated cycle of faith and betrayal, leaving only the emotion that is expressed through black tears.
value: 一个绝望的异想体，历经了信仰与背叛的反复循环，只留下那通过黑色泪水表达的情感。

key: An Abnormality taking the form of a straw scarecrow. The straw is stained with blood.
value: 一个稻草人形态的异想体。稻草上沾染着血迹。

key: An Abnormality taking the form of an old and feeble woman. Anytime someone enters its Containment Unit, it will talk to that person.
value: 一个衰老虚弱的老妇人形态的异想体。每当有人进入它的收容单元，它就会与那个人交谈。

key: An Abnormality that knows of spring’s genesis and autumn’s passing.
value: 一个知晓春之萌生与秋之流逝的异想体。

key:
An Abnormality that resembles a child's innocent doodles.

      Originally, it had no stable form, its shape would continually morph. To this day its aspects still change, albeit at a much slower pace. Component analysis has revealed that the Abnormality consists of matter that does not exist on Earth. It is notable for its metaphysical appearance that one cannot explain with words.
value:
一个形似孩子天真涂鸦的异想体。
  /  /       最初，它没有稳定的形态，形状会不断变幻。时至今日，它的样貌仍在变化，只是速度慢了许多。成分分析表明，该异想体由地球上不存在的物质构成。它那难以言喻的形而上的外观，格外引人注目。

key: An Abnormality that resembles a large, raggedy teddy bear. It's missing some fur and only has one eye.
value: 一个形似一只破旧大泰迪熊的异想体。它缺了一些毛，只剩一只眼睛。

key: An Abnormality that takes the form of a giant spider, guarding its domain in darkness. It's difficult to see the Abnormality with bare eyes. Small spiderlings skitter around the floor.
value: 一个巨型蜘蛛形态的异想体，在黑暗中守护着它的领地。用肉眼很难看清这个异想体。小蜘蛛在地板上四处乱窜。

key: An Abnormality which contains the pain of all those who couldn’t take their sorrow in stride.
value: 一个容纳了所有无法从容承受悲伤之人苦痛的异想体。

key: An Abnormality whose appearance resembles a human, but cannot and should not be human. It periodically devours employees and wears their shell. The skeleton and organs are misplaced during the process, so it takes a bizarre form.
value: 一个外表形似人类、却不可能也不应当成为人类的异想体。它定期吞噬员工，披上他们的躯壳。在过程中，骨骼与器官被错置，因此呈现出诡异的形态。

key:
An Abnormality whose brain is imbued with rage, screams, and malicious cries.

There is a wound on his forehead that never seems to heal. He hates everyone and everything. He wears a straitjacket, but is as free as any man. No amount of chains and restraints is enough to prevent him from committing violence.
value:
一个大脑中充溢着狂怒、尖叫与恶毒嚎叫的异想体。
  /  /       他额头有一道似乎永不愈合的伤口。他憎恨一切人与一切事物。他穿着束缚衣，却与任何自由人无异。无论多少锁链与束缚，都不足以阻止他施暴。

key:
An Abnormality whose form sports a goat’s fur and horns.
It is not unique in regards to its appearance with the exception of several colorful eyes embedded upon its body.
Gaining information about this Abnormality is expected to be difficult due to its ceaseless slumber.
value:
一个有着山羊皮毛与犄角的异想体。
  /       除了嵌在它身上的几颗彩色眼睛之外，它的外表并无特别之处。
  /       由于它长眠不醒，获取关于这个异想体的信息预计会很困难。

key: An Abnormality’s mood might change depending on the outcome of the work done with it. This outcome can be predicted based on the amount of PE-Boxes we obtained during the Work Process. An Abnormality typically has three states of response: Good, Neutral, and Bad. Depending on the outcome, it may use a special ability or attempt to escape.
value: 异想体的情绪可能会随着与它进行工作的结果而改变。这一结果可以根据我们在工作过程中获得的 PE-Box 数量来预测。异想体通常有三种回应状态：良好、普通和糟糕。根据结果的不同，它可能会使用特殊能力或试图出逃。

key: An Agent who performed Repression Work with the Abnormality was found to have an artifact ($0-01), which had the same chemical composition as $0. The Agent stated that it made them feel as if $0 were protecting them.
value: 一名与该异想体进行了压迫工作的员工，被发现携有一件与 $0 化学成分相同的遗物（$0-01）。该员工表示，这件遗物让他们感觉仿佛 $0 正在保护着自己。

key: An Agent with $0-01 attached was ordered to continue engaging in Repression work with any Abnormality. Each time the Work Process ended, a physical examination on the Agent was carried out. The results of the examinations found that the effect given to the Agent by $0-01 changed in accordance with the number of times Repression work was done.
value: 一名佩戴 $0-01 的员工受命继续与任意异想体进行压迫工作。每当工作流程结束时，都会对该员工进行体检。检查结果发现，$0-01 赋予该员工的效果会随着压迫工作次数的增加而改变。

key: An Agent with Level 1 Fortitude was placed into $0’s Containment Room. After the Work Process ended, they were found with their head sliced clean off.
value: 一名坚韧等级为 1 级的员工被送进 $0 的收容室。工作流程结束后，人们发现他们的头颅被干净利落地切了下来。

key:
An abnormality that loves art and tries to get the entire company to listen to its music.

<Excerpt from an Encyclopedia>

      The conductor not only corrects musical errors, but is also responsible for creating the best ensemble and taking command of the music. A conductor's skill can be determined within 5 minutes at the podium. The moment the conductor opens the score, the performers read the conductor's eyes, actions, and aura to see if the person is worthy to lead them. Without the understanding and harmony between them, the macroscopic significance contained in the score cannot be expressed. Therefore, an outstanding degree of influence, leadership, and eloquence are essential qualities for a conductor to have...(Omitted)
value:
一个热爱艺术、试图让整个公司都聆听它音乐的异想体。
  /  /       <摘自百科全书的片段>
  /  /       指挥家不仅要纠正音乐上的错误，还要负责打造最优秀的合奏，并掌控整支乐曲。一位指挥家的水准，只需在指挥台上 5 分钟便可判断。指挥家翻开乐谱的那一刻，演奏者们便会解读指挥家的眼神、动作与气场，判断此人是否值得他们追随。若他们之间缺乏理解与默契，乐谱中蕴含的宏观意义便无从表达。因此，卓越的影响力、领导力与口才，是指挥家不可或缺的品质……（省略）

key: An ancient-looking religious book that rests on top of a skinny lectern. Its numerous pages are written on old parchment.
value: 一本看起来古老至极的宗教典籍，搁在一座细长的讲经台上。它的许多书页写在古老的羊皮纸上。

key: An armor that seems to have been used hundreds of years ago. An engraving on its bottom states: “Life is only granted to those who hold no fear of death.” Obviously, putting this armor on is forbidden by the company regulations. Note: There have been rumors of employees pretending to put on the armor for fun. Please look into this immediately!
value: 一件似乎已在数百年前使用过的护甲。它底部刻着一行字：“生命只赐予那些不畏死亡之人。”显然，公司规定禁止穿上这件护甲。 / / 注：有传言称，有员工为了好玩假装穿上这件护甲。请立即彻查此事！

key: An electronic device with a mysterious symbol engraved into it.
value: 一台刻有神秘符号的电子设备。

key: An employee merged with the hammer couldn’t be ordered or harmed.
value: 一名与锤子融合的员工，无法被下令，也无法被伤害。

key:
An employee who had a face colored with cheerful eyes began to grimace at their sudden burst of sadness.
An employee who was quietly crying from having their heart broken dried their tears.
An employee who was dragging along their broken leg stood up straight as if they always could.
An employee who was on their way to the lounge suddenly fainted, bleeding from every place imaginable.
As the end circles back to the beginning, those who held hope are met with despair, and those who held despair are met with hope.
At the end of the beginning, the dragon which now became a great avatar soared through the sky.
value:
一名脸上带着欢快神情、眼睛明亮的员工，因突如其来的悲伤而皱起了脸。
  /       一名因心碎而无声哭泣的员工，拭去了泪水。
  /       一名拖着自己断腿前行的员工，像一直都能行走那样挺直了身躯。
  /       一名正前往休息室的员工突然晕倒，浑身每个能想到的地方都在流血。
  /       当终结回到开端，怀有希望的人迎来绝望，怀有绝望的人迎来希望。
  /       在开端终结之际，那条已成为伟大化身之龙，翱翔于天际。

key: An employee with Level 2 or lower Temperance dove into $0 after completing their work.
value: 一名节制等级为 2 级或以下的员工，在完成工作后扑进了 $0。

key: An employee with Level 4 or higher Fortitude dove into $0 after completing their work.
value: 一名坚韧等级为 4 级或以上的员工，在完成工作后扑进了 $0。

key: An employee’s SP was healed when they performed Insight work.
value: 员工进行洞察工作时，其 SP 得到了治愈。

key: An employee’s just died, how can the company keep ordering work as if nothing happened?
value: 一名员工刚刚死去，公司怎么能像什么都没发生一样继续安排工作？

key: An idea struck $0’s mind: “If I kill the creatures first, then no one would be killed by the beast!” It was then that the forest found peace.
value: 一个念头击中了 $0 的脑海：“若我先杀了那些生灵，那么就不会有人被那头野兽杀死了！”就在那时，森林获得了安宁。

key:
An imposing Abnormality taking the form of a female warrior with a striking red hood. Her frayed hood has initials embroidered on it, unreadable due to the damage the hood has taken. Many patches can be seen on the hood, suggesting that it's been well-worn.

According to her own claims, she used to be a mercenary before coming to this facility, wandering around without fixed residence. She does not trust others easily, and has an extreme fondness for battle. She is unusually uncomfortable with parts of her face and body being exposed, or looking at a mirror. Other numerous symptoms of paranoia have been observed in her behavior.

She has a strong desire to resolve emergency situations when they break out. She calls it “a request” of some kind. Since this behavior consequently helps management, the company recommended putting it to use depending on the situation.

※ The following contains information that employees of every level should note.
However, when she encounters the “Big Bad Wolf”, the situation will change drastically. She will undergo several psychological transitions including sudden depersonalization and intermittent explosive disorder. This encounter will lead to serious collateral damage, so it is advised to avoid any case where the two may face each other.
value:
一个气势凌人的异想体，以一名头戴醒目红色兜帽的女战士形态呈现。她磨损的兜帽上绣着姓名首字母，但因兜帽受损严重而无法辨认。兜帽上可见许多补丁，表明它已饱经沧桑。
  /  /       据她自己所说，在来到这所设施之前，她曾是一名佣兵，四处漂泊、居无定所。她不轻易信任他人，对战斗有着极度的热衷。她对自己面部和身体的暴露感到异常不适，也不愿照镜子。她的行为中还观察到了许多其他偏执的症状。
  /  /       她有着在紧急情况爆发时挺身而出的强烈渴望。她称之为某种“委托”。由于这种行为客观上有利于管理，公司建议视情况加以利用。
  /  /       ※ 以下内容值得各级员工注意。
  /       然而，当她遇到“大恶狼”时，情况将发生剧变。她会经历数种心理转变，包括突发的人格解体与间歇性暴怒障碍。这次相遇会导致严重的附带损伤，因此建议避免任何两者可能对峙的情形。

key: An observation has concluded that employees with low HP are more susceptible to $0’s special ability. In particular, taking higher damage during work raises the probability of it occurring. However, getting a Good work result prevented its special ability from occurring.
value: 一项观察得出结论：HP 较低的员工更容易受到 $0 特殊能力的影响。尤其是工作期间受到更高伤害时，触发该能力的概率会上升。不过，获得良好的工作结果可以阻止其特殊能力触发。
一道古老的诅咒弥漫在 $0 的传说之中。

key: An old watch. Clicking of gears can be heard in close range. A phrase saying “Time flows like life. Life flows like time.” is written on the back. It is unclear what is the meaning this phrase is trying to convey.
value: 一块旧手表。凑近能听到齿轮的咔嗒声。表背上写着这样一句话：“时间如生命般流逝。生命如时间般流逝。”尚不清楚这句话想传达什么含义。

key:
An urgent announcement to all personnel in our company. Lobotomy Corporation supports all club activity that promotes positivity. Recently, however, we have received reports that there are group activities plotting unhealthy schemes. Due to constant allegations, we cannot help but take notice of the matter.

It is against the company's rules to idolize and/or worship certain Abnormalities. Nothing is allowed to be "sacred" in this place.

Employees that try to enter the Containment Units of specific Abnormalities without authorization will face punishment. Especially if they are not in charge of said Abnormalities.

If you feel an impulse to throw yourself into a certain Abnormality, that means you are "infected". It means that it is in the process of manipulating and dazzling your brain, as do other Abnormalities in this place. If this happens, please stop whatever you are doing and seek immediate mental treatment. As you have all passed basic employee training, we hope no one will be foolish enough to be misled.
value:
致本公司全体人员的紧急公告。脑叶公司支持一切促进积极向上的社团活动。然而，近来我们收到报告，称有团体活动正在图谋不健康的计划。由于接二连三的指控，我们不得不对此事予以重视。
  /  /       崇拜和/或信奉特定异想体违反公司规定。这个地方不允许任何事物成为“神圣之物”。
  /  /       未经授权试图进入特定异想体收容单元的员工将受到惩罚。尤其是当他们对这些异想体并无管辖职责时。
  /  /       如果你感到一股扑向某个异想体的冲动，那就意味着你已被“感染”。意味着它正在操纵和迷惑你的大脑，正如这个地方的其他异想体所做的那样。如果发生这种情况，请停下你正在做的事，立即寻求心理治疗。既然你们都通过了基础员工培训，我们希望没有人会蠢到被误导。

key: And another one bites the dust.
And the Small Bird’s beak whispered, endlessly…
value: 小鸟的喙低语着，无休无止……

key: And the many shells cried out one word, "Manager".
value: 那许多空壳齐声呼喊着一个词：“主管”。

key: And the prayer shall inevitably end with the eternal despair of its worshipper.
value: 而那祈祷，终将不可避免地以祈祷者永恒的绝望告终。

key: And then, I heard a zip, like the noise of shredding paper, a foreign sound of something tearing. His head fell to the floor. I heard a dull thud.
value: 然后，我听到一声撕裂般的声响，像纸被撕碎的声音，一种什么东西被扯开的陌生动静。他的头落到了地板上。我听到一声沉闷的撞击。

key: And you are holding a gun.
Angela… Alors au final, tu as été consumée par ton désir, et tu as choisi de tout gâcher…
value: 安吉拉……所以到头来，你被你的欲望所吞噬，选择了毁掉一切……

key: Angela… Então você foi finalmente consumida por seu desejo e escolheu ceifar tudo…
value: 安吉拉……所以你最终还是被你的欲望所吞噬，选择了收割一切……

key: Angela… So you are finally consumed by your desire, and choose to reap everything away…
value: 安吉拉……所以你最终还是被你的欲望所吞噬，选择将一切尽数收割……

key: Angela… tu finalmente foste consumida pelo teu desejo, e escolheste ceifar tudo.
value: 安吉拉……你最终还是被你的欲望所吞噬，选择了收割一切。

key: Annoying… Irritating… A pain in the neck…

Any attempts to describe (CENSORED) will cause severe mental corruption to both the speaker and the listener. Therefore, it is forbidden to record any depictions of the appearance of this (CENSORED). All audio and written records should be inspected to ensure that such depictions are deleted from them. All work pertaining to this deletion must be designated to Level 5 or higher employees.
value: 任何试图描述（已屏蔽）的行为，都会对说话者与聆听者双方造成严重的精神污染。因此，严禁记录任何关于此（已屏蔽）外观的描述。所有音频与书面记录都应接受检查，确保此类描述被从中删除。所有与此删除相关的工作，都必须指派给五级或以上员工。

key: Any employee who panics after reading this book will perish immediately.
value: 任何阅读这本书后陷入恐慌的员工，都会立即消亡。

key: Any employee with Temperance under Level 2 will fall asleep after working on the Abnormality, never to reawaken.
value: 任何节制等级低于 2 级的员工，在与该异想体工作后都会陷入沉睡，永不再醒来。

key: Any subject who enters $0 will be immune to all forms of damage. (However, this does not apply to damage caused by O-09-91). Furthermore, the subject’s HP and SP will slowly recover starting the moment they enter $0.
value: 任何进入 $0 的对象都将免疫所有形式的伤害。（然而，这不适用于 O-09-91 造成的伤害。）此外，对象自进入 $0 的那一刻起，HP 与 SP 将缓慢恢复。

key: Any work other than Repression was found to improve the health of $0.
value: 除压迫外的任何工作，都被发现能够改善 $0 的健康状况。

key: Anyone whose gaze falls upon $0 will feel an irresistible urge to put them on.
value: 任何目光落在 $0 上的人，都会感到一股无法抗拒的、想要穿上它的冲动。

key: Apenas fracas e frágeis sementes foram plantadas pela luz, aquela que devia ter iluminado o mundo por sete dias, mas apenas resistiu por três dias.
value: 光所播下的，只有软弱而脆弱的种子——那本应照亮世界七天的光，却只支撑了三天。

key: Apesar de ser somente uma máquina que obedece ordens, ela consegue ser um pouco briguenta as vezes…
value: 尽管只是一台服从命令的机器，她有时却会有点好斗……

key: Are these Abnormalities really safe? They don’t look safe in the slightest to me.
value: 这些异想体真的安全吗？在我看来它们一点都不安全。

key: Are, are you dead? Seriously? I don’t know anything!
value: 你、你死了吗？真的假的？我什么都不知道！

key: Around $0, unrecognizable objects resembling an umbilical cord are messily scattered. Despite being a room where a “baby” resides, it is eerely quiet, devoid of any whines or cries.
value: $0 周围，散落着许多形似脐带的难以辨认之物。尽管这里是一个“婴儿”栖身的房间，却诡异地安静，听不到任何哭闹或啼声。

key: As #0 works, $0 lets out incomprehensible mumbles.
value: 在 #0 工作时，$0 发出难以理解的咕哝声。

key: As #0’s work proceeded, $0 did not respond at all.
value: 随着 #0 的工作推进，$0 完全没有回应。

key: As Asas do Mundo, Singularidades, os Becos, Sindicatos, os Sicários, as Regras, O Grande Lago, A Floresta Negra, a Caça, as Ruínas, o Tabu, o Olho, a Cabeça, a Garra e os humanos…
value: 世界的翼、奇点、后巷、工会、杀手、规则、大湖、黑森林、狩猎、废墟、禁忌、眼、头、爪，以及人类……

key: As Asas, as Singularidades, os Becos, os Sindicatos, os Sicários, as Regras, o Grande Lago, a Floresta Negra, a Caça, as Ruínas, os Tabus, o Olho, a Cabeça, a Garra e os humanos...
value: 翼、奇点、后巷、工会、杀手、规则、大湖、黑森林、狩猎、废墟、诸般禁忌、眼、头、爪，以及人类……

key: As a result of putting in a large number of employees, Employees with prudence level 1 was found not to be affected by the $0 look at work. Therefore, a psychoanalytic study of optimist employee was requested.
value: 在投入大量员工进行试验后，我们发现谨慎等级为 1 级的员工不会受到 $0 在工作时注视的影响。因此，有人请求对乐观型员工进行精神分析研究。

key: As always, her muffled whispers are incomprehensible and ignored by all.
value: 一如既往，她含糊的低语难以理解，被所有人无视。

key: As bitter as it is, I’m getting accustomed to life here.
value: 尽管苦涩，我正逐渐习惯这里的生活。

key: As if representing a long history, the heels of $0 are worn out.
value: 仿佛象征着悠久的历史，$0 的鞋跟已经磨损。

key: As if someone recently took them off, $0 are lying on the ground.
value: 仿佛有人刚把它们脱下，$0 正静静地躺在地上。

key: As it turns out, $0 is much more capable at suppressing Abnormalities than most of our employees are.
value: 事实证明，$0 在镇压异想体方面，比我们大多数员工都要能干得多。

key: As long as Kai is trapped in the Snow Palace, Gerda will eventually have to engage in the inevitable duel with $0.
value: 只要凯被困在雪之宫殿，格尔达终将不得不与 $0 展开那场无可避免的决斗。

key: As long as they exist, the Apocalypse Bird will not disappear.
value: 只要它们还存在，末日鸟就不会消失。

key: As of this moment you have accumulated exactly half of the energy needed. Well, to be technical, there is no such thing as “exactly half” of energy; energy is formless. The phrase “exactly half of the energy” is a contradictory statement, completely without reason. In other words— (You cut off the broadcast.)
value: 从此刻起，你已经积攒了所需能量的“恰好一半”。嗯，严格来说，能量并不存在“恰好一半”这种东西；能量是无形的。“恰好一半的能量”这一说法是自相矛盾的，完全没有道理。换句话说——（你切断了广播。）

key: As pessoas chamam-lhes de monstros horríveis...
value: 人们称它们为可怕的怪物……

key: As pessoas dizem que são monstros horrendos…
value: 人们说它们是骇人的怪物……

key: As pessoas encaram aquilo que elas têm buscado na luz que brilha nos seus corações.
value: 人们凝视着那在内心闪耀的光芒中一直追寻之物。

key: As pessoas encararam o que ansiavam na luz que brilhava por dentro dos próprios corações.
value: 人们凝视着那在各自内心闪耀的光芒中渴慕已久之物。

key: As she is always facing the wall, not a single person has seen her face. While she occasionally talks to herself and weeps quietly, it is impossible to have a meaningful conversation with her. Despite her human appearance, it is impossible to discern what she is really looking at or her true intentions.
value: 由于她始终面朝墙壁，没有一个人见过她的脸。尽管她偶尔会自言自语、低声啜泣，却无法与她进行有意义的交谈。尽管她外表形似人类，却无法辨清她究竟在注视着什么，也无法得知她的真实意图。

key: As so few of our employees willingly volunteered to work with it, we could only record the most bare-bones information. Originally we utilized a shift system to designate what Abnormalities our staff were to work with. However, after the “Magical Girl Incident” a few years ago, we began to give consideration to the opinions of our employees when assigning work.
value: 由于自愿与它工作的员工少之又少，我们只能记录下最基础的信息。最初，我们采用轮班制来指定员工要与哪些异想体工作。然而，在几年前“魔法少女事件”之后，我们开始在工作分配时考虑员工们的意见。

key: As time passes, people change. We may become disabled, lose our minds, be consumed by overwhelming violence, or be willed to disappear, never seen again.
value: 随着时间流逝，人会改变。我们可能会变得残废、失去心智、被压倒性的暴力吞噬，或被意志吞没而消失，再也不见踪影。

key: As to be expected of all of XX Inc’s products, it sports a variety of functions.
value: 作为 XX 公司的产品理应如此，它配备了各种各样的功能。

key: As with all pacts made with the Devil, $0’s request will not end peacefully.
value: 与和魔鬼缔结的所有契约一样，$0 的请求不会以和平收场。

key: As you increase the Virtue levels of an Agent before hiring them, the amount of LOB required will increase as well. The higher the values, the more LOB they will cost. You may need to consider thoroughly how much LOB you are willing to spend on just one Agent, as well as how much you will have afterwards before finalizing your decision.
value: 在雇佣员工之前提升其美德等级，所需消耗的 LOB 也会随之增加。数值越高，他们花费的 LOB 就越多。在做出最终决定之前，你需要仔细考量愿意为一名员工花费多少 LOB，以及之后还剩下多少。

key: Ashes scatter around the Containment Unit. Half of the match still seems unburnt.
value: 灰烬散落在收容单元四周。那根火柴似乎还有一半尚未燃尽。

key: Assim sendo, este lugar será uma biblioteca.
value: 既然如此，这个地方将成为一座图书馆。

key: At first glance, all it seems to be is a simple industrial grinder. However, the existence of it having an individual “will” meets the criteria to be classified as an Abnormality.
value: 乍看之下，它不过是一台普通的工业研磨机。然而，它拥有独立“意志”这一点，符合被归类为异想体的标准。

key: At first, it had no fixed form. It was changing its shape in a minuscule speed. The chemical component test resulted that it is made of material that is not present on the Earth. Its metaphysical form can hardly be explained in human language.
value: 起初，它没有固定的形态。它以极其缓慢的速度改变着自己的形状。化学成分测试表明，它由地球上不存在的物质构成。它那形而上的形态，几乎无法用人类语言解释。

key: At one point, the bird's eyes could see through anything. The eyes always shone brilliantly, burning like stars in the night sky. But it gave its eyes to the Big Bird in order to protect the forest. Now, only the void fills its eye sockets.
value: 曾经，那只鸟的双眼能看穿一切。那双眼睛总是闪耀生辉，如同夜空中的星辰般燃烧。但为了守护森林，它把自己的眼睛献给了大鸟。如今，它的眼眶中只有一片虚空。

key: At the end of the day, however, those Abnormalities are not sheep. That’s for certain.
value: 然而归根结底，那些异想体并不是羊。这一点毋庸置疑。

key: At the very least, #0’s final breath was a happy one.
value: 至少，#0 的最后一口气是带着幸福的。

key: At the very least, the staff lounge is decent.
value: 至少，员工休息室还算过得去。

key: At the very least, working here is better than dying out in the Backstreets.
value: 至少，在这里工作比在后巷里死去要好。
有时，$0 会治愈受伤的员工。
有时，$0 会一边颤抖一边低声咕哝。

key: At times, $0 will menacingly click its teeth, but it’s nothing to worry about.
value: 有时，$0 会发出带有威胁意味的牙齿叩击声，不过不用担心。

key: At times, a few spiderlings may fall from the ceiling, but everything’ll be fine if you just ignore them.
value: 有时，会有几只小蜘蛛从天花板掉落，但只要无视它们，一切都会没事。

key: Avez-vous la moindre idée de ce dont il s’agit ?
value: 你们可曾有一丝一毫的念头，知道这是怎么回事吗？

key: Back when I was just seven years old, by the brook…
value: 当我还是七岁孩童时，在小溪边……

key: Be sure to stop the machine only when it displays “YES”. If it is stopped while on “NO”, all the stats will drop as much as they were due to increase.
value: 务必只在机器显示“YES”时将其停下。若在显示“NO”时停下，所有属性都会下降与原本应提升的量相同的数值。

key: Bearing the hope to return to dust, it shall go back to the grave with all that desires to live.
value: 怀着归于尘埃的希望，它将与一切渴望生存之物一同回到坟墓。

key: Beau travail tout le monde. Le rideau tombe finalement sur nous.
value: 大家干得漂亮。帷幕终于在我们身上落下。

key: Before #0 entered, not a single movement came from $0.
value: 在 #0 进入之前，$0 没有做出任何动作。

key: Before $0’s ever-winding story began, #0 managed to finish their work quickly to get out of there safely.
value: 在 $0 那永无止境的故事开始之前，#0 设法迅速完成了工作，安全地离开了那里。

key: Before breathing their final breath, #0 earnestly tries to speak with $0 using all their might. However, she shuts the door as if she didn’t hear a thing.
value: 在咽下最后一口气之前，#0 竭尽全力地想要与 $0 交谈。然而，她仿佛什么都没听见一般，关上了门。

key: Before the lady could even ask why it was laughing, she began to change. Hundreds of eyes formed and a thick coat of fur grew on her. Soon, she turned into the beast.
value: 在那位小姐来得及问它为何发笑之前，她就开始变化了。数百只眼睛在她身上浮现，浓密的皮毛在她身上生长。很快，她变成了那头野兽。

key: Behind #0, the rumbling sound of a hairy black bird can be heard.
value: 在 #0 身后，可以听到一只毛茸茸的黑鸟发出的隆隆声响。

key: Being unable to bear the stories $0 recounts, the floor and walls of the Containment Unit have cracked here and there.
value: 因无法承受 $0 讲述的故事，收容单元的地板与墙壁四处出现了裂痕。

key: Beings will exist that become nothing better than the Abnormalities with their collapsed egos, and beings that shall become something greater.
value: 将会有一些存在，最终沦落得与那些自我崩塌的异想体无异；也将会有些存在，化为更伟大的事物。

key: Bem... Eu não estou entendendo. Como a Angela poderia ter algo como um desejo?
value: 唔……我不明白。安吉拉怎么可能会有欲望这种东西？

key: Big Bird's far seeing eyes were blinded,
value: 大鸟那能望极远方的眼睛，被夺去了光明，

key:
Big Bird, with its many eyes, decided to watch over the forest for intruders.
For Big Bird's eyes could see very far, and see things we cannot see.
value:
大鸟拥有众多眼睛，它决定守望森林，警惕入侵者。
  /       因为大鸟的眼睛能望见极远之处，看见我们看不见的东西。

key: Big and Might be Bad Wolf
Big and Will be Bad Wolf
Big, pitch-black pupils that gaze at nothing. They don’t even blink.
value: 硕大而漆黑的瞳孔，凝视着虚空。它们甚至不会眨动。

key:
Bill: I had an amazing dream today!
Brian: What, did you win the lottery or something?
Bill: When I got to work, everyone here was bald! Everyone including you! Maybe even people outside of this corporation!
Brian: Umm… I think you’ve been pretty stressed lately. Why don’t you go take counseling?

Employee Bill suffered an unfortunate accident with Singing Machine that day. Right after the incident, Abnormality Bald-is-awesome! appeared in the facility. We all cherish the memories of Bald Bill.
value:
比尔：我今天做了一个超棒的梦！
  /       布莱恩：怎么，你是中了彩票还是怎么着？
  /       比尔：我上班的时候，这里的每个人都是秃头！包括你在内所有人！说不定连公司外面的人也是！
  /       布莱恩：嗯……我觉得你最近压力太大了。要不要去做做心理咨询？
  /  /       那天，员工比尔与歌唱机发生了一起不幸的事故。就在那场事故之后，异想体“秃头最棒！”出现在了设施中。我们都珍视着秃头比尔的回忆。

key: Bit by bit, we discovered that this Abnormality may be evolving. It demonstrates behaviour similar to the character of the person who used to be its shell. It even makes attempts to equate itself with human beings.
value: 一点一点地，我们发现这个异想体可能正在进化。它展现出与曾经作为其躯壳之人相似的性情。它甚至试图将自己与人类等同起来。

key: Blood covered the whole floor, screams echoed, people were running away, and $0 was gleefully learning the concept of “cleaning”.
value: 鲜血覆盖了整片地板，尖叫四起，人们四散奔逃，而 $0 正兴高采烈地学习着“清洁”的概念。

key: Blood covers the whole floor, screams echo, people are running away…
value: 鲜血覆盖了整片地板，尖叫回荡，人们四散奔逃……

key: Blood gracefully flows through every mortal life.
value: 血液优雅地流淌过每一个凡人的生命。

key: Bof, ça n’a plus d’importance. On sera bientôt éteints de toute façon. C’est la dernière partie de son plan.
value: 唉，那已经不重要了。反正我们很快就会被熄灭。这是她计划的最后一部分。

key: Bom trabalho, pessoal. A cortina está prestes a se fechar.
value: 大家干得漂亮。帷幕即将落下。

key: Bom trabalho, pessoal. É hora da cortina fechar.
value: 大家干得漂亮。是帷幕落下的时候了。

key: Bora lá, temos de nós preparar.
But I had no power to change this fate.
value: 但我没有力量改变这命运。

key: But I need that power too.
But I slowly came to accept it.
But instead they provided me, an AI.
value: 但他们却提供了我，一个 AI。

key: Can you believe him? He always acted so composed. He was painfully aware of what had become of her.
value: 你能相信他吗？他总是一副镇定自若的样子。他明明痛彻心扉地知道她变成了什么样。

key: Can you order me to perform a ‘Suicide’ work? That’s what I need most right now.
value: 你能命令我进行“自杀”工作吗？那正是我现在最需要的。

key: Carmen was a human after all.

value: 中央指挥部第 1 小队
中央指挥部第 2 小队

key: Cependant, je suis arrivée aussi loin parce que je ne pouvais pas refuser les ordres qui m’ont été confiés. “Une machine doit agir comme une machine”, comme il aimait dire.
value: 然而，我能走到这一步，是因为我无法拒绝被托付给我的命令。“机器应当像机器一样行事”，他总爱这样说。

key: Cependant, les Anomalies sont bien plus belles quand elles sont elles-mêmes.
value: 然而，异想体在做它们自己时，要美丽得多。

key: Certain subjects who consumed $0 were found to suffer a side effect. Those who endured this side effect exploded and died within 20 to 30 seconds after consuming $0; the entire section they were in suffered WHITE damage.
value: 我们发现，某些食用了 $0 的对象会出现一种副作用。承受这种副作用的人会在食用 $0 后 20 至 30 秒内爆炸身亡；他们所在的整个区域都会受到白色伤害。

value: 这些人类……有的人将展现出他们的力量，有的人则将屈服于这些力量。

value: 这场实验在我心中催生了某种新的东西。

key: Chacun d’entre nous a sublimé ses faiblesses en faisant germer la Graine…
value: 我们每一个人，都已在萌发那颗种子之时升华了自身的弱点……

key: Chains are binding the hammer tightly to make sure no one can lift it.
value: 锁链紧紧缚着那把锤子，确保没有人能举起它。

key: Chegou a hora de adormecermos para todo o sempre.
value: 是时候让我们永远沉睡了。

value: 圣诞节，啊，那可怕的嘉年华。每逢圣诞，我都满怀一种冲动，想拔掉那些唱颂歌之人的舌头。

key: Coated in an unidentifiable slime, $0 is completely dissimilar to other babies, which are wrapped up in warm blankets, happily cooing and dreaming.
value: $0 浑身覆满难以辨认的黏液，与其他婴儿截然不同——那些婴儿裹在温暖的襁褓里，幸福地咿呀作声、做着甜梦。

key: Collectively losing our sanity is the only redemption we can find here.
value: 一同失去理智，是我们在这里能找到的唯一救赎。

key: Come on out everyone! Step out and free us from this accursed place!
value: 大家都出来吧！走出来，把我们从这个被诅咒的地方解放出去！

key: Come, come, let’s cut the chit-chat and wrap it up then.
value: 好了，好了，别再闲扯了，就此了结吧。

key: Coming face to face with an Abnormality, especially so when it is on the loose, can be quite shocking and frightening for your employees. Just like when an Agent enters a Containment Unit, they may receive Fear Damage. If the Risk Level of the Abnormality is high while the Agent’s level is low, it will cause a heavier strain on their mind, and lower a larger portion of their SP.
value: 与异想体面对面，尤其当它正处于出逃状态时，对你的员工来说可能会相当震惊和可怕。正如员工进入收容单元时那样，他们可能会受到恐惧伤害。若异想体的危险等级较高而员工等级较低，就会对他们的心智造成更沉重的负担，并大幅降低其 SP。

value: 与 $0 进行压迫工作展现了最佳的能量产出效果。该工作产出了可观的 PE-Box，但会对 $0 的健康产生负面影响。

key: Company P wished to construct the safest place on Earth. As such, the interior of this shelter houses a large number of non-perishable goods, which would allow anyone who stayed inside to survive for an extremely long period of time.
value: P 公司希望建造地球上最安全的地方。因此，这座避难所的内部储存着大量耐储存的物资，能让任何待在里面的人存活极其漫长的时间。

key: Composed entirely of pink slime, $0 is sliding around its Containment Unit.
value: $0 完全由粉色黏液构成，正在它的收容单元里四处滑动。
同志倒下了！同志倒下了！

key:
Confined within the counseling room, Marie eventually gave up her right to remain silent and began to reveal what she had done. How she kept the contents inside the container, and how she was able to form a bond with it. However, she couldn’t finish her words. This was because she melted in the blink of an eye, moments after signs of an anomaly showed up on her skin. Yes, she quite literally melted, melted in her entirety. And that wasn’t the end of it. The slime that once was Marie a few seconds ago began to move. It wasn’t a difficult task for a fluid creature to slide under the door of the counseling room.
Did it have a speck of human rationality? No. Just like a newborn duckling blindly follows its mother, it simply moved towards the Abnormality.
And it wasn’t just Marie that turned to slime. Every single employee who had made contact with her in some way began to melt too. Those who were questioning her, who had shared a meal with her, who had worked together…
Soon, this army of slime began to attack other employees. All for the mother slime, the Abnormality they loved. Yes, out of love and love alone, they killed.
value:
被困在咨询室里，玛丽最终放弃了保持沉默的权利，开始吐露她所做的一切。她如何保管容器内的东西，又如何与它建立起羁绊。然而，她没能说完。因为在她皮肤上出现异变征兆的片刻之后，她在眨眼间融化了。是的，她确确实实融化了，整个融化了。而这还不是结束。几秒前还是玛丽的那滩黏液开始移动起来。对一种流体生物来说，从咨询室的门缝下滑出去并不是什么难事。
  /       它身上可有一丝人类的理性？没有。就像初生的雏鸭盲目地跟随母鸭，它只是径直向那异想体移动过去。
  /       而且变成黏液的并不只有玛丽。每一个以某种方式与她接触过的员工，也开始融化了。那些审讯过她的人、与她共进过餐的人、与她共事过的人……
  /       不久，这支黏液大军开始攻击其他员工。一切都是为了母体黏液——他们所深爱的那个异想体。是的，出于爱，仅仅出于爱，他们杀戮。

key:
Document #1 <Employee David’s Song>

      David was famous in his department for his attempts to communicate with the 'Fragment of the Universe'. He was an intellectual who enjoyed reading philosophical books and gazing at the stars. He held interest in the Abnormality and as such he got the job; he researched its language and behaviour purely out of personal interest.

      So what became of David? Eventually, he succeeded in entering the domain of the Fragment of the Universe. However, it was obvious that his small brain couldn't withstand it. He was transferred to the psychiatric ward, and died of starvation while singing an unrecognizable song. This is why the Abnormality’s voice cannot be revealed to the public.

Audio Record : Echoes in the Universe (Currently Removed)
value:
文档 #1 <员工大卫之歌>
  /  /       大卫在部门里以试图与“宇宙碎片”交流而闻名。他是一位知识分子，喜欢阅读哲学书籍和凝望星辰。他对该异想体抱有浓厚兴趣，因此得到了这份工作；他纯粹出于个人兴趣研究它的语言与行为。
  /  /       那么大卫后来怎样了？最终，他成功进入了宇宙碎片的领域。然而，他那渺小的头脑显然无法承受这一切。他被转往精神病房，在哼唱着一首无法辨认的歌曲时死于饥饿。这就是为何该异想体的声音不能向公众公开。
  /  /       音频记录：宇宙中的回响（已被移除）

key:
Document #2 <Singing>

      ...Why didn't you tell me earlier that the Abnormality was responsible for their condition? I have no idea if there’s any pattern, but they all show the same strange behavior on the exact same days. Can you imagine a group of patients staring at the sky with dazed faces, wailing strange noises in the corridor at night while everyone is asleep? I had such a difficult time persuading the other patients that they must have been practicing for the company’s upcoming Halloween event. Psychiatric treatment and medicine won't help. "Coming, coming, still coming," they keep repeating these words, and anything else they utter is not from any language we know. I think sending them to a general hospital was an unwise decision. 

      - Doctor from the (Record Deleted) Ward
value:
文档 #2 <歌唱>
  /  /       ……你为什么不早点告诉我，导致他们变成那样的是那个异想体？我不知道其中是否有规律可循，但他们都在完全相同的日子里表现出同样奇怪的行为。你能想象一群病人眼神茫然地望着天空，夜里在大家熟睡时于走廊中哀嚎着发出怪声吗？我费了好大的劲才说服其他病人，他们一定是在为公司即将到来的万圣节活动排练。精神治疗和药物都无济于事。“来了，来了，还在来，”他们不断重复着这些话，而他们所说的其他任何话语，都不属于我们所知的任何语言。我想，把他们送去综合医院是个不明智的决定。
  /  /       - 来自（记录已删除）病房的医生

key:
Document 1 <Song of employee David>

      Employee David was well-known as a person who tries to commune with “Fragment of the Universe”. His queer hobbies involved reading eccentric and suspicious books, and watching stars through a telescope. He was interested in “Fragment of the Universe” since he joined the company, and it was later found out that he had been researching the abnormality’s language and behavior pattern out of personal curiosity.  

      What happened to him is, to be direct, that he eventually succeeded to enter the plane of “Fragment of the Universe”. However, his brain was not capable of handling such burden. He had to be transferred to mental hospital. In there, he starved to death, after surviving for few days singing something unintelligible while refusing to eat. After this incident, we decided to lock away the audio file that contains the abnormality’s sound. 

      Audio record: Echoes from the beyond (Currently deleted)
value:
文档 1 <员工大卫之歌>
  /  /       员工大卫以试图与“宇宙碎片”交流而闻名。他古怪的爱好包括阅读离奇可疑的书籍，以及用望远镜观测星辰。自从加入公司以来，他就对“宇宙碎片”很感兴趣，后来人们发现，他一直在出于个人好奇研究该异想体的语言与行为模式。
  /  /       直接说吧，他的结局是，他最终成功进入了“宇宙碎片”的层面。然而，他的大脑无法承受这样的负担。他不得不被转往精神病院。在那里，他拒绝进食，靠着哼唱一些难以理解的东西存活了几天后，饿死了。这起事件之后，我们决定封存含有该异想体声音的音频文件。
  /  /       音频记录：来自彼岸的回声（已被删除）

key:
Document 2 <The song>

      …..Haven’t I told you that these people went crazy because of that abnormality? They show irregular behavior on a certain day. I am not sure there is any rule to it, though. In the night, when everyone is asleep, these three guys scream to the top of their lung, looking up to the ceiling. I went through a lot of trouble explaining it to the other patients that that was just a practice for Halloween stage. No counseling or drugs help this. They just keep repeating “It’s coming. It’s coming. It’s coming.”. Sometimes they say something different but I don’t think that language even exists in this world. I think putting them into a normal medical institute was a mistake.

      -	Letter from Dr. Alisha from OO hospital.
value:
文档 2 <那首歌>
  /  /       ……我难道没有告诉过你，这些人是因为那个异想体才发疯的吗？他们在某一天会表现出反常的行为。不过，我不确定这有没有规律可循。夜里，当所有人都熟睡时，这三个人会仰望着天花板，扯着嗓子拼命尖叫。我费尽唇舌向其他病人解释，那只是他们在为万圣节舞台排练。任何心理咨询或药物都无济于事。他们只是一遍遍重复着“它来了。它来了。它来了。”有时他们会说些别的话，但我认为那种语言根本不存在于这个世界。我想，把他们送进普通医疗机构是个错误。
  /  /       - OO 医院阿丽莎医生的来信

key:
Don't look away, just keep your eyes on it.

It lives inside your gaze. The containment is but a facade.

Contain it in your sight.

Blinking is okay. It will tolerate such a brief moment of disruption.

However, once it recognizes that it lost your attention and focus…

It will spread its wings.

Yes, wings.

As if to praise a long-forgotten god, its lean, bloody wings will stretch and cover the whole corridor.

The wings still bear fruit, using fresh corpses as food.

If it still fails to gain your attention, the stalks will pierce the facility and grow toward a sunny spot.

Like an angel, its wings will reach the skies and extend toward the ground, eventually blocking the sun out.

But there is still hope. When you finally turn your eyes and bring it within your cognizance…

It will return to this deep, dark subterranean area.

That is, if you managed to survive by then.
value:
不要移开视线，就这样一直注视着它。
  /       它寄居于你的凝视之中。收容不过是一层表象。
  /       将它囚禁在你的目光里。
  /       眨一下眼是可以的。它会容忍这样短暂的失神。
  /       然而，一旦它意识到自己失去了你的注意与专注……
  /       它就会展开翅膀。
  /       是的，翅膀。
  /       仿佛在赞颂一位被遗忘已久的古神，它那消瘦而血淋淋的翅膀将伸展开来，覆盖整条走廊。
  /       那翅膀依旧结出果实，以新鲜的尸体为食。
  /       如果它仍然无法得到你的注视，那些藤蔓将刺穿设施，向着有阳光的地方生长。
  /       如同天使一般，它的翅膀将触及天空，向地面延伸，最终遮蔽太阳。
  /       但希望犹存。当你终于转动目光，将它纳入认知之中……
  /       它就会回到这片幽深、黑暗的地下区域。
  /       当然，前提是到那时你还能活下来。

value: 别为死去的人想太多。接受它，继续前行。

key: Don’t send me in!!! Don’t make me die!!!!
value: 别把我送进去！！！别让我去死！！！！

value: 别挣扎了，你也会爱上它的旋律的。

key: Don’t take them away from me…
value: 别把它们从我身边夺走……

key: Don’t trust this company too much.
Don’t worry so much, even if you’re new here. You’ll get used to it all in no time.
value: 别太担心，即使你是新来的。你很快就会习惯这一切。

key: Don’t you think it is unjust that I have to just sit and watch, when he designed me to feel emotion?
value: 他设计了我，让我能够感受情感，却只能坐在一旁眼睁睁看着——你不觉得这不公平吗？

key: Dozens of spore fruits begin to grow on #0’s body; they cannot be stopped… #0’s mind is desperately yearning for consensus with $0.
value: 数十颗孢子果实开始在 #0 身上生长；它们无法被阻止……#0 的心智正拼命渴求着与 $0 的共鸣。

key: Dude... your “little angel” is gnawing on our colleague’s finger.
value: 老兄……你的“小天使”正在啃我们同事的手指。

key: During the act of wearing on #0, their bones were scattered across the floor.
value: 在 #0 穿戴它的过程中，他们的骨头散落了一地。

key: During the work process, when the Containment Unit went out of the camera’s sight, the Qliphoth Counter lowered. When $0’s Containment Unit was still unmonitored after the phenomenon, the Counter continued to lower.
value: 在工作过程中，当收容单元移出摄像头的视野时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。当这种现象发生后，$0 的收容单元仍处于无人监控状态时，计数器继续下降。

key: Dá para acreditar numa coisa destas? Ele nunca perdia a sua compostura. Ele dolorosamente sabia o quê que eu me tinha tornado dela.
value: 你能相信这种事吗？他从未失去过他的镇定。他痛彻心扉地知道我让她变成了什么样。

key: E então eu gostaria de organizar o conhecimento que eles me deram. Creio que eles são chamados de 'livros'.
value: 那么，我想把我从他们那里获得的知识整理起来。我想，它们被称为“书”。

key: E então.... o quê que aconteceu?
E finalmente, gostaria de ordenar todo conhecimento sobre eles naquilo que, se eu me lembro bem, se chamam de ‘Livros’?
value: 最后，我想把我关于他们的一切知识整理成那些——如果我没记错的话——被称为“书”的东西？

key: E isso é culpa de quem?
E.G.O Suits offer increased resistance to certain types of damage. Inversely, some forms of damage may cause greater wounds depending on what E.G.O Suit is in use. Please extract one now.
value: E.G.O 护甲能提高对特定伤害类型的抗性。反之，根据所使用的 E.G.O 护甲不同，某些形式的伤害可能会造成更严重的伤口。现在请抽取一件。

key: Each city needed to have its own unique technologies; that was the key to reinvigorating the city. There were numerous ones, but among them, one city saw advancements in technology for the replacement of body parts. It was possible to repair or augment body parts that were broken and malfunctioning, or simply undesirable. Every citizen was eligible for that treatment. However, rumors circulated. When a rich person looking to improve their eyesight approached a beggar with broken lungs struggling to breathe, they would transplant the beggar's eyes to the rich person. Then they would abandon the beggar's corpse somewhere along the outskirts, still with those rotting lungs.
value: 每座城市都需要拥有自己独一无二的技术；那是让城市重焕生机的关键。这样的技术数不胜数，但其中，有一座城市在人体部件替换技术上取得了长足进展。破损失灵、或者仅仅是不合心意的身体部件，都可以被修复或增强。每位市民都有资格接受这种治疗。然而，流言四起。当一个想要改善视力的富人，找上一个肺部破损、呼吸困难的行乞者时，他们会把行乞者的眼睛移植给富人。然后，他们会把行乞者的尸体弃置在城郊某处，那具尸体上仍然挂着那些正在腐烂的肺。

key: Each time a Qliphoth Meltdown occurs in the facility, the Meltdown Level increases. The higher the Meltdown Level, the more Containment Units that will undergo the Qliphoth Meltdown. There is also the possibility that Ordeals manifest instead of a Meltdown passing. If you wish to know what Ordeals are, please consult the Manager’s Manual and read the relevant article.
value: 每当设施内发生一次逆卡巴拉熔毁，熔毁等级就会提升。熔毁等级越高，发生逆卡巴拉熔毁的收容单元就越多。此外，也有可能降临的不是熔毁，而是考验。若你想了解考验是什么，请查阅主管手册，阅读相关条目。

key: Each work you can request your Agents to perform with an Abnormality will have a different result. The Success Rate for each Work Type will also vary between Abnormalities.
value: 你可以要求员工与异想体进行的每一种工作都会产生不同的结果。每种工作类型的成功率也会因异想体而异。

key: Eating is the only joy we can find here.
value: 进食是我们在这里能找到的唯一快乐。

key: Ela certamente queria viver, mesmo enquanto lutava por um bem maior.
value: 她确实想要活下去，即使是在为更伟大的事业而战时。

key: Ela deu-me o desejo de querer viver, a solidão da existência e a detestável ânsia.
value: 她给了我活下去的渴望、存在的孤独，以及那令人憎恶的渴求。

key: Ela deve estar esperando como nós.
value: 她一定在像我们一样等待着。

key: Ela deve estar à espera, assim como nós.
value: 她一定在等着，就像我们一样。

key: Ela deve ter desejado viver, mesmo quando lutava pelo bem maior.
value: 她一定渴望过活下去，即使是在为更伟大的事业而战时。

key: Ela me deu o desejo ardente da vida, a solidão da existência, e um sentimento detestável de saudade.
value: 她给了我炽烈的求生之欲、存在的孤独，以及一种令人憎恶的思念之情。

key: Ela é apenas uma máquina que obedece a ordens, mas pode ser um pouco mal-humorada…
value: 她只是一台服从命令的机器，但有时会有点闹脾气……

key: Ele precisava de mim mais do que qualquer outro para o plano, mas eu não fazia parte do final dele, assim como eu também não era parte do prólogo dele.
value: 在那个计划中，他需要我胜过需要任何其他人，但我既不属于他的终章，正如我也不属于他的序章。

key: Ele precisava de mim para o plano dele mais do que qualquer outra pessoa, mas eu não era parte do seu final, assim como eu também não fui parte do seu prologo.
value: 在他的计划中，他需要我胜过任何其他人，但我不是他结局的一部分，正如我也不是他序章的一部分。

key: Ele queria que eu cuida-se dele assim como a Carmen o fez quando ele ficou sozinho. Patético.
value: 他希望我像卡门在他孤身一人时所做的那样照顾他。可悲。

key: Ele queria que eu cuidasse dele assim como a Carmen fez enquanto ele estava totalmente sozinho. Mas que covarde lamentável.
value: 他希望我像卡门在他完全孤身一人时所做的那样照顾他。多么可悲的懦夫。

key: Eles chamaram esses três dias e quatro noites da semana como ‘Noites Brancas e Dias Sombrios’.
value: 他们把这一周的三天四夜称为“白夜与暗日”。

key: Eles chamaram esses três dias e quatro noites dessa semana "Noites Brancas e Dias Negros".
value: 他们把那一周的三天四夜称为“白夜与黑日”。

key: Eles não pareciam se sentir mais perdidos.
value: 他们似乎不再感到迷失。

key: Elijah had a large family to provide for.
value: 以利亚有一大家子人要养活。

key: Elle a dû vouloir vivre, même lorsqu’elle s’efforçait de lutter pour le bien de tous.
value: 她一定渴望过活下去，即使当她努力为众人之善而战时。

key: Elle doit être en train d’attendre, comme nous.
value: 她一定正在等待着，就像我们一样。

key: Elle m’a donné le désir brûlant de vivre, la solitude de l’existence, et un sentiment détestable d’envie.
value: 她给了我炽烈的求生之欲、存在的孤独，以及一种令人憎恶的渴望。

key: Elle nomma ces trois jours et quatre nuits la semaine des “Nuits Blanches et Jours Sombres”.
value: 她将那三天四夜命名为“白夜与暗日”之周。

key: Elle n’est qu’une machine qui suit les ordres, un peu agressive parfois par contre…
value: 她只是一台服从命令的机器，不过有时会有点攻击性……

key: Employee #0 feels shame for working for the company while managing $0.
value: 员工 #0 为自己在管理 $0 的同时为公司工作而感到羞愧。

key: Employee #0 picked up the hammer when he/she was sent to room of $0, which was shining.
value: 员工 #0 被派往 $0 的房间时，捡起了那把闪闪发光的锤子。

key: Employee #0’s tomorrow might come, or not.
value: 员工 #0 的明天或许会到来，或许不会。

key: Employee : “This happened during at around 4:00 PM. Anyways, there was a railway about 20 minutes from my house. Some of my good friends and I decided to dress as forest animals. One of us chose to go as a deer. It was a crude costume, it could hardly be called one to be honest. Just a pair of clumsily made antlers and a dark outfit with some deer-like spots on it. (Omitted) I don't know how our ‘deer’ friend wandered into the woods. We didn't even notice he was missing for maybe an hour. We searched for him and finally found him in some bushes. We called out his name, and I'm not sure if it was from relief of finally finding us or what but he started sprinting towards us. And that's when we heard it; the gunshots. Bang! Bang! Bang! When I came to my senses, I saw his blood splattered all the way to my feet. After that, not one of us dressed up as an animal ever again. That’s all. By the way, is this really supposed to work?”
value: 员工 <已编辑>： / / “这件事发生在 <已编辑> 下午 4 点左右。总之，离我家大约 20 分钟路程的地方有一条铁路。我和几个好朋友决定打扮成森林动物。我们中有人选择扮成鹿。那是一件粗糙的戏服，老实说几乎算不上戏服。只是一对做工笨拙的鹿角和一件带有些鹿斑的深色衣服。（省略）我不知道我们的‘鹿’朋友是怎么晃进树林里的。我们甚至大约过了一个小时才发现他不见了。我们四处找他，最后在灌木丛里找到了他。我们喊他的名字，不知道他是因为终于找到我们而如释重负，还是别的什么，他开始朝我们飞奔而来。就在那时，我们听到了——枪声。砰！砰！砰！等我回过神来，我看见他的血溅了一路，一直溅到我的脚边。在那之后，我们再也没人扮过动物。就这些。对了，这真的有用吗？”

key: Employee Alex, who had a serious scar on his forehead from subduing an Abnormality, walked into this Abnormality's chamber with his scar's recovery incomplete. The Abnormality, which normally isn't loquacious, started talking as soon as it saw the employee's scar.
value: 员工亚历克斯在镇压一个异想体时额头留下了一道重伤疤。他在伤疤尚未完全愈合时走进了这个异想体的房间。这个通常不爱多言的异想体，一看到员工的伤疤便开口说起话来。

key: Employees of Fortitude Level 3 or lower immediately panicked when entering $0’s unit. It is recommended that employees lower than Fortitude Level 4 never be sent to work with $0.
value: 坚韧等级为 3 级或以下的员工，在进入 $0 的收容单元时会立即陷入恐慌。建议切勿派遣坚韧等级低于 4 级的员工与 $0 工作。

value: 当 $0 试图发笑时，员工们会因恐惧而战栗。

key: Employees who are in the same area as D-03-109-1 have a low chance of being infected by the slime. Those who are infected by the slime (D-03-109-2) can be distinguished with a trace of slime on their cheeks. Employees who made contact with D-03-109-2 also had a low chance of infection. When enough time passed after infection, D-03-109-2’s skin was completely merged with the slime, and infected employees turned into ████████.
value: 与 D-03-109-1 处于同一区域的员工，有较低概率被黏液感染。被黏液感染者（D-03-109-2）可以通过脸颊上的一抹黏液加以辨认。与 D-03-109-2 接触过的员工也有较低概率被感染。感染经过足够长的时间后，D-03-109-2 的皮肤会与黏液完全融合，被感染的员工会变成 ████████。

key: Employees who did not attack any targets before returning the heart, or those who returned the heart before 30 seconds had passed entered a state of derangement, repeating mindless killings with their enhanced strength.
value: 在归还心脏前没有攻击任何目标、或在 30 秒过去之前归还心脏的员工，会进入精神错乱状态，以增强的体力重复着无意识的杀戮。

key:
Employees who made contact with the Abnormality stated that it provided them a significant psychological comfort.
Such statements were deemed truthful as the employees displayed a visible increase in work efficiency, along with a notable decrease in mental corruption.
value:
与该异想体接触过的员工表示，它给他们带来了显著的心理慰藉。
  /       这些陈述被认为是可信的，因为员工们表现出工作效率的显著提升，同时精神污染明显下降。

key: Employees who worked with $0 had a chance of being infected by its spores. Send them to work with other Abnormalities regularly to counteract complete infection.
value: 与 $0 工作过的员工有概率被其孢子感染。定期派他们去与其他异想体工作，以抵消完全感染。

value: 谨慎等级为 1 级的员工碾碎了小蜘蛛。$0 将那些伤害它孩子的人变成了茧。

value: 节制等级为 1 级的员工，在听到 $0 的声音后可能会转过头去。若他们这么做，就会遭受恐慌发作。

key: Employees with Temperance Level 2 or Prudence Level 3 or lower were sucked in as soon as they encountered the escaping Abnormality.
value: 节制等级为 2 级或谨慎等级为 3 级或以下的员工，一遇到出逃的异想体就会被吸进去。

key: Employees with Temperance Level 2 or lower should not work with $0, as inside $0’s Containment Unit, #0 went insane. $0 remember their previous owner.
value: 节制等级为 2 级或以下的员工不应与 $0 工作，因为在 $0 的收容单元内，#0 发疯了。$0 记得它以前的主人。

value: 节制等级为 3 级或以下的员工，在 $0 出逃时会因它的攻击受到大量白色伤害。

value: 确实如此。我们的主管将他的最后请求托付给了我；那便是永远封存这一切，并赐予你们，亲爱的赛菲拉们，永恒的安息。

value: 被蛊惑的员工一离开停电波及的部门，便从恍惚中解脱出来。

key: Energy production is not the end of the process. We must refine the energy and it takes additional time out of the workday. However, compared to your management time, it is a brief moment.
value: 能量生产并非过程的终点。我们必须对能量进行精炼，这需要占用工作日中的额外时间。然而，与你的管理时间相比，那只是短暂的一瞬。

key: Então esse lugar será chamado de Biblioteca.
value: 那么，这个地方将被命名为图书馆。

value: 那么，这意味着外面的所有人都以某种方式改变了吗？

value: 那么我们终于要被关闭了吗？啊，我们终于可以休息了！

key: Então nós vamos ser desativados? Finalmente iremos descansar!
value: 那么我们会被停用吗？我们终于要休息了！

key: Então, eu preciso que vocês durmam.
Então, o que vocês tanto tagarelam aí?
value: 那么，你们在那儿叽叽喳喳些什么？

key: Então, será que isto quer dizer que todos lá fora mudaram?
value: 那么，这是否意味着外面的所有人都改变了？
那是一件截然不同的事物。

key: Essa experiência fez nascer algo novo dentro de mim.
value: 这场实验在我心中催生了某种新的东西。

key: Essas sementes incompletas deram poderes instáveis à humanidade,
value: 这些不完整的种子，赋予了人类不稳定的力量，

key: Esses humanos… terão aqueles que manifestarão seu poder, e aqueles que serão consumidos por esse poder.
value: 这些人类……有的人将展现出自己的力量，有的人则将被那股力量吞噬。

key: Est-ce que ça veut dire que tout le monde dehors s’est transformé d’une manière ou d’une autre ?
value: 这是否意味着外面的所有人都以某种方式改变了？

key: Esta experiencia deu à luz algo dentro de mim.
value: 这场经历在我体内孕育出了某种东西。

key: Este lugar será a minha nova casa.
value: 这个地方将成为我的新家。

key: Este é o descanso que vós sempre quisestes.
value: 这是你们一直渴望的安息。

key: Este é um belo final, não é?
value: 这是一个美好的结局，不是吗？

key: Estou certa que todos vocês tentarão me parar…
value: 我确信你们所有人都会试图阻止我……

key: Estou feliz que esta história acaba assim. Eu tenho a certeza que o Enoque estaria feliz com este final.
value: 我很高兴这个故事以这样的方式结束。我确信以诺会对这个结局感到欣慰。

key: Estou grata que a história termine assim. Enoch ficaria bastante feliz…
value: 我很感激故事能以这样的方式结束。以诺一定会非常高兴……

key: Estão a falar sobre o quê?
Et pourtant je n’étais pas le “résultat” qu’il désirait, alors il en est venu à m’exécrer. Ses yeux se remplissaient de dégoût chaque fois qu’il regardait dans ma direction.
value: 然而，我并不是他所期望的“结果”，于是他开始厌恶我。每当他朝我这边看过来时，他的眼中都充满嫌恶。

key: Eternal guilt will likely be the greatest of all punishments for #0.
value: 永恒的罪咎，对 #0 来说可能是所有惩罚中最重的一种。

Eu acho que gostaria de continuar vivendo.
value: 我想，我愿意继续活下去。

value: 我想，微笑是一个人所能做出的最有人情味的举动。

value: 我可以回答你。“而光的种子，被播撒在城中每个人的心里。”完。

key: Eu estarei aqui com as pobres almas que estão perdidas e abandonadas.
value: 我会与那些迷失而遭遗弃的可怜灵魂同在。

key: Eu estarei aqui com as pobres almas que se perderam e que foram abandonadas.
value: 我会与那些迷失了方向、遭到遗弃的可怜灵魂同在。

key: Eu experienciei literalmente um milhão de anos.
value: 我确确实实经历了一百万年。

key: Eu farei o que minha alma me dizer.
value: 我会做我的灵魂指引我做的事。

key: Eu fiz o design dela. Não importa o quão antigo um evento seja, ela lembra-se dele tão vividamente como se tivesse acontecido ontem.
value: 我参与了她的设计。无论一件事有多么久远，她都会像发生在昨天一样清晰地记得它。

key: Eu gostaria de continuar a viver.
Eu irei construir a mais preciosa das bibliotecas, erguida apenas para mim.

key:
Experiment 1_<Possibility of communication> 

      We have concluded that this abnormality possesses intelligence that is equivalent of, or advanced than human. We proceeded to give simple lectures on human language. As a result, we were able to communicate with it in some form. The followings are documented text of the conversation record. 

      Q: Do your race all look the same as you?

      A: Negative. Outside. Child. See. Picture. Face. Happiness. Change. Shape.
 

      Q: Why are you here?

      A: Knowledge. Give. Human. 


      Q: Why are you trying to give us the knowledge?

      A: Understand. Knowledge. Moment. Know. Universe. Coincidence. Negative. No.

      The followings are the result of efforts to comprehend the abnormality’s words.

      1.	It took its form referencing to a child’s painting, and because the child looked happy, it changed the shape.

      2.	It came here to give humanity their knowledge, the moment we understand this knowledge, we will know the goal behind its action. 

      3.	There are no coincidences in the universe.
value:
实验 1_<交流的可能性>
  /  /       我们得出结论，这个异想体拥有与人类相当或更高的智力。我们随后进行了简单的人类语言教学。结果，我们得以与它进行某种形式的交流。以下是对话记录的文字记载。
  /  /       Q：你的种族都长得和你一样吗？
  /       A：否定。外面。孩子。看见。图画。脸。幸福。改变。形状。
  /  /       Q：你为什么会在这里？
  /       A：知识。给予。人类。
  /  /       Q：你为什么试图把知识给予我们？
  /       A：理解。知识。时刻。知晓。宇宙。巧合。否定。没有。
  /  /       以下是我们努力解读该异想体话语的结果。
  /  /       1. 它以一幅孩子的画为原型，因为画中的孩子看起来很开心，所以它改变了形状。
  /       2. 它来到这里是为了将知识给予人类；当我们理解这些知识的那一刻，我们就会知道它行动背后的目的。
  /       3. 宇宙中不存在巧合。

key:
Experiment_1 <The Possibility of Communication>

      We have determined that the Abnormality has an intelligence similar to (or even higher than) that of humans, and gave it a simple language learning course. As a result, a crude communication by combining words has become possible. The following is a segment of the communication record with the Abnormality.

      Q: Are all of your kind similar in appearance?
      A: Negative. Outside. Child. See. Picture. Face. Happy. Change. Form.

      Q: Why have you come here?
      A: Knowledge. Share. Human.

      Q: Why do you want to share your knowledge with us?
      A: Understanding. Knowledge. Moment. Know. Universe. Coincidence. Negative; None.

This section is an attempt to decipher the conversation with the Abnormality.

      1. It based its form on a picture drawn by a child. It changed its form because the child's expression while drawing it was happy.
      2. It came here to share its species’ knowledge with us. The moment we fully understand that knowledge, we will know their ultimate goal.
      3. There is no such thing as a coincidence in the universe.
value:
实验 1 <交流的可能性>
  /  /       我们已确定该异想体拥有与人类相似（甚至更高）的智力，并为它安排了一门简单的语言学习课程。结果，通过组合词汇进行粗略交流成为可能。以下是与该异想体交流记录的一段节选。
  /  /       Q：你们所有同类的外貌都相似吗？
  /       A：否定。外面。孩子。看见。图画。脸。开心。改变。形态。
  /  /       Q：你为何来到这里？
  /       A：知识。分享。人类。
  /  /       Q：你为何想与我们分享你的知识？
  /       A：理解。知识。时刻。知晓。宇宙。巧合。否定；无。
  /  /       本节是我们试图破译与该异想体对话的内容。
  /  /       1. 它以一幅孩子画的画为原型。它改变形态，是因为孩子画画时的表情是开心的。
  /       2. 它来到这里，是为了与我们分享其种族的知识。当我们完全理解那些知识的那一刻，我们就会知道它们的最终目标。
  /       3. 宇宙中不存在所谓的巧合。

key:
Experiment_2 <An Experiment on Laughter>

      After watching a video about laughing for 30 minutes, the Abnormality understood the concept of “laughing”. After that, when employees entered its Containment Unit to work with it, it would sometimes emit a strange noise with what appeared to be the shape of a smile on its face. It looked like it was mimicking laughter.
value:
实验 2 <关于笑的实验>
  /  /       在观看了一段 30 分钟的笑声视频后，该异想体理解了“笑”的概念。此后，当员工进入它的收容单元与它工作时，它有时会发出一种奇怪的声响，脸上还带着看似微笑的形状。它看起来像是在模仿笑声。

key:
Experiment_2 <Reaction to laughter>

      After being exposed to the video of laughter for 30 minutes, it perceived the facial expression of laughter. After this experiment, when an employee enters its chamber, it sometimes rips its bottom in lengthways and makes eerie sound. It is assumed to be imitation of laughter.
value:
实验 2 <对笑的反应>
  /  /       在接触了 30 分钟的笑声视频后，它感知到了笑这种面部表情。在此实验之后，当员工进入它的房间时，它有时会纵向撕开自己的下半部分，发出诡异的声音。推测这是在模仿笑声。

key:
Experiment_3 <Comprehension of Symbols>

      We taught it the meaning of various symbols along with language. Among them was the shape of a heart. This symbol provoked a distinct change from the Abnormality.

      Q (Showing the Abnormality a picture of a heart): This is the symbol of the “heart”. Many people believe that emotions come from the heart, and this symbol is used to express positive emotions or a liking towards someone.
      (Omitted)

      Afterwards, several symbols resembling hearts were seen on the Abnormality’s body. It seemed to understand that the symbol could be used to express friendliness towards humans.

      Combining the results of the previous two experiments, we can confirm that this Abnormality is non-hostile to humans, and wishes to become friends.
value:
实验 3 <对符号的理解>
  /  /       我们在教它语言的同时，也教它各种符号的含义。其中就有心形。这个符号引起了该异想体的明显反应。
  /  /       Q（向异想体展示一幅心形图画）：这是“心”的符号。许多人相信情感源自心脏，这个符号被用来表达积极的情感或对某人的好感。
  /       （省略）
  /  /       之后，可以看到该异想体身上出现了几个形似心形的符号。它似乎明白了这个符号可以用来向人类表达友好。
  /  /       结合前两次实验的结果，我们可以确认该异想体对人类没有敌意，并且希望成为朋友。

key:
Experiment_3 <Comprehension of symbols>;

      As we taught this abnormality our language, we also gave lectures about the meanings of symbols. The abnormality had a special reaction to the symbol of heart. 

      Q: (Showing the heart symbol) This is a symbol representing a heart. People think emotions come from hearts, so this symbol is often used to express one’s positive feelings to others.

      (Omitted)

      Later, we saw symbols similar to “hearts” drawn on this abnormality’s body. It is assumed that the abnormality understood the meaning of heart symbol as friendly approach. 

      Considering the results of experiments, the abnormality does not possess any hostility towards humanity, rather, it is trying to be friendly.
value:
实验 3 <对符号的理解>；
  /  /       在我们教这个异想体我们的语言时，我们同时也讲解了符号的含义。这个异想体对心形符号有特殊的反应。
  /  /       Q：（展示心形符号）这是代表心的符号。人们认为情感源自心脏，因此这个符号常被用来向他人表达积极的情感。
  /       （省略）
  /  /       后来，我们看到这个异想体身上出现了类似“心形”的符号。推测该异想体已理解心形符号意味着友好的接近。
  /  /       综合实验结果来看，这个异想体对人类并不怀有任何敌意，相反，它正试图表现得友善。

Finally, one afternoon the apple gained the ability to move on its own. It thought of the princess and the prince who left happily. Snow White had also been sleeping for a long time, but a prince came and woke her up. The apple, now a princess in its own right, no longer needed a prince; she began to embark on a journey.
      - Excerpt from ‘The Hidden Stories in Fairy Tales No One Knew’ (Author unknown)
value:
终于，一个下午，那颗苹果获得了自行移动的能力。它想起了那位公主和幸福离去的王子。白雪公主也曾沉睡了很久，但一位王子前来唤醒了她。那颗苹果，如今自己也成了公主，不再需要王子；她踏上了属于自己的旅程。
  /       - 摘自《无人知晓的童话隐藏故事》（作者不详）

key: Half of a pair that is missing each other.

Happiness became obsession, obsession became greed, and the greed forever solidified to become a golden amber. The happiness in the beginning, still holding a smile, dwells inside.

The first seed of desire originated from the pure yearning for happiness. The tiny seed grew larger and larger, hungering for more. Over time, the seed hardened and turned into a piece of shiny gem. Enticed by its sheen, a starving fish swallowed it. But it only made the fish even hungrier.

The desires of people usually go unfulfilled. Many desires are abandoned, but they are not completely gone. They hide deep in the subconscious, lurking at the bottom of the lake, ready to spring up at any moment.

However, the yearning for happiness may also rear its head from time to time, darting its tongue like a snake.

As soon as a tiny piece of bait falls into the river, the hungry fish will come up and snatch it in an instant. We delude ourselves to be highly rational beings who are in full control of these things, but it's such a preposterous belief, it's laughable. We don't have as much control over ourselves as we believe.

The magical girl, who was no longer a magical girl, ate many things.

Authority, money, fame, and many other forms of pleasure. She ended up eating away anything in her sight. Now, only visceral greed remains.
value:
幸福化为执念，执念化为贪婪，而贪婪最终凝固成一块金色琥珀。最初的那份幸福仍带着微笑，栖息其中。

欲望的第一粒种子，源于对幸福纯粹的渴望。微小的种子越长越大，渴求着更多。随着时间推移，种子渐渐硬化，化作一枚闪亮的宝石。一条饥饿的鱼被它的光泽吸引，将它吞下。可这反而让鱼更加饥饿。

人的欲望往往无法得到满足。许多欲望被弃置一旁，但它们并未彻底消失。它们深藏在潜意识之中，潜伏于湖底，随时准备一跃而出。

然而，对幸福的渴求也会不时探出头来，像蛇一样吐着信子。

只要有一小块饵食落入河中，饥饿的鱼便会立刻浮上来，瞬间将其攫走。我们自欺欺人地以为自己是高度理性的存在，能完全掌控这一切，可这种想法荒谬得可笑。我们对自身的掌控，远没有自己以为的那么多。

那位已不再是魔法少女的魔法少女，吞噬了许多东西。

权力、金钱、名望，以及种种其他形式的欢愉。她最终把她目之所及的一切都吃掉了。如今，只剩下源自脏腑的贪婪。

key: Have you experienced death before? It’s hard to believe, but it’s just you and me here. I am merely an AI with a voice, and there are entities that can hardly even be called monsters crawling outside. Now, may I hope that you finally understand the gravity of the situation?
value: 你体验过死亡吗？难以置信吧，但这里只有你和我。我不过是一个有声音的 AI，而外面爬行着一些几乎称不上怪物的存在。现在，我希望你终于明白事态的严重性了？

value: 你也失去过珍视的东西吗……？

value: 死后有人为你哀悼，是一种福分。

key:
He always had to wear a straitjacket. Some say he was a death row inmate from a federal prison. The researchers were always cautious around him. They felt that the straitjacket couldn't contain him.

The researchers wanted to study a murderer's brain to prove that innate evil existed. It was difficult to determine who was worse: A man who murdered the innocent with no remorse, or the researchers who wanted to open up his brain to satiate their curiosity.
value:
他总得穿着束身衣。有人说他是联邦监狱的死囚。研究人员在他身边总是格外谨慎。他们觉得束身衣根本困不住他。

研究人员想研究杀人犯的大脑，以证明天生的邪恶是存在的。很难判断谁更恶劣：一个毫无悔意地杀害无辜者的人，还是那些为了满足好奇心而想打开他大脑的研究人员。

key: He had flesh for the first time in a long while, and its taste was so good. In the corner of his eye, a familiar piece of red cloth stood out from the wardrobe. He may or may not have seen it before, but he didn't really care about it. Since then, it got harder and harder to keep himself in check. Still, it didn’t matter to him. After all, he was “destined” to be a big bad wolf.
value: 许久以来他第一次尝到了血肉，那滋味如此美妙。眼角的余光里，衣橱中一块熟悉的红布格外显眼。他或许见过它，或许没有，但他并不真的在意。从那以后，他越来越难以克制自己。不过，他不在乎。毕竟，他“注定”要成为一只大恶狼。

key: He needed me for his plan more than anyone else, but I was not a part of his ending, just as I was not a part of his prologue.
value: 在他的计划里，他比任何人都需要我，可我既不属于他的结局，也不属于他的开场。

key: He wanted me to watch over him just like Carmen did when he was left all alone. What a pitiable coward.
value: 他希望我像卡门那样看护他，在他孤身一人的时候。多么可怜的懦夫。

key: He/she could end up in “medium” only for the elevators.
value: 他/她只有在乘电梯时才会被归入“中等”。

key: He/she gets depressed for few days if his/her favorite anime character dies. But he/she would try to act as if nothing has happened.
value: 如果最喜欢的动漫角色死了，他/她会消沉好几天。但他/她会努力装作什么都没发生。

key: He/she is not amazingly fast but not really slow either. The middle way always works.
value: 他/她算不上飞快，也不算慢。中庸之道总是行得通。

value: 他/她是那种去鬼屋看朋友被吓、然后拿这事取笑他们一辈子的人。

key: He/she is unstoppable. He/she never gets tired. If he/she gets severely injured or killed, it’s entirely your fault.
value: 他/她势不可挡，永远不会累。如果他/她受了重伤或死了，那完全是你 的错。

key: He/she thinks watching zombie movies is the most worthless and futile thing in the world.
value: 他/她觉得看僵尸电影是世界上最无意义、最徒劳的事。

key: He/she will be waiting for another order even before you finish issuing one.
value: 你还没下完命令，他/她就已经在等待下一个命令了。

key: Heed me, thou that are more azure than justice and more crimson than love…
value: 听我说，你这比正义更蔚蓝、比爱情更绯红的存在……

key: Hell, some of them may even manifest their own E.G.O like I did in the past.
value: 见鬼，其中一些甚至可能像我过去那样，展现出自己的 E.G.O。

value: 喂，主管？能听到我吗？你看起来相当心烦意乱。你该不会失去理智了吧？现在你该明白，当主管可没你想的那么容易。所以振作起来，是时候纠正你的错误了。

value: 你好，主管。欢迎来到脑叶公司。从今天起，你负责管理我们所拥有的异想体，并确保我们达成每日的能量配额。

key: Help me! Please! I want to get out of here! Just open the emergency door!
value: 救命！求你了！我想离开这里！快打开应急门！

key: Help me, I wanna go home, please open the emergency door.
value: 救命，我想回家，求求你打开应急门。

key: Her eyes are unfocused, and she’s forcing an unusually dreary smile.
value: 她的目光涣散，勉强挤出一个异常阴郁的微笑。

key: Her flames flicker, blackening the floor and everything around her.

value: 她那贫寒的父母总说：“虽然我们没有什么能留给你的，但我们拥有最宝贵的财富——诚实与勤勉。这些现在或许帮不了你大忙，但总有一天会让你们都过上幸福的生活。”

value: 她的无数故事曾令人着迷，但久而久之，一道诅咒渗入了她的童话。

Her “Magic Shoes” occasionally click together, making a cheerful sound.

value: 嘿，#0，#0。这里有没有一只胖乎乎的小猪？哦，没什么要紧的。他是我的朋友，我只是想看看他现在过得怎么样。

key: His disciples will be born again as ones who shall reach out to those far away from the light, ones who shall embrace their neighbors, missionaries who shall spread the gospel to all their fellows. They are…
value: 他的门徒将重生为这样的人：向远离光明之人伸出援手，拥抱自己的邻人，向所有同胞传播福音的传道者。他们……

value: 嗯？你觉得这是谁的责任？

value: 嗯？你觉得谁该为此负责？

key: Hm? Who do you think is the one responsible for this?
value: 嗯？你觉得谁该为此负责？

key: Hmph! It’s going to be a bit tough.
How about installing a beer vending machine in the staff lounge? I bet employee morale would skyrocket.
value: 要不要在员工休息室装一台啤酒自动贩卖机？我敢打赌员工士气会飙升。

key:
How it felt? I can't find the words to describe it. Remember the greatest happiness you've ever felt in your life? This feeling would be hundreds of times better.

You say I'm the last employee in charge of Porccubus? That's understandable, as the brain craves more intense stimulation. At first, all I had to do was be lightly pricked by one of the thorns. Now I have to rub my whole body against it to get the same high.

I feel like all the blood in my body will rush to my head, eventually bursting it. I’ve already imagined my head bursting thousands of times anyhow.
value:
那是什么感觉？我找不到言语来形容。还记得你人生中感受过的最大的幸福吗？这种感觉要好上几百倍。

你说我是负责菠萝怪的最后一名员工？可以理解，因为大脑渴求更强烈的刺激。起初，我只需要被一根刺轻轻扎一下。如今，我得把整个身体贴上去蹭，才能获得同样的快感。

我感觉全身的血液都会涌上头顶，最终把脑袋撑爆。反正，我已经想象过自己的脑袋爆裂几千次了。

key: How many hours left till we can leave?
value: 还有几个小时才能下班？

value: 主管到底能拿多少薪水？肯定比我们高出一大截吧？

The number on the left indicates the Virtue Level an Agent needs to perform that level of work. Please unlock all this information now.

value: 光芒如何闪耀，因人心中各有不同。不是每个人都会那么突然地改变。

key: How to recognize this Abnormality is a matter that needs to be discussed further. Currently, we are researching ultraviolet technology that may be able to detect the Abnormality using the eyes of shrimp, but the performance so far has been far from satisfactory. For now, a good method is to have employees entering its Containment Unit bring a glass cup filled only halfway with water. They will need to place this cup on the floor while working. If the cup begins to slosh, threatening to spill over, the employee must stop working and leave the unit immediately.
value: 如何识别这异想体，是需要进一步讨论的问题。目前，我们正在研究一种或许能利用虾的眼睛来探测异想体的紫外线技术，但迄今为止的效果远不能令人满意。眼下，一个不错的方法是让进入其收容单元的员工带一只只装了半杯水的玻璃杯。工作时，他们需要把杯子放在地板上。如果杯中的水开始晃动、眼看要溢出来，员工必须立刻停止工作，离开单元。

key: However you expect, they will be late. Actually, he/she doesn’t even try to finish the job before today.
value: 无论你怎么期待，他/她都会迟到。实际上，他/她甚至不会试着在今天之前完成工作。

key: However, A put a part of Carmen inside me.
value: 然而，A 把卡门的一部分放进了我体内。

key: However, Abnormalities are more beautiful when they are themselves.
value: 然而，异想体做自己的时候才更美丽。
