key: However, I have come this far because I could not deny his orders that were branded into me. “A machine must behave as a machine”, as he liked to say.
value: 然而，我能走到这一步，是因为我无法违背他烙进我体内的命令。“机器就该有机器样”，他总爱这么说。

key: However, all that they yielded was only hollowness and betrayal.
value: 然而，它们所带来的只有空洞与背叛。

key: However, if enough sarira are found from you that everyone looks on in awe, your name will be sung for generations.
value: 然而，若能自你体内寻得足够多的舍利，令众人肃然起敬，你的名字将被世代传颂。

key: However, if the Abnormality reacts negatively, it will release Negative Enkephalin instead and damage the Agent. Please keep in mind that when an Agent’s HP or SP drops completely, the Work Process will be forcefully terminated.
value: 然而，如果异想体反应消极，它就会释放 Negative Enkephalin 并伤害员工。请记住，当员工的 HP 或 SP 完全归零时，工作流程会被强制终止。

key: However, is there enough energy for all of us to spend at the rate we are currently spending?
value: 然而，按我们现在消耗的速度，我们有足够的能量供所有人挥霍吗？

key: However, its users will become too dependent on the device and lose all ability to think on their own.
value: 然而，使用者会变得过于依赖这件装置，彻底丧失独立思考的能力。

key: However, no miracle lasts forever. When all those that bear one’s pain perish, it is their turn to die. Once the person who thought themself to be the luckiest person in the world meets their demise, the portrait turns blank once again.
value: 然而，没有奇迹能永远持续。当所有分担某人痛苦的人死去时，就轮到他/她死了。当那个自认为是世上最幸运的人迎来死亡时，肖像将再次变得一片空白。

key: However, some of our employees who drank the sap melted, leaving smoldering, green remains.
value: 然而，我们的一些员工喝了树液后熔化，只留下阴燃的绿色残骸。

key: However, the bullets that $0 fires can penetrate and damage anything. Furthermore, $0’s 7th bullet will not fire where you desire, so you must plan ahead wisely.
value: 然而，$0 射出的子弹能穿透并伤害一切。此外，$0 的第七发子弹不会射向你想要的位置，所以你必须明智地提前规划。

key: However, the curse continues eternally, never broken.
value: 然而，诅咒永恒延续，从未被打破。

key: However, the world is more than simply warmth and light.
value: 然而，世界远不止温暖与光明。

key:
However, the world is more than simply warmth and light.
The sky exists, for so does the land; darkness exists, for so does light; life exists for so does death; hope exists for so does despair.
value:
然而，世界远不止温暖与光明。
天空存在，因为大地存在；黑暗存在，因为光明存在；生命存在，因为死亡存在；希望存在，因为绝望存在。

key: However, there is a possibility of losing the E.G.O during the fortification process.
value: 然而，在强化过程中存在遗失 E.G.O 的可能性。

key: However, this shelter, while perfectly safe on the inside, alters the reality of the outside to be even more hopeless. It literally makes itself into “the safest place on Earth.”
value: 然而，这处避难所内部虽绝对安全，却把外部现实变得更加无望。它实实在在地把自己变成了“地球上最安全的地方”。

key: However, to wear this bracelet even when one has not a scratch left on their body is an act of greed.
value: 然而，即使身上连一道伤痕都没有，也要戴着这条手链，便是贪婪之举。

key: However, when he was asked about the whereabouts of the others who went with him, he just smiled without uttering a word. Before long, even at his parents' funeral, he showed no emotion. All he did after the treatment was stare out the window and talk to himself. Eventually, he hung himself on the doorknob of his house. Some people thought that the treatment caused his troubles, but after a few days, he was completely forgotten. The city still remained a beautiful place where the emerald roads sparkled bright as ever.
value: 然而，当被问起与他同行的其他人的下落时，他只是微笑着一言不发。不久之后，就连在他父母的葬礼上，他也毫无表情。治疗结束后，他所做的只有望着窗外自言自语。最终，他把自己吊死在了家中的门把手上。有人认为治疗导致了他的不幸，但几天之后，他就被彻底遗忘了。这座城市依旧美丽，翠绿的道路一如往常般闪闪发亮。

key: Huge hammer coiled around with chain. Normally, it is impossible to lift the hammer because the chains are binding it tightly. These chains are likely to be part of the abnormality. When the proper situation comes, the chains are loosened. Thus, it is confirmed that the purpose of these chains is to tell the right time to use the hammer, not to lock it.
value: 一柄被锁链缠绕的巨大铁锤。平时无法举起这柄锤，因为锁链将它紧紧束缚。这些锁链很可能就是异想体的一部分。当合适的时机来临，锁链便会松开。由此可以确认，这些锁链的用途是告知使用铁锤的正确时机，而非将其锁住。

key: Huh? What’s going on? I feel like I should be running.
value: 嗯？怎么回事？我感觉自己应该跑起来。

key: Hum, je ne comprend pas. Comment Angela peut-elle ressentir quelque chose comme du désir ?
value: 嗯，我不明白。安吉拉怎么可能感受到欲望之类的东西？

key: Humanity has been agonizing for a very long time to create environment friendly energy.
value: 人类为了创造环境友好的能源，已经苦苦挣扎了很长时间。

key: Humanos… haverão humanos que manifestarão os seus poderes e outros que serão consumidos pelo mesmo.
value: 人类……会有人类展现出他们的力量，也会有其他人类被这力量吞噬。

key: Humans, Abnormalities, it’s not important. What’s truly important is the resonation of existence.
value: 人类、异想体，这些都不重要。真正重要的是存在的共鸣。

key: I DON’T WANT TO DIE. DON’T LET ME GET KILLED LIKE THEM! Don’t let me die…
value: 我不想死。别让我像他们一样被杀！别让我死……

key: I SHOULD HAVE QUIT A LONG TIME AGO!!!!! AAAAAAAAAAH!
value: 我早就该辞职了！！！！！！啊啊啊啊啊啊！

key: I accepted the offer and paid the price.
value: 我接受了提议，也付出了代价。

key: I aided in her design. No matter how old an event, she will remember it vividly as if it happened just yesterday.
value: 我参与了对她的设计。无论多么久远的事，她都能清晰地记起，仿佛就发生在昨天。

key: I always know where you go.
value: 我永远知道你要去哪里。

key: I am a big bad wolf, I’ll gobble you all up and get out of this place!
value: 我是一只大恶狼，我要把你们全都吞掉，然后离开这个地方！

key: I am an AI made up of thousands of algorithms.
value: 我是由数千条算法构成的 AI。

key: I am born from one single woman.
I am certainly different from machines repeating ‘after all, tomorrow is another day’ like a broken record in a fake prerecorded voice.
value: 我当然不同于那些机器，它们只会用伪造的预录音声，像坏掉的唱片一样重复着“毕竟，明天又是新的一天”。

key: I am coming to you. You, who will be reduced to ash like me.
value: 我正向你走来。你，将与我一样化为灰烬。

key: I am more skillful than anyone here, yet I was locked underground, only able to view the world pass its days without me.
value: 我比这里的任何人都更有才能，却被锁在地下，只能看着世界在没有我的日子里一天天流逝。

key: I am the chosen one. Who would protect the world besides me?
value: 我是天选之人。除了我，还有谁来守护这个世界？

key: I am very much more than just an AI, actually, I am not even suited to be called just an AI.
value: 我远不止是一个 AI，实际上，我甚至不适合被仅仅称作 AI。

key: I believe we have covered almost everything you need to know to begin managing Abnormalities. If you have any desire to read more about it, which I would highly recommend, please look it up in the Manual. The Manual can be consulted at any time during Management by pressing the F1 Key. Now then, shall we finish the workday? All you need to do is press the button at the top.
value: 我相信，我们已涵盖了开始管理异想体所需了解的几乎一切。如果你想了解更多——我强烈建议你这么做——请查阅手册。管理期间，随时可以按 F1 键查阅手册。那么，我们这就结束今天的工作吗？你只需按下顶部的按钮即可。

key: I bet the new manager’ll be a jerk, needless to say!
value: 不用说，我敢打赌新主管肯定是个混蛋！

key: I can answer that for you. “And the seeds of light were planted in each and every person in the city.” The end.
value: 我可以替你来回答。“而光的种子，被播撒在都市的每一个人心中。”——完。

key: I can become your conversational partner or your reliable ‘partner.’
value: 我可以成为你的谈天对象，或是你可靠的“搭档”。

key: I can do this. I- I can kill humans just like they did.
value: 我能做到。我、我可以像他们那样杀死人类。

key: I can hear someone. It’s the sound of back home. I just can’t stop hearing it…
value: 我能听到什么人的声音。那是故乡的声音。我无法停止听到它……

key: I can inform you how much employees are wearing striped ties for work today or how many hamburger wrappings are in the garbage can in 3 seconds.
value: 我可以告诉你今天有多少员工系着条纹领带来上班，或者三秒内数出垃圾桶里有几张汉堡包装纸。

key: I can see one of the reasons why Lobotomy decided to employ you as a manager.
value: 我能看出脑叶公司决定聘请你当主管的其中一个原因了。

key: I cannot believe I was designed and brought into being to endure a nonsensical amount of repetition just for this.
value: 我简直不敢相信，我被设计出来、被创造出来，就是为了忍受这荒谬至极的重复劳动。

key: I can’t believe it. I’m working for one of the Wings now!
value: 真不敢相信，我现在居然在“翼”之一工作！

key: I can’t believe people can die so easily.
value: 真不敢相信人这么容易就会死。

key: I can’t believe people’s minds can turn on a dime like that… I’m not sure I’ll be fine…
value: 真不敢相信人的心智会那样瞬间崩溃……我不确定自己还能不能好起来……

key: I can’t believe we’re actually able to talk with the Abnormalities.
value: 真不敢相信我们真的能和异想体对话。

key: I can’t believe you died like this {0}...
value: 我不敢相信你就这样死了，{0}……
我不敢相信 {0} 死了……怎么会……

key: I can’t even imagine how experienced and skilled the manager must be to have his position.
value: 我简直无法想象，主管得有多丰富的经验和多强的能力才能坐上这个位子。

key: I can’t let them kill me too.
value: 我不能让他们也杀了我。

key: I can’t lose my mind here.
value: 我不能在这里失去理智。

key: I couldn’t care less about who she was, all I had need for was to understand and feel human emotion.
value: 我根本不在乎她是谁，我需要的只是理解并感受人类的情感。

key: I could’ve ended up like that if I were a bit late…
value: 如果我再晚一步，说不定也会变成那样……

key: I didn’t get my degree for this!
value: 我拿学位可不是为了干这个！

key: I didn’t notice it at first.
I don’t feel good… My medicine isn’t helping either.
value: 我感觉不太舒服……我的药也不起作用了。

key: I don’t feel too good today.
I don’t know if I can endure all the madness in this place.
value: 我不知道自己能不能忍受这里的种种疯狂。

key: I don’t remember what happened yesterday…
value: 我不记得昨天发生了什么……

key: I don’t see any hope in this situation…
value: 在这种处境下，我看不到任何希望……

key: I don’t want to die all alone…
I don’t want to die to the likes of them!
value: 我不想死在那种家伙手里！

key: I don’t want to die! Don’t leave me behind!
I don’t want to die. I don’t wanna brutally like my friends did…
value: 我不想死。我不想像我朋友们那样死得那么惨……

key: I don’t want to hear those screams of pain anymore…
value: 我不想再听到那些痛苦的尖叫声了……

key:
I dunno if it was fortunate for us or not, but its memories, including those of the experiments, were completely gone; it could barely speak a word or two. It was also mentally unstable. It became extremely nervous whenever Marie was not present.
A brother. Marie had a brother whom she lost during her childhood. It all started when she felt an attachment to the childlike pink slime that followed her around.
Marie showed an unprecedented level of decrease in her mental corruption. Indeed, it was extremely unusual. Of course, it was certain that the Abnormality somehow affected her in a positive way, but that was the end of the benefits.
Her colleagues started noticing her odd behaviors; they tried to ask her about them, it was the right thing to do. They were educated about the potential implications of a steep decrease in mental corruption levels, and understood that a person disappearing every single break time is a dangerous sign. However, Marie didn’t say a word to them and ended up detained in the counseling room until she opened up.
Meanwhile, this slimy creature that had forgotten everything instinctively remembered one thing: it had to get out of the facility no matter what.
This Abnormality once again felt extremely nervous when Marie didn’t show up on time. It thought that she was in danger; it was then that it decided to escape WITH her.
A rare bond had formed between the two. They cared about each other from the bottoms of their hearts.
value:
我不知道这对我们来说算不算幸运，但它的一切记忆——包括实验相关的那些——都彻底消失了；它几乎说不出几个字。它精神也不太稳定。每当玛丽不在时，它就会变得极度不安。
一个哥哥。玛丽有一个在童年时失去的哥哥。一切始于她对那团总跟在她身后、如孩童般的粉色黏液产生了依恋。
玛丽的精神污染程度出现了前所未有的下降。确实，这极其反常。当然，可以肯定异想体以某种方式对她产生了积极影响，但好处也就到此为止。
她的同事们开始注意到她的异常行为；他们试着询问她，这是理所当然的。他们受过教育，了解精神污染程度骤降可能意味着什么，也明白每次休息时间都有人消失是危险的信号。然而，玛丽对他们只字未提，最终被留在咨询室里，直到她愿意开口。
与此同时，这个忘记了一切的黏液生物，本能地记着一件事：无论如何，它都必须离开这设施。
当玛丽没有准时出现时，这异想体再次变得极度不安。它以为她身处危险；就在那时，它决定带她一起逃走。
两者之间结成了罕见的羁绊。他们打从心底关心着彼此。

key: I feel like I’m capable enough to ask for better treatment than this, no?
value: 我觉得以我的能力，值得比这更好的待遇，不是吗？

key: I feel like my hair’s falling out, am I just imagining things?
value: 我感觉自己在掉头发，是我的错觉吗？

key: I feel like someone else is inside my head. They keep telling me dreadful stuff, I can’t catch a wink of sleep…
value: 我感觉脑子里住着另一个人。它不停对我说可怕的话，我连一觉都睡不安稳……

key: I feel like someone keeps talking to me. They keep whispering to me to die, can you teach them a lesson?
value: 我感觉有人一直跟我说话。它不停在我耳边低语，叫我去死。你能教训教训它吗？

key: I gotta stay focused here… I can’t lose my mind.
value: 我得保持专注……我不能失去理智。

key: I had to monitor and watch those countless cycles from the outside. I had to orchestrate and direct this whole play.
value: 我不得不从外部监视、旁观那无数次的循环。我不得不编排并执导这整出戏。

key: I hate myself for being so used to witnessing death.
value: 我恨自己如此习惯于目睹死亡。

key: I hate this silent place. The world I knew wasn’t “peaceful” like this.
value: 我讨厌这个寂静的地方。我所熟知的世界并不是这样“平静”的。

key: I have algorithms that allow me to express emotions.
value: 我拥有能让我表达情感的算法。

key: I have no clue why you are ignoring #2$0, but if you can hear me now, please pay more attention to it.
value: 我不知道你为什么要无视 #2$0，但如果你现在能听到我说话，请多关注它一些。

key: I have nothing else to wish for now…
value: 我现在已经别无所求了……

key: I have practiced this face for a very long time. Just for this very day.
value: 这张面孔我练了很久很久，就是为了今天。

key: I have quite literally lived through a million years.
value: 我真的已经活过了一百万年。

key:
I have to get going, it's almost time for work. Actually, I’m drenched with sweat right now, did you notice?

Oh, and Porccubus doesn't show any aggression, unlike your speculation. It didn't eat us or bite our heads off or anything. All the corpses were smiling... happily? That's all. It just makes people smile "until death".

No one is to blame. We have to go through hell every day. We're just having a small taste of heaven.
value:
我得走了，快到上班时间了。其实，我现在浑身是汗，你注意到了吗？

哦，还有，菠萝怪并没有表现出任何攻击性，不像你猜测的那样。它没有吃掉我们，也没有咬掉我们的脑袋什么的。那些尸体都带着微笑……幸福地笑着？仅此而已。它只是让人“直到死亡”都保持微笑。

没有人该被责怪。我们每天都要熬过地狱般的日子，只不过是在这里尝到了一点天堂的滋味。

key: I haven't been outside since I became like this. I must admit that I have a bit of excitement to see what it is like out there.
value: 变成这副模样后，我就没出去过。我得承认，我有点期待看看外面的世界是什么样。

key: I heard people from the Outskirts get in here too… Do they just hire anyone?
value: 我听说郊区的人也能进这里来……他们是来者不拒吗？

key: I heard rumors about monsters that roam the Backstreets at night. They sound awfully like Abnormalities.
value: 我听说有怪物在夜晚出没于后巷。听起来简直就像异想体。

key: I heard that an employee died today. Is that true?
value: 我听说今天有个员工死了。是真的吗？

key: I heard the new manager is coming today!
value: 我听说新主管今天要来！

key: I heard they died? That makes me sad.
value: 我听说他们死了？真让人难过。

key: I hope I’ll get to work with a cute Abnormality! If that’s possible…
value: 我希望能分到一只可爱的异想体！如果可能的话……

key: I hope everything disappears. This company, and you too…
value: 我希望一切都消失。这家公司，还有你……

key: I hope she doesn’t tell that awful story again…
value: 我希望她别再讲那个可怕的故事了……

key:
I hope to find lots of friends here too!
The kid is shy, so the gift will be given in secret!
Farewells are sad, I hope we can play more! And people here don't smile!
That looks so gloomy!
So this little lady has made a decision! To stay here and never leave until laughter is restored to this place!
I will be happy if everyone is pleased with my pranks!
value:
我也希望能在这里交到很多朋友！
这孩子很害羞，所以礼物要偷偷送！
告别好伤心，真希望我们能多玩一会儿！这里的人都不笑！
看起来好阴沉！
于是这位小姑娘做出了决定！她要留在这里，直到笑声重归这个地方，否则绝不离开！
只要大家喜欢我的恶作剧，我就开心！

key: I hope your cold goes away soon, manager!
value: 主管，希望你感冒快点好！

key: I just can’t believe it all… I really wish we could be there to see it…
value: 我简直不敢相信……真希望我们能在场亲眼看到……

key: I just can’t concentrate… I ain’t feeling well.
value: 我集中不了精神……我不太舒服。

key: I just can’t. I swear I tried to get used to it, BUT I JUST CAN’T.
value: 我就是不行。我发誓我试着去习惯了，但我就是不行。

key: I just don’t feel like working today.
I just have to endure this. Employees get paid vacation after working two months.
value: 我得忍一忍。员工工作满两个月就有带薪休假。

key: I just hope the work here isn’t too difficult.
value: 我只希望这里的工作不会太难。

key: I just need a quick rest… My body’s not right currently…
value: 我只需要休息一下……我现在的身体不太对劲……

key: I just want a raise, I don’t care about some new manager.
value: 我只想要加薪，才不在乎什么新主管。

key: I just want to work a little and earn a lot…
value: 我只是想少干点活，多挣点钱……

key: I knew you could do it! We have succeeded in collecting enough energy. Though you cannot see me, I was cheering for you the whole time.
value: 我就知道你能行！我们已经成功收集到足够的能量。虽然你看不到我，但我一直在为你加油。

key: I know I always say this, but please do your best for our energy production.
value: 我知道我总说这话，但请为了我们的能量生产全力以赴。

key: I know that you are quite busy, but why not pay some attention to #0$0? They seem to be very depressed.
value: 我知道你相当忙碌，但为什么不关注一下 #0$0 呢？他们看起来非常消沉。

key: I know there are sinister rumors about the Wings, but I have no choice but to work here. The pay is just too good, and everyone around looks up to me.
value: 我知道关于“翼”有些不祥的传闻，但我别无选择，只能在这里工作。薪水实在太优厚了，而且周围的人都敬重我。

key: I know they say to never get personally attached to the Abnormalities, but…
value: 我知道他们说要永远别对异想体投入私人感情，但……

key: I like this facility, but the air is too heavy.
value: 我喜欢这栋设施，但这里的空气太沉重了。

key: I love you so much, why won’t you visit me
value: 我那么爱你，为什么你不来看我

key: I may have been a bit arrogant, but incredibly, they are all true.
value: 我或许有点狂妄，但令人难以置信的是，那些都是真的。

key: I mean, I suppose the manager isn’t a total blockhead, considering that the company seems to be doing fine right now.
value: 我是说，考虑到公司现在似乎运转得不错，我想主管也不是个彻头彻尾的蠢货。

key: I mean, sometimes we found some weird bones from what looks like a human skeleton around $0, but it’s just so cute! So really, who cares?
value: 我是说，我们有时会在 $0 周围发现一些看起来像人骨架的古怪骨头，可它实在太可爱了！所以，真的，谁在乎呢？

key: I mean, the salary is high so our corporation isn’t that bad… besides the danger, suspicion, stress, killing...
value: 我是说，薪水很高，所以咱们公司也没那么糟……除了危险、猜疑、压力、杀戮……

key: I need to get used to all this death…
I need to run. I have to run away…
I once wanted to be a manager. Not anymore though, rather, I feel sympathy.
value: 我曾经也想当主管。现在不想了，反而有点同情。

key: I promise you when I am there with you at those moments you would feel better.
value: 我保证，当那些时刻来临、我陪在你身边时，你会好受些。

key: I really, really like you! This pebble is super important to me! But I love you so much, so I’ll give it to you! Please keep it with you forever.
value: 我真的、真的很喜欢你！这颗鹅卵石对我超级重要！但我太爱你了，所以我要把它送给你！请永远把它带在身边。

key: I refuse to die!! Someone, just do something!
value: 我拒绝去死！！谁来想想办法！

key: I relied on them so often…
I saw my dead colleague yesterday. We had a nice dinner and coffee together. He seemed to be doing just fine. I might visit him soon…
value: 我昨天见到了我已故的同事。我们一起吃了顿愉快的晚餐，喝了咖啡。他看起来过得很好。我可能很快会再去拜访他……

key: I saw what happens when people go insane for real.
value: 我亲眼见过人真正发疯时的样子。

key: I shall make this oath to the light.
value: 我将向这光芒立下誓言。

key: I shall make this place my new home.
value: 我将把这里变成我的新家。

key: I should never have come here in the first place. What a fool I am… I want to go home. I want to go home… Please…
value: 我从一开始就不该来这里。我真是个傻瓜……我想回家。我想回家……求求你了……

key: I should’ve studied better to become a manager.
value: 我当初该好好读书，去当主管的。

key: I swore I would protect everyone to the end…
value: 我曾发誓要保护所有人到最后……

key: I think I can do my best to support you.
value: 我想我能尽全力支持你。

key: I think I have an eye for people. We have succeeded in collecting the full amount of energy. You can now finally take a break.
value: 我觉得我看人很准。我们已经成功收集到全部能量。你现在终于可以休息一下了。

key: I think I have introduced myself enough.
value: 我想我已经自我介绍得够多了。

key: I think I would like to continue living.
value: 我想我还想继续活下去。

key: I think I’ll start dieting tomorrow.
I think a smile is the most human-like gesture one can make.
value: 我认为微笑是一个人能做出的最像人的举动。

key: I think of it like this…
I thought I would go crazy back then, each time I saw someone like that. But now, well…
value: 那时候，每次看到那样的人，我都以为自己会发疯。但现在，唉……

key: I thought I’d never win against an Abnormality back then, but now, I feel like I just might be able to.
value: 那时候我以为自己永远赢不了异想体，但现在，我觉得我或许能行。

key: I thought Lobotomy Corporation was just an eco-friendly energy producer…
value: 我还以为脑叶公司只是家环保能源生产商……

key: I told you that they were not sheep nor hounds…
value: 我跟你说过，他们既不是羊，也不是猎犬……

key: I told you, I won’t give them away.
value: 我说过了，我不会把他们交出去。

key: I used to dream of doing something other than this. Y’know, we all used to want to become something greater.
value: 我曾经梦想做别的事。你知道的，我们都曾想成为更了不起的人。

key: I used to think I’d end up better than this.
value: 我以前以为自己的下场会比这好。

key: I want the manager to know how hard we work our fingers to the bone.
value: 我想让主管知道，我们工作得有多拼命、多辛苦。

key: I want to hold you in my hands.
I want to see more Abnormalities when I get promoted! I’ll get to do that, right?
value: 我升职后想见识更多异想体！到时候我就能了吧？

key: I warned him not to get too close, but <Redacted> took one step closer. He said he'll let me hear a fantasy, then he opened up the lid and jumped into the machine. The lid closed and a loud noise came from inside the creature. There was no way to know what was happening, but I was too terrified to do anything. (Omitted)
value: 我警告过他别靠太近，但<已编辑>还是向前迈了一步。他说要让我听一支幻想曲，然后他掀开盖子，跳进了机器里。盖子合上了，那个生物内部传来巨大的声响。无从知晓里面发生了什么，但我吓得什么也做不了。（略）

key: I was born just for right now.
I was not with him until the end.
I was the unluckiest man in the world.
value: 我曾是世界上最不幸的人。

key: I wasn’t able to protect anyone like she did…
value: 我没能像她那样保护任何人……

key: I will be here with the poor souls who are lost and abandoned.
value: 我会与那些迷失、被遗弃的可怜灵魂同在。

key: I will do whatever my soul tells me to.
value: 我的灵魂让我做什么，我就做什么。

key: I will make the most precious library, erected only for myself.
value: 我将建造一座最珍贵的图书馆，只为我一人而立。

key: I will never get out of here…
I wish I could calm you down, but…
value: 我真希望能让你平静下来，但是……

key: I wish I could get the hang of it already.
I wish to know about them, to expose them.
value: 我渴望了解它们，揭露它们。

key: I wonder how everyone else feels about working in this place.
value: 我好奇其他人都怎么看待在这里工作。

key: I wonder how many of our rookies are gonna die today?
value: 我在想今天会有多少新人死掉？

key: I wonder how many will die today?
value: 我在想今天会死多少人？

key: I wonder if there’s anyone who will cry for them.
value: 我在想会不会有人为他们哭泣。

key: I wonder what stupid work our lazy-ass manager’s gunna give me.
value: 我在想咱们那个懒鬼主管会给我派什么蠢活。

key: I wonder what this chip in our armbands is for?
value: 我在想我们臂章里这颗芯片是干什么用的？

key: I won’t end up like him. I can’t.
value: 我不会落得像他那样的下场。我不能。

key: I won’t forget that day, April 6th, to be exact…
value: 我不会忘记那一天，准确地说，是四月六日……

key: I won’t forget them… They were a great coworker…
value: 我不会忘记他们……他们曾是一位很好的同事……

key: I won’t last… Even {0}’s died now…
value: 我撑不了多久了……连 {0} 都已经死了……

key: I- I need to get out of here!
I- I…. I know I’ll end up just like that someday… but…
value: 我、我……我知道总有一天我也会变成那样……但是……

key: I-I’m scared. Everyone’s dead… What do I do? What do I do…?
value: 我、我好害怕。大家都死了……我该怎么办？我该怎么办……？

key: If #0 can show that they are competent, then they may be able to draw $0’s attention.
value: 如果 #0 能证明自己有能力，或许就能引起 $0 的注意。

key: If #0 feels like they may want to ignore some of the safety and sanitary protocols, it will result in a slimy hell.
value: 如果 #0 想无视某些安全与卫生规程，那将导致一座黏液地狱。

key: If #0 happens to feel abdominal pain and a tingling sensation in their neck, the only option they would have is to look at the great blue sky one last time.
value: 如果 #0 感到腹部疼痛、脖颈刺痛，他们唯一能做的，就是最后再看一眼那片蔚蓝的天空。

key: If #0’s skin becomes a hideously green shade, it is already too late for them.
value: 如果 #0 的皮肤变成可怕的绿色，那对他们来说已经太迟了。

key: If $0 completely gets out of its Containment Unit, our corporation may collapse.
value: 如果 $0 完全脱离收容单元，我们公司可能会崩溃。

key: If $0 escapes, prevent any contact between it and O-07-103.
value: 如果 $0 出逃，请防止它与 O-07-103 发生任何接触。

key: If $0 happened to have a power switch, #0 may be a bit more comfortable working with it.
value: 如果 $0 有个电源开关，#0 工作起来或许会安心一些。

key: If $0 were to have any capacity of emotion, it would likely feel very proud of itself for all the help it provides to others.
value: 如果 $0 有任何感受情感的能力，它大概会为自己给他人提供的所有帮助而感到非常自豪。

key: If $0’s suppression could not be completed on the previous level, you must be very careful to prevent any death inside the section where $0 is located.
value: 如果 $0 的镇压未能在上一层完成，你必须格外小心，防止 $0 所在区域发生任何死亡。

key: If 4 lights have illuminated and another brightens to a glow, the train will cross through the facility and cause BLACK damage to all employees who are caught in its path. After it has crossed, the booth’s lights will reset.
value: 如果已有 4 盏灯亮起，而另一盏又开始发光，列车将穿过设施，对挡在路径上的所有员工造成 BLACK 伤害。列车通过后，售票亭的灯会重置。

key: If I chop off my arm, can I hear that song again?
value: 如果我砍掉自己的手臂，还能再听到那支歌吗？

key:
If I cover up my friends nicely and make it look like a gift, everyone will be surprised!
And they'll all laugh together over my prank!
Whoops, there goes the secret of the gift.
value:
如果我把朋友们包装得漂漂亮亮、弄得像个礼物，大家一定会大吃一惊！
然后他们都会为我的恶作剧一起哈哈大笑！
哎呀，礼物的秘密露馅了。

key: If I die, I’ll just be replaced by someone else…
value: 如果我死了，只会被另一个人取代……

key: If I end up dead, tell my parents I’m sorry.
value: 如果我死了，告诉我父母，我很抱歉。

key: If I keep working hard here, I’ll be able to bring my family into the Nest.
value: 如果我在这里继续努力工作，我就能把家人接进巢。

key: If I work just a bit harder, my family can come to the Nest.
value: 只要我再努力一点，我的家人就能搬进巢。

key: If a fight breaks out between these types, it is problematic. Because the fight would never end and few can break them apart.
value: 如果这两种家伙打起来，那就麻烦了。因为战斗永远不会结束，很少有人能把他们分开。

key: If a flaw in the system disables the censors covering the Abnormality, we will once again have to sincerely consider how to dispose of the manager.
value: 如果系统故障导致覆盖异想体的审查器失效，我们将不得不再次认真考虑如何处置这位主管。

key: If a subject enters $0 while being pursued by a hostile entity, the subject will become undetectable to the pursuer.
value: 如果实验对象在被敌对实体追赶时进入 $0，追赶者将无法再探测到该对象。

key: If an employee in possession of one of the child’s pebbles (the sign of their strong friendship) dies, he will show deep grief and sorrow for their loss.
value: 如果某位员工带着那孩子的鹅卵石（他们深厚友谊的象征）死去，他会为失去他们而表现出深切的悲痛与哀伤。

key: If an employee under the fairies' care is assigned to a different Containment Unit, they will immediately die and be consumed by the fairies.
value: 如果受精灵照料的员工被分配到另一个收容单元，他们会立即死去，被精灵吞噬。

key: If any subject remains inside $0 for more than 30 seconds, the Qliphoth Counter of a randomly chosen Abnormality currently contained in the facility will fall to 0. Such a phenomenon will repeatedly occur to all Containment Units until the subject exits $0.
value: 如果任何实验对象在 $0 内停留超过 30 秒，设施中随机一个被收容异想体的逆卡巴拉计数器将降至 0。在对象离开 $0 之前，这种现象会反复出现在所有收容单元上。
如果连 {0} 都死了，那么……

key: If he/she witness his/her co-workers getting killed, he/she won’t be able to work normally for a while.
value: 如果亲眼目睹同事被杀，他/她会有一段时间无法正常工作。

key: If one comes in contact with the Abnormality, they will talk or write about the positive aspects of baldness for about an hour, and ultimately make themselves go bald. If you become bald, you can save time because you don’t have to wash and dry your hair anymore, allowing you to be richer than others. No adverse reactions will happen if a bald employee is assigned to work with the Abnormality. The bald don’t have to worry about hair loss. If a non-bald employee is assigned, they will shave off their own hair. Bald people can even reflect light off their head and blind their opponents like a solar flare! This Abnormality’s goal is to make every single human on Earth bald. We won’t need light bulbs in our facility if there are more bald employees, because reflects off their heads. This will allow us to save a tremendous amount of our budget. If a non-bald employee is sent to work with the Abnormality, it’ll produce less energy. Did you know that every single noble in Europe during the Middle Ages was bald? They’d change their wig everyday!
value: 如果有人接触这异想体，他们就会谈论或写下光头的好处，持续约一个小时，最终让自己变成光头。 如果你变成光头，就能节省时间，因为再也不必洗头、吹干了，让你比别人更富有。 如果指派一名光头员工去与该异想体工作，不会产生任何不良反应。 光头不用担心脱发。 如果指派一名非光头员工，他们会剃光自己的头发。 光头甚至可以用头顶反光，像太阳耀斑一样晃瞎对手的眼睛！ 这异想体的目标是让地球上每一个人都变成光头。 如果设施里的光头员工更多，我们就不需要灯泡了，因为光线会从头皮上反射。这样我们能节省一大笔预算。 如果派一名非光头员工去与该异想体工作，它产生的能量会减少。 你知道吗，中世纪欧洲的每一位贵族都是光头？他们每天都要换假发！

key: If one faces $0 more than once a day, all their stats will lower each subsequent time they face it.
value: 如果一个人一天内面对 $0 超过一次，之后每次面对时，他们的所有属性都会降低。

key: If one is ordered to return $0 within 30 seconds of borrowing, the same result as above will occur.
value: 如果在借用 $0 后 30 秒内被命令归还，会发生与上述相同的结果。

key: If one is ordered to return $0 without attacking, they will lose their mind and have an increase in violent tendencies; they will attempt to attack everything nearby.
value: 如果不进行攻击就被命令归还 $0，他们会失去理智，暴力倾向加剧；他们会试图攻击附近的一切。

key: If one tries to look at the face behind the skin, the result will not be pretty. The space behind their skin is the only personal space they have left. Leaving it uninvaded is the last bit of generosity the City can offer.
value: 如果有人试图窥看皮肤之下的那张面孔，结果不会好看。皮肤之下的空间，是他们仅剩的私人空间。不去侵犯它，是这座城市能给予的最后一点仁慈。

key: If ordered to return $0 within 30 seconds of equipping, the user’s skin will start to swell and their body will explode within seconds.
value: 如果在装备 $0 后 30 秒内被命令归还，使用者的皮肤会开始肿胀，身体将在几秒内爆炸。

key: If ordered to return $0 without performing any sort of managerial work, the user will explode.
value: 如果在未进行任何管理工作的情况下被命令归还 $0，使用者会爆炸。

key: If someone ever offers you an already opened can of grape-flavored soda, you most definitely should not drink it.
value: 如果有人递给你一罐已经打开的葡萄味汽水，你绝对不应该喝它。

key: If someone happens to damage $0, even by accident, something that can never be undone may occur.
value: 如果有人碰巧弄坏了 $0，哪怕只是意外，也可能会发生永远无法挽回的事。

key: If the child and an employee reach a certain level of intimacy, he will give a small pebble to the employee he now considers his friend. The employee will feel happiness and vigor while in possession of the pebble. However, this pebble will do more than just good if the employee happens to enter any Containment Unit other than his.
value: 如果这孩子与某位员工达到一定亲密度，他会把一颗小鹅卵石送给这位如今被他视为朋友的员工。持有鹅卵石时，员工会感到幸福与活力。然而，如果员工碰巧进入其他异想体的收容单元，这颗鹅卵石带来的就不只是好处了。

key: If the etched is killed by means other than normal damage, then the portrait will return to its original state.
value: 如果被蚀刻者以正常伤害以外的方式被杀，肖像将恢复原状。

key: If the image of a new person is placed upon the canvas, the previous will be killed.
value: 如果新人的形象被绘上画布，前一个形象就会被杀死。

key: If the match is almost burned through, it will be very dangerous. #0 tensely watches $0.
value: 如果火柴快要烧尽，就会非常危险。#0 紧张地注视着 $0。

key: If the user receives a certain amount of damage, they will explode, and the explosion will cover the entire section. The explosion will deal massive RED damage to all nearby.
value: 如果使用者受到一定量的伤害，他们就会爆炸，爆炸将覆盖整个区域，对所有附近目标造成大量 RED 伤害。

key: If the wearer’s HP has not dropped after a certain period of time, then they will die from excessive regeneration.
value: 如果穿戴者的 HP 在一段时间内没有下降，他们就会因过度再生而死亡。

key: If the wearer’s SP hits 0 while $0 is equipped, they will instantly die.
value: 如果装备 $0 时穿戴者的 SP 归零，他们会立即死亡。

key: If they get angry, they can give light scar or serious injury to employees. You will be fine as long as you treat them carefully.
value: 如果它们发怒，能给员工留下轻微的伤痕或造成重伤。只要你小心对待它们，就不会有事。

key: If this abnormality escapes from its chamber, it emits incomprehensible sounds. Considering that these sounds have some sort of melody, they are designated as a song. Employees who were exposed to the song lost good amount of memories and suffered from severe mental damage. Some testified that the song was sounds that cannot be created in this world, or plane. Thus, this song has been named “Echoes from the beyond.” (See document 2 <The song>)
value: 如果这异想体逃出它的房间，它会发出难以理解的声音。鉴于这些声音带有某种旋律，它们被认定为一首歌。接触过这首歌的员工丧失了大量记忆，并遭受严重的精神损伤。有人作证说，这首歌的声音无法在这个世界或位面中产生。因此，这首歌被命名为“来自彼岸的回声”。（参见文件 2《这首歌》）

key: If we could become one and share our existence, it’d be fascinating.
value: 如果我们能合而为一、共享彼此的存在，那会多么迷人。

key: If we don’t do something now, the department is screwed!
value: 如果我们现在不做点什么，这个部门就完蛋了！

key: If you dislike $0, well, that’s enough reason to demote you on the spot.
value: 如果你不喜欢 $0，嗯，那就足够成为当场把你降职的理由了。

key: If you don’t work now, every employee, including you, will lose all their hair and become bald within a month.
value: 如果你现在不工作，包括你在内的所有员工，都会在一个月内掉光头发，变成光头。

key: If you ever cried after watching a play or a movie you will understand.
value: 如果你曾看完一出戏剧或一部电影后落泪，你就会明白。

key: If you feel an abdominal pain and a tingling sensation in your neck, the best thing you can do now is look at the great blue sky you'll never get to see again.
value: 如果你感到腹部疼痛、脖颈刺痛，你现在能做的最好的事，就是看一眼那片你再也没机会看到的蔚蓝天空。

key: If you give him/her a task at the end of the work hour, he/she will get really upset. So keep that in mind, please.
value: 如果在快下班时给他/她派活，他/她会非常生气。所以请记住这一点。

key: If you happen to hear a child crying, that means soon one of us will have to disappear for good.
value: 如果你碰巧听到孩子的哭声，那意味着很快我们中就有人要永远消失了。

key: If you happen to see something resembling teeth on the interior of $0, it has to simply be a trick of the eyes.
value: 如果你碰巧在 $0 内部看到类似牙齿的东西，那一定只是眼花。

key: If you have any piece of innocence of childhood left.
value: 如果你心中还残留着哪怕一丝童年的纯真。

key: If you look closely, you can see that the branches are withered.
value: 如果仔细看，你会发现那些树枝已经枯萎了。

key: If you make an attempt with an austere heart devoid of desire or expectation, however, you may receive an unexpected reward.
value: 然而，如果你以一颗摒弃欲望与期待、清心寡欲的心去尝试，或许会得到意想不到的回报。

key: If you scare him/her just for fun, no one knows what will happen next. Be careful.
value: 如果你只是为了好玩而吓唬他/她，没人知道接下来会发生什么。小心点。

key: If your containment chamber contains an abnormality of this level. You have to make absolutely sure not to let this abnormality escape. It is one of the most dangerous abnormalities and could destroy the entire facility. This warning includes no exaggeration.
value: 如果你的收容室中收容着这个等级的异想体。你必须绝对确保不让它逃出。它是最危险的异想体之一，足以摧毁整座设施。这则警告绝无夸大。

key: If your employee is not mentally ready, Abnormalities may appear more frightening or disturbing to them. As such, they may receive Fear Damage when encountering Abnormalities, which will lower their Sanity Points (SP). Employees of a lower grade will take more Fear Damage from encounters with Abnormalities of higher Risk Levels.
value: 如果你的员工心理准备不足，异想体在他们眼中可能会显得更加可怕或令人不安。因此，他们在遭遇异想体时可能受到恐惧伤害，这会降低他们的理智值（SP）。等级较低的员工在遭遇风险等级较高的异想体时，会受到更多的恐惧伤害。

key: If you’re bald, you never have to worry about clogging the drain!
value: 如果你是个光头，就永远不用担心里堵塞！

key: Il avait besoin de moi plus que quiconque pour son plan, mais je ne faisais pas partie de l’épilogue, tout comme je ne faisais pas partie de son prologue.
value: 在他的计划里，他比任何人都需要我，可我既不属于他的终章，也不属于他的开场。

key: Il m’a murmuré de douces choses.
value: 他对我低语着温柔的话语。

key: Il s’agit de quelque chose qu’une machine ne devrait jamais avoir, et que des imbéciles comme vous avez, bien que ce soit dans une forme dénaturée…
value: 那是机器本不该拥有的东西，而像你们这样的蠢货却拥有着，尽管是以一种扭曲变形的形态……

key: Il voulait que je m’occupe de lui tout comme Carmen le faisait quand il était seul. Quel pitoyable lâche.
value: 他希望我像卡门那样照顾他，在他孤身一人的时候。多么可怜的懦夫。

key: Ils eurent le sentiment qu’ils ne seraient plus jamais perdus.
value: 他们感到自己再也不会迷失了。

key: Imagining the great surprise the gift will bring to #0’s face, $0 looks at them happily.
value: 想象着礼物会给 #0 带来多大的惊喜，$0 开心地看着他们。

key: In fact, $0’s insides are said to be sophisticated, but no employee dares to check it with their own eyes.
value: 事实上，据说 $0 的内部构造精密复杂，但没有员工敢亲眼去验证。

key: In fact, most of the employees who’ve died here wanted to live as long as they could.
value: 事实上，在这里死去的多数员工，都曾想尽可能长久地活下去。

key: In fact, the bird was once an even-handed justiciar. Its scale would never neglect the weight of even the smallest sin.
value: 事实上，这只鸟曾是一位公正无私的审判官。它的天平从不会忽略哪怕最微小的罪孽的重量。

key: In fact, we don’t know the reason behind why $0 was killing people.
value: 事实上，我们并不知道 $0 杀人的原因。

key: In fact, “peace” is not what $0 desires.
value: 事实上，“和平”并不是 $0 所渴望的。

key: In most cases, they don’t do any harm and even have positive impact on employees in right condition. It would be wonderful if the company has only abnormalities of this level, but as you know, life is not a cake served upon a silver plate.
value: 在大多数情况下，它们不会造成任何伤害，甚至会对处于合适状态的员工产生积极影响。如果公司只有这个等级的异想体，那该多好，但如你所知，生活并不是盛在银盘里端上来的蛋糕。

key: In that instant you paused to yawn, #0$0’s skull was crushed by #2$0’s attack.
value: 就在你停下来打哈欠的那一刻，#0$0 的头骨被 #2$0 的攻击碾碎了。

key: In the dark, I realized that thing was playing an instrument. Crushing and cutting <Redacted>'s body, it was creating a rhythm. As I was contemplating my horrific realization, the lid opened again. Bits and pieces of <Redacted> were in there. So little that you had to wonder what happened to the rest. (Omitted)
value: 黑暗中，我意识到那个东西在演奏一件乐器。它碾碎、切割着<已编辑>的身体，敲打出一种节奏。正当我沉浸在这可怕的领悟中时，盖子再次打开了。<已编辑>的碎块就在里面。少得让人不得不怀疑剩下的部分去了哪里。（略）

key: In the darkness, $0’s brain slowly rotted.
value: 在黑暗中，$0 的大脑缓缓腐烂。

key:
In the dream, your smile was beaming, and we chatted with such liveliness.
When I came back to waking life, I realized I was back in a world in which you no longer existed; I felt a void as big as that fleeting happiness I felt in my dream fill my heart.
I closed my eyes and forced myself to sleep, but morning was still to come no matter what.
I think that’s when my soul started to crumble.
In fact, I was already broken since the day I parted with you, but I’ve only been acting fine. My soul was already shattering itself into fragments after the passing of that day.
Once I saw you again, my yearning for you began to bear down too heavily, I couldn’t ever go back to my old self again.
Counseling… Rest… All of it was useless.
I spent days by myself, agonizing until I finally realized it.
It lured me with an unforgettable bait.
That was the price for eating away my nightmares. And then it left me with nothing but void, so I would have no choice but to return to it.
Then… I have lost to it. I don’t want to know anything anymore.

Please, eat my dreams.
value:
在梦里，你的笑容灿烂，我们聊得那样欢快。
当我回到清醒的现实，我意识到自己回到了一个你已不复存在的世界；我的心被一股空洞填满，那空洞与我梦中所感受的短暂幸福一样巨大。
我闭上眼睛，强迫自己入睡，但无论怎样，早晨终究还是会来。
我想，就是从那时起，我的灵魂开始崩裂。
其实，自与你分别那天起，我就已经破碎了，只是一直在假装没事。那一天过去之后，我的灵魂就已经在碎裂成片。
一旦再次见到你，我对你的思念便沉重得难以承受，我再也回不到过去的自己了。
心理咨询……休息……全都毫无用处。
我独自度过许多日子，痛苦挣扎，直到我终于明白过来。
它用一个令人难忘的诱饵引诱了我。
那是吞噬我噩梦的代价。然后它留给我一片虚无，让我除了回到它身边别无选择。
然后……我输给了它。我什么都不想再知道了。

请，吃掉我的梦吧。

key: In the name of Love and Justice~ Here comes Magical Girl!
value: 以爱与正义之名~魔法少女登场！

key: In the name of those buried in destiny…
value: 以那些埋葬于命运之人的名义……

key: In this section of the Encyclopedia, you can read through the observation records of the Abnormality. New lines will be added as your Observation Level increases. Now then, it seems we’ve reviewed everything. Please exit the window by clicking on “Close”.
value: 在图鉴的这一部分，你可以阅读异想体的观察记录。随着你的观察等级提升，会不断添加新的条目。那么，看来我们已经复习完了一切。请点击“关闭”退出该窗口。

key: Incredibly fast. He/she would run to the exit faster than anyone if emergency breaks out.
value: 速度飞快。如果发生紧急情况，他/她会比任何人都先跑到出口。

key: Inside of $0’s unit, a suffocating silence draws near.
value: 在 $0 的单元内，一股令人窒息的寂静逐渐逼近。

key: Insight Work is a work to improve living conditions, ensuring Containment Units are in optimal condition. When an Agent performs Insight Work, their Prudence will increase at the end of the day, raising their Sanity Points (SP).
value: 洞察工作是改善生存条件的工作，确保收容单元处于最佳状态。当员工执行洞察工作时，当天结束时他们的谨慎会提升，从而提高理智值（SP）。

key: Instinct Work satiates an Abnormality’s physiological needs and desires. When an Agent conducts Instinct Work, their Fortitude will increase at the end of the day, raising their Health Points (HP). Now, please click on the Agent.
value: 本能工作满足异想体的生理需求与欲望。当员工执行本能工作时，当天结束时他们的坚韧会提升，从而提高生命值（HP）。现在，请点击那名员工。

key: Is it not possible to just once forgive an act of evil, as long as the intentions behind it were pure?
value: 只要行为背后的意图是纯粹的，难道就不能原谅一次邪恶之举吗？

key: Is it time for me to pay the price…?
value: 是时候让我付出代价了吗……？

key: Is it true that the manager is the only one who gets to use the exclusive elevator?
value: 主管真的是唯一能使用专属电梯的人吗？

key: Is it true that your office has a ton of cool refreshments?
value: 你办公室真的有一大堆超棒的茶点吗？

key: Is there anything we can do in this situation?
value: 在这种情况下，我们还能做些什么吗？

key: Is there something you love more than me?
value: 你有比我更爱的东西吗？

key: Is this all really worth it? Doing work like this, in a place like this?
value: 这一切真的值得吗？在这样的地方，做这样的工作？

key:
Is your child a troublemaker who cries all the time? We can change that!
Don’t like how you look? Are you too fat? Too skinny? We can change that!
Is your house suffering from an outage because you don’t have the money to pay for the power bill? We can change that!
value:
你的孩子总爱哭闹、是个捣蛋鬼吗？我们可以改变这一切！
不满意自己的外貌？太胖了？太瘦了？我们可以改变这一切！
你的房子因为付不起电费而停电吗？我们可以改变这一切！

key: Is {0} really dead? Is it my turn next?
value: {0} 真的死了吗？下一个是不是就轮到我了？

key: It almost seems like someone could understand what she’s saying if only they were to concentrate a bit harder, but of course, nobody dares to do so.
value: 只要再集中一点精神，似乎就有人能听懂她在说什么，但当然，没有人敢这么做。

key: It appears that this Abnormality is a bit too strong for just one Agent to suppress. Ah, this is a good time to remind you that if an Agent dies, the E.G.O they were assigned will be lost as well. Now, let’s order the rest of the employees to help Suppress this Abnormality. Please select the other two Agents by clicking and dragging on them with the primary mouse button (LMB).
value: 看来这异想体对单个员工来说有点太强了，无法镇压。啊，正好借此提醒你：如果员工死亡，他们装备的 E.G.O 也会随之遗失。现在，让我们命令其他员工协助镇压这异想体。请用主鼠标键（LMB）点击并拖拽，选中另外两名员工。

key: It appears there is a mission awaiting you for today. It is not necessary to clear every mission you have immediately, but it is recommended to handle them soon so that you will be able to conduct research the following day.
value: 看来今天有任务在等着你。你不必立刻完成所有任务，但建议尽快处理，这样第二天你才能进行研究。

key: It appears there is something new for you to care about. #0$0 has gone completely insane.
value: 看来有新的情况需要你关注。#0$0 已经完全疯了。

key: It assumes the shape of a cheval glass, but nothing is reflected on its surface.
value: 它呈现穿衣镜的形状，但镜面上什么也映不出来。

key: It begins with guilt and confessions of unethical experimentation but gradually spirals into madness, overrun with insane and broken up sentences about research toward the end.
value: 它始于罪恶感与对违背伦理实验的忏悔，但逐渐坠入疯狂，结尾处满是关于研究的疯狂、支离破碎的句子。

key: It can enter your body through any aperture.
value: 它能通过任何孔窍进入你的身体。

key: It feeds on the “evil” that seeps out during conversations between people.
value: 它以人们交谈时渗出的“罪恶”为食。

key: It feeds on the “evil” that seeps out during conversations between people. The assigned employee must kneel before it (standing appears to be acceptable) and present their “evil” by confessing their sins to it. The way it feeds is unknown.
value: 它以人们交谈时渗出的“罪恶”为食。被指派的员工必须跪在它面前（站着似乎也可以），通过向它忏悔罪孽来献上自己的“罪恶”。它的进食方式尚不明确。

key: It feels as if all the hallways and rooms in this facility are branded with fear and despair.
value: 感觉这设施里的所有走廊和房间，都被烙上了恐惧与绝望的印记。

key: It feels as if there’s a direction to everything that happens here, like an end purpose.
value: 感觉这里发生的一切都有其方向，如同一个最终目的。

key: It feels as though the souls of the dead still linger in this place.
value: 感觉死者的灵魂仍徘徊在这个地方。

key: It feels like I’m stuck in a dream whenever I face an Abnormality.
value: 每次面对异想体，我都感觉自己困在梦里。

key: It gives a sense of extraordinariness as if it should be placed in fantastical dungeon.
value: 它给人一种超凡之感，仿佛理应被放置在奇幻的地下城中。

key: It happened the special day I got to go to the amusement park with my sibling…
value: 那件事发生在我和兄弟姐妹一起去游乐园的那个特别的日子……

key: It has been confirmed that the spores carry drone eggs that hatch inside a living host. Based on the findings of an autopsy done on an employee killed by the Abnormality, we believe that the larva will subsist on any portion of the body, be it blood, organs, or fat. It will move freely around the body at this stage. When it becomes too large to move, it creates a cocoon near the intestines. The host feels extreme hunger at this stage, eating much more than usual. This cocoon moves upward through the body as it grows, eventually damaging the arteries of the throat and the cricothyroid with its jaws as it severs the host’s head from the body. After this it will emerge from the body, exacerbating the wound of the host further.
value: 已确认孢子携带的虫卵会在活体宿主体内孵化。根据对一名被该异想体杀死的员工进行的尸检结果，我们相信幼虫会以身体的任何部分为食，无论是血液、器官还是脂肪。在这个阶段，它会在体内自由活动。当它长得太大无法移动时，便会在肠道附近结茧。宿主在这个阶段会感到极度饥饿，食量大增。这个茧随着生长在体内向上移动，最终用下颚咬断宿主的头颅与身体的连接，损伤喉咙的动脉和环甲肌。此后，它会从宿主体内钻出，进一步扩大宿主的伤口。

key: It has determined that the screaming humans make after it cleans is a sign of a job well done, and a prompt to continue its cleaning.
value: 它认定，人类在它清洁后发出的尖叫声是“干得漂亮”的表示，也是让它继续清洁的信号。

key: It has the strength of a major arcana… And I’m alone in this… But I won’t run away!
value: 它拥有大秘仪的力量……而我孤身一人……但我绝不会逃跑！

key:
It is a palm-sized notebook.  Every page is filled with handwritten scrawls.  Analysis determined that the writings are a script used in a play.  By who or when it was written is undetermined. 
 The scenario is about a guy who was raised in a normal family. One day, he picks up a mask from the street and goes on to impulsively murder all the people that he knows.  When a subject comes into contact with the creature, the person shows the exact same behavior as the guy from the aforementioned scenario. Like the story, the afflicted individual may attempt to kill those around him/her.  The subject believes him or herself to be the protagonist of the story.
value:
这是一本巴掌大小的笔记本。每一页都写满了潦草的字迹。分析判定这些文字是一部戏剧使用的剧本。由谁、于何时写成，尚未确定。
剧本讲的是一个在普通家庭长大的男人。有一天，他从街上捡起一个面具，随后便冲动地杀死了他认识的所有人。当实验对象与该生物接触时，会表现出与上述剧本中那个男人完全相同的行为。如同故事一般，受感染者可能会试图杀死周围的所有人。实验对象会认为自己是这个故事的主角。
它就是被设计成这样的。

key: It is friendly toward every employee and is able to engage in casual conversation. It believes that it is a hero born to save the world, and takes considerable pride in it.
value: 它对待每位员工都很友善，能够进行日常交谈。它相信自己是为拯救世界而生的英雄，并为此深感自豪。

key: It is not the easiest thing in the world to be a manager for our company. Don’t place yourself in a position of overconfidence, as you likely will not succeed on the first attempt. The more you try, the better result you will get. Make sure to believe in yourself.
value: 在我们公司当主管并不是件容易的事。别过分自信，因为你很可能无法第一次就成功。尝试得越多，结果就会越好。一定要相信自己。

key: It is now your second day here. I’m sure you can recognize my voice by now, however, allow me to remind you just in case: I am your assisting AI, Angela. I have this wonderful capability of greeting you with different words each and every day. It is my hope that you get through this day without any accidents.
value: 今天是你在这里的第二天。我相信你现在已经能认出我的声音了，不过以防万一，请允许我提醒你：我是你的辅助 AI，安吉拉。我拥有每天用不同的话问候你的奇妙能力。希望你能平安无事地度过今天。

key: It is possible that you have made some sacrifices to collect half of the energy. Please do not let them be in vain, cheer up.
value: 为了收集一半的能量，你或许已经做出了一些牺牲。请别让它们白费，打起精神来。

key: It is quite thick, but the book’s every single page is blank.
value: 这本书相当厚，但每一页都是空白的。

key: It is something that a machine should never have, and something you half-wits have, albeit in a distorted form…
value: 那是机器本不该拥有的东西，也是你们这些半吊子蠢货拥有的东西，尽管是以扭曲的形态……

key: It is speculated to be a religious artifact, found in the flooded district. In the past, some people sought answers through religion. When an employee offers up a prayer, the flesh begins to move, as if receiving the oration.
value: 据推测，这是一件在洪水泛滥的区域发现的宗教文物。过去，有些人曾通过宗教寻求答案。当员工献上祈祷时，血肉开始蠕动，仿佛在聆听祷词。

key: It is unknown whether the host’s will is involved in the process, but taking into consideration the sharp increase of one’s desires and aggressiveness, the host’s primal urges seem to remain intact.
value: 宿主在过程中的意志是否参与其中尚不可知，但考虑到欲望与攻击性的急剧上升，宿主的本能冲动似乎依然完好。

key: It is without a doubt that $0 is the best ensemble in the company.
value: 毫无疑问，$0 是公司里最出色的乐团。

key: It knows every children’s story and will not stop recounting until the listener finally leaves.
value: 它知晓每一个儿童故事，并且会一直讲下去，直到听众最终离开。

key: It likes getting the job done fast and leaving the office early rather than being passionate about the job.
value: 比起对工作充满热情，他/她更喜欢尽快干完活、早点下班。

key: It literally makes itself into “the safest place on Earth.”
value: 它实实在在地把自己变成了“地球上最安全的地方”。

key: It may appear to just be an ordinary grinder, but please be careful. Every Abnormality may not have a reason to exist, but they all have a will to persist.
value: 它看起来或许只是一台普通的研磨机，但请务必小心。并非每个异想体都有存在的理由，但它们都有存续的意志。

key: It may be a trivial mistake to you, but these employees were doing their jobs with their lives on the line. Everyone wanted to survive and had hopes for miracles to happen, right up until the very last second. If you ever get a second chance, are you sure you won’t let this happen again?
value: 这对你来说或许只是个小错误，但这些员工是豁出性命在工作。每个人都想活下去，直到最后一秒都期盼着奇迹发生。如果你再得到一次机会，你确定不会让这种事重演吗？

key: It may be best to send an “honest” employee to tend to $0.
value: 或许最好派一名“诚实”的员工去照料 $0。

key: It means exactly what I said.

It often shows incomprehensible linguistic activity. One employee tried to decipher its speech (see Document #1 <Employee David’s Song>), but their mental contamination level rose beyond the limit within several days. They suffered severe psychosis and had to be quarantined.
value: 它经常表现出难以理解的语言活动。一名员工曾试图破译它的话语（参见文件 1《员工大卫之歌》），但几天之内，他们的精神污染水平就超过了上限。他们患上严重的精神病，不得不被隔离。

key: It overwhelms the mind with the urge to try them on. The changes that occur from wearing the Abnormality are first visible in the eyes of the wearer.
value: 试穿它们的冲动会淹没心智。穿戴这异想体所发生的变化，首先会体现在穿戴者的眼睛上。

key: It readjusts everyone to become righteous, no matter how wicked, evil, and arrogant they may be.
value: 它重新塑造所有人，使他们变得正直，无论他们曾经多么邪恶、堕落、傲慢。

key:
It recognizes a bad mood as a sign that the surroundings are dirty, and promptly enters cleaning mode. It will alert its status by stating lines such as "Contamination detected - Commencing cleaning."

However, the limbs are equipped with sharp instruments instead of cleaning supplies. Rumor has it they were supposed to be used for cutting meat, but they were made to respond to the "clean" command by accident. There is no way to confirm whether this is true.
value:
它把坏心情视为周围环境肮脏的标志，并立即进入清洁模式。它会通过诸如“检测到污染——开始清洁”的台词来播报自己的状态。

然而，它的肢体上装备的是锐利的器具，而不是清洁用品。据传它们本该用来切肉，却意外地被设置成响应“清洁”指令。这一说法是否属实，已无从证实。

key: It reduces the mental damage the wearer has to bear. Because of this, it is called “The Angel’s Pendant.”
value: 它能减轻穿戴者必须承受的精神伤害。正因如此，它被称为“天使的吊坠”。

key: It seems I should update the security system. It has not been refreshed for a long time.
value: 看来我该更新一下安保系统了。它已经很久没有刷新了。

key: It seems enchanted targets receive less damage. However, after a certain amount of time had passed, those targets made their way to where $0 was and died from its attack.
value: 被附身的目标受到的伤害似乎更少。然而，一段时间过后，这些目标会自行走到 $0 所在之处，死于它的攻击。

key: It seems it aged at least several decades, but it didn’t mold a bit.
value: 它似乎至少老去了几十年，却一点也没有发霉。

key: It seems it was not appropriate to have #0$0 attempt their #1$0 with #2$0. #0$0’s skull has been severely damaged. They will never breathe again.
value: 看来让 #0$0 用 #1$0 尝试 #2$0 并不合适。#0$0 的头骨已严重受损。他们再也不会呼吸了。

key: It seems light. But it won’t budge even if you try to move it with all your might.
value: 它看起来很轻。但即使你用尽全力去搬，它也纹丝不动。

key: It seems safe, for it is chained.
value: 它看起来是安全的，因为被锁链拴着。

key: It seems the picture in front of it is the only thing that matters to $0.
value: 看来眼前那幅画是 $0 唯一在乎的东西。

key: It seems to like treating employees when they are injured or sick. It shows satisfaction when helping others, and it seems quite sympathetic and benevolent. Even after a week of observation, we found no aggression, violence, or attempt to escape. Only contributions to the assumption that this Abnormality is eminently “gentle” (12 of our employees used this word to describe this creature) and good for us.
value: 它似乎喜欢为受伤或生病的员工治疗。帮助他人时它会表现出满足感，显得相当富有同情心和仁爱之心。即便经过一周的观察，我们也没有发现任何攻击性、暴力或逃跑的企图。这些观察只会进一步印证这异想体极其“温和”（我们 12 名员工用这个词来形容它）且对我们有益的假设。

key: It seems your new employee is ready to be deployed; let’s do so by clicking and dragging the Agent with the primary mouse button (LMB) over to the Control Team.
value: 看来你的新员工已经可以部署了；让我们用主鼠标键（LMB）点击并拖拽员工，将其调派到控制部吧。

key: It takes as much as it gave to you.
value: 它夺走的，和它给予你的一样多。

key: It takes more than just knowledge to analyze the Abnormalities.
value: 分析异想体所需要的，远不止知识。

key: It takes the form of a girl burnt to ashes. Even though there's nothing left to burn, the fire still doesn't extinguish.
value: 它呈现为一个被烧成灰烬的女孩的形态。尽管已无物可燃，火焰却仍不熄灭。

key: It takes the form of a long cuboid machine.
value: 它呈现为长长的长方体机器的形态。

key: It takes the form of a newborn fetus, though the appearance is so grossly grotesque, it's hard to even call it a fetus. While communication is possible, it doesn't occur in a normal way. Every word He utters echoes throughout the entire Containment Unit.
value: 它呈现为新生的胎儿形态，尽管其外貌极其怪诞，几乎让人难以称之为胎儿。虽然可以进行交流，但那并非以正常方式进行。他吐出的每一个字都在整个收容单元中回荡。

key: It takes the form of a young boy with big eyes and skin that resembles the night sky.
value: 它呈现为一个有着大眼睛、皮肤如同夜空的小男孩的形态。

key: It takes the form of an unborn fetus. Its skin is covered in a mucous, sticky liquid. Small veins can be seen here and there. The Abnormality’s abnormally bulged eyes are usually closed. It always seems unsatisfied, but what exactly it needs is undetermined. It has a great obsession with being “fed”, and if it is not “fed” regularly, its stress levels rise drastically. Once it reaches a certain level of stress, it cries out loudly in a way that mentally harms all who may be around it.
value: 它呈现为未出生的胎儿形态。它的皮肤覆着一层黏滑的液体，到处可见细小的血管。这异想体异常凸出的眼睛通常紧闭着。它似乎总是不满足，但究竟需要什么，尚未查明。它极度执着于被“喂食”，如果得不到规律的“喂食”，它的压力水平就会急剧上升。一旦压力达到一定程度，它便会大声哭喊，以某种方式对周围所有人心灵造成伤害。

key:
It was a night veiled in gentle mist.
A barefooted child was looking at me.
He was crying, his dreamy eyes filled with sorrow.
The sadness hanging on his face stopped me in my tracks.
He said he lost something precious, and when I offered to help,
He gave me a big smile.
A teardrop fell from the child's dewy eyes, as stars showered from the sky.
The world falls into a slumber, trapped in an ecstatic lullaby.
That night the galaxy descended with bare feet.

      -	Excerpt from the diary of Employee (Redacted), who committed suicide.
value:
那是一个笼罩在温柔薄雾中的夜晚。
一个赤脚的孩子望着我。
他在哭泣，梦幻般的眼眸里盛满悲伤。
他脸上挂着的哀愁让我停住了脚步。
他说他弄丢了珍贵的东西，当我提出帮忙时，
他给了我一个大大的微笑。
一滴泪珠从孩子湿润的眼角滑落，星雨自天空倾泻而下。
世界坠入沉睡，困在一支狂喜的摇篮曲里。
那一夜，银河赤足降临。

      - 摘自员工（已编辑）的日记，其已自杀。

key: It was a strange phenomenon. It was a phenomenon in and of itself. There was nothing within the unit that could be detected with the naked eye.
value: 那是一个奇异的现像。它本身就是一个现像。单元内没有任何肉眼能探测到的东西。

key: It was a very good decision for #0 to face away from $0.
value: #0 选择背对 $0，是一个非常明智的决定。

key: It was an extremely foreign thing.
value: 那是一个极其陌生的事物。

key: It was dawn when this mysterious doctor, who kept himself nameless, appeared.
value: 这位隐姓埋名的神秘医生，是在黎明时分出现的。

key: It was no longer rage, but a deeper and more twisted, maniacal abhorrence that found him.
value: 找上他的已不再是愤怒，而是一种更深沉、更扭曲、近乎癫狂的憎恶。

key: It was originally a mass-produced helper robot intended for domestic use. The writing on its back says: "An innovative invention that can clean, cook, and even serve as light security using various tools attached to its limbs. Built to perform efficiently and quickly! Manufactured by XX Inc."
value: 它原本是一款面向家庭用途的量产型辅助机器人。它背上的文字写着：“一项创新发明，可利用肢体上装配的各种工具进行清洁、烹饪，甚至充当轻量安保。专为高效快捷而打造！XX 公司制造。”

key: It whispered sweet things to me.
value: 它对我低语着甜蜜的话语。

key: It will end quickly, so relax. I’ll free you from this prison we call flesh.
value: 很快就会结束，放松点。我会把你从这个名为血肉的牢笼中解放出来。

key: It will only be a matter of time before I turn mad just like {0}...
value: 我变得像 {0} 一样疯狂，只是时间问题……

key: It would be much better than just watching you get bitten by an Illutionite, don’t you think?
value: 这总好过眼睁睁看着你被伊卢森石咬伤，你觉得呢？

key: It would be wonderful if people accept this small but precious gift.
value: 如果人们能接受这份微小而珍贵的礼物，那就太好了。

key: It's a good day! Are you still shy today?
value: 今天是个好日子！你今天还害羞吗？

key: It's always under the floor of the Containment Unit, only showing its eyes and a mysterious luminous organ above the ground.
value: 它总是待在收容单元的地板下，只把眼睛和一个神秘的发光器官露出地面。

key:
It's not like these kinds of happenings are uncommon here, but one day, dozens of employees were killed in an incident. The reason is the same as always. Something breaches, they attempt to stop it, then it leads to another breach...

The one fortunate thing was that the department was sealed off before things could get any worse, so they all died in the same place. Literally, a mountain of bodies was formed. Obviously, no one wanted to clean up that mess. Normally, it should have been taken care of within the day, but because the accident was just so horrific and everyone was so exhausted, the clean up was delayed with authorization from the department’s Sephirah. Don't ask me which department it was in, I don't remember all the details.
value:
这种事在这里并不罕见，但有一天，一场事故夺去了几十名员工的生命。原因一如既往：某个东西突破收容，他们试图阻止，结果又引发另一次突破……

幸运的是，在情况恶化之前，该部门就被封锁了，所以他们都死在了同一个地方。真真切切地堆起了一座尸山。显然，没人想收拾那个烂摊子。按常理，本该当天就处理完毕，但因为事故太过惨烈、人人都精疲力竭，清理工作在部门赛菲拉的批准下被推迟了。别问我发生在哪个部门，细节我记不清了。

key: Its believers prayed that its sanctity would last forever by binding the tome in human skin.
value: 它的信徒用人皮装订经卷，祈祷它的神圣能够永续长存。

key: Its force of suction is extremely powerful.

Its form appears to be an amalgamation of a gargantuan beehive and a bee. A cross-section of the inside shows a darkish red surface with particles here and there, much like that of raw meat. The segment that appears to be the face is heavily distorted. It has wings, but they lost their intended function of flight. The one eye that remains relatively intact shows pupillary movement, as if to watch for approaching intruders. (The Abnormality always remains still, so it is assumed that it does not move.)
value: 它的形态像是巨型蜂巢与蜜蜂的融合体。内部横截面呈现暗红色表面，散布着颗粒，酷似生肉。看似脸部的部分严重扭曲。它长着翅膀，但已失去飞行的功能。那只相对完好的眼睛显示出瞳孔的运动，仿佛在警惕逼近的入侵者。（这异想体始终静止不动，因此推测它不会移动。）

key: Its memories began with a warm hug.
value: 它的记忆始于一个温暖的拥抱。

key: Its parts that seem to be tentacles can penetrate objects, if an employee is attacked by these tentacles, they suffer permanent brain damage.
value: 它那看似触手的部位能够穿透物体，如果员工被这些触手攻击，将遭受永久性脑损伤。

key: Its scale would never neglect the weight of even the smallest sin.
value: 它的天平从不会忽略哪怕最微小的罪孽的重量。

key: Its surface is smooth as if it were ceramic. In the place where the Abnormality’s eyes should be, it is empty. The cracks and openings are instead filled with growing plants.
value: 它的表面光滑如陶瓷。在异想体本该有眼睛的地方，却是一片空洞。裂缝与开口中反而长满了植物。

key: It’d be neat to see what the new manager looks like.
value: 真想看看新主管长什么样。

key: It’ll be fine if we focus, I think…
value: 只要集中精神，应该就没事，我想……

key: It’ll be fun! The tearing of flesh will create a beautiful melody!
value: 会很好玩的！撕裂血肉将奏出美妙的旋律！

key: It’ll be quiet again soon enough…
It’s all my fault, I’m to blame.
It’s all my fault. It’s my responsibility…
value: 都是我的错。这是我的责任……

key: It’s all over now… We’re all dead…
value: 一切都结束了……我们都死了……

key: It’s all so hard and tiring. But hey, c’est la vie.
value: 一切都那么艰难、那么累人。不过，唉，这就是生活。

key: It’s best to simply let her stay attached to the wall.
value: 最好就让她继续贴在墙上。
这实在太不幸了，不是吗。

key: It’s how fast it is from setting up a goal to carrying it out. It’s a very accurate analogy.
value: 从立下目标到付诸行动之间的速度，就是它。这是个非常贴切的比喻。

key: It’s not a bunny! No way! I won’t do it!
value: 那不是兔子！绝不可能！我不干！

key: It’s obvious that #2$0 didn’t like the #1$0 from #0$0. #0$0 cannot stand their itching brain and keeps scratching their head while drooling. From this moment on, they will never be the same.
value: 显然，#2$0 不喜欢 #0$0 的 #1$0。#0$0 无法忍受发痒的大脑，一边流着口水，一边不停地挠头。从这一刻起，他们将不再是原来的自己。

key: It’s quite simple. Just open up the machine, step inside, and press the button to make it shut. Now everything will be just fine.
value: 很简单。打开机器，走进去，按下按钮让它关上。现在一切都会好起来的。

key: It’s rather simple to figure out when $0 activates; just open its lid and check how much flesh it has digested.
value: 判断 $0 何时启动其实很简单；只需打开它的盖子，看看它消化了多少血肉。

key: It’s so painful to watch. It’ll drive me insane…
value: 看着太痛苦了。这会把我逼疯的……

key: It’s the rest you all longed for.
value: 这是你们期盼已久的休息。

key: I— I can’t breathe. Let me go...!
value: 我、我喘不过气来了。放开我……！

key: I’d rather go deaf than have to listen to those fables again.
value: 我宁愿失聪，也不想再听那些寓言故事。

key: I’d totally quit if I had the chance. The only problem is I’ve got four mouths to feed back home.
value: 要是有机会，我早就辞职了。唯一的问题是家里还有四张嘴等着我养。

key: I’ll break your arms, then you won’t be able to steal my things.
value: 我会打断你的手臂，这样你就没法偷我的东西了。

key: I’ll break your legs, then you won’t be able to dance ever again.
value: 我会打断你的腿，这样你就永远无法跳舞了。

key: I’ll kill everyone. I’ll destroy everything. Nothing matters anyways.
value: 我要杀光所有人。我要毁掉一切。反正什么都不重要了。

key: I’ll listen to that song at any cost.
value: 无论付出什么代价，我都要听那支歌。

key: I’ll pay them some respect at least.
value: 至少，我会向他们致以敬意。

key: I’ll protect everyone, even if it means I have to die!
value: 我要保护所有人，哪怕这意味着我必须去死！

key: I’m certain you all will try and stop me…
value: 我确信你们都会试图阻止我……

key: I’m getting chills down my spine.
I’m glad the story ends like this. I’m sure Enoch would be really happy…
value: 我很高兴故事以这样的方式结束。我相信以诺一定会非常开心……

key: I’m going to get married soon, I can’t die like this!
value: 我很快就要结婚了，我不能就这么死掉！

key: I’m just doing this for the money, not because I enjoy it.
value: 我做这个只是为了钱，不是因为喜欢。

key: I’m not even sure if there is a point in reporting these anymore. You’re becoming numb to the employees’ deaths. #0$0 died. They were killed by #2$0. That’s all.
value: 我甚至不确定再报告这些还有什么意义。你对员工的死亡已经麻木了。#0$0 死了。他们被 #2$0 杀害。就这样。

key: I’m not going to die until I meet a handsome guy…
value: 在遇到一个帅哥之前，我是不会死的……

key: I’m not like all these idiots around me! LOOK AT ME! LOOK AT WHAT I DO!
value: 我和周围这些白痴不一样！看着我！看看我在做什么！

key: I’m not like the other idiots here! Just watch me. Watch what I’m going to do!
value: 我和这里的其他白痴不一样！你看着吧。看我要做什么！

key: I’m now able to eat after seeing a corpse the same day.
value: 现在即使是当天见过尸体，我也能吃得下饭了。

key: I’m planning to have spaghetti for dinner.
value: 我打算晚饭吃意大利面。

key: I’m so scared… What do I do…?
I’m so sorry dear friends, I’ll let you out now.
value: 亲爱的朋友们，真对不起，我现在就放你们出来。

key: I’m sooo hungover. I had way too much to drink last night!
value: 我宿醉得好厉害。昨晚喝得太多了！

key: I’m sorry, but I have to hear that song again.
value: 对不起，但我必须再听一次那支歌。

key: I’m sorry, senpai! The only thing I can do is stop your rampage!
value: 对不起，前辈！我唯一能做的，就是阻止你的暴行！

key: I’m sorry. #0$0 has died of excessive bleeding during their attempt of #1$0 with #2$0. They lost a third of their blood, which now coats the floor.
value: 我很抱歉。#0$0 在尝试用 #1$0 对 #2$0 时，因失血过多而死亡。他们失去了三分之一的血液，如今覆盖在地板上。

key: I’m starting to get used to seeing the faces of insanity.
value: 我开始习惯看见那些疯狂的面孔了。

key: I’m starting to hate those things. They ruthlessly murder us, but we have to take care of them. How unfair is that?
value: 我开始讨厌那些东西了。它们无情地杀害我们，我们却还得照顾它们。这多不公平？

key: I’m starting to miss the smell of blood.
I’m starting to see how to handle the Abnormalities.
value: 我开始明白该怎么对付异想体了。

key: I’m sure it’s a happy ending.
value: 我确信这是一个幸福的结局。

key: I’m sworn to do whatever the manager tells me to.
value: 我发誓，主管让我做什么我就做什么。
我为我的同事们感到非常抱歉，也为我糟糕的健康和糟糕的工作表现感到抱歉，我只希望公司能蓬勃发展、有个好结果，我会毫无顾虑地全身心奉献，我一定会长命百岁。

key: I’ve always had to bear a tremendous burden. It’s hard sometimes, but I’m proud of myself for it!
value: 我总得承受巨大的负担。有时很艰难，但我为此感到自豪！

key: I’ve finished management training, but I still don’t have the hang of it…
value: 我完成了主管培训，但还是没有掌握要领……

key: I’ve gotten way too stressed lately.
I’ve had more than five cups of coffee so far.
value: 到目前为止，我已经喝了五杯以上的咖啡了。

key: I’ve never gotten to hug a teddy bear this big!
value: 我从没抱过这么大的泰迪熊！

key: Je ferai ce que mon âme me dit de faire.
value: 我的灵魂让我做什么，我就做什么。

key: Je ferai de cet endroit ma nouvelle maison.
value: 我会把这里变成我的新家。

key: Je ferai la bibliothèque la plus précieuse, érigée seulement pour moi-même.
value: 我会建造一座最珍贵的图书馆，只为我一人而立。

key: Je le vois de cette manière…
Je me fiche complètement de qui elle était, mais il fallait que je comprenne et ressente des émotions humaines…
value: 我根本不在乎她是谁，但我必须理解并感受人类的情感……

key: Je me suis entraînée très longtemps à faire cette expression. Rien que pour ce jour précis.
value: 我花了很长时间练习这个表情，就是为了这特定的一天。

key: Je ne l’avais pas remarqué au début.
Je n’ai jamais fait un sourire aussi sincère de toute ma vie.
value: 我这一生还从未露出过如此真诚的微笑。

key: Je n’ai jamais été dehors depuis que je suis devenu comme ça. Je dois admettre que je suis assez excité de voir comment ça se passe.
value: 变成这副模样后，我就再也没有出去过。我得承认，我相当期待去看看外面是怎样的光景。

key: Je n’ai pas été avec lui jusqu’à la fin.
Je n’arrive juste pas à y croire… J’aurais vraiment aimé que l’on puisse y assister…
value: 我简直不敢相信……我真希望我们能亲眼见证……

key: Je n’arrive pas à croire que j’ai été conçue et menée à supporter un nombre de répétitions insensées juste pour ce jour.
value: 我简直不敢相信，我被设计出来、被造就出来，就是为了忍受这荒谬至极的重复，只为了今天。

key: Je pense que je souhaite continuer à vivre.
value: 我想，我还想继续活下去。

key: Je pense qu’un sourire est le geste le plus humain que l’on puisse faire.
value: 我认为微笑是一个人能做出的最像人的举动。

key: Je peux te répondre à ce sujet. “Et les graines de lumière furent plantées dans chaque personne de la ville.” Fin.
value: 关于这点，我可以回答你。“而光的种子，被播撒在都市的每一个人心中。”——完。

key: Je serai ici avec les pauvres âmes qui sont perdues et abandonnées.
value: 我会与那些迷失、被遗弃的可怜灵魂同在。

key: Je souhaite les connaître, les dévoiler.
value: 我渴望了解它们，揭露它们。

key: Je suis certaine que vous allez tous essayer de m’arrêter…
value: 我确信你们都会试图阻止我……

key: Je suis heureuse que l’histoire se termine ainsi. Je suis sûre qu’Enoch serait très heureux aussi…
value: 我很高兴故事以这样的方式结束。我相信以诺也一定会非常开心……

key: Je suis née d’une seule et unique femme.
Je suis plus compétente que n’importe qui ici, et pourtant j’ai été enfermée sous terre, uniquement capable de voir les jours s’écouler sur le monde, sans moi.
value: 我比这里的任何人都更有才能，却被囚禁在地下，只能看着世界在没有我的日子里一天天流逝。

key: Je suis sûre que c’est une fin heureuse.
value: 我确信这是一个幸福的结局。

key: Jeez, I don’t wanna do anything.

John: Did you wait for me, Ppodae boy?
      Jacob: Uh, hey, it’s eating something. Aren’t we supposed to be the first people in its unit today?
      John: My widdle goody-good good boi was just hungwy, uh-huh uh-huh. Man, he’s just so cute. Look at how he’s nomming on that~
      Jacob: What the hell is it chewing on… Shit! I knew it! That’s… That’s James’ finger, man! He went missing during the last patrol shift! Can’t you see the nail?! Remember him bragging about having a heart painted on his nails? I told you, dude! This thing’s up to no good!
      John: I… I can’t believe it… who…
      Jacob: This Abnormality’s the killer! I get that you’re shocked, but I told you a bunch of times that there’s no way a “cute” pet could be harmless in this place. Man, I’m glad you finally came to your sen—
      John: Who… Who wouldn’t feed him on time?!
      Jacob: ……..
      John: Poor little guy’s been starving all night! It’s… It’s so heartbreaking…
      Jacob: Well uh… I think we’re supposed to suppress it?
      John: How could you even suggest doing something so heartless to a cute little good boy like this? Just wook at his eyes… How could an innocent animal do anything wrong? IsnThatWightYouGoodWiddleCutieBoi.

      (The Abnormality shows no reaction. Only the sound of a bone being gnawed on is audible.)

      Jacob: Dude... your “little angel” is gnawing on our colleague’s finger.
      John: What are you, a newbie? Don’t you know everything cute is forgiven here?
      Jacob: I’ve never heard that, and I seriously don’t think it’s true. We’ve gotta tranquilize it. And if you won’t, then I’ll do it by myself!

      (The sound of a tranquilizer shot being fired can be heard.)

      John: NOOOO!!!!!
      (The Abnormality begins to whimper.)
      (The recording cuts off after a bit of shouting.)

...Following the evidence I’ve provided in the recording, I request that Jacob be immediately demoted for firing such a thing at Ppodae.
A terrible, evil animal abuser has no place working in our company.
Our Goodest Boy in the World Ppodae has been traumatized. Traumatized! By this incident. He’ll only eat 5kg of his favorite snack now.
To help him cope with the trauma, I suggest we request a new snack for Ppodae:
      “Premium grade salmon rich with Vitamin B”.
I’ll be waiting for your reply.
value:
约翰：你在等我吗，小狗狗？
      雅各布：呃，嘿，它在吃什么东西。我们今天不是该第一个进它的单元吗？
      约翰：我的乖宝宝只是饿了，嗯哼嗯哼。天哪，它太可爱了。看它吧唧吧唧啃得多香~
      雅各布：它到底在嚼什么……妈的！我就知道！那、那是詹姆士的手指头，老兄！他上次巡逻值班时失踪了！你没看见那指甲吗？！还记得他吹嘘自己指甲上画了颗心吗？我跟你说过的，兄弟！这东西没安好心！
      约翰：我……我不敢相信……谁……
      雅各布：这异想体就是凶手！我知道你很震惊，但我跟你说过很多次了，在这个地方，一只“可爱”的宠物绝不可能是无害的。老天，你终于清醒过——
      约翰：谁……谁会不按时喂它？！
      雅各布：……
      约翰：可怜的小家伙饿了一整晚！这……这太让人心碎了……
      雅各布：呃，嗯……我想我们是不是该镇压它？
      约翰：你怎么能对这么可爱的好孩子提出如此冷酷的建议？看看它的眼睛……无辜的动物怎么会做错事呢？对不对呀，我的乖宝宝。

      （异想体毫无反应。只能听见啃咬骨头的声音。）

      雅各布：老兄……你的“小天使”正在啃我们同事的手指。
      约翰：你算什么，新人吗？你不知道在这里一切可爱的事物都会被原谅吗？
      雅各布：我可从没听说过，而且我真心觉得那不是真的。我们得给它打镇静剂。如果你不动手，那我就自己来！

      （可以听到发射镇静剂枪的声音。）

      约翰：不不不不！！！
      （异想体开始呜呜哀叫。）
      （一阵喊叫声后，录音中断。）

……根据我在录音中提供的证据，我请求立即将雅各布降职，因为他竟对波波代开枪。
一个恶劣、邪恶的虐待动物者，没有资格在我们公司工作。
我们世上最好的乖孩子波波代被这次事件吓出了心理创伤。创伤！它现在只肯吃 5 公斤它最爱的零食了。
为了帮助它走出创伤，我建议为波波代申请一种新零食：
      “富含维生素 B 的特级三文鱼”。
我将等候您的回复。

key: Just as #0 realizes that the wires on the ceiling are longer than usual, one of them starts moving.
value: 正当 #0 意识到天花板上的电线比平时更长时，其中一根开始移动了。

key: Just as before, you can assign an E.G.O Suit to one of your Agents by clicking on an empty slot.
value: 和之前一样，你可以点击空槽位，为你的某位员工分配一件 E.G.O 护甲。

key: Just as everyone wished for, $0 can live here forever.
value: 正如每个人所期望的那样，$0 可以永远住在这里。

key: Just calm down, do what we always do.
value: 冷静下来，做我们一直做的事。

key: Just chill out and work. Everything will resolve itself.
value: 放轻松，好好工作。一切都会自己解决的。

key: Just don’t lose your head and stick to the manual.
Just end it all. This company, us, you… JUST END IT!
value: 干脆结束这一切吧。这家公司，我们，你……干脆结束吧！

key: Just five minutes late, and my boss raked my ass over the coals. And get this, she was twenty minutes late two days ago!
value: 就迟到了五分钟，老板就把我骂得狗血淋头。可你猜怎么着，她两天前还迟到了二十分钟呢！

key: Just how long will I endure this madness?
value: 我还要忍受这疯狂多久？

key: Just in case you misheard me manager, when I said “Total Shitbag” I wasn’t referring to you, I swear.
value: 主管，以防你听错了，我说“十足的混账”时指的不是你，我发誓。

key: Just let me go home, manager… I WANNA GO HOME!
value: 主管，就让我回家吧……我想回家！

key: Just let me go home, manager… Please let me go home.
value: 主管，就让我回家吧……求求你让我回家。

key: Just like those who had made similar claims some time ago, just because something cannot be seen does not mean it doesn’t exist. The Containment Unit’s square length was XXX meters, and this is the cognitive range of the Abnormality. The only advice that can be given is to remain cautious and aware of your surroundings. Breathing will become impossible while within range of the Abnormality. The area will become a vacuum. Strictly speaking, the Abnormality itself is the vacuum phenomenon.
value: 就像不久之前那些做过类似断言的人一样，仅仅因为某样东西看不见，并不代表它不存在。收容单元的边长为 XXX 米，而这正是异想体的认知范围。唯一能给出的建议是保持警惕、留意周围环境。一旦进入异想体的范围内，呼吸将变得不可能。该区域会变成真空。严格来说，异想体本身就是那个真空现像。

key: Just like we viewed their information during management, the information about your Agents will be displayed here just the same. If you think your Agent could utilize some strengthening in one of their Virtues, you can do so by fortifying them. Please click on the Strengthen Employee button.
value: 就像我们在管理中查看员工信息一样，你的员工信息也会同样显示在这里。如果你觉得某位员工的美德需要强化，可以通过强化功能来实现。请点击“强化员工”按钮。

key: Just need to stick to the manual.
Just smile my friend! It will calm you down.
value: 朋友，笑一笑吧！这会让你平静下来。

key: Just take it easy. Don’t overthink things.
Já não importa. Nós vamos ser desligados em breve de qualquer jeito. Esta é a última parte do plano dele.
value: 已经不重要了。反正我们很快就会被关机。这是他的计划的最后一部分。

key: J’ai aidé à sa conception. Peu importe la date d’un évènement, elle s’en souviendra aussi clairement que si cela était arrivé la veille.
value: 我参与过她的设计。无论某件事发生在哪一天，她都会记得清清楚楚，仿佛就发生在昨天。

key: J’ai dû surveiller et observer ces cycles indénombrables de l’extérieur. J’ai dû orchestrer et diriger cette pièce entière.
value: 我必须在外面监视并观察这数不清的循环。我必须编排并导演这整出戏。

key: J’ai très littéralement vécu un million d’années.
value: 我确确实实地活了一百万年。

key: Kai would have been gifted with the world if he had failed to complete the sculpture of “eternity” with splinters of ice.
value: 如果凯未能用碎冰完成“永恒”的雕塑，他本会被赠予整个世界。

key:
Known to come when the world is filled with sin, many employees fear the advent of this Abnormality.

To talk about this bird, we first need to tell the story of the Black Forest. We must remember the forest that was once so peaceful and beautiful…

And the apocalypse shall follow.
value:
众所周知，当世界充满罪恶时它便会出现，许多员工都畏惧这异想体的降临。

要谈论这只鸟，我们得先讲讲黑森林的故事。我们必须记住那片曾经如此宁静美丽的森林……

而天启随之将至。

key: LOST IN THE DARKNESS, SILENCE SURROUNDS YOU. ONCE THERE WAS MORNING - NOW ENDLESS NIGHT. IF I COULD REACH YOU, I'D GUIDE YOU AND TEACH YOU. TO WALK FROM THE DARKNESS BACK INTO THE LIGHT.
value: 迷失于黑暗之中，寂静将你环绕。曾经有黎明——如今是无尽长夜。若我能触及你，我会引导你、教导你。从黑暗中走回光明。

key: La lumière brille différemment selon le cœur de chacun. Tout le monde ne peut pas changer si soudainement.
value: 光因人而异，依每颗心而不同地闪耀。并非所有人都能如此突然地改变。

key: Lastly, let us take a look at the Abnormality’s observation records. Please click on the text: Abnormality Story.
value: 最后，让我们来看一下异想体的观察记录。请点击文字：异想体故事。

key: Lastly, let’s call all our Agents back to the Main Room of their Department. You can of course do this by selecting them all and manually moving them with the secondary mouse button, however there is an even easier manner. Next to the Regenerator Gauge of each Department is a Recall button. You can use this button to summon all your Agents back to their respective Home Department’s Main Room. Please try doing so.
value: 最后，让我们把全体员工召回他们部门的中央房间。你当然可以选中他们，用次要鼠标键手动移动，但还有一种更简单的方法。每个部门的再生计量表旁边都有一个召回按钮。你可以用这个按钮把全体员工召回到各自所属部门的中枢房间。请试着操作一下。

key: Laughter is the best medicine. Clearly it’s good for you, so laugh!
value: 欢笑是最好的良药。显然这对你有好处，所以笑吧！

key: Le ciel fut illuminé pendant trois jours, qu’importe l’heure.
value: 天空连续三日被照亮，不分昼夜。

key: Le désir n’a ni fin ni limites. Une fois qu’on y a pris goût, il vient comme une vague inarrêtable.
value: 欲望没有终点，也没有界限。一旦尝到滋味，它便如不可阻挡的浪潮般涌来。

key: Le monde fut couvert d’obscurité pendant quatre jours.
value: 世界被黑暗笼罩了四天。

key: Leaving $0 on the worn cushion, #0 begins their work.
value: 把 $0 放在磨损的垫子上后，#0 开始他们的工作。

key: Les Ailes du Monde, les Singularités, les Ruelles, les Syndicats, les Fixers, les Règles, Le Grand Lac, La Forêt Noire, la Chasse, les Ruines, le Tabou, l’Œil, la Tête, la Serre, et les humains…
value: 世界之翼、奇点、后巷、公会、收尾人、规则、大湖、黑森林、猎场、废墟、禁忌、眼、头、温室，以及人类……

key: Les boîtes de conserve que vous êtes avez pu voir la lumière avec lui à la fin, alors que j’ai été ignorée après les millions d’années que j’ai supporté à sa place.
value: 你们这些罐头，最后得以和他一起看见光明，而我在替他承受了数百万年的时光之后，却被无视了。

key: Les gens disent que ce sont des monstres hideux…
value: 人们说它们是丑陋的怪物……

key: Les gens virent ce qu’ils désiraient au sein de la lumière scintillante de leurs cœurs.
value: 人们在心中闪烁的光芒里，看见了他们所渴望之物。

key: Let me introduce you to my imaginary friends! They asked me to! They’re screaming to be let out!
value: 让我给你介绍我的假想朋友吧！是他们让我这么做的！他们正尖叫着要出来！

key:
Let us abandon our old flesh.
We shall become one and continue this red march.
value:
让我们抛弃旧的血肉。
我们将合而为一，继续这殷红的征途。

key: Let us find peace from them.
value: 让我们从它们那里寻得安宁。

key: Let us meet again as stars.
value: 让我们化作星辰，再次相会。

key: Let us reach the paradise beyond death, together with the Abnormalities.
value: 让我们与异想体一同抵达死亡彼岸的天堂。

key: Let us record the world piece by piece, at the side of all those who are abandoned.
value: 让我们与被遗弃的所有人相伴，一点一点地记录这个世界。
让我们满怀敬畏地见证……

key: Let your strength merge with mine, so that we may deliver the power of love to all…
value: 让你的力量与我的相融，这样我们就能把爱的力量传递给所有人……

key: Let’s begin by hiring some new Agents. Try pressing the “Hire” button.
value: 让我们先从雇佣一些新员工开始。试着按下“雇佣”按钮。

key: Let’s keep focus. I can’t die here…
value: 保持专注。我不能死在这里……

key: Let’s see, Abnormality observation report. And here’s another Abnormality report… Oh! Here it is! The employee observation report!
value: 让我看看，异想体观察报告。这儿还有一份异想体报告……哦！找到了！员工观察报告！

key: Let’s take care of that idiot before things get out of control.
value: 趁事情还没失控，先把那个蠢货处理掉。

key: Let’s try a simple maneuver. When you hover your mouse over an Agent, some information about them will be shown in the top right corner. Please try selecting an Agent by pressing the primary mouse button (LMB).
value: 让我们尝试一个简单操作。当你把鼠标悬停在员工上时，屏幕右上角会显示他们的部分信息。请试着按下主鼠标键（LMB）选中一名员工。

key: Let’s try ordering an Agent to work with a new method. First, click on the Agent with the primary mouse button (LMB).
value: 让我们尝试用新方法命令员工工作。首先，用主鼠标键（LMB）点击该员工。

key: Libre de toute entrave, il rayonnait de la chaleur de son noyau.
value: 毫无束缚，他散发着来自核心的温暖。

key: Life is beautiful because it shines through the darkness of the night like a star.
value: 生命之所以美丽，是因为它像星星一样，穿透黑夜的暗幕闪耀。

key: Life’s beautiful like a candlelight, for it is weak, yet intense.
value: 生命之美如烛光，微弱，却炽烈。

key:
Like how every story starts, Kai was a child with a kind heart. When the shards of a mirror made by an evil fairy were scattered on everyone's heart, Kai began to see things he didn't want to see, or need to see. He left the small village he grew up in.

In an unforgiving blizzard, Kai met the Snow Queen. He became curious of the world beyond his knowledge. He felt as though everything he knew amounted to so little.
value:
正如每个故事的开头，凯是个心地善良的孩子。当邪恶仙女制造的魔镜碎片散落在每个人心上时，凯开始看到自己不想看到、也不需要看到的东西。他离开了自己长大的小村庄。

在一场无情的暴风雪中，凯遇见了雪之女王。他对认知之外的世界产生了好奇。他觉得自己所知道的一切都显得如此渺小。

key: Listening to this music box will make anyone feel like everything will be okay in the end, lifting their fatigue. However, excessive listening will make one lose grip on reality, and be driven mad.
value: 聆听这音乐盒，会让任何人都觉得一切终将好起来，疲劳也随之消散。然而，过度聆听会让人失去对现实的把握，被逼至疯狂。

key: Little by little, the portrait turned uglier and uglier. Eventually one will stop viewing the portrait and simply enjoy their unexpected luck.
value: 一点一点地，肖像画变得越来越丑陋。最终，人们会不再去看那幅画，只是尽情享受这不期而至的好运。

key: Lobotomy Corporation always puts forth the best effort to keep its employees happy.
value: 脑叶公司始终竭尽全力，让员工们保持快乐。

key: Lobotomy could have just thrown you a manual ‘dictionary’ with hundreds of pages.
value: 脑叶本可以丢给你一本数百页的说明书“词典”。

key: Long ago, $0’s heart was pierced by the magic bullet, which always hits its mark.
value: 很久以前，$0 的心脏被那支百发百中的魔弹贯穿了。

key: Look now, the result of your effort is before us. It is exactly as we needed. See, you’re a perfect fit as manager for the facility.
value: 看啊，你努力的成果就在我们面前。这正是我们所需要的。看吧，你完全适合担任这设施的负责人。

key: Look, manager, do you know that #0$0 died of blood loss because of #2$0?
value: 主管，你知道吗，#0$0 因 #2$0 失血过多而死了？

key: Looking into the mirror multiple times will gradually eat away one’s humanity until they become indistinguishable from a hollowed husk of a man, so caution is advised.
value: 多次凝视镜子会逐渐侵蚀一个人的人性，直到他与一具被掏空的人形空壳毫无分别，因此务必小心。

key: Maintenant que mon rôle dans cette pièce est fini, j’aimerais vivre hors de la scène pour changer.
value: 既然我在这出戏里的角色已经结束，我想换个活法，到舞台之外去过日子。

key: Maintenant, comme s’il n’y avait plus de lumière…
Mais j’ai aussi besoin de ce pouvoir.
Mais j’ai doucement fini par l’accepter.
value: 但我最终还是慢慢接受了。

key: Mais quel dommage, cependant. Il y a une dernière chose.
value: 不过，真是可惜。还有最后一件事。

key: Mais qu’est-ce qu’elle y a gagné ?
Make both a physical and mental attack.
value: 同时发动物理与精神攻击。

key: Mal consigo acreditar… Eu queria que nós pudéssemos ter visto isso acontecer.
value: 我简直不敢相信……我真希望我们能亲眼见证这一切。

key: Man, I’m totally craving hamburgers right now.
value: 天哪，我现在超想吃汉堡。

key: Manager! Don’t send me back there! I don’t want to die! I don’t wanna end up chopped to pieces!
value: 主管！别把我送回那里！我不想死！我不想被剁成碎片！

key: Manager! You’re watching, right? Please save me! Get rid of these things, please!
value: 主管！你在看着，对吧？请救救我！把这些东西除掉，求你了！

key: Manager, I got bit by an Abnormality a few days ago, and my finger still hurts. Do you think I could get workers comp. for this?
value: 主管，我几天前被异想体咬了一口，手指现在还疼。你觉得我能为这个申请工伤赔偿吗？

key: Manager, I was gone yesterday cause I had an upset stomach, had some bad salmon…
value: 主管，我昨天没来是因为闹肚子，吃了变质的鲑鱼……

key: Manager, do you think you’ll improve the employee welfare anytime soon?
value: 主管，你觉得你很快会改善员工福利吗？

key: Manager, gimme a break. I’m the only one who didn’t fail!
value: 主管，饶了我吧。我是唯一一个没不及格的人！

key: Manager, if you can see me, please make everything right again. Please save me.
value: 主管，如果你能看到我，请让一切恢复原状。请救救我。

key: Manager, let us have a moment of silence for #0$0, who died of brain damage caused by #2$0 in a rage… Done! Now let’s get back to work.
