key:
Many employees called it “The Devil’s Pendant.”
Some say just looking at it will fill up your mind with negativity.
Employees dislike being anywhere near the thing.
After all, it was the polar opposite of its other half.
Many would let out similar complaints that all ended with the same remark:
      “We wish it was only the white one.”
Its surroundings erode; those who come near it suffer.
This wasn’t the result of the pendant’s own volition; those things only happened because of the aura it exudes.
Then it must wonder: “Why do I exist?”
      “If my very existence corrodes my surroundings, and brings suffering and darkness to whoever interacts with me, maybe I shouldn’t have been born at all, just like they say.”
      “Maybe my creator only wanted to make the white pendant, and I’m just an unintentional accident.”
If so, how can such an impure being disappear from this world?
value:
许多员工称它为“恶魔的吊坠”。
有人说只要看它一眼，心中就会被负面情绪填满。
员工们都不愿靠近这东西。
毕竟，它是其另一半的绝对对立面。
许多人都会发出类似的抱怨，而抱怨都以同一句话收尾：
      “真希望只有白色的那个。”
它周围的环境会遭到侵蚀；靠近它的人会受苦。
这并非吊坠自身意愿的结果；这些事之所以发生，只因它散发出的气场。
于是它一定会想：“我为什么要存在？”
      “如果我自身的存在会侵蚀周围，给与我互动的人带来苦难与黑暗，那我或许根本不该出生，就像他们说的那样。”
      “也许我的创造者只想要那枚白色的吊坠，而我不过是一次无意的意外。”
若是如此，这样一个不洁之物，该如何从这世上消失？

key: Many employees file their temptation to push the button as so strong it gives them insomnia. However, as the number of employees claiming they are suffering from this temptation is quite large, a solution to this problem is being worked on currently.

key:
Many hunters longed to obtain even one of its feathers, as it would be their pride and honor. There were many tales about the bird. Some said that those who caught the bird would see their families prosper for many generations. A few even claimed that one wasn’t a true hunter until they had gotten one of the flamelike feathers. Others believed that one feather was so strong it could take the owner anywhere they dreamed of. Be what it may, the bird was a symbol of adventure to people.

The faraway forest was soon filled with people looking for the bird. Not only hunters, but adventurers and travelers too...

The once silent forest became a crowded place.
value:
许多猎人渴望得到它哪怕一根羽毛，因为那将是他们的骄傲与荣耀。关于这只鸟的传说数不胜数。有人说，抓到这只鸟的人会让家族繁荣数代。还有人声称，没拿到一根烈焰般的羽毛，就算不上真正的猎人。另一些人则相信，一根羽毛的力量足以带主人去任何梦想之地。无论如何，这只鸟对人们而言是冒险的象征。

远方的森林很快挤满了寻找这只鸟的人。不仅有猎人，还有冒险家和旅人……

曾经寂静的森林变成了一处熙熙攘攘之地。

key:
Memo:
      When training employees who have never worked with this Abnormality before, it goes without saying, but please make sure to tell them not to look at the Abnormality directly. If someone raises doubts about this, tell them what happened to employee Yumi, who didn't follow instructions and stared directly at the Abnormality.

Memo 2:
      Employee Yumi can no longer be in charge of this Abnormality. She claims that she is under constant surveillance, but this is a preposterous accusation and we believe that she has a severe delusional disorder. Most of what she says is nonsense, but to put it simply, she claims that someone keeps watching her, whether she's eating or going to the restroom. Also, whenever she sees something like a keyhole or a crack between a door, she will become hysterical and try to seal any hole that she sees. However what's more aggravating is that her mental corruption levels read normal, which makes it difficult for us to dispose of her by the system. Please replace her soon… 

Memo 3:
      Oh, the request we made before was resolved. Employee Yumi was found in her room. She covered all the holes in her room with duct tape, including the vent. She even stabbed her eyes out with a pen. The delusional disorder seems to have been resolved as well; she's not muttering nonsense anymore... However, I have to wonder why you would want to send a blind employee to the Containment Unit again. I don't know what Experiment D-004 is about, but I don't think it will do much good...
value:
便签：
      在培训从未与该异想体共事过的员工时，自不必说，但请务必告知他们不要直视异想体。若有人对此提出质疑，就告诉他们员工由美的事——她没有遵守指示直视了异想体。

便签 2：
      员工由美已不能再负责该异想体。她声称自己一直处于监视之下，但这实属荒谬的指控，我们认为她患有严重的妄想症。她说的大部分都是胡话，但简而言之，她声称无论是吃饭还是去洗手间，都有人一直在看着她。此外，每当她看到锁孔或门缝之类的东西，她就会歇斯底里，试图封住她看到的每一个孔洞。然而更让人恼火的是，她的精神腐蚀水平读数正常，这让我们难以通过系统处置她。请尽快替换她……

便签 3：
      哦，我们之前的请求已经解决了。员工由美被发现于自己的房间。她用胶带封住了房间里所有的孔洞，包括通风口。她甚至用笔捅瞎了自己的双眼。妄想症似乎也解决了；她不再胡言乱语了……不过，我不禁要问，为什么你要把一个盲人员工再次送进收容单元。我不知道实验 D-004 是什么，但我不认为这会有多大好处……

key:
Now after that the leader told us it’s time to move, and he said he got a van rented for us. We all thought he was an awesome guy for that. I hopped in the van with two employees from the horde and one guy from the same dept as me. Leader said it was gunna take about an hour drive so we could just nap if we wanted, so we did. Weird thing was though, I went to sleep real fast, like real fast. Like, the moment I shut my eyes I was out like a light. I have insomnia but for whatever reason I fell asleep so fast then. Sigh...that was my big mistake. Anyways, I was sound asleep, but then I heard seagulls, and was like, Wtf??? Seagulls??????? Yeah, at first I thought it was someone’s phone alarm, but then I heard waves crashing. I was like, “man this is way too real to be a phone alarm,” so I opened my eyes to find myself…
      …lying on a deck. I was on a goddamn boat, lmfao. AN ACTUAL, REAL-LIFE BOAT. I knew I was screwed the moment I saw shrimp hopping around. Sent chills down my spine. I wanted to believe it was all a dream but I swear that shrimp’s realistic flopping was a sobering sight. The realization crushed me like a hammer. And I was surrounded by people who looked like they were the crew. They were all beefed up, it felt like they’d put me back to sleep with force if I said something wrong. One slip and I’d be swimming with sharks.
value:
之后，领队告诉我们该出发了，他说他给我们租了一辆面包车。我们都觉得他为此真是个了不起的家伙。我和两个人潮里的员工，还有一个和我同部门的家伙一起上了车。领队说车程大约一小时，想睡的话可以小睡一会儿，于是我们就睡了。奇怪的是，我一下子就睡着了，真的非常快。就像我闭上眼的瞬间就睡死过去了。我有失眠症，但那次不知为何睡得那么快。唉……那是我最大的失误。总之，我睡得正香，却听到了海鸥的叫声，心想：搞什么？？？海鸥？？？？？是啊，起初我以为是谁的手机闹钟，但接着又听到了海浪拍打的声音。我想：“老兄，这真实得不像手机闹钟，”于是我睁开眼，发现自己……
      ……正躺在一层甲板上。我在一艘该死的船上，笑死。一艘真真切切、实实在在的船。看到活蹦乱跳的虾的那一刻，我就知道自己完了。寒意直窜脊背。我多想相信这只是一场梦，但我发誓，那只虾逼真的扑腾绝对是让人清醒的一幕。这个认知像锤子一样把我砸得粉碎。而我身边围满了看似船员的人。他们个个壮实得很，感觉我只要说错一句话，他们就会强行把我打晕。一步走错，我就得去跟鲨鱼一起游泳了。

key:
One day, a dense fog covered the city.
The hazy fog, thought to be a natural phenomenon at first, didn't dissipate even after a few days had passed.

Some claimed it was making them feel nauseous or making them retch, but most people thought nothing of it. A lot of people continued to work and go about their days in the fog.
Of course, Elijah was one of the people who had to be okay with it. She was the only family member with a proper job, and the inheritance of poverty had left them in huge debt. Elijah had several brothers, but their wills were broken after being faced with several failures.
Elijah was always tired, but she thought if she just worked a little harder, things would work themselves out. Just like what her parents used to say to her, and just like in fairy tales.
Just like that bird who eventually spread its white wings and became the envy of all.
value:
一天，浓雾笼罩了整座城市。
起初被认为是自然现象的朦胧雾气，几天过去也没有消散。

有人说雾让他们恶心、反胃，但大多数人并不在意。许多人在雾中继续工作、照常度日。
当然，以利亚也是那些不得不接受这一切的人之一。她是家里唯一有正经工作的人，贫穷的继承让他们背上了巨额债务。以利亚有好几个兄弟，但在屡次受挫之后，他们的意志已经破碎。
以利亚总是疲惫不堪，但她想，只要再努力一点，一切都会好起来的。就像她父母常对她说的那样，就像童话里那样。
就像那只最终展开白色翅膀、成为所有人艳羡之物的鸟儿那样。

key:
One day, on the way home after work, she bumped into a pedestrian running at full speed. Though the pedestrian who crashed into her was at a full sprint, he was unable to get back up, so she offered him a helping hand, asking if he was alright.

He slapped her hand away and got up on his own. The pedestrian took a few faltering steps before collapsing again. The man seemed like he was running away from something; he seemed worried that Elijah would hurt him.

Elijah tried to ask him what was wrong. However, the pedestrian opened his mouth first. The simple act of opening his mouth seemed labored, so she patiently waited for him to talk.

The pedestrian didn’t open his mouth to speak; he began to vomit a mixture of blood and waste.

The gooey mixture poured from his mouth at first, then it gushed out from his nose, ears, and eyes. If he hadn’t been expelling from all of his orifices, then Elijah might have tried to help him.

Elijah thought she heard a shout in the distance. She left the vomiting man behind and started to walk slowly.

What happens when the black swan wakes up from dreaming of a white swan?

There were many people amidst the fog. Some screaming, some laughing. Some wielding clubs, some curled up; bodies covered in wounds. Dark, wet, and fetid dregs were scattered all over the ground, covered in footprints.

She began to look for her brothers. Her family who needed to wear the nettle clothing to be free from the curse. Ones whom she shared happy dreams with.

She saw her dear brothers in the distance.

Elijah fell to her knees and finally started to puke up the thing everyone else was vomiting.

      The lake ripples gently. As if a number of swans just took flight.
value:
一天，下班回家的路上，她撞上了一个全速奔跑的行人。虽然撞上她的行人是全速冲刺，却没能再站起来，于是她向他伸出了援手，问他是否安好。

他拍开她的手，自己站了起来。行人踉跄了几步，又倒了下去。这个男人似乎正在逃避什么；他似乎担心以利亚会伤害他。

以利亚想问他怎么了。然而，行人先开了口。单单是张嘴这个动作似乎就已十分费力，于是她耐心地等他说话。

行人张嘴不是为了说话；他开始呕吐出血液与秽物的混合物。

黏稠的混合物起初从他嘴里涌出，接着又从他的鼻子、耳朵和眼睛里喷涌而出。如果他没有从所有孔窍同时涌出这些东西，以利亚或许还会试着帮他。

以利亚觉得自己听到了远处传来的喊叫声。她抛下那个呕吐的男人，开始缓缓前行。

当黑天鹅从梦见自己是白天鹅的梦中醒来时，会发生什么？

雾中有许多人。有的在尖叫，有的在大笑。有的挥舞着棍棒，有的蜷缩成一团；身上布满伤痕。暗色、潮湿而恶臭的渣滓散落满地，上面踩满脚印。

她开始寻找她的兄弟们。那些需要穿上荨麻衣才能摆脱诅咒的家人。那些曾与她共享美梦的人。

她看到了远处亲爱的兄弟们。

以利亚双膝跪地，终于也开始吐出其他所有人都在呕吐的东西。

      湖面泛起温柔的涟漪。仿佛有一群天鹅刚刚振翅起飞。

key: One day, she went inside the count's room. The room that she was instructed to never enter during the day. There she saw the count's true form. He was truly horrendous. Hundreds of eyes, four legs, he was neither human nor animal.
value: 一天，她走进了伯爵的房间。那间她被告知白天绝不能进入的房间。在那里，她看到了伯爵的真面目。他真是骇人至极。数百只眼睛，四条腿，既非人也非兽。

key:
One day, the black pendant heard a call:
      “Now the day has come. It is time for us to reunite.”
The black pendant left the place it thought it would never leave.
It found itself swimming away.

Everything it passed turned to ruin.
Destruction was but an instinct.
It wasn’t something that could be stopped, nor could it be hidden.
It could see the white pendant, no, it could see the part of itself that it hadn’t seen for a long, long time. The two opposites were swimming towards each other.
For the first time ever, the black pendant felt meaning in its existence.
      
      “We used to be one. I am, and thus you are. You are, and thus I am.
      We were originally together; it was a fruitless deed to divide us.
      Now you become the sky, and I the land.”
value:
一天，黑色吊坠听到了呼唤：
      “这一天已经到来。是我们重聚的时候了。”
黑色吊坠离开了它以为永远不会离开的地方。
它发现自己正在游走。

它所经过之处尽数化为废墟。
毁灭不过是本能。
它无法被阻止，也无法被隐藏。
它能看见那枚白色吊坠，不，它看见的是自己很久很久未曾见过的一部分。这对截然相反的存在正向着彼此游去。
有生以来第一次，黑色吊坠感到了自己存在的意义。
      
      “我们本是一体。我存在，所以你存在。你存在，所以我存在。
      我们原本就在一起；将我们分开是徒劳之举。
      如今你成为天空，我成为大地。”

key: One day, the marksman realized the Devil no longer followed him. He pondered why, then realized that his soul had already fallen to Hell from the beginning. The contract had already been fulfilled, so the Devil had left.

value: 定义异想体的最重要方面之一是“自由意志”。这异想体被确认拥有强烈的意志，能让周围的任何人都想按下它。因此，它被归类为异想体。

value: $0 对我们说过的话之一是：“宇宙中不存在巧合。”

key: One other thing: if an Agent is using an E.G.O Weapon whose Grade is higher than the Abnormality’s Risk Level (e.g. TETH > ZAYIN), they will deal more damage to the Abnormality and take less damage as well. In our current situation, the E.G.O’s Grade and the Abnormality’s Risk Level are the same (TETH = TETH), so this does not apply.
value: 还有一件事：如果员工使用的 E.G.O 武器等级高于异想体的危险等级（例如 TETH > ZAYIN），他们会对异想体造成更多伤害，自身受到的伤害也更少。在我们目前的情况下，E.G.O 的等级与异想体的危险等级相同（TETH = TETH），因此这不适用。

value: 人们不应试图去理解那些根本无法理解的事物。

key:
One sunny day, when they were sincerely drying the laundry in the yard, sadness struck suddenly.

“In our city, sacrifices for corporates must be highly praised. Honor for their deaths. No reason for you to cry either. Rather, you should be glad.”
“What's with that look on your face? That kind of facial expression isn't recommended in our city.”
“Goodness, why are you making such a face? You're making others feel gloomy too. Please be more considerate, you don't live in this world alone after all.”
“You are very poor at expressing your emotions. You must be quite shy.”
“Hey, try to look more pleased, that way those living in the Outskirts will be more envious of us.”
“Put a bigger smile on your face! It's not that hard.”
“Next time, try to express yourself more clearly, it's very important to express oneself in this society.”

One sunny day, just like that day they sincerely dried the laundry, they dried their own skin.
value:
一个阳光明媚的日子，当他们真心实意地在院子里晾晒衣物时，悲伤突然袭来。

“在我们的都市里，为公司献身必须受到高度赞扬。为他们的死亡感到荣耀。你也没有理由哭泣。相反，你应该感到高兴。”
“你脸上那是什么表情？在我们都市，不推荐那种表情。”
“天哪，你为什么做出这种表情？你让别人也感到压抑了。请多为别人着想，毕竟你不是独自活在这个世界上的。”
“你太不善于表达自己的情感了。你一定很害羞吧。”
“嘿，试着显得更高兴点，这样住在郊区的人会更嫉妒我们。”
“把笑容放大一点！这并不难。”
“下次，试着更清楚地表达自己，在这个社会里表达自我非常重要。”

一个阳光明媚的日子，就像那天他们真心实意地晾晒衣物一样，他们晾晒了自己的皮肤。

key: One will begin to feel strange. One will be unharmed by any shape or form of attacks, however, others will bear the pain instead.
value: 人会开始感到异样。任何形态的攻击都无法伤害自己，然而，其他人将代为承受痛苦。

key:
Pansy: Bonjour again. How’s work been going for you?
Xavier: Golly, the flowers just keep blooming. I think it’ll fill up the whole unit at this rate. You should see it for yourself. It’s really beautiful. I don’t think I’d ever get sick of looking at it.
Pansy: I’d love to, man, but I can’t. I’ve been so busy lately.
Xavier: Really? Damn, what a shame… It’s absolutely magnificent, I’m telling ya.
Pansy: Hmm… You doing alright by the way? You’ve been making a lotta mistakes these days… It seems like you’ve been spacing out a ton too.
Xavier: Don’t worry, it’s nothing. I gotta head back now. Oh, I’ve been making a sketch of the tree, actually. I’ll let you be the first person to see it when I’m done.
value:
帕西：又见面了，你好。工作还顺利吗？
泽维尔：天哪，花一直在开。照这速度，我觉得它们会开满整个单元。你真该亲眼看看。真的很美。我想我永远都看不厌。
帕西：我很想去看，兄弟，但我去不了。我最近太忙了。
泽维尔：真的吗？该死，真可惜……我跟你说，那绝对是美极了。
帕西：嗯……话说，你还好吗？你这几天犯了好多错……看起来你也经常走神。
泽维尔：别担心，没什么。我得回去了。哦，其实我一直在给那棵树画素描。画好后我会让你第一个看。

key:
Pansy: Hey Xavier, did you see that new Abnormality? I think you got put in charge of it.
Xavier: Yeah, I saw it alright. Just some tree with buds along its branches. I don’t think they’ll be able to blossom without sunlight.
Pansy: Did you start making observations and writing reports yet?
Xavier: Nah, I think I’ll get to it soon enough, though.
Pansy: Alrighty, take care.
value:
帕西：嘿，泽维尔，你看到那个新异想体了吗？我觉得它归你管了。
泽维尔：是啊，我看到了。就是棵枝条上长着花苞的树。我觉得没有阳光它们开不了花。
帕西：你开始做观察、写报告了吗？
泽维尔：还没，不过我想我很快就会去做的。
帕西：好吧，保重。

key:
Pansy: Heya, long time no see. How’s it going lately?
Xavier: Yo, get this! Y’know that Abnormality we talked about before? I don’t think it’s hostile. And guess what? It started blooming! It was so surreal looking at them, it felt like spring had come for the first time in this place.
Pansy: Is that okay? Usually, any sort of change is a bad omen for something catastrophic here.
Xavier: Don’t worry, it’s just some harmless little flowers. Thanks for worrying about me though!
value:
帕西：嘿，好久不见。最近怎么样？
泽维尔：哟，你听我说！还记得我们之前聊过的那个异想体吗？我觉得它并不敌对。你猜怎么着？它开始开花了！看着它们，感觉那么超现实，仿佛这地方第一次迎来了春天。
帕西：那样没事吗？通常在这里，任何变化都是某种灾难的凶兆。
泽维尔：别担心，只是些无害的小花。不过还是谢谢你担心我！

key:
People have been committing sins since long ago. “Why do they commit sins, knowing it's wrong?" The small bird wondered.

“It must be because there's no one to punish people for their misdeeds. If someone takes that role, then no foul act would happen in this world ever again!”

With this in mind, the little bird left the forest it had been living in, and never went back.
value:
人们自古以来便一直在犯罪。“明知那是错的，他们为什么还要犯罪？”小鸟想不通。

“一定是因为没有人惩罚人们的恶行。如果有谁来承担这个角色，那么这世上就再也不会发生任何邪恶之举了！”

怀着这个念头，小鸟离开了它一直生活的森林，再也没有回去。

key: People say they are hideous monsters…

key:
People soon became bored with the rumors; they were no longer interested in the hunt. Fewer and fewer people paid any sort of visit to the faraway forest. When the bird finally became nothing but a legend, it experienced a great pain, being blinded. Now all that was left of this legend was a blind bird with bright feathers, alone in an abandoned forest.

After a long time had passed, the bird found a new forest. Many people lived in that forest, and the bird just wanted their eagerness to pursue it to once again be stoked like the fiery hues of its blazing feathers.

Those who succeed in the hunt are granted with one of the very feathers that countless hunters once yearned for.
value:
人们很快就对传说失去了兴趣；他们对狩猎不再感兴趣。前往远方森林的人越来越少。当这只鸟最终只剩下传说时，它遭受了巨大的痛苦——被弄瞎了双眼。如今，这传说只余下一只羽色鲜亮的盲鸟，孤零零地待在被遗弃的森林里。

很久很久以后，这只鸟找到了一片新森林。那片森林里住着许多人，而这只鸟只希望他们对追逐自己的渴望，能像它燃烧羽毛的烈焰色泽一样被再度点燃。

在狩猎中成功的人，将获得一根无数猎人曾经渴望的羽毛。

key:
Pretty soon I won't be able to keep talking. I'm about to swallow a large bomb. Time's running out. Blood is flowing all around here. I'm starting to see the smiling faces now... Something you don't see much of around here.

Don't be surprised when you hear a loud explosion. Like I said, it's precisely 3 minutes. I'm sure a bomb this size will be able to suppress it.

The last body it finds will be mine.
value:
很快我就没法再说话了。我就要吞下一枚大炸弹。时间不多了。这里到处都在流血。我开始看到那些笑脸了……在这附近不怎么常见的东西。

听到巨大的爆炸声时别惊讶。就像我说的，正好是 3 分钟。我确信这么大的一枚炸弹足以镇压它。

它找到的最后一具尸体，会是我的。

value: 允许向 $0 请求援助。$0 同意以消耗我们当前能量 10% 为代价执行这一请求。

key: Resource Management is the one place I know for a fact I’d dip out of. I heard you gotta bust your ass daily there.
value: 资源管理部门是我确定一定会躲开的地方。我听说在那里每天都得拼死拼活。

key: Returning to whence one came in one piece is now a miracle that will never happen.
value: 全身而退地回到来处，如今已成为一个永不会发生的奇迹。

key: Rudolph: An organic entity in colors of green, red, and white that appears to be a horse or a deer. Its muscles do not seem to move, but many of our staff report movement in the eyes. Some even say that they’ve made eye contact with it. There’s a 30cm diameter hole in its abdomen. Armed employees later reported that the hole was empty.
value: 鲁道夫：一个由绿、红、白三色组成的有机实体，外形像是马或鹿。它的肌肉似乎不会动，但我们的许多员工报告说它的眼睛会动。有些人甚至说与它有过眼神接触。它腹部有一个直径 30 厘米的洞。持械员工后来报告说，那个洞是空的。

key: Rumor has it that any employee who opened $0’s lid later requested a sick leave.
value: 有传言说，任何打开过 $0 盖子的员工，事后都请了病假。

key: Rumor has it that passionate battle cries or shouts such as “CHARGE!” can be heard from the armor in the middle of the night.
value: 有传言说，深夜里能听到从这套护甲中传出激昂的战斗呐喊，比如“冲锋！”。

key: Rumor has it this Abnormality was chosen to be used for training as it is the most docile and tame of any that we have extracted. It’s called a training dummy “rabbit”, but it doesn’t seem to enjoy carrots. It likes people. If it escapes, it is merely following the employee as they leave its Containment Unit.
value: 有传言说，这异想体因为是我们提取的所有异想体中最温顺驯服的，所以被选来用于训练。它被称为训练假人“兔子”，但它似乎并不喜欢胡萝卜。它喜欢人类。如果它逃出来，那只是因为它跟着离开其收容单元的员工走而已。

key: Rumor says that the curse will fall upon you if you hear the thirteenth ring.
value: 有传言说，如果你听到第十三次铃声，诅咒就会降临到你身上。

key: Rumor says that you might get one of your organs removed after drinking an open can of grape-flavored soda.
value: 有传言说，喝下一罐已开封的葡萄味汽水后，你可能会被摘除某个器官。

key: Rumors say some employees yearn to be penetrated by the tentacle.
value: 有传言说，一些员工渴望被触手刺穿。

key: Sabes muito bem sobre isso, Gebura. Sim, o poder da semente é grandioso.
value: 你对此很清楚，格贝拉。是的，种子的力量是伟大的。

key: Same shit, different day. We just follow orders.
value: 一样烂的破事，不一样的一天。我们只是听从命令而已。

key: Santa: A mysterious and transparent organic entity on top of Rudolph. It is full of what seems to be human organs, all of which function normally.
value: 圣诞老人：鲁道夫上方一个神秘而透明的有机实体。里面装满了看似人类器官的东西，全都功能正常。

key: Satiating Abnormalities is more than just feeding them, it turns out.
value: 事实证明，满足异想体不仅仅是喂食它们那么简单。

key: Save us now and forevermore. The truth shall set us free.
value: 救救我们，从现在直到永远。真相将使我们自由。

key: Say, how’s it sound to change the cafeteria menu to a full-course buffet?
value: 喂，把食堂菜单改成全套自助餐怎么样？

key: Say, manager, You wanna share a cup of coffee?
value: 喂，主管，要一起喝杯咖啡吗？

key: Say, manager, is ‘Magical Girl’ as dangerous as the rumors say? I just started working here so I haven’t seen her yet.
value: 喂，主管，‘魔法少女’真像传闻说的那么危险吗？我刚来这里上班，还没见过她。

key: Say, you wanna join our get-together after work, manager? It’ll be fun!
value: 喂，主管，下班后要不要加入我们的聚会？会很好玩的！

key: Scores of $0’s eyes suddenly direct themselves towards #0.
value: $0 的众多眼睛突然齐刷刷地转向 #0。

key: Seeing as you have learned the preferences for Attachment Work, the Success Rate the Agent will have and the amount of time needed to perform the work are displayed. You can also see the various details of the Agent by mousing over them. This will allow you to make mindful decisions when giving out orders. Please select an Agent to do the work.
value: 既然你已经了解了依附工作的偏好，员工的成功率与完成工作所需的时间都会显示出来。你也可以通过将鼠标悬停在员工上来查看他们的各种详细信息。这能让你在下达命令时做出审慎的决定。请选择一名员工进行这项工作。

key: Sendo imparável, ela brilhou de pé com calor no seu interior.
value: 势不可挡，她昂然挺立，闪耀着来自内心的温暖。

key: Seniors like me have a better understanding of this company. Of course, this is stuff like things that even you don’t know.
value: 像我这样的前辈更了解这家公司。当然，这些都是连你也不知道的事。

key: Senpai, if I had to face you outside, I’d totally be dead by now…
value: 前辈，如果要在外面与你为敌，我现在早就死透了……

key: Senpai… I know you tried your hardest to hold it back…
value: 前辈……我知道你已经尽了最大努力去克制……

key: Seres que não são melhores que as Anormalidades existirão com o ego caído, e também seres que se tornarão algo maior.
value: 并不比异想体更好的存在，将以堕落之自我存续；也会有存在，将化为更伟大的东西。

key: Seules des graines faibles et fragiles furent plantées de la lumière qui aurait dû éclairer le monde pendant sept jours, mais qui n’en dura finalement que trois.
value: 那本应照亮世界七天、却最终只持续三天的光，只种下了孱弱易碎的种子。

key: She gave me the burning desire of life, the loneliness of existence, and a detestable feeling of longing.
value: 她给了我燃烧的生命渴望、存在的孤独，以及一种可憎的眷恋之感。

key: She must be waiting, like we are.
value: 她一定在等着，就像我们一样。

key: She must have wanted to live, even while striving for the greater good.
value: 即使在为更伟大的善而努力时，她一定也想活下去。

key: She really hopes that #0 will be happy with her heartfelt gift.
value: 她由衷地希望 #0 会喜欢她这份诚挚的礼物。

key: She was so sad that she had to leave her dear friends behind, so she came up with a brilliant idea!
value: 她为不得不抛下亲爱的朋友们而悲伤不已，于是她想出了一个绝妙的主意！

key: She was so talkative before, yet in the end, loneliness was the only listener.
value: 她从前那么健谈，可到头来，孤独是唯一的听众。

key:
She will attempt to talk to or pique the interest of those who are about to leave her Containment Unit. However, one should never look back in response, as it may cause mental damage.

Certain rumors insist that one may turn to stone upon looking back, but this is clearly not true.
value:
她会试图与那些即将离开她收容单元的人交谈，或勾起他们的兴趣。然而，千万不能回头回应，因为这可能会造成精神伤害。

有些传言坚称，回头的人会变成石头，但这显然不是真的。

key: Shells are just shells, we must not forget what they cover.
value: 外壳终究只是外壳，我们不能忘记它们所包裹的东西。

key: She’s just a machine that follows orders, can be a bit feisty sometimes though…
value: 她只是个服从命令的机器，不过有时也会有点暴躁……

key: Shit! My clothes are on fire!
Shouldn’t the manager at least be held a bit responsible for the death of that employee?
value: 那位员工的死，主管难道不应该至少承担一点责任吗？

key: Shrimp are delicious no matter how you cook them. Boil ‘em, fry ‘em, whatever!
value: 虾无论怎么做都很好吃。煮着吃、炸着吃，随便怎么都行！

key: Sigh, I wish I could go home in time today…
value: 唉，真希望今天能按时回家……

key: Sigh… There’s not a single handsome guy here…
value: 唉……这里一个帅哥都没有……

key: Silence is no longer just bringing peace.
value: 沉默不再仅仅带来安宁。

key: Sim, nós finalmente poderemos flutuar em um sono sem fim.
value: 是的，我们终于可以漂浮在无尽的睡眠中。
是的，我们把他们记录在这里吧……

key: Since you have yet to unlock any information about this Abnormality, you have no way of knowing how it will respond to the four different Work Types. In order to learn this information, an Agent will need to perform a work with it. For now, please select the first Work Type available, Instinct Work.
value: 由于你尚未解锁这异想体的任何信息，你无从得知它会对四种不同的工作类型作何反应。为了了解这些信息，需要一名员工对它进行一次工作。现在，请选择第一个可用的工作类型：本能工作。

key: Small Bird decided to punish the creatures' wrongdoings with its beak.
value: 小鸟决定用它的喙惩罚众生的恶行。

key: Small Bird's mouth that could devour anything was shut,
value: 小鸟那张能吞噬一切的嘴被合上了，

key: So I truly am nothing after all…
value: 所以我终究还是一无所有……

key: So a lot’s happened up to now. To summarize the whole thing, this Abnormality is the best thing we’ve ever had here. A few months ago, I took a chance asking this Abnormality for help, and ever since I’ve been using it. I’ve gotten help from it about (Redacted) times by now. My efficiency at work has gotten so much better too. At this point, just looking at something pink makes me feel better. Those creatures bolster in a way even the greatest leaders can’t match. This Abnormality will greatly improve our employees’ quality of life.
value: 到现在已经发生了很多事。总的来说，这异想体是我们这里迄今为止最好的东西。几个月前，我冒险向这异想体求助，从那以后就一直在用它。到现在我已经得到过它（已编辑）次的帮助。我的工作效率也大大提高了。到了现在，光是看到粉色的东西，我就会感觉好起来。那些生物以一种连最伟大的领袖都无法企及的方式鼓舞人心。这异想体将极大地改善我们员工的生活质量。

key: So damn tired, I just wanna sleep at home.
value: 累死了，我只想回家睡觉。

key: So now you must be wondering what happens when the Qliphoth Counter drops to zero, no? Shall we find out? Please select the Containment Unit and order an Agent to perform Repression Work.
value: 那么现在你一定在好奇，当逆卡巴拉计数器降到零时会发生什么，对吧？让我们一起去看看？请选择收容单元，命令一名员工进行压迫工作。

key: So there is an all-mighty existence beyond the realm of us beings…
value: 原来在我们这些存在的领域之外，还有一个全知全能的存在……

key: So this is the true face of Lobotomy Corporation…
value: 这就是脑叶公司的真面目……

key: So we AREN’T doing any hazing for the new manager? Lame.
value: 所以我们不给新主管搞点下马威？真没劲。

key: So we aren’t planning a welcome party for the new manager?
value: 所以我们不打算为新主管办欢迎会？

key: So we’ll finally be shut down? Ah, we can rest at last!
value: 所以我们终于要被关停了？啊，我们终于可以休息了！

key: So what are you all chirping about?
value: 你们都在叽叽喳喳说什么呢？

key: So you still have your silky hair?
value: 所以你还留着那头柔顺的头发？

key: So you’re to blame! If it weren’t for you, it wouldn’t have gone this way!
value: 都怪你！如果不是你，事情不会变成这样！

key: So you’ve been consumed too, senpai… Can this cycle really not be stopped?
value: 前辈，你也被吞噬了吗……这个循环真的无法停止吗？

key: So, I need you to fall asleep.
So, does this mean everyone out there changed into something else somehow?
value: 那么，这是否意味着外面的所有人都以某种方式变成了别的东西？

key: So, we need to satisfy the Abnormalities’ desires, such as hunger, with Instinct.
value: 那么，我们需要用本能工作来满足异想体的欲望，比如饥饿。

key: Some employees reported that they heard a voice coming from the stomach of $0. Rescue should be possible after suppression when it escapes. It may be possible to contract help from F-01-57.
value: 一些员工报告说，他们听到了从 $0 腹部传来的声音。当它逃逸时，镇压之后应该可以实施救援。或许可以从 F-01-57 那里获得帮助。

key:
Some employees suffering from the phenomenon showed the following symptoms over time:
1. Green skin and a rash on the body.
2. Drastically reduced movement speed.
If either of these symptoms is seen on any employee, handle them immediately.
value:
一些受该现象困扰的员工随时间推移出现了以下症状：
1. 皮肤变绿，身上出现皮疹。
2. 移动速度急剧下降。
如果在任何员工身上发现上述任一症状，请立即处理。

key: Some employees who were addicted to $0’s pleasure tried to pull out its thorns, but failed.
value: 一些沉溺于 $0 之快感的员工试图拔掉它的刺，但失败了。

key: Some of our employees think that $0 is trapped inside this thing that resembles an egg, however, the truth is that she shut herself inside it.
value: 我们的一些员工认为 $0 被困在某个形似蛋的东西里，然而，真相是她自己把自己关在了里面。

key: Some of this type deliberately descended from “high” to “medium” after realizing there is absolutely no merit in finishing the work quickly.
value: 这种类型中的一些人，在意识到快速完成工作毫无益处之后，会故意从“高”降级到“中等”。

key: Some of us have been here before you even sat down at that desk of yours. Don’t believe everything you see.
value: 我们中的一些人在你坐上那把椅子之前就已经在这里了。别相信你看到的一切。

key: Some people just have to do what they’re told not to do.
value: 有些人就是非得去做被禁止的事。

key:
Some people left the city to escape the fog.

They said the city was done for. Elijah didn't listen.

Elijah felt queasy at times. She felt her whole body blistering.

Almost there, just a little more; if she held out just a little longer, the clothes made of nettles would be complete, and if she threw them to her brothers she once loved dearly, then the days when her family lived harmoniously could be restored.
value:
有些人离开了都市，以逃离浓雾。

他们说都市已经完了。以利亚没有听。

以利亚时常感到恶心。她觉得自己的全身都在起水泡。

就快好了，再坚持一下；只要她再撑一会儿，荨麻制成的衣服就能完成，而只要把它们抛给她曾经深爱的兄弟们，一家人和睦相处的日子就能重现。

key: Some thought death would be a new beginning; however, there is nothing but the void after death.
value: 有些人以为死亡会是一个新的开始；然而，死亡之后唯有虚空。

key: Someday, someone made an offer to me.
value: 有一天，有人向我提出了一个提议。

key: Somehow, bald people always look professional no matter what they’re doing!
value: 不知为何，光头的人无论做什么都看起来很专业！

key: Somente sementes fracas e frágeis foram plantadas pela luz que deveria ter iluminado o mundo por sete dias, porém só durou por três.
value: 那本应照亮世界七天、却只持续三天的光，只种下了孱弱易碎的种子。

key: Someone call the Emergency Planning Team! We’re all going to die here!
value: 快叫应急规划小组！我们都会死在这里！

key: Someone get a fire extinguisher! It’s too hot!
Someone told me that there are no bad guys anymore… Is that true?
value: 有人告诉我，这世上已经没有坏人了……这是真的吗？

key: Someone's persistent gaze can be felt from the keyhole inside the machine.
value: 可以感觉到来自机器内部锁孔的、持续不断的注视。

key: Someone's persistent gaze can be felt from the keyhole inside the machine. It blinks, but never closes. The purpose of the eye or what it is observing is unknown.
value: 可以感觉到来自机器内部锁孔的、持续不断的注视。它会眨眼，但从不闭上。这只眼睛的目的，以及它在观察什么，都不得而知。

key: Someone’s just hit the maximum mental corruption level!
value: 有人刚刚达到了精神腐蚀的极限！

key: Something in my heart wavers every time I do Repression work.
value: 每次进行压迫工作时，我心中的某处都会动摇。

key: Something that I could only obtain after a million years…
value: 那是我唯有在一百万年后才能得到的东西……

key: Something unfortunate may come to pass if you do not pay attention to #2$0. Though I am aware that this is a difficult task to perform with only two eyes.
value: 如果你不留意 #2$0，可能会有不幸的事发生。虽然我知道，仅凭两只眼睛要做到这一点是件难事。

key: Something’s stuck between my teeth… Must be that chicken sandwich from lunch.
value: 有什么东西卡在我的牙缝里……一定是午饭的那个鸡肉三明治。

key: Sometimes I feel like I’ve awakened from a long slumber.
value: 有时我觉得自己像是从一场漫长的沉睡中醒来。

key: Sometimes I wish I could go back to when I was younger. Just mere fantasy, though.
value: 有时我希望自己能回到更年轻的时候。不过，这仅仅是幻想罢了。

key: Sometimes these types would complain, saying things like “If I did one more push-up there, I would be classified as ‘high’.” But you don’t have to listen to them.
value: 这种类型的人有时会抱怨，说些“如果我当时再多做一下俯卧撑，就会被评定为‘高’了”之类的话。但你大可不必理会他们。

key: Sometimes, it engages in unintelligible linguistic activity. An employee tried to decode what it is saying, but resulted in mental derangement. (See document 1 <Song of employee David>)
value: 有时，它会进行难以理解的语言活动。一名员工曾试图破译它的话语，结果精神错乱。（参见文件 1《员工大卫之歌》）

key: Sometimes, some of these types arrogantly think they can handle it without a weapon. If they do, just ignore them.
value: 有时，这种类型中的一些人会傲慢地以为，没有武器也能应付得了。如果他们这样想，无视他们就好。

key: Somewhere in the distance, you can hear seagulls.
value: 在远处的某个地方，你能听到海鸥的叫声。

key: Spiders have strong maternal instincts. They will defend their offspring at all costs.
value: 蜘蛛有强烈的母性本能。它们会不惜一切代价保护自己的后代。

key: Spring arrived with blossoming roses. Gerda and Kai held hands, and they walked home.
value: 春天随着绽放的玫瑰一同到来。格尔达和凯手牵着手，走回了家。

key: Stats regarding Fortitude will greatly increase while $0 is worn.
value: 穿戴 $0 时，与坚韧相关的属性会大幅提升。

key: Stats regarding Justice will increase greatly when $0 is equipped. However, all stats regarding Prudence will drop at the same time.
value: 装备 $0 时，与正义相关的属性会大幅提升。然而，所有与谨慎相关的属性会同时下降。

key: Still, it didn’t matter to him. After all, he was “destined” to be a big bad wolf.
value: 不过，这对他来说并不重要。毕竟，他“注定”要成为一只大恶狼。

key: Stop! Manager! Think of those poor employees. Don’t you have any pity for them?
value: 住手！主管！想想那些可怜的员工吧。你就一点也不怜悯他们吗？

key: Suas obrigações acabaram e também as minhas.
value: 你的职责结束了，我的也是。

key: Subjects who consume $0 instantly recover physically. Furthermore, they will continue to heal over time.
value: 服用 $0 的对象会立即恢复体力。此外，他们的伤势还会随时间推移持续愈合。

key: Successful work completion will cause a healing (HP/SP) Token of Friendship to be bestowed upon the employee. The amount of healing will vary in relation to $0’s Qliphoth Counter.
value: 成功完成工作后，一枚友谊之愈（HP/SP）代币将被赐予员工。治疗量与 $0 的逆卡巴拉计数器数值相关。

key: Such a beautiful finale, isn’t it?
value: 多么美丽的终幕啊，不是吗？

key: Such a tempting offer. I could become something that I could only wish to be.
value: 真是诱人的提议。我可以变成那个我只能在梦里成为的存在。

key: Suppose I’ll buy W Corp’s travel package when my vacation time finally rolls up.
value: 等我的休假终于到来时，大概会买W公司的旅行套餐吧。

key: Surprisingly, the beast laughed in its last moments.
value: 令人意外的是，那野兽在最后的时刻笑了。

key: THAT PERSON WILL KILL US ALL! THIS PLACE WILL TURN TO HELL FOR US!
value: 那个人会杀了我们所有人！这里对我们来说将变成地狱！

key: Tais sementes incompletas deram poderes instáveis para a humanidade.
value: 这些不完整的种子，给了人类不稳定的力量。

key: Talvez alguns deles até mesmo sejam capazes de manifestar os seus próprios E.G.Os assim como eu fiz.
value: 也许他们中的一些人，甚至能够像我一样，显现出属于他们自己的E.G.O。
任务进行中（点击查看日志）

key: Tell me if anything bad happens, okay? I know I can help you!
value: 如果发生什么坏事就告诉我，好吗？我知道我能帮上忙！

key: Tell the kid today's treat is going to be grape-flavored candy. It's his favorite.
value: 告诉那孩子，今天的零食是葡萄味糖果。那是他的最爱。

key: Thanks to this shelter, the selected refugees were safely shielded from the ocean of endless screams and bloodshed.
value: 多亏了这个避难所，被选中的难民才得以安全地避开那无尽尖叫与杀戮的海洋。

key: That is why I do not make promises.
value: 正因如此，我才不做承诺。

key: That night, when stars showered down from the sky, a child walked.
value: 那一夜，当群星自天穹倾泻而下时，一个孩子行走着。

key: That one’s as strong as a minor arcana... Is this place filled with villains?
value: 那家伙强得像小阿卡纳一样……这地方是塞满了恶棍吗？

key: That thing’s gonna kill us all! We’re done for!
value: 那东西会杀了我们所有人！我们完蛋了！

key: That was excellent. Truly well done. If you ever happen to fall into a situation you would wish to redo, such as turning back time to avoid the death of an Agent, you can do so by pressing ESC and clicking the Rewind to Memory Repository button or by clicking Retry. When you choose Memory Repository, you will go back to the most recent Imprinted Day. Retry, on the other hand, will restart back at the current day’s Deployment.
value: 刚才做得非常出色。真的干得漂亮。如果你不慎陷入想要重来的局面——例如倒转时间以避免某名员工的死亡——你可以按ESC键，点击“回溯至记忆库”按钮，或点击“重试”。选择记忆库时，你将回到最近的记忆铭刻日。而选择重试，则会从当天的部署阶段重新开始。

key:
That's how its creation began, from the mountains of bodies. The dead gave life to something. Amazed yet? I've still got more to tell you. The dead fused with one another, all smiling. Sharing body parts, at least those that were still intact, they became each other's legs and mouths. That doesn't mean their consciousness has also been restored though. It only wants one thing: our flesh drenched in blood. When there’s an announcement of someone’s death, the first thing you should do is check if this thing’s quarantined. Once it gets a whiff of the scent, it will pursue us in an instant. The smiling faces are unfamiliar yet sorrowful.

The more bodies it comes across, the more defined its shape becomes. And it is never satisfied.

I'm telling you all this because it's almost here. Accidents always happen in this place. Some may spare a bit of their time for a moment of silence, but most will turn away thinking, "Again?". At the very least, one thing that was done right is that the department’s been sealed off. I'm the only one left anyways. Did you learn anything from my story? What kind of lesson can be learned from a story as horrible as this, you ask? It's similar to most fairy tales. "Don't be lazy" is the lesson. When my voice ceases, come here and clean up your colleagues in exactly 3 minutes.
value:
它的诞生就是这样开始的，从那堆成山的尸体中。死者赋予了某个东西生命。惊讶吗？我还有很多要告诉你。死者彼此融合，全都微笑着。分享着身体部位——至少是那些还完好的部分——他们成了彼此的腿和嘴。但这并不意味着他们的意识也一同恢复了。它只想要一样东西：我们浸满鲜血的血肉。当有死亡通告响起时，你要做的第一件事就是检查这东西是否已被隔离。一旦它嗅到气味，就会立刻追上我们。那些笑脸既陌生又悲伤。

它接触的尸体越多，身形就越清晰。而且它永不满足。

我告诉你这些，是因为它已经快到了。这地方总会发生意外。有些人也许会抽出片刻默哀，但大多数人只会转过身去，心想：“又来了？”。至少有一件事做对了——部门已经被封锁。反正我是最后一个留下的人。你从我的故事里学到了什么吗？你问，这么可怕的故事能学到什么教训？它和大多数童话相似。“不要偷懒”就是教训。当我的声音停止时，过来，在整整3分钟内收拾好你的同事们。

key:
That's what a gaze is. Attention. An invisible string that connects us. Sole focus.

Do not come here, as there is no place for you to rest.

Is this what you wanted to see?

When your tears dry up at last, tell me your answer.
value:
注视，就是这么一回事。是注意。是连接我们的无形之线。是唯一的焦点。

不要来这里，这里没有可供你休憩的地方。

这就是你想看到的吗？

当你的眼泪终于干涸时，告诉我你的答案。

key: That’s a bunny… That’s a fluffy, cute bunny…
value: 那是兔子……那是一只毛茸茸的可爱兔子……

key: That’s how competent and sophisticated I am.
value: 我就是这么能干、这么老练。

key: That’s right. Our manager has made his final request to me; it is to permanently seal this company and give you Sephirot an eternal rest.
value: 没错。我们的主管向我提出了最后的请求；那就是永久封印这家公司，让你们赛菲拉得到永恒的安息。

key: The #0 employee went to $0 for a job that was not listed in the scenario. $0's mood value was reduced by a small amount, confirming that energy was produced. It was found that a faint curtain was formed in the $0’s containment room.
value: #0员工为了一个不在预案中的工作前往 $0 处。$0 的心情值减少了一小部分，确认有能量产出。还发现 $0 的收容室里形成了一道微弱的帷幕。

key: The #1$0 was not the correct approach with #2$0. Manager, let us have a moment of silence for #0$0 who died of brain damage… Done! Now let’s get back to work.
value: 对 #2$0 来说，#1$0 并不是正确的方式。主管，让我们为因脑损伤而死的 #0$0 默哀片刻……好了！现在我们回去工作吧。

key: The Abnormalities are always so picky about their games.
value: 异想体们对它们的游戏总是这么挑剔。

key: The Abnormalities are more dangerous than I thought.
value: 异想体比我以为的还要危险。

key: The Abnormality does have a tongue, however, it has no knowledge of speech and as such cannot talk; it can only make meaningless sounds. There is no telling what is inside its shell, but its skin continuously wears down, so there is a need to change and maintain the outer layer. It is insensible to pain; it may break its own bones or cut itself up to escape through a small crevice.
value: 这异想体确实有舌头，然而，它并不知晓言语，因此无法说话；它只能发出毫无意义的声音。无法得知它的壳里是什么，但它的皮肤会不断磨损，因此需要更换和维护外层。它没有痛觉；它可能会折断自己的骨头，或割开自己的身体，以穿过一条狭小的缝隙逃走。

key: The Abnormality is similar to a fairy, having two pairs of wings and a small body. They act as a cluster.
value: 这异想体与仙子相似，长着两对翅膀和娇小的身体。它们以群体行动。

key: The Abnormality produces motile, microscopic airborne spores. They mostly proliferate by invading other organisms through their respiratory systems. It is difficult to notice the initial symptoms from this invasion because the only sensations are a light dyspnea and dry, sandy throat. Thus, it is mandatory to wear a mask when working with this Abnormality.
value: 这异想体会产生能动的、微小的空气传播孢子。它们大多通过侵入其他生物的呼吸系统来增殖。由于这种入侵的初期症状很难察觉——只有轻微呼吸困难和干燥沙哑的喉咙——因此，在与这异想体工作时必须佩戴口罩。

key: The Abnormality resides inside the host's brain, and the host will not be able to feel any physical sensation. You can try stabbing the employee with something sharp, feigning it as a mistake, but this is not recommended. As mentioned before, the host should already be around 30% merged with the Abnormality, so conversing will be impossible.
value: 这异想体寄居于宿主的脑内，宿主将无法感受到任何身体感觉。你可以试着用尖锐的东西刺向员工，假装是失误，但这并不推荐。如前所述，宿主应该已经与异想体融合了约30%，因此交谈已不可能。

key: The Abnormality's tentacles (which are quite different from what we consider the average tentacle; for simplicity’s sake we’ve monickered them as “tentacles”) can pierce through the barrier of humanity. Employees impaled by the tentacles will suffer semi-permanent brain damage.
value: 这异想体的触手（与我们通常所认为的一般触手颇为不同；为简便起见，我们将其戏称为“触手”）能够刺穿人性的屏障。被触手刺穿的员工将遭受半永久性的脑损伤。

key: The Abnormality’s Qliphoth Counter can be raised by 1 via a special work type. To satisfy the Abnormality, an employee must be selected from a random drawing.
value: 通过一种特殊的工作类型，这异想体的逆卡巴拉计数器可以上升1点。为满足异想体，须通过随机抽选来选定一名员工。

key: The Agent you were customizing has just been hired. How about we take a look at their information again? Please click on the Agent.
value: 你刚才在定制的员工刚刚被录用了。我们再来看一下他们的信息如何？请点击那名员工。

key: The Big Bird’s eyes imprisoned light.
The City encouraged $0 to keep smiling, but they who were too shy to reveal themself instead chose to...
value: 都市鼓励 $0 保持微笑，但那个羞于展现自我的它，却选择了……

key: The Containment Room will burn down! Do something!
value: 收容室要被烧毁了！快想想办法！

key: The Containment Unit fills with the unprecedented harmony that leaks from $0.
value: 收容单元中充满了从 $0 身上泄漏出的前所未见的和谐。

key: The Containment Unit is one giant spiderweb. As soon as an employee enters it, the spider’s eyes are fixed on its prey.
value: 收容单元是一张巨大的蜘蛛网。员工一进入，蜘蛛的目光便牢牢锁定了它的猎物。

key: The Control Team doesn’t do much, right?
value: 控制部其实没多少活干，对吧？

key: The Devil ultimately wished for despair.
value: 恶魔最终所祈愿的，是绝望。

key: The Funeral of the Dead Butterflies
The Long Bird’s arms concealed time.
value: 长鸟的双臂遮蔽了时间。

key: The Meltdown can be resolved by performing works with the Abnormalities whose Containment Units are affected. If the Meltdown is not dismissed within the time limit, a portion of energy that we have collected will be lost, and the Qliphoth Counter of the Containment Unit will immediately drop to 0; please try to prevent this from happening. You can find more detailed information about this in the “Work-Count Penalties” section of the Manager’s Manual.
value: 逆卡巴拉熔毁可以通过对受影响的收容单元中的异想体进行工作来解决。如果未在时限内解除熔毁，我们已收集的一部分能量将会损失，且该收容单元的逆卡巴拉计数器会立即降至0；请尽力阻止这种情况发生。你可以在主管手册的“工作次数惩罚”部分找到更详细的信息。

key: The Monster in the Black Forest
The Qliphoth Counter decreased after 3 non-Insight works were performed in a row.
value: 连续进行了3次非洞察工作后，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: The Qliphoth Counter decreased every time an Abnormality escaped. However, it did not respond to the escape of O-02-56.
value: 每当有异想体逃逸时，逆卡巴拉计数器就会下降。然而，它对 O-02-56 的逃逸没有反应。

key: The Qliphoth Counter decreased when an employee wore O-07-103 for more than 30 seconds.
value: 当员工穿戴 O-07-103 超过30秒时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: The Qliphoth Counter dropped to 0 when D-03-109-1 died.
value: 当 D-03-109-1 死亡时，逆卡巴拉计数器降到了0。

key: The Qliphoth Counter dropped to 0 when the number of D-03-109-2 took up more than 50% of the department while D-03-109-1 was still alive.
value: 在 D-03-109-1 仍存活时，当 D-03-109-2 的数量占部门内超过50%时，逆卡巴拉计数器降到了0。

key: The Qliphoth Counter immediately lowered to 0 when O-05-102 passed by $0’s Containment Unit.
value: 当 O-05-102 经过 $0 的收容单元时，逆卡巴拉计数器立即降到了0。

key: The Qliphoth Counter increased when #0 completed their work with the Token.
value: 当 #0 携带代币完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器上升了。

key: The Qliphoth Counter lowered every time 10 employees died. However, deaths caused by Execution Bullets were not recognized.
value: 每有10名员工死亡，逆卡巴拉计数器就会下降。然而，由处决子弹造成的死亡不被计入。

key: The Qliphoth Counter lowered every time 5 employees died. However, deaths caused by Execution Bullets were not recognized.
value: 每有5名员工死亡，逆卡巴拉计数器就会下降。然而，由处决子弹造成的死亡不被计入。

key: The Qliphoth Counter lowered to 0 when an employee entered the unit to play for the third time.
value: 当一名员工第三次进入单元玩耍时，逆卡巴拉计数器降到了0。

key: The Qliphoth Counter lowered when #0, whose Justice was lower than Level 3, completed work with $0.
value: 当正义等级低于3级的 #0 与 $0 完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: The Sleigh: The size is similar to that of a child’s. The plating looks like organic skin, and there are white runners attached to the bottom. The accessories of the sleigh are replaced with stiff, severed hands. Unknown objects are carefully wrapped in gifts. Many employees tried to open these gifts but failed. Rumor has it that they can only be opened on Christmas Day.
value: 雪橇：大小与孩童的身形相仿。外壳看起来像是生物的皮肤，底部装有白色的滑行板。雪橇的饰物被替换成了僵硬的、被斩断的手。未知的物体被小心地包裹在礼物中。许多员工试图打开这些礼物，但都失败了。传闻它们只能在圣诞节那天打开。

key:
The Snow Palace he reached was so cold, but the Snow Queen's kiss froze his heart, and he couldn't feel the cold anymore. There was no joy in the palace, only the long winter night.

Gerda was strong enough to remain unpierced by the mirror, and brave enough to go on a journey to rescue Kai. So she set off towards the Snow Palace.

The journey was agonizing. Gerda was hurt and pained, sometimes she cried.

However, eventually, Gerda met Kai.

Spring arrived with blossoming roses. Its warmth melted the Snow Queen's palace, and the piece of mirror in Kai's heart evaporated without a trace.

Then, left all alone, the Snow Queen... (Omitted)
value:
他抵达的雪之宫殿是那么寒冷，但冰雪女王的一吻冻结了他的心，他便再也感觉不到寒冷了。宫殿里没有欢乐，只有漫长的冬夜。

格尔达足够坚强，没有被魔镜刺穿，也足够勇敢，踏上了拯救凯的旅程。于是她出发前往雪之宫殿。

旅程令人痛苦。格尔达受了伤、饱受煎熬，有时她会哭泣。

然而，格尔达最终见到了凯。

春天随着绽放的玫瑰一同到来。它的温暖融化了冰雪女王的宫殿，凯心中那片魔镜的碎片也消失得无影无踪。

然后，被独自留下的冰雪女王……（略）

key:
The Tin Woodsman couldn't agree with this. In anger, he swung his axe through the wizard's heart. The warm heart was pulsing vigorously. He shoved the lead into the wizard's now empty chest. For the first time in his life, the Woodsman started laughing at the sight and felt a pleasure he'd never had before.

Grabbing a chunk of mushy hearts, he shoves it into his "chest". There will never be enough hearts. Once a Woodsman, he now fells people instead of trees. This is a forest full of hearts. No matter how many he cuts down, the forest still remains dense. A kind person would carry a warmer heart.
value:
锡樵夫无法认同这一点。盛怒之下，他挥动斧头劈开了巫师的心脏。那颗温暖的心脏正在有力地搏动着。他把铅块塞进了巫师如今空荡荡的胸腔。有生以来第一次，樵夫看到这一幕而大笑起来，感受到了他从未体验过的愉悦。

他抓起一大团黏糊糊的心脏，塞进自己的“胸腔”。心脏永远都不够。曾是樵夫的他，如今砍伐的不再是树木，而是人。这是一片布满心脏的森林。无论他砍倒多少，森林依然茂密。善良的人会怀着一颗更温暖的心。

key:
The Ultimate Buffet!
Alluring Flavors and Great Portion!
value:
终极自助盛宴！
诱人的风味与超大的分量！

key: The Wings of the World, Singularity, the Backstreets, the Syndicates, the Fixers, the Rules, The Great Lake, The Black Forest, the Hunt, the Ruins, the Taboo, the Eye, the Head, the Claw, and the humans…
value: 世界的翼、奇点、后巷、帮派、收尾人、规则、大湖、黑森林、狩猎、废墟、禁忌、眼睛、首脑、利爪，以及人类……

key: The above phenomenon also occurred when employees of Fortitude Level 3 finished working with $0.
value: 当坚韧等级3级的员工与 $0 完成工作时，上述现象也同样发生了。

key: The above phenomenon also occurred when employees of Fortitude Level 4 or higher finished working with $0.
value: 当坚韧等级4级或以上的员工与 $0 完成工作时，上述现象也同样发生了。

key: The amount of energy produced will increase as time goes by.
value: 产生的能量量将随时间推移而增加。

key: The ankle straps on $0 still appear elegant even though they’re worn out.
value: $0 脚踝上的系带虽然已经磨损，但看起来依然优雅。

key: The armor still awaits those who are reckless, and those who have given up on life.
value: 这铠甲仍在等待着那些鲁莽之人，以及那些已对生命放弃的人。

key: The bandage is in tatters, like it could tear off at any second. The bird's face was once covered in gleaming feathers, but they fell out as it spent too much time without sunlight.
value: 绷带破破烂烂，仿佛随时都会撕裂脱落。那只鸟的脸上曾覆满闪亮的羽毛，但因为太久没有阳光，羽毛都掉光了。

key: The bar at the top left of the screen displays the amount of energy you need to collect to end the day. The top right corner lists what missions you are able to attempt today.
value: 屏幕左上角的进度条显示结束一天所需收集的能量量。右上角则列出了你今天可以尝试的任务。

key:
The bird began to prowl the forest, but there was nothing.
There were no creatures, no sun and moon, and no beast. All that was left was just a bird and the Black Forest.
value:
那只鸟开始在森林中逡巡，却一无所获。
没有生灵，没有日月，也没有野兽。剩下的只有一只鸟，和那片黑森林。

key:
The black carp swims towards harmony. The white carp swims towards chaos.
What will happen when the two fish meet?
value:
黑鲤游向和谐。白鲤游向混沌。
当这两条鱼相遇时，会发生什么？

key:
The black pendant is darker than any other shade of black, the most obscure of all the forms of darkness in the world.
Employees should not touch or possess the pendant. Merely looking at it makes one feel as if darkness is creeping into their heart.
It seems that this pendant originally made up a circle; however, it is now separated from its other half.
value:
黑色吊坠比任何其他黑色的色度都要深，是这世上所有黑暗形态中最晦暗的一种。
员工不应触碰或持有这枚吊坠。仅仅是看着它，就会让人感觉黑暗正悄悄渗入内心。
这枚吊坠似乎原本构成一个圆环；然而，它如今已与它的另一半分离了。

key: The bone, which appears to be a rib of $0, makes a crunching sound.
value: 那根看似是 $0 的肋骨的骨头，发出嘎吱作响的声音。

key: The book can be read until one’s Prudence reaches its limit.
value: 这本书可以一直读到人的谨慎达到极限为止。

key: The booking clerk who remains dauntingly quiet sells tickets for a train with no final destination. There are no clocks to alert the arrival times, instead, there are some blinking lights.
value: 那位静得令人发怵的售票员，为一趟没有最终目的地的列车售票。这里没有提示到站时间的时钟，取而代之的是一些闪烁的灯光。

key: The burdensome fluttering wings come closer in a familiar yet strange way.
value: 那沉重的振翅声以一种既熟悉又陌生的方式靠近。

key: The carcasses of birds and bugs piled up near the apple. The apple pondered about its existence in the midst of the corpses rotting around it. One day, a branch grew from it. The leaves and branches were already withered and dry, but it continued to grow.
value: 鸟和虫子的尸体在苹果旁堆积起来。在四周腐烂的尸体中间，苹果思索着自己的存在。有一天，一根枝条从它身上长了出来。枝叶早已枯萎干瘪，但它仍在继续生长。

key: The child shows great enjoyment with talking and playing with others. He has a strong attachment to the act of making contact with another.
value: 这孩子在与他人交谈、玩耍时表现出极大的愉悦。他对与他人发生接触这件事有着强烈的依恋。

key: The child, who was thought to die within 2 years, managed to live for a long time. As always, he liked sweet candy, followed them, and loved the place as his home. Though the only thing the child could do was run around inside a cramped lab instead of a grass field under the sun, his steps were shaky but filled with enthusiasm. Excited about what kind of candy he would eat tomorrow.
value: 那个被认为活不过2年的孩子，竟活过了很长一段时间。一如既往，他喜欢甜糖果，跟着他们，把这里当作自己的家来热爱。尽管这孩子唯一能做的，就是在狭窄的实验室里跑来跑去，而不是在阳光下的草地上奔跑，但他的脚步虽然踉跄，却充满热情。为明天能吃上什么样的糖果而兴奋不已。

key: The city still remained a beautiful place where the emerald roads sparkled bright as ever.
value: 都市依然是一个美丽的地方，翡翠般的道路依旧如往昔般熠熠生辉。

key: The city's representative reassured them, dismissing the rumors as nonsense. To put the rumors to rest, they announced that they would select a number of sick people from the outskirts and fix any body parts they wanted. Out of the lucky few who were chosen, one returned several days later. He had a visibly long scar on his head. People asked him how he felt and he responded that his head felt lighter. He was a man filled with sorrow who used to cry a lot, so everybody believed that the surgery was a success.
value: 都市的代表安抚了他们，斥那些传闻为无稽之谈。为平息谣言，他们宣布将从郊区挑选一些病人，修复他们想要的任何身体部位。在被选中的少数幸运儿中，有一个人几天后回来了。他头上有一道明显很长的伤疤。人们问他感觉如何，他回答说头感觉轻了。他是个充满悲伤、过去常哭的男人，所以所有人都相信手术成功了。

key: The color of the human heart is pink, and by wearing the same color, we can blend in with people’s minds.
value: 人心的颜色是粉色的，而穿上相同的颜色，我们就能混入人们的意识之中。

key: The colorful lights were as bright as Christmas, and as dark as every child’s nightmare and grimace.
value: 那斑斓的灯光明亮如圣诞节，又幽暗如每个孩子的噩梦与鬼脸。

key: The conductor of $0 is awaiting the musicians.
value: $0 的指挥正在等待乐手们。

key: The conductor of $0 is usually quiet. The Containment Unit is also still.
value: $0 的指挥通常很安静。收容单元里也一片寂静。

key: The count had a monstrous appearance. Rumor says anyone who dares to enter his manor is never seen again.
value: 那位伯爵有着怪物般的外貌。传闻说，任何胆敢进入他宅邸的人都再也没出现过。

key: The creature is a cluster of thousands if not hundreds of millions of molecules.
value: 这生物是由数千——乃至数亿——个分子构成的集合体。

key:
The crew was something around 10 people including the captain, boatswain, cook and all that. They all chuckled at me while I was spacing out. The guy who looked like the captain walked towards me and asked me about my height and weight. I asked him when the ship goes to port. He told me it’d be about a month but that I shouldn’t try and run away or anything cause they already made a deal with “my people”. I had no damn idea who “my people” were but I was too scared to ask. Then the other crew members called me over for lunch. They were making instant ramen, putting shrimp, crabs, clams, and all sorts of other stuff in it. They told me to stop acting like I was about to jump into the sea and to try their ramen. I said no at first, but they laughed at me again saying there weren’t any sleeping pills or stuff like that in it and gave me some anyway. A man’s gotta live, so I ate it. It tasted better than I expected it to. As soon as we finished lunch they told me they were going to teach me how to adjust the ropes. I pretty much gave up at that point, so I just simply answered “sure…”. All I could see anyways was these little islands that no one would have a chance at surviving on. For a month, I learned how to pull up fish traps, fill bait boxes, repair fishing nets, cook some ramen, get coffee, and all sorts of stuff. I kept getting better and I got to the point where I could prepare mackerel sashimi and fish stew for the crew. Everyone complimented it. Said I could open a restaurant with that stew. Later on, we went through a couple of typhoons. Them and I started forming some kind of bond. A companionship. Whales were becoming a common sight at that point. Two weeks in, the captain told me I was pretty good and asked me if I was interested in officially joining the crew. When I thought about it, I would have been fired from the Corp anyway, so this seemed like a legit opportunity to make a living. This was the first time I ever got a compliment after all. What am I doing now? Well, I’ve been promoted and now I’m living fine. I’ve found true happiness in cracking open a cold one after a hard day’s work, covered in sea water and sweat. I’m at the port now but we gotta take off soon to catch some more shrimp. Never know what your future holds, bros. Sometimes I think about those other folk who were at the meetup that day. Not that I really wanna snoop around to find out though, I just try to keep a positive mind. I wanna say they’re hopefully doing good just like me.

      Oh, it’s time to sail out, see you guys.
value:
船员大约有10人，包括船长、水手长、厨师等等。我在发呆的时候，他们都冲我笑。那个看起来像船长的人向我走来，问了我的身高和体重。我问他船什么时候进港。他告诉我要大约一个月，但我不该试图逃跑或做别的什么，因为他们已经和“我的人”谈好了交易。我完全不知道“我的人”是谁，但我怕得不敢问。然后其他船员喊我去吃午饭。他们在做速食拉面，往里面放了虾、螃蟹、蛤蜊和各种其他东西。他们让我别一副要跳海的样子，尝尝他们的拉面。我起初拒绝了，但他们又笑着跟我说里面没有安眠药之类的东西，还是给我盛了一碗。人总得活下去，所以我吃了。味道比我预想的要好。我们一吃完午饭，他们就告诉我接下来要教我如何调整缆绳。那时我基本上已经放弃了，所以只是简单地回答“好吧……”。反正我能看到的，只有这些没人能在上面存活的小岛。一个月里，我学会了拉鱼笼、装饵料盒、修补渔网、煮拉面、冲咖啡和各种各样的事。我越做越好，到了能为船员准备鲭鱼刺身和炖鱼汤的地步。大家都夸赞我，说凭那锅鱼汤我都能开家餐馆了。后来，我们经历了几场台风。我和他们之间开始形成某种羁绊。一种情谊。那时鲸鱼已经成了常见的景象。两周后，船长说我干得不错，问我有没有兴趣正式加入船员队伍。我仔细想了想，反正我本来也会被公司开除，所以这看起来倒是个正当的谋生机会。毕竟，那还是我第一次被人夸奖。我现在在做什么？嗯，我升职了，现在过得不错。我在一天的辛苦工作后，浑身沾满海水和汗水，打开一罐冰镇饮料时，找到了真正的幸福。我现在在港口，但我们很快就要出发去捕更多的虾。伙计们，永远不知道未来会怎样。有时我会想起那天聚会上的人们。倒不是我真想去打探他们的下落，我只是尽量保持积极的心态。我想说，希望他们也和我一样过得好。

      哦，该出海了，再见啦各位。

key: The curse has existed for centuries, inflicting agony upon many unfortunate victims.
value: 这诅咒已存在了数百年，将痛苦施加于许多不幸的受害者身上。

key: The day $0’s hunger ceases will be the end of everything.
value: $0 的饥饿停止之日，便是一切的终结之时。

value: 当一颗成熟的苹果从公主与国王伫立的花园中的树上坠落的那一天，女巫的心碎了。

value: 那把他变成这样的那一天……

value: 对异想体而言，“食物”的定义相当模糊。

value: “善”与“恶”的定义在它心中是固定的。有些人推测，当这异想体的信念引向对邪恶存在与否的可怕怀疑时，它会选择成为邪恶，以否定那种怀疑。

key: The directive that forces us to do whatever is ordered feels too harsh for me.
value: 那种迫使我们服从一切命令的指令，对我来说太过严苛了。

key: The dirty ribbon around $0’s neck ruffles gently even though there is no wind to move it. The name that was written on that ribbon is worn away and unrecognizable by now.
value: $0 脖子上的脏丝带，即使在没有风去吹动它的情况下，也轻轻飘动着。丝带上写着的名字，如今已磨损得无法辨认了。

key: The easier the work is, the faster we’ll finish.
value: 工作越简单，我们就能越快完成。

key: The employee who reads this book will experience an increase in Prudence.
value: 阅读这本书的员工将获得谨慎的提升。

value: 接受了 $0 第二次亲吻的员工忘记了一切，被困在了收容单元里。

key: The employees cannot return to whence they came, and have no choice but to endlessly repeat the day.
value: 员工们无法回到他们来处，别无选择，只能无休止地重复这一天。

key: The employees often talk about you. According to my data, your name came up in conversation at least 43 times yesterday. It appears you are rather popular.
value: 员工们经常谈论你。根据我的数据，昨天你的名字在谈话中被提到了至少43次。看来你相当受欢迎。

key: The employees put a perch in $0’s Containment Unit because it seemed to be bored.
value: 员工们在 $0 的收容单元里放了一根栖木，因为它似乎很无聊。

key: The endings of the many employees who were tamed by $0 were always tragic.
value: 那些被 $0 驯服的员工，结局总是悲惨的。

key: The endless wailing of $0 fills the entire facility. #0, who is nearby the Containment Unit, begins to feel themself fall into madness.
value: $0 无休止的哀嚎回荡在整个设施中。收容单元附近的 #0 开始感到自己陷入疯狂。

key: The engulfing flame of #2$0 caught onto #0$0. Their #1$0 failed.
value: #2$0 的吞噬烈焰蔓延到了 #0$0 身上。他们的 #1$0 失败了。

key: The entries on $0 are almost complete, so as long as we remain cautious, work will successfully finish with her.
value: 关于 $0 的记录几乎已经完整，所以只要我们保持谨慎，与她的工作就能顺利完成。

key: The equipment here is fascinating… I feel a rush of nostalgia about them.
value: 这里的装备真迷人……我对它们涌起一阵怀念。

key: The essence of Repression work is connected to the subject’s meaning of existence.
value: 压迫工作的本质，与对象的存在意义相连。

key: The eyes and lamp of $0 light up the dark chamber like stars.
value: $0 的眼睛和提灯如同星辰般照亮了黑暗的房间。

key: The facility and its employees will be unable to detect the Abnormality in any fashion when it escapes. Therefore, the manager must manually locate it and directly order its suppression.
value: 当这异想体逃逸时，设施及其员工将无法以任何方式探测到它。因此，主管必须手动定位它，并直接下令镇压。

key: The facility’s systems and the employees will be unable to detect the Abnormality when it escapes. Thus the manager will need to manually pinpoint it and order suppression directly.
value: 当这异想体逃逸时，设施的系统与员工将无法探测到它。因此，主管需要手动锁定它的位置，并直接下令镇压。

key: The faint sound of rustling leaves can be heard from $0’s Containment Unit.
value: 从 $0 的收容单元中可以听到微弱的树叶沙沙声。

key:
The fairies are no more than carnivorous monsters, and their "protection" is their method to keep the meat fresh. When an employee enters another Containment Unit, they gobble them up in fear that they would lose their food to something else.

      However, the employees were greatly satisfied by the fairies' care, and we saw a drastic decrease in the accident rate, so we deemed it unnecessary to tell the truth to the employees.
value:
精灵不过是肉食性的怪物，它们的“保护”只是保存肉块新鲜的手段。当员工进入另一个收容单元时，它们会狼吞虎咽地把他吃光，生怕自己的食物被别的什么东西抢走。

      然而，员工们对精灵的照料感到非常满意，事故率也大幅下降，因此我们认为没有必要把真相告诉员工们。

key:
The fairies protect our employees. If you often act out of the goodness of your heart, and are a lover of nature, then the fairies will gladly take care of you. Everything will be peaceful while you are under the fairies' care (you can also enjoy the envious glances you'll get from other employees. Not that it's important, but...). What if the fairies don't approach you? Then you should reflect on your life. When Emil and I took shifts entering the fairies' Containment Unit, the fairies did not hesitate to approach me. Only me, never towards Emil. (You all know Emil and how he is. Why, just yesterday he refused to share his snacks with me, and he was acting all high and mighty.)

It is a sacred act to be protected by fairies in any world. However, do not enter their Containment Unit just to have a bit of fun; if you’ve read a few books on them, you’ll know that fairies dislike those who take advantage of their kindness.
value:
精灵保护着我们的员工。如果你经常出于内心的善意行事，并且热爱自然，那么精灵们会乐意照顾你。在精灵的照料下，一切都会和平安宁（你还可以享受其他员工投来的嫉妒目光。虽然这并不重要，但是……）。要是精灵们不接近你呢？那你该反省一下自己的人生了。当我和埃米尔轮班进入精灵的收容单元时，精灵们毫不犹豫地接近了我。只接近我，从不靠近埃米尔。（你们都知道埃米尔是什么样的人。唉，就在昨天，他还拒绝和我分享零食，而且一副高高在上的样子。）

在任何一个世界里，被精灵保护都是一件神圣的事。然而，不要只是为了找点乐子就进入它们的收容单元；如果你读过几本关于精灵的书，你就会知道，精灵讨厌那些利用它们善意的人。

key: The fight has been ongoing for a long, long time. Her disgust for the wolf deepens by the second.
value: 这场战斗已经持续了很久很久。她对那只狼的厌恶，每一秒都在加深。

key: The final chapter ends with the phrase: “Born again.”
value: 最后一章以这样一句话收尾：“重生。”

The first and second lights illuminate; your mind clears.
The third light illuminates; your mind clears and your wounds close.

第一道与第二道光亮起；你的思绪变得清明。
第三道光亮起；你的思绪清明，伤口也随之愈合。

key:
The following is a recording of the abnormal behavior an employee exhibited in their last moments after they became a shell of ‘Nothing There’.

      Employee 1: Manager, manager!
      Employee 2: Man, you've been looking for the manager for quite a while now. You've been acting really weird today y'know? With that weird smile and all.
      Employee 1: ...
      Employee 2: Anyhow, I sure hope we get pasta in the cafeteria for dinner today. I’d love some of that with thick bacon.
      Employee 1: ...
      Employee 2: Oh, we just got an emergency notice. It says the last employee to work with "Nothing There" should get to the counselor's office immediately.
      Employee 1: ...
      Employee 2: Wait... Wasn't that... You?
      Employee 1: ...
      Employee 2: Hey, say somethi—
      Employee 1: Manager, manager! Manager!
value:
以下是员工在成为“一无所有”的空壳后，于生命最后时刻表现出的异常行为的录音。

      员工1：主管，主管！
      员工2：我说，你已经找主管找了好一会儿了。你今天真的很不对劲，你知道吗？带着那种诡异的微笑。
      员工1：……
      员工2：不管怎样，我真希望今晚食堂的晚餐有意大利面。我超想配上厚厚的培根来一碗。
      员工1：……
      员工2：哦，我们刚收到一份紧急通知。上面说最后一个与“一无所有”工作的员工要立刻去咨询室。
      员工1：……
      员工2：等等……那不是……你吗？
      员工1：……
      员工2：喂，你说句话——
      员工1：主管，主管！主管！

key: The fortified weapon will have higher Attack Power.
value: 强化后的武器将拥有更高的攻击力。

key: The fox said: “What is essential is invisible to the eye.”
value: 狐狸说：“真正重要的东西，用眼睛是看不见的。”

key:
The friends were imperfect in one way or another, so they helped each other to fill what they were lacking and embarked on a journey to make their wishes come true. The Scarecrow wanted a brain, the Tin Woodsman wanted a heart, the Cowardly Lion wanted courage, and Dorothy wanted to return home.

      The one they thought to be the great wizard instead gave the Woodsman a lead heart.
value:
朋友们各自都有着这样那样的缺憾，所以他们互相帮助，弥补彼此所欠缺的东西，踏上了实现愿望的旅程。稻草人想要一颗大脑，锡樵夫想要一颗心脏，胆小狮想要勇气，而多萝西想要回家。

      那个他们以为的伟大巫师，却给了樵夫一颗铅做的心脏。

value: 送葬的队伍永无止境；#0 继续平静地哀悼着。

value: 收容单元中充满了振翅的扑棱声和提灯摇曳燃烧的可怕声响。

key: The hallway is all coated with blood and brain fluid… You can see it too, right? We need a mop and bucket… We have to clean it up…
value: 走廊上到处都是血和脑浆……你也看到了，对吧？我们需要拖把和水桶……我们得把它清理干净……

key: The head that always gazed upon the cosmos was lowered,

key: The incident on the day of <Redacted> was an alerting event for many employees. The moment Red Riding Hood ran into the Wolf, the situation spiraled out of control. Prevent the two from meeting at all costs. Considering the potential damage it may cause, it could be a wise decision to sacrifice a few employees to divert their attention away from each other.

key: The knight who wanted to redeem herself by saving others was now dishonorably called the Knight of Despair; forgotten from the people's memory, just like the others.

value: 她华丽魔法装束上的花边，正欢快地摆动着。

The lady thought: "Perhaps such a hideous monster would be better off if it didn't exist."

那位女士心想：“也许这样丑陋的怪物，不存在反而更好。”

key: The lady was hired and worked at the manor. Contrary to the rumor, the monster was nowhere to be seen. Sometimes at night, she could hear a voice. It was very kind and compensated her for her troubles handsomely.
value: 那位女士被雇用在庄园里工作。与传闻相反，哪里都看不到怪物的身影。有时在夜里，她会听到一个声音。那声音十分和善，并为她的辛劳慷慨地给予报酬。

key: The last thing I wanna do is work. I sure wish I could be a manager and supervise my own subordinates...

key:
The monk spoke to a man behind him in the crowd.

“How can they be so upset at such a sacred ceremony?”

A slight distance away, a very old man in the crowd answered instead.

“The poor and hungry yearn for miracles to save them. By how you’re dressed, I would guess that you are also on the path of a Buddhist. This event must have worried you.”

The monk responded in a slightly disturbed tone.

“Sarira forms when a monk has bettered his body and spirit, and finally reaches nirvana. It is a natural process and not to be artificially wanted. How can you call it a miracle?”

The old man then burst out in laughter.

“This monk was known well here for his good deeds. He shared his food with the hungry, and clothes with those who were cold. However, as they say, it seems he was unable to reach true nirvana, as only two spoonfuls of sarira were found. He ended up being a miserable old monk who couldn’t achieve nirvana even though he was a well respected man, and known as a benevolent living saint. Do you think you will be any different?”
“I… I have proudly practiced—”
“They say a monk from the temple of (Redacted) had earned more than three hundred spoons of sarira. Colorful lights sparkled across the sky as the crowd paid devout prayers at his cremation, and his sarira were as round as pearls. The emperor himself ordered for four temples to be built in his name.”

The monk could not reply.

“...But, the creation of sarira is a natural process all go through—”
“It is well known that Buddha’s sarira were enough to fill a grand palace when he was cremated. One day, your body shall fail and eventually lead you to the eternal heaven. Someday, people will be there for your cremation, just like now.”

The monk was silent.

“If nothing is found in your ashes, you will be a sinner of the trailokya, and your path will ultimately reach nowhere. However, if enough sarira are found from you that everyone looks on in awe, your name will be sung for generations. The emperor will be awestruck and build a huge temple in your name, and the people will chant while admiring the pagoda of that temple.”
“...”
“This feeble old man is telling you all this because I can see you becoming one of the greatest monks. Listen, a few hours' walk from here, there is a mound we call (Redacted). Go up there, and you will see several old pagodas. Inside of them are the boxes of sarira from long-forgotten great monks. Why, they’ll just return to the soil if nothing happens to them. But if you were to consume them, perhaps, you would display more sarira than Buddha himself…”

The monk then realized that the old man was suspicious, and did not sound as an old man should. However, the old man was gone in a flash as he tried to catch a glimpse of his face. The monk concluded that it must have been a trick of the devil, and tried to forget what the old man had said. But the old man’s voice lingered in his ears even as he tried to sleep.
value:
僧侣对身后人群中的一个男人说道。

“如此神圣的仪式，他们怎能如此躁动不安？”

稍远处，人群中的一个老人代为回答。

“穷人和饥饿的人渴望奇迹来拯救他们。看你的穿着，我猜你也是走在佛道上的修行人。这场活动想必让你忧心了。”

僧侣以略带不安的语气回应。

“舍利子是僧人在身心修持圆满、最终证得涅槃时形成的。这是自然的进程，不该被人为地渴求。你怎能称之为奇迹？”

老人随即爆发出一阵大笑。

“这位僧人在此地以善行闻名。他与饥饿的人分享食物，与寒冷的人分享衣物。然而，正如人们所说，他似乎未能证得真正的涅槃，因为只找到了两勺舍利子。他最终成了一个悲惨的老僧，纵然备受尊敬、被称作慈悲的活菩萨，却未能证得涅槃。你觉得你会有何不同吗？”
“我……我一直在精进修行——”
“据说（已编辑）寺的一位僧人，修得了三百多勺舍利子。在他火化时，人群虔诚祈祷，五彩的光芒在天空中闪烁，他的舍利子圆润如珠。皇帝亲自下令，以他的名义修建四座寺庙。”

僧侣无言以对。

“……但是，舍利子的形成是所有人都经历的自然进程——”
“众所周知，佛陀火化时的舍利子足以装满一座宏伟的宫殿。总有一天，你的身体会衰败，最终引你走向永恒的极乐。有朝一日，人们也会像现在这样，来参加你的火化。”

僧侣沉默不语。

“如果在你骨灰中一无所获，你将成为三界之内的罪人，你的道路终将无处可去。然而，如果人们从你身上找到足够多的舍利子，令所有人惊叹仰望，你的名字将被世代传颂。皇帝会惊叹不已，以你的名义修建一座巨大的寺庙，人们会在瞻仰那座寺庙的宝塔时齐声诵念。”
“……
“这个孱弱的老头子告诉你这些，是因为我能看出你会成为最伟大的僧侣之一。听着，从这儿走几个小时的路程，有一座我们称之为（已编辑）的土丘。爬上去，你会看到几座古老的宝塔。塔内放着早已被遗忘的古代高僧的舍利盒。唉，要是没人动它们，它们就只是回归尘土。但如果你把它们吃了，或许，你能展现出比佛陀本人更多的舍利子……”

僧侣随即意识到，那老人很可疑，听起来也不像一个老人该有的样子。然而，当他试图看清那老人的脸时，老人已瞬间消失无踪。僧侣断定那必定是恶魔的诡计，试图忘掉老人所说的话。但即使在他试图入睡时，那老人的声音仍在他耳边萦绕。

key: The staff lounge is way too small. It’s like you’re not even intended to use it.
value: 员工休息室太小了。简直像是根本没打算让你用似的。

key: The staff lounge just got some new coffee that smells divine. You’re always welcome to join us for a cup, manager!
value: 员工休息室刚进了些新咖啡，闻起来香极了。主管，随时欢迎你来和我们喝一杯！

key: The stars are singing to me… Can you hear them?
value: 星星在对我歌唱……你能听见吗？

key: The stats will increase greater the longer the machine is used.
value: 机器使用的时间越长，属性提升得就越多。

key: The stench of blood still lingers in my nostrils. I can’t seem to wash it away with water.
value: 血腥的恶臭仍萦绕在我的鼻腔。我似乎怎么用水也洗不掉。

key: The stillness that encroaches upon the room is broken by the horrible creaking of the rocking chair.
value: 笼罩房间的死寂，被摇椅那可怕的吱嘎声打破了。

key: The stronger survives. That is all.

The supplicant will suffer various ordeals in a manner like being put through a trial. Meanwhile, all those around them will recover their ails and woes just as if they were being blessed with redemption.
value: 祈求者将以类似经受审判的方式，遭受种种磨难。与此同时，他们周围的所有人，都将仿佛蒙受救赎之恩般，治愈自身的病痛与苦难。

key: The surveillance camera detected various noises emitting around the facility. Based on the fact that this occurred after $0’s Qliphoth Counter reached 0, it can be assumed that the noise originated from $0’s Containment Unit.
value: 监控摄像头检测到设施周围发出的各种噪音。鉴于这些噪音发生在 $0 的逆卡巴拉计数器归零之后，可以推测噪音源自 $0 的收容单元。

key: The taller and grander you stand, the harder you will fall. Oh, my beloved A… all your dreams shall crash onto the ground and shatter to pieces.
value: 你站得越高、越宏伟，摔得就越重。哦，我亲爱的A……你的所有梦想都将坠落地面，摔得粉碎。

key: The treatment miraculously made everyone silent, even those who refused to be quiet after any other therapy.
value: 这种治疗奇迹般地让所有人都安静了下来，即便是那些在其他任何疗法后都拒绝安静的人。

key: The true nature of Repression Work is the denial of the meaning of existence.
value: 压迫工作的真正本质，是对存在意义的否定。

key: The twelve employees who were blessed by Him will transform and roam the facility to deliver redemption to every single employee. Wings will grow from their backs, and they will wear masks in the shape of beaks and bear crosses that forgive all sins.
value: 受祂祝福的十二名员工将会转化形态，在设施中游荡，为每一名员工送去救赎。他们的背上会长出翅膀，他们会戴上喙形的面具，背负宽恕一切罪孽的十字架。

key: The type of “food” differs between Abnormalities.
value: 不同异想体的“食物”类型各不相同。

key: The universe lingers in your ears.
The vending machine overwhelms #0 with its shiny neon lighting.
value: 自动售货机那闪闪发亮的霓虹灯光，令 #0 目不暇接。

key: The wall near $0 is covered in mold, but no one cares to do anything about it.
value: $0 附近的墙上长满了霉菌，但没人愿意去管它。

key: The warning to not look at $0 has caused many employees to fall curious, leading to many a terrible incident.
value: 那个不要注视 $0 的警告，反而让许多员工心生好奇，酿成了许多可怕的事故。

key: The wearer will die if any attempt to return $0 is made before they are fully healed.
value: 在穿戴者完全痊愈之前，任何试图归还 $0 的行为，都将导致穿戴者死亡。

key: The wearer will enter a panic if ordered to return $0 within 30 seconds of equipping it and will die shortly after showing abnormal behavior.
value: 如果在装备 $0 后30秒内被命令归还它，穿戴者将陷入恐慌，并在表现出异常行为后不久死亡。

key: The weather is rather bad outside today. The world cannot always be sunny, I suppose. However, no matter how the weather may be, you still have your job to do.
value: 今天外面的天气相当糟糕。我想，世界不可能永远是晴天。然而，无论天气如何，你仍有你的工作要做。

key: The weird thing is, most of these types become unexpectedly fast on Friday. But as a side effect, they become sluggish on Monday.
value: 奇怪的是，这种类型中的大多数人在周五会出人意料地敏捷。但作为副作用，他们周一就会变得迟钝。

key: The whispering of the moon and the sound of the stars. And the truth beyond…
value: 月亮的低语，群星的声音。以及那更深处、超越一切的真相……

key: The witch cast the most powerful spell she knew on that apple, sacrificing herself.
value: 女巫在苹果上施下了她所知的最强大的咒语，并献出了自己。

key: The world that $0 may have once loved is now being devoured by her.
value: 那个 $0 或许曾经爱过的世界，如今正被她吞噬。

key: The world was covered with darkness for four days.
value: 世界被黑暗笼罩了四天。

key: The world will be overturned the day the black carp and white carp meet.
value: 当黑鲤与白鲤相遇之日，世界将被颠覆。

key: The “Magic Jewelry” around her neck shimmers in the light.
value: 她颈上的“魔法珠宝”在光中闪烁。

key: Their roar. The resonance between you and I. The incandescent wisdom…
value: 它们的咆哮。你我之间的共鸣。那炽热发光的智慧……

key: Then as if enough hadn't happened already, something began to crawl out of his neck. Just like a butterfly emerging from a cocoon, tearing apart his headless body; the wings, the yellow trunk, the teeth that gnawed away his body; it's something I never want to see again, a being I'd hate to describe as something alive...
value: 然后，仿佛发生的一切还不够似的，有什么东西开始从他的脖颈处爬出来。就像蝴蝶破茧而出一般，撕裂了他那无头的躯体；那翅膀，那黄色的躯干，那啃噬掉他身体的牙齿；那是我再也不想看到的东西，一个我极不情愿称之为生物的存在……

key: Then there was the apple created from the witch's wrath and curse. It was also a part of herself. The apple that dropped from Snow White's hand after a single bite could never be happy. The apple, full of loneliness and hatred toward the princess, waited for the day it would rot away and return to the earth.
value: 还有那颗由女巫的愤怒与诅咒所创造出的苹果。它也是她自己的一部分。白雪公主咬了一口后从手中掉落的那颗苹果，永远无法快乐。那颗充满了对公主的孤独与憎恨的苹果，等待着腐烂殆尽、回归大地的那一天。

key: Then this place shall be called a library, then.
value: 那么，这个地方就叫做图书馆吧。

key: Then ultimately, I would like to sort the knowledge I have gained about them. ‘Books’ are the name as I recall?
value: 那么最后，我想整理一下我关于它们所获得的知识。我记得名字叫做“书”？

key:
Then, in the middle of all the chaotic cries, someone shouted:
“It's the beast! A big, scary monster lives in the black, dusky forest!”
value:
接着，在纷乱的喊叫声中，有人高声喊道：
“是那只野兽！一只巨大而可怕的怪物，就住在那片漆黑幽暗的森林里！”

key: There are a few phrases crudely carved on its surface: “Do you remember this melody? The professor used to play this song when the students were sleepy. Happy birthday.”
value: 它的表面粗糙地刻着几句话：“你还记得这段旋律吗？从前学生们昏昏欲睡时，教授常弹奏这首曲子。生日快乐。”

key: There are many different kinds of energy existing in this world.
value: 这世上存在着许多不同种类的能量。

key: There are no flowers or trees in this place, so where do all these butterflies come from?
value: 这地方没有花草树木，那这些蝴蝶都是从哪儿来的？

key: There have been various results such as the solar energy, wind power, and hydroelectric power however, compared to the expense, those have virtually no productivity.
value: 虽然已有太阳能、风能、水力发电等各种成果，但与投入相比，那些几乎毫无生产力可言。

key: There is a book made of antique parchments.
value: 有一本书是用古老的羊皮纸制成的。

key: There is a book which seems like the cover is going to be torn if handled thoughtlessly.
value: 有一本书，若是不小心对待，封面似乎随时都会被撕裂。

key: There is a hammer, chained like a prisoner who haven’t seen sunlight for a long time.
value: 有一柄锤子，被锁链束缚着，像个久未见阳光的囚徒。

key: There is a long scarlike line across the abdomen of $0.
value: $0 的腹部横亘着一道长长的、疤痕般的纹路。

key: There is a stark difference between a container being “half full” or “half empty.” It took me a long time to grasp that difference as well.
value: 容器是“半满”还是“半空”，二者之间有着截然不同的区别。我也花了很长时间才领会到那种差别。

key:
There is a tale of a beast that lies in the deepest, darkest part of the forest who dazzles creatures away never to be seen again.

To protect all creatures from the beast, the big bird burned all of its feathers to make a wick, and then made a lamp that would burn forever.

With this eternally lit lamp, the big bird wandered the forest, warning the creatures to not stray too deep into the trees.

Thanks to the large bird, fewer creatures fell victim to the beast in the forest. However, it was still concerned for the creatures still being killed by the beast.

An idea struck the big bird’s mind: “If I kill the creatures first, then no one would be killed by the beast!”

Since then, only rumors of a beast that would bite your head off flew around the dark forest.

It is said that the beast carefully examines and stares at its victims to see if they are the beast that lures helpless creatures away.

      This is a tale from a town in the <Location Redacted> area. We heard the tale from the town's oldest inhabitant, <Redacted>. Although there is a general assumption that the tale was told to prevent children from entering the forest, it is uncertain who first inherited the tale.
value:
有一个传说，讲的是一只潜伏在森林最深处、最黑暗之地的野兽，它会魅惑生灵，令其一去不复返。

为了保护所有生灵免受野兽之害，大鸟烧尽了自己所有的羽毛做成灯芯，造了一盏永不熄灭的灯。

大鸟提着这盏长明灯巡游森林，警告生灵们不要深入林中太远。

多亏了那只大鸟，森林中沦为野兽牺牲品的生灵变少了。然而，它依然挂念着那些仍在被野兽杀害的生灵。

一个念头在大鸟的脑海中闪现：“如果我先杀掉那些生灵，那么就没有人会被野兽杀死了！”

从那时起，幽暗的森林中便只流传着关于一只会咬掉你脑袋的野兽的传闻。

据说，那只野兽会仔细端详、凝视它的猎物，看看它们是不是那只诱拐无助生灵的野兽。

      这是来自<位置已编辑>地区一个小镇的传说。我们是从镇上最年长的居民<已编辑>那里听到这个传说的。虽然人们普遍认为这个故事是为了防止孩子们进入森林而讲述的，但最初是谁传承了这个传说，已无从知晓。

key: There is an old saying: “Never forget the bird of judgement; no matter how long it takes, it will eventually find you.”
value: 有一句古老的谚语：“永远不要忘记审判之鸟；无论要花多长时间，它终将找到你。”

key: There is no need for #0 to be afraid of $0 as long as they are a cold person.
value: 只要 #0 是个冷漠的人，就无需惧怕 $0。

key: There is no one inside the fire, however, $0’s eyes gleam as if she sees someone.
value: 火焰之中空无一人，然而，$0 的双眸却闪烁着，仿佛她看见了什么人。

key: There is nothing and nobody inside that flame.
value: 那火焰之中，空无一物，空无一人。

key: There is one last thing I should warn you about. Each time an Agent enters a Containment Unit to work with an Abnormality, the Qliphoth Meltdown Gauge will fill by one tick.
value: 还有最后一件我该提醒你的事。每当一名员工进入收容单元与异想体工作时，逆卡巴拉熔毁量表就会增加一格。

key: There may be lots of stories here, but no story is as disgusting as the wolf's role. It was a sin to be born as a wolf. No one cared about a wolf's name. It has to be called the big bad wolf. All wolves are raised to become giant, ferocious, and hairy monsters. Wolves could not eat other animals even if they were starving. Wolves could not cross the line when doing bad things. And wolves had to be punished. Wolves always needed to be an example. Wolves could not make friends with anyone... (Omitted)
value: 这里或许有很多故事，但没有任何一个故事，像狼的角色那样令人作呕。生而为狼，便是一种罪。没有人在意狼的名字。它必须被叫作大恶狼。所有的狼都被养育成巨大、凶猛、毛茸茸的怪物。狼即使饿到极点，也不能吃其他动物。狼作恶时不能越过界限。而狼必须受到惩罚。狼永远需要成为反面教材。狼不能和任何人交朋友……（略）

key: There was a blackout in the Department where $0 was roaming. Employees who are in the Department with a blackout may become enchanted by $0.
value: $0 游荡的那个部门发生了停电。处于停电部门中的员工可能会被 $0 蛊惑。

key: There's a special employees-only event held by our company. No one knows when or why this event is held. Even my coworker who’s been here for 5 years doesn’t seem to know. When the event starts, a giant roulette begins to spin. Everyone stops what they're doing to stare at the roulette and see who'll be the lucky winner, with desperate looks on their faces. The name of every single employee is written on that roulette. Whoever ends up being selected, they're extremely lucky. They'll be promoted and transferred to another branch of the company, "Headquarters". In addition, their family will be gifted with an unimaginable fortune. At the headquarters, you don’t have to worry about being attacked by Abnormalities, or need to bid farewell to your dead colleagues. My senior, (Redacted), really hopes that they’ll get picked eventually. You see, their father got into an accident one day, and it takes a lot of money to keep him alive and well. I really hope the roulette picks (Redacted) someday.
value: 我们公司有一个只对员工开放的特别活动。没有人知道这个活动何时举行、为何举行。就连我那位在这里干了5年的同事似乎也不知道。活动开始时，一个巨大的轮盘开始旋转。所有人都停下手中的工作，脸上带着绝望的表情，盯着轮盘，看谁会成为那个幸运儿。那个轮盘上写着每一名员工的名字。无论谁最终被选中，他们都是极其幸运的。他们将获得晋升，被调往公司的另一家分部——“总部”。此外，他们的家人还会获得一笔难以想象的财富。在总部，你不必担心被异想体袭击，也不必向死去的同事告别。我的前辈（已编辑）真心希望自己最终能被选中。你知道，他们的父亲有一天出了事故，要花很多钱才能让他维持生命、好好活着。我真心希望有一天轮盘能选中（已编辑）。

key:
There's an eerie rumor spreading among employees. It's not out of the ordinary for a rumor or two to spread in a company like this, but it is interesting that the number of alleged witnesses seems to multiply. The rumor says the following:
“Whispers can be heard in the Containment Unit at night...”
“It was the voice of Alex, who went missing a few days ago...”
“They say the voice wept in terror, asking to be saved from the darkness...”
value:
一条诡异的传闻正在员工之间流传。像这样的公司里，流传一两条传闻并不稀奇，但有趣的是，所谓的目击者人数似乎越来越多。传闻是这样的：
“夜里，可以听到收容单元里传来低语声……”
“那是几天前失踪的亚历克斯的声音……”
“据说那声音在恐惧中哭泣，哀求着从黑暗中获救……”

key: There's no way to confirm what it looks like in its entirety. As it moves underground, not through the hallway, it is impossible to predict its path when breaching. For the same reason, its escape cannot be detected.
value: 无法确认它的完整样貌。由于它在地下移动，而非经由走廊，破墙而出时的路径无法预测。出于同样的原因，它的逃逸也无法被探测到。

key: There’s a rumor floating about that people have been abducted onto a fishing boat after drinking an open can of grape-flavored soda.
value: 有一条传闻正在流传，说有人喝完一罐打开过的葡萄味汽水后，就被绑架到了一艘渔船上。

key: There’s no hope left in this place… Everyone eventually goes crazy…
value: 这地方已经没有希望了……每个人最终都会发疯……

key: There’s no hope left. My mind’s collapsing. Everything’s collapsing…
value: 已经没有希望了。我的精神正在崩塌。一切都在崩塌……

key: There’s no light without the darkness, it’s like I’m not even here.
value: 没有黑暗就没有光，感觉就像我根本不在这里一样。

key: There’s no room for error here.
There’s no sunlight to be found inside this facility, yet $0 delicately dries their own skin.
value: 这设施内找不到一丝阳光，然而 $0 却细致地晾晒着自己的皮肤。

key: There’s no time to grieve for them.
There’s not much meaning to be had. We work and get paid. That’s all.
value: 没有什么意义可言。我们工作，我们拿薪水。仅此而已。

key: There’s something off about this place.
These shoes are the most beautiful pair I’ve seen.
value: 这双鞋是我见过的最漂亮的一双。

key: These three elements are crudely sewn together. Dr. ████████ suggested that “All three parts may be made from a single body. Whoever made this thing must have had a great hatred for Christmas. Well, that or they’ve never seen Santa Claus.”
value: 这三个部件被粗糙地缝在一起。████████博士推测：“这三个部分可能都取材于同一个身体。无论这东西是谁造的，一定对圣诞节怀有极大的憎恨。嗯，要么就是他从未见过圣诞老人。”
