key: These types think the result is more important than speed, but the results they produce are actually not really good.
value: 这种类型的人认为结果比速度更重要，但他们产出的结果实际上并不怎么好。

key:
They call me an adorable little kid because I am a small and lovely child!
The kid comes from a place far far away!
And when the kid meets someone she likes, she will give them a gift made all by herself.
The gift's content is a secret though!
value:
大家都叫我可爱的小孩子，因为我是个又小又惹人爱的孩子！
这孩子来自一个很远很远的地方！
当这孩子遇到她喜欢的人时，她会送给他们一件自己亲手制作的礼物。
不过礼物的内容是个秘密哦！

key: They called these three days and four nights the week of ‘White Nights and Dark Days’.
value: 他们把这三日四夜称为“白夜与黑暗之日”之周。

key: They can easily kill one or two employees. You should pay attention to their mood status.
value: 它们可以轻易杀死一两名员工。你应该留意它们的心情状态。

key: They don’t accept that they are “Low” meaning poor, so they ask for a re-test at every opportunity.
value: 他们不接受自己被评为“低”，也就是差劲，所以一有机会就要求重测。

key: They felt as though they would no longer be lost.
value: 他们觉得，自己仿佛再也不会迷失了。

key:
They imported a tree.
      That tree, standing in the middle of the Containment Unit, was such a beautiful sight to behold. I could feel the scent of flowers flit across my face even though there was no breeze or wind.
      Smelling that scent for even just a moment makes my attachment for the tree blindly grow. I was very intuitive since my childhood, so I could sense that this artificial attachment was hazardous.
      Ever since then, I tried everything I could to avoid contact with that tree, making all kinds of excuses whenever I was assigned to work on it.
      “Well, if you put it that way… just this once, okay? Geez, did that tree do something to you?”
      My colleague’s banter gets stuck in my ears. Did it do something? Yes, it did, and it scares me.
      A few days later, the same colleague has now become a staunch worker, wearing a constant smile on his face. I knew he’s always been an optimistic person, but I couldn’t help but feel uneasy because his face seemed strangely comfortable.
      “Really, do I seem content lately?
      Yeah, well, that’s because the tree is helping me out.”
      He answered light-heartedly. From my years of experience, I can say for certain that few people can smile so sincerely while working for this company. That means, when someone keeps smiling at work, it’s a sign that something went wrong. My suspicion immediately led me to report this behavior to my superior.
      The answer came sooner than I thought. It said that I am to observe the Abnormality myself and file an observation report because there have been several abnormal behaviors related to this tree which were identified in several other employees, not just the guy I reported.
      The order forced me to finally confront this tree that I had been avoiding as best I could. I knew I couldn’t pass it over to someone else this time.
      It was no longer a barren, naked tree that I saw the day it was imported. Instead, I saw a Containment Unit covered in grass that seemed to be sprawling around the tree. Which was peculiar, since there’s no way grass can grow in a Containment Unit. This facility is completely inorganic.
      ‘Hello, have you come here to receive my blessing, too?’
      The moment I felt that something was wrong, a voice echoed in my head…
value:
他们引进了一棵树。
      那棵树矗立在收容单元中央，景色美得令人移不开眼。即使没有一丝风，我也能感觉到花香拂过面颊。
      只要闻到那香气片刻，我对那棵树的依恋就会盲目地滋长。我从小就直觉敏锐，所以能察觉到这种人造的依恋是危险的。
      从那以后，我想尽一切办法避免与那棵树接触，每当被分配去处理它时，我都会编出各种借口。
      “好吧，既然你这么说……就这一次，行吗？天哪，那棵树对你做了什么吗？”
      同事的玩笑话卡在我耳朵里。它做了什么吗？是的，它做了，而这件事让我恐惧。
      几天后，同一个同事已经变成了一个坚定的工人，脸上始终挂着微笑。我知道他一向是个乐观的人，但他的表情看起来莫名地安详，让我不禁感到不安。
      “真的吗，我最近看起来心满意足？
      是啊，那是因为那棵树在帮我。”
      他轻快地回答。凭我多年的经验，我可以肯定地说，在这家公司工作时，很少有人能笑得如此真诚。这意味着，当有人在工作时一直微笑，那就是出了问题的征兆。我的疑心立刻促使我把这一行为报告给了上级。
      答复来得比我预想的更快。上面说，我需要亲自观察这异想体并提交观察报告，因为与这棵树相关的异常行为已在其他几名员工身上发现，不只是我报告的那个人。
      这道命令迫使我最终直面那棵我一直尽力回避的树。我知道这次不能再把它推给别人了。
      它不再是引进那天我所见的那棵光秃秃、赤裸裸的树。相反，我看到收容单元里长满了草，那些草似乎在树的四周蔓延开来。这很奇怪，因为收容单元里根本不可能长出草来。这座设施是完全无机的。
      “你好，你也是来这里接受我的祝福的吗？”
      就在我感觉到不对劲的那一刻，一个声音在我脑海中回响……

key: They once belonged to a researcher who had gone mad during their work. It’s only been partially deciphered, but it seems most of it relates to the various experiments that were conducted in this place.
value: 它们曾属于一位在工作中发了疯的研究员。目前只破译了其中一部分，但看起来大部分内容都与在这里进行的各种实验有关。

key: They say a hive’s drones spend their entire life providing food for the queen.
value: 据说蜂巢里的工蜂终其一生都在为蜂后提供食物。

key: They say not just anyone can become a magical girl. They should be kind-hearted, just, and love the world! Then they may just become a magical girl like me.
value: 据说不是谁都能成为魔法少女。她们应该心地善良、正义凛然、热爱这个世界！那样的话，她们或许就能成为像我这样的魔法少女。

key:
They say the mourner with a huge luggage on his back had come to be a savior to all.

Eventually, he himself was trapped in this place, and now he wanders the company with only the memory of an empty faith.

He's carrying a coffin. A large coffin to pay tribute to the employees who have nowhere else to go. However, it is still too small to comfort those innocent sacrifices.

Inside it is a kaleidoscope of butterflies waiting for the moment to fall asleep. Until then, they flutter their wings uselessly. The wings that may have been many jumbled into one, or one split into many.

Butterflies are supposed to pollinate flowers, but not a single proper flower blooms in this place.

There is no choice but to wait. After all, there must be an end to every world.
value:
据说那个背着巨大行囊的哀悼者，是为了成为所有人的救世主而来的。

最终，他自己被困在了这个地方，如今只带着对空洞信仰的记忆，在公司里徘徊。

他背着一口棺材。一口为那些无处可去的员工致哀的巨大棺材。然而，它依然太小了，无法抚慰那些无辜的牺牲者。

棺材里是万千蝴蝶的万花筒，等待着沉眠之刻的降临。在那之前，它们徒劳地扇动着翅膀。那些翅膀，或许是许多只混杂成一只，又或许是一只分裂成许多只。

蝴蝶本应为花朵授粉，但这个地方连一朵像样的花都不曾绽放。

别无选择，只能等待。毕竟，每一个世界都必然有其终结。

key: They say the pleasure it provides exceeds the amount a human can bear, but there is no one who can explain how it truly feels.
value: 据说它所带来的快感超出了人类所能承受的限度，但没有人能解释那真正是怎样的感受。

key: They say there’s a shelf with all sorts of wine and champagne in the manager’s room.
value: 据说主管的房间里有一个架子，摆满了各种葡萄酒和香槟。

key: They say we should spend breaktime doing things that are good for us. I guess that makes it fine to spy on people to make sure they’re okay, right…? It comforts me.
value: 他们说我们应该把休息时间花在对自身有益的事情上。我想这样一来，偷偷观察别人以确保他们没事，也就没问题了吧……？这让我感到安慰。

key: They use a language we cannot understand to communicate with each other. They follow a few employees around when they enter the Containment Unit, using their special abilities to help heal injuries. Employees call this act "The Fairies' Care".
value: 它们用一种我们无法理解的语言彼此交流。当员工进入收容单元时，它们会跟在一些员工身边，用它们的特殊能力帮助治愈伤势。员工们将这种行为称为“精灵的照料”。

key: They were a good person… They used to listen to any worry I had and would help me through it…
value: 他们是好人……他们曾倾听我的每一份忧虑，并帮我渡过难关……

key: They were a passionate employee. The company should compensate their family well.
value: 他们是一位尽职尽责的员工。公司应当好好抚恤他们的家人。

key: They weren’t just some employee. They were a part of our team. We’ll never forget them.
value: 他们不只是某个员工。他们是我们团队的一部分。我们永远不会忘记他们。

key: They won’t be interested in anything in their lives, once its tentacle penetrates them.
value: 一旦它的触手刺入他们的身体，他们便会对生活中的一切都失去兴趣。

key: They’re dead? Goodness… we ate together just a few days ago!
value: 他们死了？天哪……我们几天前还一起吃过饭呢！

key: They’re much prettier with blood on them.
value: 沾上血之后，它们漂亮多了。

key: They’re not so different, suppressing Abnormalities and culling panicked coworkers.
value: 镇压异想体，和清除陷入恐慌的同事，二者也没什么不同。

key: Things like this happen too often in the world. Even among people.
value: 这种事在世上发生得太频繁了。甚至在人与人之间也是如此。

key: Things that may have once been hearts are now shoved into $0 indiscriminately.
value: 那些或许曾经是心脏的东西，如今正被不分青红皂白地塞进 $0 体内。

key: This Abnormality changes their facial expression at certain intervals. However, when faced with another person, their changes halt.
value: 这异想体每隔一段时间就会变换面部表情。然而，当面对另一个人时，它的变化便会停止。

key: This Abnormality deals RED damage and is weak to WHITE damage. How convenient that our Agents are all equipped with E.G.O Suits which resist RED, and E.G.O Weapons that deal WHITE damage.
value: 这异想体造成红伤，并且弱于白伤。多么凑巧，我们的员工全都装备了抵御红伤的E.G.O护甲，以及造成白伤的E.G.O武器。

key: This Abnormality has a strong will to return to its original place; the creature causes unintentional psychological damage because of its desire for a child’s purity. To specify this phenomenon, more studies and experiments are needed but it is confirmed that the minuscule molecules have the ability to brainwash employees.
value: 这异想体有着强烈的、回归原初之地的意志；由于它对孩童纯真的渴望，这生物会造成无意的心理伤害。要确切描述这一现象，还需要更多的研究与实验，但已确认的是，那些微小的分子具有洗脑员工的能力。

key: This Abnormality is a phenomenon with no visible form. It was discovered when employees began to exhibit shared symptoms when entering a specific area of the facility. They all suffered hallucinations of a specific nature, and their mental corruption increased.
value: 这异想体是一种没有可见形态的现象。它是在员工进入设施特定区域时开始表现出相同症状时被发现的。他们都遭受着特定性质的幻觉，且精神腐蚀程度不断加深。

key: This Abnormality is not affected by Qliphoth Meltdowns.
value: 这异想体不受逆卡巴拉熔毁的影响。

key: This armor was secured from a museum. The information below is the fragments of its legend. …This armor once belonged to General XXXX, who joined the War of XX during the year of XXX. It was a family heirloom, passed down through many generations. The general always wore this armor to keep himself protected. By a stroke of bad luck however, an arrow flew into a gap in the armor, killing him instantly. Somehow, the armor was undamaged. After the death of General XXXX, the armor was presented to Commander XXX of Battalion 00. The commander was always seen steel-clad each time he set out into battle. During one of his battles, the commander fell from his horse while fleeing from the enemy and died due to a fatal injury upon his skull. Still, the armor once again remained undamaged. There are many others throughout this armor’s history who have had their hands on it, and each and every one of them has died in battle. Meanwhile, the armor still kept its pristine condition. Over the years, the armor made its way to a warrior named XXX. He was known for simply keeping the armor in storage, not wearing it for a single battle. Eventually, XXX died of old age after participating in dozens of wars without sustaining a single injury. During his lifetime, the armor’s right arm became damaged, but there was no sign of exterior impact. XXX’s family later donated the armor to a museum.
value: 这件铠甲是从一座博物馆取得的。以下信息是它的传说残片。 ……这件铠甲曾属于XXXX将军，他在XXX年参加了XX战争。它是世代相传的传家之宝。将军总是穿着这件铠甲以保自身周全。然而，不幸的是，一支箭射入了铠甲的缝隙，瞬间夺去了他的性命。不知为何，铠甲毫发无损。 XXXX将军死后，铠甲被赠予00营的XXX指挥官。每当指挥官出征，人们总能看到他身披铁甲。在一次战斗中，指挥官在逃离敌人时坠马，因颅骨遭受致命伤而身亡。然而，铠甲再次完好无损。在这件铠甲的历史上，还有许多其他人曾拥有过它，而他们每一个都战死沙场。与此同时，铠甲始终保持着它完美的状态。 岁月流转，铠甲落到了一位名叫XXX的战士手中。他以将铠甲仅仅封存入库、从未穿着它上过一场战斗而闻名。最终，XXX在参加了数十场战争却未受一处伤之后，寿终正寝。在他生前，铠甲的右臂损坏了，却没有任何外部撞击的痕迹。XXX的家人后来将铠甲捐赠给了博物馆。

key: This bracelet shall not forgive those who hold greed in their hearts, thus it must only be worn by those in true need.
value: 这手镯不会宽恕心怀贪婪之人，因此，只有真正需要它的人才能佩戴。

key: This concludes our basic Manager Training and Education. If any questions or concerns happen to cross your mind while you’re on the job, you can always refer to the Manual by pressing F1 or by opening it from the ESC Menu. Lastly, there will be tooltips that appear if you mouse over the various interfaces and wait a moment. I wish you good luck and lasting health at Lobotomy Corporation, manager.
value: 我们的主管基础培训与教育到此结束。如果你在工作中遇到任何疑问或顾虑，可以随时按F1键或从ESC菜单打开手册进行查阅。最后，当你把鼠标悬停在各种界面上并稍作等待时，会出现提示信息。主管，祝你在脑叶公司好运常伴、健康长存。

key: This displays the current information we have on the Abnormality. As you can see, we still have very little knowledge about it, as most of it is locked away.
value: 这里显示的是我们目前所掌握的关于这异想体的信息。如你所见，我们对其的了解仍然很少，因为大部分信息都被封存了。

key: This experience has given birth to something new inside me.
value: 这段经历在我心中孕育出了某种新的东西。

key: This is a forest full of hearts. No matter how many he cuts down, the forest still remains dense.
value: 这是一片布满心脏的森林。无论他砍倒多少，森林依然茂密。

key: This is a recording of the day we must never forget.
value: 这是一段关于我们绝不能忘记的那一天的录音。

key:
This is another really really important secret, but the kid has lots of talents!
This girl has many friends, but they said she can't bring them here.
She was so sad that she had to leave her dear friends behind, so she came up with a brilliant idea!
value:
这是另一个非常非常重要的秘密，但这孩子有着许多才能！
这个女孩有许多朋友，但他们说她不能把朋友们带到这里来。
不得不把亲爱的朋友们留在身后，这让她非常难过，于是她想出了一个绝妙的主意！

key: This is mine, I won’t let anyone have it.
value: 这是我的，我不会让任何人得到它。

key: This is much sadder than I expected.
value: 这比我预想的要悲伤得多。

key: This is not good. #0$0 has undergone heavy stress, and is now panicking.
value: 这可不好。#0$0 承受了巨大的压力，现在正在恐慌。

key: This is way too inefficient. Why do these dangerous things need to be managed by humans?
value: 这也太没效率了。为什么这些危险的东西必须由人类来管理？

key: This is where people end up when they prefer not going to the work at all than running.
value: 比起奔跑，宁愿完全不去工作的人，最终就会落到这般境地。

key:
This little Abnormality couldn’t be evil at all. The only thing you have to worry about is your heart aching if you look at it too long because it’s just so cute. In fact, employees who enter this Abnormality’s Containment Unit tend to lose themselves a bit and often need to be forcibly removed from the unit by other employees. Caution needs to be taken as the assisting employees can also become captivated by its cuteness and become lost as well.

      + Attempts to bring the Abnormality out of its unit may occur from time to time, but this is not a concern as they are typically prevented by other employees.
      + When too many employees want to work with this Abnormality, a lottery will be held to decide who gets the privilege of doing so.
      + Our employees tend to show symptoms of mental regression such as oddly toned speech with a high pitch upon entering its Containment Unit, but it seems this is only a temporary problem.
      + Many of our employees refer to this Abnormality as “The Goodest Boy in the World Ppodae”, however, its official designation is simply ‘Ppodae’. Please make sure you don’t get confused.
      ++++ Every employee who enters its Containment Unit must upload a video or photo report of this Abnormality. (This is highly, extremely, UBER important; ensure that nobody misses this step.)
value:
这个小异想体完全不可能是邪恶的。你唯一需要担心的是，因为看它太久而心头发疼——它实在太可爱了。事实上，进入这异想体收容单元的员工往往会有些迷失自我，常常需要被其他员工强行带出单元。需要注意，前来协助的员工也可能被它的可爱迷住，一同迷失。

      + 偶尔会有人试图把这异想体带出它的单元，但这不必担心，因为通常都会被其他员工阻止。
      + 当有太多员工想与这异想体工作时，将举行抽签来决定谁获得这一特权。
      + 我们的员工在进入它的收容单元后，往往会表现出精神退化的症状，比如音调怪异、尖细的说话方式，但这似乎只是暂时的问题。
      + 我们许多员工把这异想体称为“全世界最乖的孩子波波代”，然而，它的正式名称只是“波波代”。请务必不要混淆。
      ++++ 每名进入它收容单元的员工都必须上传一段关于这异想体的视频或照片报告。（这非常、极其、超级重要；确保没有人漏掉这一步。）

key: This machine was designed to pull back the skull and destroy nerve tissue safely and efficiently.
value: 这台机器的设计用途，是拉开颅骨，安全高效地摧毁神经组织。

key: This place is too peaceful. Something must be wrong.
value: 这地方太和平了。一定有什么不对劲。

key: This place will sometimes make you feel empty and lonely.
value: 这个地方有时会让你感到空虚和孤独。

key: This portrait encaptures a moment; it is what we are destined to lose.
value: 这幅肖像定格了一个瞬间；那是我们注定会失去的东西。

key: This portrait encaptures a moment; it is what we are destined to lose. Those who see their healthy self will subconsciously begin craving. “If life could always be like that. If only I could always have a bright smile just like in that portrait.”
value: 这幅肖像定格了一个瞬间；那是我们注定会失去的东西。那些看到自己健康模样的人，会下意识地开始渴求。“如果生活能永远像那样就好了。如果我能永远拥有画中那样明亮的笑容就好了。”

key: This watch will not only take your lost time back, but also give you even more time.
value: 这块表不仅能把你失去的时间夺回来，还会给你更多的时间。

key: Those betrayed hearts sank into the depths, slowly forgotten in the ever-lengthening corridors of time.
value: 那些被背叛的心沉入深渊，在时光不断拉长的走廊里，被缓缓遗忘。

key: Those humans… There will be those who manifest their power, and those who will be consumed by such power.
value: 那些人类……有人会显现出他们的力量，也有人会被那样的力量所吞噬。

key: Those incomplete seeds gave humanity unstable powers.
value: 那些不完整的种子，赋予了人类不稳定的力量。

key: Those newbies have no idea what they’ll face here.
value: 那些新人对他们将在这里面对什么一无所知。

key: Those things are dried to such a crisp that a single touch would render them dust; they look much too horrible to be called “plants”.
value: 那些东西已经干枯到一碰就会化为齑粉的程度；它们看起来恐怖至极，根本无法称之为“植物”。

key: Those who answered “Yes” to the question “Do you love your city?” were deemed cured. Those who answered “No” weren’t allowed to discharge.
value: 对“你爱你的都市吗？”这一问题回答“是”的人，被视为已痊愈。回答“否”的人则不被允许出院。

key: Those who came near it yearned for its energy; they said it cleared their minds, and gave warmth to their hearts. However, they feared the black pendant. “I sure wish every Abnormality was helpful like this one.” they would say, sighing. Yet, it didn’t understand. It never intended to help others, that was simply what it did.
value: 靠近它的人都渴望它的能量；他们说它能清空思绪，给内心带来温暖。然而，他们却惧怕那枚黑色吊坠。“我真希望每个异想体都像这个一样有用。”他们会叹着气说。然而，它并不理解。它从未打算帮助别人，那只是它自然而然的所作所为。

key: Those who equip $0 will benefit from a sharp increase in the stats related to Temperance.
value: 装备 $0 的人将获得与节制相关属性的急剧提升。

key: Those who equip $0 will benefit from increased HP and Attack Speed.
value: 装备 $0 的人将获得HP与攻击速度的提升。

key: Those who face $0 will have their stats randomly adjusted.
value: 与 $0 对峙的人，其属性将被随机调整。

key: Those who face themselves in the mirror may appear the same, but in actuality, they have become completely different people.
value: 在镜子中面对自己的人，看起来或许与从前无异，但实际上，他们已变成了完全不同的人。

key: Those who have been kissed by $0 shall be reborn as the blessed.
value: 被 $0 亲吻过的人，将以受祝福之身重生。

key: Those who listen to $0’s music will recover SP, including the employee playing the music box and everyone in the department where the Abnormality is located.
value: 聆听 $0 音乐的人将恢复SP，包括演奏音乐盒的员工以及异想体所在部门的每一个人。

key: Those who open the book will be enlightened to unimaginable truths. The ones who have mastered the truths will be called by the prophets; this call cannot be denied.
value: 翻开这本书的人，将被启迪以难以想象的真理。那些掌握了真理的人，将被先知召唤；这一召唤无法拒绝。

key: Those who remain have no time to remember those who’ve died, all they can do is prepare for the next death.
value: 活着的人没有时间去缅怀死者，他们所能做的，只是为下一次死亡做准备。

key: Those who succeed in the hunt are granted with one of the very feathers that countless hunters once yearned for.
value: 在狩猎中取得成功的人，将被赐予一根无数猎人曾梦寐以求的羽毛。

key: Thousands of particles in the isolation sector have penetrated into #0’s nerve center of their brain
value: 隔离区的数千个微粒已渗入 #0 大脑的神经中枢

key: Time’s wasting, time’s running out… They are nothing but meaningless tantrums.
value: 时间在流逝，时间在耗尽……它们不过是毫无意义的任性发作罢了。

key:
Title: Peccatum Proprium 
 Today, we perform for the king. 
Characters :  A, The Failed, The Abandoned, The Broken, The Coward, and…….
value:
标题：自身之罪
 今天，我们为国王献演。
角色：A、失败者、被遗弃者、破碎者、懦夫，以及……。

key: To avoid $0’s deadly third kiss, and to rescue the trapped employee, a duel with $0 must be commenced.
value: 为了避开 $0 致命的第三次亲吻，并救出被困的员工，必须与 $0 展开一场决斗。

key: To be willing to bear pain is half the atonement.
value: 甘愿承受痛苦，便是赎罪的一半。

key: To give birth to the greatest masterpieces, sacrifices must be made. $0 is the perfect example of this phrase.
value: 要诞生最伟大的杰作，就必须做出牺牲。$0 便是这句话最完美的例证。

key: To him/her, the world is too slow. You will understand what “too fast to see their feet moving” means when you see him/her running.
value: 对他/她而言，这个世界太慢了。当你看到他/她奔跑时，就会明白什么叫“快到看不清双脚移动”。

key:
To keep the forest's peace, Long Bird weighed the sins of those who entered the forest.
For Long Bird's scale was fair and just, and could weigh any and all kinds of sin.
value:
为了维系森林的和平，长鸟称量着每一个进入森林者的罪孽。
因为长鸟的天平公正无私，能够称量任何一种罪孽。

key: To specify, our energy is a kind of bioenergy, but not the kind extracted from lowly grass or animal excrements.
value: 具体来说，我们的能量是一种生物能量，但不是那种从卑微的草木或动物粪便中提取出来的种类。

key: To the horizon of knowledge, beyond understanding…
value: 向着知识的水平线，超越理解之外……

key: To them, Sephira is just a house constructed of cake and confectionery, which they can easily destroy. And employees are chocolate chips on this house to them.
value: 对它们来说，赛菲拉只是一座用蛋糕和甜点搭成的房子，可以轻易摧毁。而员工在它们眼中，不过是这座房子上的巧克力碎。

key: Today is #0’s lucky day; $0 hasn’t activated.
value: 今天是 #0 的幸运日；$0 没有启动。

key:
Today, I’d like to talk about the recent incident everyone has heard of.
That’s right, that dreadful incident when an army of slimes took over our facility for (Redacted) minutes.
There were several containers left in the (Redacted) lab which were not processed properly during the experiment related to (Redacted).
If you know about the (Redacted) experiment, you would already know that the contents of those containers are merely useless leftovers that only prove the experiment has failed. Our researchers felt there was no need to dispose of them.
It was obvious that one newbie to the research team had no idea what was inside those containers. Employee Marie found the containers of pink slime and felt that they could pose a threat. It is assumed that she thoroughly concealed and kept them in (Redacted) status.
If my assumption is correct, the melted object in those containers was probably the (Redacted) of (Redacted). I became sure of this when I read the passage that described its appearance as that of an adolescent human.
value:
今天，我想谈谈大家最近都听说的那起事件。
没错，就是那起可怕的、史莱姆大军占领了我们设施（已编辑）分钟的事件。
在（已编辑）实验室里遗留了几个容器，它们在与（已编辑）相关的实验中未被妥善处理。
如果你了解（已编辑）实验，你就会知道，那些容器里的东西不过是无用的残渣，只能证明实验已经失败。我们的研究员觉得没有必要处理掉它们。
显然，研究团队里有个新人对那些容器里是什么一无所知。员工玛丽发现了那些粉色史莱姆的容器，觉得它们可能构成威胁。据推测，她彻底隐藏了它们，并使其保持在（已编辑）状态。
如果我的推测没错，那些容器里融化的物体，大概就是（已编辑）的（已编辑）。当我读到那段把它的外表描述得如同一个青春期人类的文字时，我就确信了这一点。

key: Todos nós sublimamos as nossas falhas enquanto brotávamos a Semente,
value: 我们所有人都在催生种子之时升华了自己的缺陷，

key: Todos nós sublimamos nossas falhas enquanto brotávamos a Semente…
value: 我们所有人都在催生种子之时升华了自己的缺陷……

key: Todos sentem que não estarão mais perdidos.
value: 所有人都觉得自己将不再迷失。
你们全都知道这件事吗？

key: Trust is quite an important factor here. Trust between you and I, you and the employees, and in yourself, and such.
value: 在这里，信任是相当重要的因素。你我之间的信任、你与员工之间的信任、对自身的信任，诸如此类。

key: Trying to resist viewing $0 again, #0 looks in the opposite direction, trying to resume the job at hand.
value: 努力克制着不再看 $0，#0 望向相反的方向，试图继续手头的工作。

key: Tu le connais, Gebura. Oui, le pouvoir de la graine est puissant.
value: 你认识他，格贝拉。是的，种子的力量是强大的。

key: Uhm, I don’t think this question is relevant.
value: 嗯，我觉得这个问题不太相关。

key: Um dia, esse desejo sussurrou-me algo.
value: 有一天，那个愿望对我低语了一些什么。

key: Um, I don’t get it. How can Angela have something like a desire?
value: 嗯，我不明白。安吉拉怎么可能有愿望之类的东西？

key: Uma árvore colossal semelhante a uma torre se ergue na cidade cinza.
value: 一棵高塔般的参天巨树，在灰色的都市中矗立而起。

key: Uma árvore imponente e colossal emergiu da cidade cinza.
value: 一棵巍峨参天的巨树，从灰色的都市中拔地而起。

key: Un arbre imposant et colossal a jailli de la ville grise.
value: 一棵巍峨参天的巨树，从灰色的都市中喷薄而出。

key: Un magnifique dénouement, vous ne trouvez pas ?
value: 多么美丽的结局，你们不觉得吗？

key: Unbeknownst to all, $0’s army grows day by day.
value: 在无人知晓的情况下，$0 的军团与日俱增。

key: Unfortunately, #0$0 failed to Observe #2$0. The Encyclopedia remains unchanged.
value: 遗憾的是，#0$0 未能成功观察 #2$0。图鉴没有变化。

key: Unimpeded by anything, it shone straight up with the warmth of its core.
value: 不受任何阻碍，它以核心的温暖笔直地向上照耀。

key: Unlike how she usually is, $0 is not paying any attention to #0 who just entered the room.
value: 与平时不同，$0 对刚进入房间的 #0 毫不理会。

key: Unlike many of the Abnormalities we have contained, only one employee was responsible for naming $0.
value: 与我们收容的许多异想体不同，为 $0 命名的只有一名员工。

key: Unlike other babies, $0 does not whine nor search for its mother.
value: 与其他婴儿不同，$0 既不哭闹，也不寻找母亲。

key: Unlike the fiery and vibrant match, $0 stands motionless in the Containment Unit.
value: 与那炽烈鲜活的火柴不同，$0 在收容单元中一动不动地伫立着。

key: Unsurprisingly, not a single employee volunteered to retrieve the corpse of their cocooned colleague.
value: 毫不意外，没有一名员工自愿去取回他们那位被茧包裹的同事的尸体。
永不凋谢的花朵猛烈地绽放。

key: Upbeat music can be heard, emitted from the inside of the vending machine.
value: 可以听到自动售货机内部传出的轻快音乐。

key: Upon completion of the work process, a canned beverage is discharged from the vending machine. The type of beverage that is emitted seems to vary in correlation with the work type.
value: 工作流程完成后，自动售货机会吐出一罐饮料。吐出的饮料种类似乎与工作类型相关而有所不同。

key: Upon observing the Abnormality, it has been confirmed that the spores attached to employees for a certain amount of time, and inflicted RED damage over that period. In addition, employees infested with spores were significantly slowed, and could not be healed by the regenerator or bullets.
value: 经过对这异想体的观察，已确认孢子会在员工身上附着一段时间，并在期间造成红伤。此外，被孢子感染的员工行动大幅减缓，且无法被回复装置或子弹治愈。

key: Using a ‘Special method,’ you can extract energy from the Illutionite organisms.
value: 通过一种“特殊方法”，你可以从幻彩石生物中提取能量。

key: Utilize the Abnormality to fortify an E.G.O Weapon. This will consume a small amount of the facility’s currently collected energy.
value: 利用异想体来强化一件E.G.O武器。这将消耗设施目前收集的一小部分能量。

key: Vamos gravar o mundo, pedaço por pedaço, ao lado de todos aqueles que estão abandonados.
value: 让我们与所有被遗弃之人并肩，将这个世界一点一点地刻录下来。

key: Venha, venha, vamos deixar de papinho e terminar com isso.
value: 来吧，来吧，别废话了，把这事了结掉。

key: Você consegue acreditar nele? Ele sempre agiu tão sereno, mesmo sabendo o que tinha acontecido com ela.
value: 你能相信他吗？即使知道她身上发生了什么，他也总是那么从容。

key: Você sabe muito bem, Gebura. Sim, o poder da semente é grandioso.
value: 你很清楚，格贝拉。是的，种子的力量是伟大的。

key: Vocês acham que eu não sabia disso? Eu fui rejeitada desde o momento em que nasci.
value: 你们以为我不知道这件事吗？我从出生的那一刻起就被抛弃了。

key: Vocês tem alguma ideia do que pode ser?
value: 你们知道那可能是什么吗？

key: Vocês, latas de ferro, puderam ver a luz com ele até o fim, tudo enquanto eu tive que aguentar tudo por milhões de anos sendo ignorada por ele.
value: 你们这些铁皮罐头，能和他一起看到最后的光，而我却要独自忍受这一切，忍受数百万年被他无视的岁月。

key: Vos tâches sont terminées, tout comme les miennes.
value: 你们的任务已经结束了，就像我的一样。

key: Vós achais que é justo eu ter de ficar aqui sentada e a assistir, mesmo quando ele me criou para sentir emoções?
value: 你们认为，即便他创造我是为了让我感受情感，我却只能坐在这里旁观，这公平吗？

key: Vós achastes que eu não estava ciente disso? Eu fui negada desde o momento que me deram vida.
value: 你们以为我不知道这件事吗？从我获得生命的那一刻起，我就被否定了。

key: Vós, meras latas de metal, pudestes ver a luz com ele no final, enquanto eu fui ignorada mesmo tendo aguentado um milhão de anos por ele.
value: 你们这些微不足道的铁皮罐头，最后能和他一起看到光，而我即使为他忍受了一百万年，却依然被无视。

key: WE WILL ALL BE DRIVEN MAD AND DIE JUST LIKE THEM!!!
value: 我们全都会像他们一样发疯而死！！！
哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

key: Wanna grab a drink or two after work, manager?
value: 主管，下班后想去喝两杯吗？

key: Warning: You have been hit by the baldy-bald psychological attack. If a non-bald person reads this, they’ll be granted the privilege to go bald at an extremely rapid pace. If one wants to stop this from happening, they must be assigned to work on this Abnormality. In addition, if you find 10 or more strands of hair on your pillow in the morning, it is recommended to peruse this encyclopedia article at least three times.
value: 警告：你已遭受光头光头精神攻击。若非光头人士阅读此内容，将被赋予以极快速度秃头的特权。若想阻止此事发生，就必须被指派去对这异想体工作。此外，若你早晨在枕头上发现10根或更多的头发，建议至少仔细阅读这篇图鉴文章三遍。

key: Was it the enchantment, or was it the wrath which was bending the laws of nature? Even after enough time had passed for it to rot and allow its seed to bear fruit, the apple did not rot. In the meantime, one half of it was kicked and crushed by someone's foot, the other half was filled with holes, eaten away by the likes of birds and bugs.
value: 是魔咒，还是那扭曲自然法则的怒火？即便时间已流逝到足以让它腐烂、让种子结出果实，苹果却依然没有腐烂。与此同时，它的一半被人用脚踩碎，另一半则布满孔洞，被鸟和虫子之类啃食殆尽。

key: Watch me, manager! I didn’t fail! I swear I didn’t fail!
value: 看着我，主管！我没有失败！我发誓我没有失败！

key: We are all equal in the face of death.

value: 我们不过是渺小的存在……

key:
We are releasing the blacklist to the public. Those who are on this list must take 3 days of mental treatment provided by the company and will receive punishment accordingly by their respective Sephirah. We are making this list public to bring your attention to the astonishing number of infected employees around you.

Please note: Calling Emily—who killed herself after breaking into the Containment Unit of a certain Abnormality—a “martyr” will be treated as noncompliance with the company’s rules.

On a side note, we would like to praise employee Dylan's courageousness in his rescuing of employee Sophie, who was about to throw herself into a certain Abnormality.

If you see any of your valuable colleagues displaying this kind of behavior, please promptly report it to the Sephirah in charge.
value:
我们将黑名单公之于众。名单上的人必须接受公司提供的为期3天的心理治疗，并将由各自所属的赛菲拉给予相应处罚。我们公开这份名单，是为了提醒你们注意身边感染者那惊人的数量。

请注意：将艾米丽——她在闯入某个异想体的收容单元后自杀——称为“殉道者”，将被视为违反公司规定。

另外，我们要表扬员工迪伦的勇敢，他救下了即将投身于某个异想体的员工苏菲。

如果你看到任何宝贵的同事表现出此类行为，请及时向负责的赛菲拉报告。

key: We are still in the midst of our journey. We followed the yellow brick road to make our dreams come true.
value: 我们仍在旅途之中。我们沿着黄砖路前行，以实现我们的梦想。

key:
We are the feathers of a Wing. Resignation isn't as simple as you think. Just like how a feather doesn't detach from a wing of its own will.

- Then, where did all the resigned employees go?

They're bound to the company the moment they enter. Even if they do resign, they are doomed to stay here forever.

- Long ago, in some world, people believe that they would become beautiful beings with small wings when they died. It's a silly story. Nonsensical too.

If we get wings, will we be able to leave this place? Do we get our wings only after we retire?
value:
我们是翼的羽毛。离职可没有你想的那么简单。就像羽毛不会凭自己的意志脱离翅膀一样。

- 那么，那些离职的员工都去哪儿了？

他们踏入公司的瞬间，就被束缚于此。即使真的离职，他们也注定永远留在这里。

- 很久以前，在某个世界里，人们相信死后会变成长着小翅膀的美丽存在。那是个愚蠢的故事。也毫无道理。

如果我们长出翅膀，就能离开这个地方吗？我们是不是只有在退休之后才能长出翅膀？

key:
We ate continuously to live.
Inevitable depletion, the wastes…
value:
我们为了活下去而不断进食。
无法避免的枯竭，那些废料……

key: We can feel the passion and fire that emerges from deep inside $0.
value: 我们能感受到从 $0 内心深处涌出的激情与火焰。

key: We cannot understand. They cannot understand.
value: 我们无法理解。它们无法理解。

key: We cannot use your energy right away. We have to filter out impurities first, so wait just a little longer.
value: 我们无法立刻使用你们的能量。必须先过滤掉杂质，所以请再稍等片刻。

key: We can’t always be doom and gloom. Let’s keep our heads up!
value: 我们不能总是愁云惨淡。抬起头来！

key: We can’t do anything. It’s too late to change.
value: 我们无能为力。现在改变已经太迟了。

key: We can’t let grief grip us.
value: 我们不能让悲伤扼住我们。

key: We can’t let this happen again. How could someone work for a company like this?
value: 我们不能让这种事再次发生。怎么会有人愿意在这种公司工作？

key: We don’t say it all too often, but we admire you, manager!
value: 我们不常把这话挂在嘴边，但我们敬佩您，主管！

key: We fought to eat each other.
value: 我们争斗，是为了吃掉彼此。

key: We have enough energy, so collection and Abnormality management can be put on hold for now. If I were able to at this moment, I would high-five you.
value: 我们的能量已经足够了，所以收集和异想体管理可以暂时搁置。如果此刻我能做到的话，我真想和你击个掌。

key: We just have to keep on what we’ve always done before.
value: 我们只需继续做我们一直以来所做的事。

key: We know of an ancient practice; the countless promises that were made, and the unending faith placed in them.
value: 我们知道一种古老的做法；那无数许下的承诺，以及寄托于其中的无尽信念。

key: We may only be able to understand the secrets of the universe once we enter $0’s domain.
value: 或许只有进入 $0 的领域，我们才能理解宇宙的秘密。

key: We must do what we can now, not wrap our heads around the future.
value: 我们必须做好现在力所能及的事，而不是为未来绞尽脑汁。

key: We must gaze upon things beyond what our eyes can see.
value: 我们必须凝视那些超越肉眼所及之物。

key: We need to analyze the Abnormalities via Insight, and shape the environment they favor.
value: 我们需要通过洞察工作分析异想体，并塑造它们所青睐的环境。

key: We need to know what they truly are, and repress them.
value: 我们需要知道它们的真面目，然后压制它们。

key: We recreate the world by witnessing the truth with the eye of wisdom.
value: 我们用智慧之眼见证真相，以此重塑世界。

key: We should focus on #2$0. If its mood gets the slightest bit worse, it’s likely there will be nothing else we can do.
value: 我们应该关注 #2$0。如果它的心情稍有恶化，恐怕我们就无计可施了。

key: We still don’t know much about this Abnormality, so please order the Agent to perform Insight Work with it.
value: 我们对这异想体还知之甚少，所以请命令员工对它进行洞察工作。

key: We who live in a world lacking forgiveness offer up our souls as a tribute for redemption.
value: 我们这些生活在缺乏宽恕的世界里的人，献上自己的灵魂，作为救赎的祭品。

key: We will all eventually become one in the origin.
value: 我们终将在原初之中合而为一。

key: We will all sink and perish, devoured by madness…
value: 我们终将沉沦毁灭，被疯狂吞噬……

key: We will come again after death, following the guidance of the soul…
value: 死后我们将循着灵魂的指引，再次归来……

key: We will find our redemption through the Abnormalities.
value: 我们将通过异想体找到救赎。

key: We will know some day, we will be together in coming days.
value: 总有一天我们会知晓，在未来的日子里我们会在一起。

key: We will lose all our humanity someday if we continue to work here.
value: 如果我们继续在这里工作，总有一天会失去全部的人性。

key: Weak baddies like this are no match for me!
value: 这种弱鸡反派根本不是我的对手！

key: Weak minded folk have no place here.
value: 意志薄弱的人在这里没有立足之地。

key: Wears a black fedora and a beaked mask. Has huge black wings instead of arms or legs. It is capable of human communication, though it prefers to talk little. It came to this facility by itself, claiming that the world has contracted a dreadful disease only it is able to cure. We could not find anything about this “disease” it refers to.
value: 戴着黑色软呢帽和鸟喙面具。没有手臂或腿，取而代之的是巨大的黑色翅膀。它能够与人交流，不过更喜欢少言寡语。它是自行来到这座设施的，声称世界染上了一种只有它才能治愈的可怕疾病。我们查不到它所称的这种“疾病”的任何信息。

key: Well done, manager. Here you can view what E.G.O Gift the Abnormality may present to an Agent. If this information is unlocked, each time an Agent finishes the Work Process with the Abnormality, they will have the possibility of receiving the E.G.O Gift displayed here. Please note that the chances of this occurring tend to be rather slim.
value: 干得好，主管。这里可以查看这异想体可能赠予员工的E.G.O饰品。如果这项信息被解锁，每当员工与异想体完成工作流程时，他们都有机会获得这里显示的E.G.O饰品。请注意，出现这种情况的概率往往相当低。

key: Well done, now to give them some equipment. If you recall, we extracted some E.G.O Equipment from the Abnormality yesterday; we can give that to our employees. To view it, please press the E.G.O List button.
value: 干得好，现在来给他们一些装备。如果你还记得，我们昨天从异想体那里提取了一些E.G.O装备；我们可以把这些交给员工。要查看的话，请按下E.G.O清单按钮。

key: Well done. The information displayed in the panel on the right is related to the selected Agent. Some of this information is vital, such as their statistics and E.G.O Equipment. Please view the section in the Manager’s Manual titled “The Agents” for more details about what this information means.
value: 干得好。右侧面板显示的信息与选中的员工相关。其中一些信息至关重要，比如他们的属性与E.G.O装备。请参阅主管手册中题为“员工”的章节，以了解更多关于这些信息含义的细节。

key: We’re all going to be killed by that thing…
value: 我们都会被那东西杀死的……

key: We’re all going to die. Stuck in misery, with our whole bodies [e] by that monster. We’ll be killed.
value: 我们都要死了。被那怪物困在痛苦中，全身都被[e]了。我们会被杀死的。

key: We’re all going to die. They’ll ravage our bodies and minds here in this miserable place…
value: 我们都要死了。在这个悲惨的地方，它们会蹂躏我们的身心……

key: We’re nothing but flesh and blood after all.
value: 说到底，我们不过是血肉之躯罢了。

key: We’ve got all the energy that is needed but please wait a little longer, as we are in the process of filtering out the impurities with our special technology.
value: 我们已收集到所需的全部能量，但请再稍等片刻，因为我们正在用特殊技术过滤杂质。
我们失去了一位同事。小心！

key: We’ve made it this far. Let’s keep it that way.
value: 我们已经走到这一步了。让我们保持下去。

key: What #0 is right now is far different from who they imagined they would be in childhood.
value: 如今的 #0，与他们童年时想象中自己会成为的样子相去甚远。

key: What I just swore about in my mumble had nothing to do with you, manager.
value: 主管，我刚才嘟囔着骂的事跟您没关系。

key: What a beautiful day it is! I haven’t been outside yet, but I can tell the birds are singing happily!
value: 多么美好的一天啊！我还没出去过，但能听出鸟儿们都在欢快地歌唱！

key: What a shame, though. There is one last thing.
value: 不过，真遗憾。还有最后一件事。

key: What am I supposed to do here again? Oh that, yeah.
value: 我在这里该做什么来着？哦，那个啊，对。

key: What day is it today? I forgot again.
What does it truly mean to be humane? Is it humane to seek truth and verity?
value: 真正的人道意味着什么？追求真理与真实，算是人道吗？

key: What happens when the black swan wakes up from dreaming of a white swan?
value: 当黑天鹅从梦见白天鹅的梦境中醒来时，会发生什么？

key: What if Abnormalities are some kind of gods?
value: 如果异想体是某种神明呢？

key: What in the world are you talking about?
What is this? That which I cannot gain through leaving, and that I leave by gaining.
value: 这是什么？那是我无法通过离去而获得，却通过获得而离去的东西。

key: What it tells differs from time to time, however, it will always commence with “Dearie, dearie, would you like to hear a story?”. This story could be a lullaby, an unspecified poem, a nursery rhyme, a common children’s story, or something entirely new.
value: 它讲述的内容因时而异，然而，它总是以“亲爱的，亲爱的，你想听个故事吗？”开头。这故事可能是摇篮曲、一首无名诗、一首童谣、一个普通的儿童故事，或者完全是新鲜的东西。

key: What kind of place is this?
What price did you pay to it?
value: 你向它付出了什么代价？

key: Whatever their original purpose is, those tentacles inflict severe damage to human brain.
value: 无论那些触手的原始用途是什么，它们都会对人类大脑造成严重的损伤。

key: What’s with that look?! I’ll make you feel all better, so hold still!
value: 你那是什么眼神？！我会让你舒服起来的，所以别动！

key: Whelp, it doesn’t matter anymore. We’ll be turned off soon anyways. It’s the last part of his plan.
value: 唉，已经无所谓了。反正我们很快就会被关闭。这是他计划的最后一步。

key: When #0 begins to mend the tears and rips on its plush body, $0 does not react.
value: 当 #0 开始缝补它毛绒身体上的撕裂处时，$0 没有任何反应。

key: When #0 died while working with $0, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当 #0 在与 $0 工作时死亡，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When #0 fell into a panic, $0’s Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当 #0 陷入恐慌时，$0 的逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When #0 notices that the floor shouldn’t be black, a large shadow begins to move.
value: 当 #0 注意到地板不应该是黑色时，一个巨大的影子开始移动。

key: When #0 was assigned to work with a different Abnormality instead of $0, a ███████ eventually burst out of their body at a certain point.
value: 当 #0 被指派去与别的异想体工作而非 $0 时，一个 ███████ 最终在某个时刻从他们的身体里爆裂而出。

key: When #0, carrying the scent of F-01-57 from their previous work, completed the work process, the Qliphoth Counter decreased. #0 was then devoured by $0.
value: 当带着先前工作中 F-01-57 气味的 #0 完成工作流程时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。随后，#0 被 $0 吞噬。

key: When #0, who had Level 1 Fortitude, completed the work process, a hand stretched out of $0 and dragged #0 into its depths. The same phenomenon occurred with an Agent who had Level 1 Temperance.
value: 当拥有1级坚韧的 #0 完成工作流程时，一只手从 $0 体内伸出，将 #0 拖入其深处。拥有1级节制的员工也出现了同样的现象。

key: When #0, who had previously worked with F-02-58 completed the Work Process with $0, the Qliphoth Counter decreased.
value: 当先前与 F-02-58 工作过的 #0 与 $0 完成工作流程时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When #0, who was suffering from the mentioned symptoms, was left alone for a certain time, they changed into a form akin to $0. (O-02-74-1)
value: 当出现上述症状的 #0 被单独留置一段时间后，他们变成了与 $0 相似的形态。（O-02-74-1）

key: When #0, who witnessed $0’s human appearance, fell into a panic, they became $0’s new shell. At the same time, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当目睹了 $0 人类外貌的 #0 陷入恐慌时，他们成了 $0 的新空壳。与此同时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When $0 assumes the form of an egg, you can faintly see a smiling girl inside it.
value: 当 $0 变成蛋的形态时，你可以隐约看到蛋里有一个微笑的女孩。

key: When $0 engages in combat, you’ll be able to see her numerous small wounds and large scars between the fluttering of her hood.
value: 当 $0 投入战斗时，你会在她兜帽的飘动之间看到她身上无数细小的伤口和巨大的疤痕。

key: When $0 escaped from its containment, it began to spread its roots and branches along the ground of the area it was in. Those withered vines slowed employees, hampering their movement.
value: 当 $0 逃出收容后，它开始在所处区域的地面上蔓延根须与枝条。那些枯萎的藤蔓使员工减速，阻碍他们的移动。

key: When $0 escaped, it slowly moved throughout the facility, inflicting WHITE damage to employees near it.
value: 当 $0 逃逸时，它缓缓地穿过整个设施，对附近的员工造成白伤。

key: When $0 escaped, it voluntarily returned to its Containment Unit after the end of the third movement. The movement also prematurely ended when $0 was suppressed.
value: 当 $0 逃逸时，它在第三乐章结束后自行返回了收容单元。当 $0 被镇压时，乐章也会提前结束。

key: When $0 escaped, it voluntarily returned to its unit after attacking an employee and taking █████ from their corpse.
value: 当 $0 逃逸时，它在袭击一名员工并从其尸体上取走 █████ 后，自行返回了单元。

key: When $0 escaped, its light put every employee who came into contact with it asleep. They woke up when the manager shook them.
value: 当 $0 逃逸时，它的光芒使每一个与它接触的员工陷入沉睡。主管摇晃他们时，他们才醒来。

key: When $0 was escaping and killed an employee, it sucked their brain out to recover its HP.
value: 当 $0 逃逸并杀死一名员工时，它会吸出他们的脑子以恢复HP。

key: When $0 was in a bad state, you had to pay for using pause.
value: 当 $0 处于糟糕状态时，使用暂停功能需要付出代价。

key: When $0 was in operation, a nearby employee complained that they could hear a continuous melody out of nowhere. We have decided to call this phenomenon “Addicted”.
value: 当 $0 运转时，附近的一名员工抱怨说，他们能听到不知从何而来的、持续不断的旋律。我们决定将这一现象称为“成瘾”。

key: When $0’s Containment Unit was in view for 5 seconds or longer during work, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当工作中 $0 的收容单元进入视野5秒或更久时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When $0’s Qliphoth Counter hit 0, every employee in the department suffered WHITE damage.
value: 当 $0 的逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，部门内的每名员工都遭受了白伤。

key: When 10 employees die inside the facility, the Qliphoth Counter will lower. However, deaths caused by Execution Bullets were not recognized.
value: 当设施内有10名员工死亡时，逆卡巴拉计数器将会下降。然而，由处决子弹造成的死亡不被计入。

key: When 20 to 30 seconds have passed after the music box begins playing, the SP of the employee operating the music box will begin to fall rapidly, causing them to panic.
value: 当音乐盒开始播放20到30秒后，操作音乐盒的员工的SP将开始急剧下降，导致他们陷入恐慌。

key: When 3 Abnormality escapes were confirmed, the Qliphoth Counter lowered and F-02-70-3’s appearance changed.
value: 当确认有3起异想体逃逸时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降，且 F-02-70-3 的外貌发生了变化。

key: When 5 buds had sprouted on $0, it turned dark and its blessed employees panicked. After some time passed, stems ripped through them and turned them into saplings (D-04-108-1) which strikingly resemble the Abnormality.
value: 当 $0 上长出5个花苞时，它变得暗淡，其受祝福的员工陷入恐慌。一段时间后，茎蔓撕裂他们的身体，将他们变成了与这异想体惊人相似的树苗（D-04-108-1）。

key: When 5 or more employees died within the facility, the Qliphoth Counter lowered and F-02-70-1’s appearance changed. However, deaths caused by Execution Bullets were not recognized.
value: 当设施内有5名或更多员工死亡时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降，且 F-02-70-1 的外貌发生了变化。然而，由处决子弹造成的死亡不被计入。

key: When 5 or more employees within the facility panicked, the Qliphoth Counter lowered and F-02-70-2’s appearance changed.
value: 当设施内有5名或更多员工陷入恐慌时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降，且 F-02-70-2 的外貌发生了变化。

key: When 5 works with other Abnormalities were completed while $0 was not being worked with, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当在未与 $0 工作的情况下完成了5次与其他异想体的工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When Attachment Work was performed with $0, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当对 $0 进行依附工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When D-03-109-1 completed Repression Work, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当 D-03-109-1 完成压迫工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When F-01-57 entered the hallway leading to $0’s containment unit, the Qliphoth Counter immediately became zero.
value: 当 F-01-57 进入通往 $0 收容单元的走廊时，逆卡巴拉计数器立即变为零。

key: When F-02-58 howled near $0’s Containment Unit, the Qliphoth Counter immediately dropped to 0.
value: 当 F-02-58 在 $0 的收容单元附近嚎叫时，逆卡巴拉计数器立即降到了0。

key: When Justice turns its back once more, several dozen blades will rove without a purpose. In shame of failing to defend once again, and in rage against the world, the swords will eventually point at those she could not protect.
value: 当正义再次转过身去时，数十把利刃将漫无目的地游荡。为再次未能守护而感到羞愧，为这个世界感到愤怒，这些剑最终将指向那些她未能保护的人。

key: When O-01-73-1 panicked, $0 escaped from its Containment Unit. The same results occurred when O-01-73-1 died.
value: 当 O-01-73-1 陷入恐慌时，$0 从收容单元中逃逸。当 O-01-73-1 死亡时，也出现了同样的结果。

key: When Peter squashed one of the spiderlings by accident, a giant spider descended from the ceiling. Peter was dragged to the ceiling in only a moment. The cocooned employee hanging off the ceiling of the Containment Unit will be a healthy meal for the spider's offspring.
value: 当彼得不小心压扁了一只小蜘蛛时，一只巨大的蜘蛛从天花板上降了下来。彼得瞬间就被拖到了天花板上。悬挂在收容单元天花板上的、被茧包裹的员工，将成为蜘蛛后代的一顿营养大餐。

key: When Repression work was performed with $0, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当对 $0 进行压迫工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When Repression work was performed, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当进行压迫工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When a Qliphoth Meltdown occurred in the facility without the death of 3 or more employees, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当设施内发生逆卡巴拉熔毁而没有3名或更多员工死亡时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When a Qliphoth Meltdown occurs, the Containment Unit will have a timer displayed alongside the alarm on top. This timer will slowly drop until it reaches zero; however, if the Abnormality was already being worked with at the moment of the Qliphoth Meltdown, the timer will be paused until the Work Process is finished.
value: 当发生逆卡巴拉熔毁时，收容单元顶部会在警报旁显示一个计时器。这个计时器会缓慢下降，直至归零；然而，如果在逆卡巴拉熔毁发生时，该异想体已经在被工作中，计时器将暂停，直到工作流程结束。

key: When a Trumpet Level 2 emergency occurred, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当发生2级号角紧急事态时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When a captivated employee reached the Containment Unit, they were dragged into the tree.
value: 当一名被蛊惑的员工到达收容单元时，他们被拖进了树里。

key:
When a marksman received a gun from the Devil, the Devil proposed a childish contract: The last bullet would puncture the head of his beloved. The moment he heard that, he sought and shot all the people he loved. Then he told the Devil, "This magical bullet can truly hit anyone just like you say."

With the last bullet gone for good, the hunter traveled to numerous worlds. Sometimes he helped those in need or fought evil, but it was all done on impulse, not a gesture of goodwill or ideals. In one world, he was called a righteous hunter, while in another, he was a bloodstained gunman.
value:
当一位射手从恶魔那里得到一把枪时，恶魔提出了一个幼稚的契约：最后一颗子弹将贯穿他挚爱之人的头颅。听到那句话的瞬间，他便去寻找并射杀了所有他爱的人。然后他对恶魔说：“这魔法子弹正如你所说，能射中任何人。”

随着最后一颗子弹永远消失，这位猎人游历了无数个世界。有时他帮助需要帮助的人，或与邪恶战斗，但这一切都是出于一时冲动，而非善意的姿态或理想。在一个世界里，他被称为正义的猎人，而在另一个世界里，他则是一个满身血污的枪手。

key: When a mission is successfully completed, you will be able to conduct a research project. The proposals for a Department’s various research projects are displayed at the start of each day during Deployment. To select a research project, click and drag it to the open slot at the lower right, then click ‘Proceed’ to confirm your choice. Please try to do so with this example proposal.
value: 当任务成功完成时，你将能够进行一项研究项目。各部门各种研究项目的提案会在每天开始时的部署阶段显示。要选择研究项目，请点击并将其拖拽到右下角的空槽中，然后点击“进行”确认你的选择。请用这个示例提案试着操作一下。

key: When a subject who suffered bleeding by aggression from F-01-57 entered the hallway leading to the containment unit of $0, the Qliphoth Counter decreased.
value: 当一名因 F-01-57 的袭击而出血的对象进入通往 $0 收容单元的走廊时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When a ticket is received with 1 illuminated light, the employee will slightly recover their HP and SP.
value: 当收到亮着1盏灯的车票时，员工将略微恢复HP和SP。

key: When a ticket is received with 2 illuminated lights, the employee will significantly recover HP and SP.
value: 当收到亮着2盏灯的车票时，员工将大幅恢复HP和SP。

key: When a ticket is received with 3 illuminated lights, all employees within the department will recover HP and SP.
value: 当收到亮着3盏灯的车票时，部门内的所有员工都将恢复HP和SP。

key: When a ticket is received with 4 illuminated lights, all employees within the facility will recover HP and SP.
value: 当收到亮着4盏灯的车票时，设施内的所有员工都将恢复HP和SP。

key: When a wounded employee entered the Containment Unit, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当一名受伤的员工进入收容单元时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When all had abandoned hope, the masked man who called himself a doctor arrived.
value: 当所有人都放弃希望时，那个自称医生的蒙面人出现了。

key: When an Abnormality other than $0 was worked with, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当与 $0 以外的异想体工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When an Abnormality was suppressed, the Qliphoth Counter raised.
value: 当有异想体被镇压时，逆卡巴拉计数器上升了。

key: When an Abnormality’s Qliphoth Counter reaches 0, they will either escape or use a special ability. Such things can lead to rather inconvenient situations. This particular Abnormality happens to escape; our Agents cannot work with it while it is escaping, so we need to Suppress it. Please click on the escaped Abnormality.
value: 当异想体的逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，它们要么逃逸，要么使用特殊能力。这类事情会带来相当麻烦的局面。眼前这个异想体恰好逃逸了；我们的员工无法在它逃逸时与它工作，所以我们需要镇压它。请点击这个逃逸的异想体。

key: When an Agent had less than 20% of their max HP remaining after completing the work process, $0 granted the same light.
value: 当一名员工在完成工作流程后剩余HP不足最大值的20%时，$0 赐予了同样的光。

key: When an Agent with Prudence Level 4 or lower completed their work, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当谨慎等级4级或以下的员工完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When an Instinct work process was completed with $0 while its abdomen was noticeably enlarged, all previously consumed employees were orally voided.
value: 当 $0 的腹部明显膨胀时与其完成一次本能工作流程，所有先前被吞食的员工都被从口中排出。

key: When an employee Level 3 or lower encounters $0 while it is escaping, they will go out of control and attack other employees. The same instance occurred when an employee’s SP hit 0 due to $0’s attack.
value: 当3级或以下的员工在 $0 逃逸时遇到它，他们会失控并攻击其他员工。当员工因 $0 的攻击而SP归零时，也出现了同样的情况。

key: When an employee entered the Containment Unit of another Abnormality, $0’s Qliphoth Counter lowered with a normal probability.
value: 当员工进入另一异想体的收容单元时，$0 的逆卡巴拉计数器以正常概率下降。

key: When an employee enters the unit while the Counter is at 0, they will immediately die. Then, the Abnormality will escape.
value: 当计数器为0时员工进入单元，他们会立即死亡。然后，异想体会逃逸。

key: When an employee inhales enough spores, bizarre cysts will begin to grow on their body, and tissues will be eroded. Ultimately, they will become a dysmorphic creature whose original form is hardly noticeable. They will show hostility in this state, so they must be terminated on sight.
value: 当员工吸入足够多的孢子时，他们身上会开始长出怪异的囊肿，组织会被侵蚀。最终，他们会变成一种畸形生物，几乎看不出原来的形态。这种状态下他们会表现出敌意，因此一经发现必须立即处决。

key: When an employee panicked in the Containment Unit, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当员工在收容单元内陷入恐慌时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When an employee uses the machine, they will experience an increase in all their stats.
value: 当员工使用这台机器时，他们的所有属性都会得到提升。

key: When an employee whose Justice was lower than Level 4 completed the work, the Qliphoth Counter decreased.
value: 当正义等级低于4级的员工完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When an employee with $0’s Token of Friendship died, the Qliphoth Counter lowered by 4.
value: 当持有 $0 的友谊之愈代币的员工死亡时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了4点。

key: When an employee with Prudence Level 3 or higher finished their work, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当谨慎等级3级或以上的员工完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When an employee with Temperance Level 1 finished their work, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当节制等级1级的员工完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When an employee with Temperance Level 3 or higher completed their work, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当节制等级3级或以上的员工完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When an employee with the Token worked with another Abnormality, they received damage in proportion to $0’s Qliphoth Counter, which will then decrease.
value: 当持有代币的员工与另一异想体工作时，他们会受到与 $0 的逆卡巴拉计数器成比例的伤害，随后计数器将会下降。

key: When an employee’s Sanity (SP) falls to 0, they will panic. A panicked employee will show different behaviours depending on their highest Virtue. If you wish to learn more about this, please refer to the section “Employee Panic” in the Manager’s Manual. Now, please click on the currently panicking employee with the primary mouse button (LMB).
value: 当员工的理智（SP）降至0时，他们会陷入恐慌。陷入恐慌的员工会依据其最高美德表现出不同的行为。如果你想了解更多，请参阅主管手册中的“员工恐慌”一节。现在，请用鼠标主键（左键）点击当前陷入恐慌的员工。

key: When another Abnormality escaped in the department in which $0 was contained, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当 $0 所在部门内有另一异想体逃逸时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When another Abnormality escaped, the Qliphoth Counter lowered with a low probability.
value: 当另一异想体逃逸时，逆卡巴拉计数器以低概率下降。

key: When approached or touched, the employee will become delirious and throw themself into the Abnormality's mechanical body. Afterward, the machine's ventilation fan will quickly shut off, and the sound of the Abnormality operating can be heard from within. This process takes about 5 minutes.
value: 当被接近或触碰时，员工会变得神志不清，投身进入异想体的机械身躯。之后，机器的通风扇会迅速关闭，可以听到异想体在内部运转的声音。这个过程大约需要5分钟。

key: When borrowed, its rate of contraction will double, enhancing the borrower’s vigor and strength.
value: 借出后，它的收缩频率将翻倍，增强借用者的活力与力量。

key: When certain conditions are met, it releases spores. It will generate billions of spores within a 20-meter radius. The existence of lifeforms in its vicinity seems to be one of the key requirements.
value: 当满足特定条件时，它会释放孢子。它将在20米半径内产生数十亿个孢子。其附近存在生命体似乎是关键条件之一。

key: When cleaning the unit due as a part of Insight Work, #0 was quickly turned into a cocoon by $0.
value: 作为洞察工作的一部分进行单元清理时，#0 迅速被 $0 变成了茧。

key: When employee #0 panicked during work, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当员工 #0 在工作中陷入恐慌时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When employee #0 picked up the hammer, other beings with hammers appeared out of nowhere.
value: 当员工 #0 拿起锤子时，其他持锤的存在不知从哪里冒了出来。

key: When employees of Justice Level 2 or lower finished working with $0, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当正义等级2级或以下的员工与 $0 完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When employees of Justice Level 3 finished working with $0, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当正义等级3级的员工与 $0 完成工作时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When employees with Temperance Level 3 or lower had a Good work result, they died.
value: 当节制等级3级或以下的员工取得“优”的工作结果时，他们死了。

key: When he/she is tired, he/she would slow down, and when he/she caught his/her breath, he/she would run again. Yes. Just like you.
value: 当他/她累了，就会放慢脚步，而当他/她缓过气来，又会再次奔跑。没错。就像你一样。

key: When her brothers show any sign of pain, $0 will approach them, dragging her exhausted body.
value: 当她的兄弟们露出任何痛苦迹象时，$0 会拖着疲惫的身体走向他们。

key: When it did, there was no immediate change in the employees who inhaled the spores, and no anomalous signs could be detected on the examinations that followed.
value: 当它这样做时，吸入孢子的员工没有立即出现变化，随后的检查中也检测不到任何异常迹象。

key: When it escapes, it wears the skin of the person it killed and mimics them. Then, without any sign or forewarning, it reveals its true/second form. In its true/second form, its resemblance is much similar to that of humanity in comparison to its earlier form. The new form is confirmed to possess bipedalism, properly aligned organs, and the addition of greater physical strength. All the employees are afraid of this form.
value: 当它逃逸时，它会披上被它杀死之人的皮肤并模仿他们。然后，在没有任何征兆或预警的情况下，它会显露出它的真实/第二形态。在真实/第二形态下，与早期形态相比，它与人类的相似度要高得多。已确认新形态拥有直立行走能力、排列整齐的器官，以及更强大的体力。所有员工都惧怕这种形态。

key: When it is worn, all wounds are healed without a trace of scarring.
value: 穿戴后，所有伤口都会愈合，不留一丝疤痕。

key: When it shows signs of anxiety or doubt while conversing with an employee, its appearance and personality will undergo an adverse change within 4 days, and it will display symptoms of dissociative disorders.
value: 当它与员工交谈时流露出焦虑或疑虑的迹象，其外貌与人格将在4天内发生不利的变化，并表现出解离性障碍的症状。

key: When it was discovered that $0 contained a critical error, it had already been sent to a household.
value: 当发现 $0 存在严重缺陷时，它已经被送到了一户人家。

key:
When left out in the open, a corpse will begin to rot within a few hours. Most of the bodies that die here are damaged in one way or another, so they decay even faster.

You probably don’t know it yet, but most of the employees here are rather skilled at cleaning up dead bodies. Tidying up over and over will make anyone an expert at it, whether you want to or not. Let’s say someone you were just talking to about dinner plans died horrifically. With your repeated experience to help you, you won’t be vomiting or running away at least.
value:
尸体如果暴露在开阔地带，几小时内就会开始腐烂。这里死去的大多数尸体都以某种方式受过损伤，所以它们腐烂得更快。

你可能还不知道，但这里的大多数员工都相当擅长清理尸体。反复收拾，会让任何人成为这方面的专家，无论你愿不愿意。假设一个刚才还和你聊晚餐计划的人，惨死了。有了你反复积累的经验，至少你不会呕吐，也不会逃跑。

key: When more than 60 seconds of work time had taken place, the Qliphoth Counter lowered by 1, and the Agent who was working with $0 threw herself in.
value: 当工作时间超过60秒时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降1点，正在与 $0 工作的员工纵身扑了进去。

key:
When my senior's name showed up on the roulette, I congratulated them with all my heart. Though, they didn’t seem too happy for some reason. Others gave them a hug, one by one. Everyone was crying for some reason. They said goodbye to me, shedding tears while trying to force a smile. I haven't seen them since. I’m sure they’re working under much better conditions with a really nice salary! But, when I try to bring them up in conversation, people stop talking as if I've spoken some sort of taboo. I still remember the last thing they said to me before they left.

      “One day you'll understand. The meaning of the desperation on their faces when the roulette spins.”
value:
当我前辈的名字出现在轮盘上时，我真心诚意地恭喜了他们。不过，出于某种原因，他们似乎并不怎么高兴。其他人一个接一个地拥抱他们。不知为何，每个人都在哭泣。他们含泪强笑着向我道别。从那以后，我再也没见过他们。我相信他们一定在好得多的条件下工作，拿着相当优厚的薪水！但是，当我试着在谈话中提到他们时，人们就会停止交谈，仿佛我说了什么禁忌之语。我依然记得他们离开前对我说的最后一句话。

      “总有一天你会明白。轮盘转动时，他们脸上那种绝望的含义。”

key: When she was Hysteric, generating 15 or fewer PE-Boxes lowered her Qliphoth Counter.
value: 当她处于歇斯底里状态时，产出15个或更少的PE-Box会降低她的逆卡巴拉计数器。

key: When she was Hysteric, generating 16+ PE-Boxes raised her Qliphoth Counter.
value: 当她处于歇斯底里状态时，产出16个或更多的PE-Box会提高她的逆卡巴拉计数器。

key: When someone suppressed F-02-58 without allowing $0 to land the killing blow, $0 began to attack those around it indiscriminately.
value: 当有人镇压了 F-02-58 而未让 $0 完成致命一击时，$0 开始不分青红皂白地攻击周围的一切。

key: When something bad happens to you, do you want an alarm clock that repeats ‘emergency alert’ over and over with a siren sound,
value: 当你遇到不好的事情时，你想要一个用警笛声一遍又一遍重复“紧急警报”的闹钟吗，

key: When suppressing $0-1, please pay attention to the spores that are released from its body upon death. Those spores will cause sustained mental damage, and employees who panic from the spores may attempt to enter $0’s Containment Unit, which should be immediately stopped.
value: 镇压 $0-1 时，请注意它死亡时从体内释放的孢子。这些孢子会造成持续的精神损伤，而因孢子陷入恐慌的员工可能会试图进入 $0 的收容单元，必须立即阻止。

key: When the Abnormality escapes its Containment Unit, it will emit noises in the corridor. As the sounds it makes have what could be considered a melody and syllables, we consider it “singing”. However, none of our staff can precisely remember it, given that most of the time they are unable to describe it due to their serious brain damage. Those who were within 100 meters of the “singing” called it a sound unheard of in this world. Because of these descriptions, we’ve titled it “Echoes from the Beyond”. (See Document #2 <Singing>)
value: 当这异想体逃出收容单元时，它会在走廊里发出声响。由于它发出的声音可以被认为具有旋律和音节，我们认为那是在“歌唱”。然而，我们的员工中没有一个人能准确地记住它，因为大多数时候，他们由于严重的脑损伤而无法描述它。那些身处“歌声”100米范围内的人称，那是这世上闻所未闻的声音。基于这些描述，我们将其命名为“来自彼岸的回声”。（参见文件#2<歌唱>）

key: When the HP of an employee infested with spores had depleted, a giant drone burst out of their body. The drone indiscriminately attacked nearby employees. From the corpses of attacked employees, more drones emerged.
value: 当被孢子感染的员工HP耗尽时，一只巨大的雄蜂从他们体内爆裂而出。这只雄蜂不分青红皂白地攻击附近的员工。在被攻击员工的尸体上，又涌现出更多的雄蜂。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter became 0, a low-Temperance employee #0 entered the Containment Unit in a trance. This phenomenon has been dubbed “Allurement”.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器变为0时，一名节制等级低的员工 #0 恍惚地进入了收容单元。这一现象被称为“蛊惑”。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter hit 0, $0 summoned employees to its Containment Unit to bless them.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，$0 召唤员工来到它的收容单元，为他们祝福。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter hit 0, $0 willfully fired a bullet towards a random location.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，$0 随心所欲地朝一个随机方向开了一枪。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reached 0, $0 began crying. Employees who heard its wails complained of a headache. Furthermore, the Qliphoth Counters of all nearby Abnormalities gradually decreased over time.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，$0 开始哭泣。听到它哀嚎的员工抱怨头痛。此外，附近所有异想体的逆卡巴拉计数器都随时间逐渐下降。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reached 0, $0 emitted red spores throughout the entire department.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，$0 在整个部门内释放了红色孢子。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reached 0, $0, taking the appearance of the dead #0, disappeared from its Containment Unit. The manager must quickly find and kill $0’s disguised appearance.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，$0 化作死去的 #0 的模样，从收容单元中消失了。主管必须迅速找到并杀死 $0 的伪装形态。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reached 0, a few random employees in the facility began to move towards $0’s unit. (This status was designated as “Captivated”.)
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，设施内一些随机员工开始朝 $0 的单元移动。（这一状态被命名为“被蛊惑”。）

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reached 0, all employees with the Token died.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，所有持有代币的员工都死了。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reached 0, black shapes formed inside the Containment Unit. We’ve decided to dub these shapes “solitude” based on the condition in which they form.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，收容单元内形成了黑色的形体。根据它们形成的状态，我们决定将这些形体命名为“孤独”。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reached 0, some employees heard $0’s calling and went to its Containment Unit to be blessed.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，一些员工听到了 $0 的呼唤，前往它的收容单元接受祝福。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter reached 0, the next employee to enter the unit dove into $0 and activated it.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器归零时，下一个进入单元的员工纵身扑进 $0 体内，启动了它。

key: When the Qliphoth Counter was at its max, the HP and SP of the employee who worked with her were healed.
value: 当逆卡巴拉计数器处于最大值时，与她工作的员工的HP和SP得到了治愈。

key: When the Suppression UI is on display, you can take note of what E.G.O each Agent has been equipped with before sending them into combat. Hovering your mouse over an Agent will also allow you to check up on their defenses. Now, please click on an Agent to begin Suppressing our escaped Abnormality.
value: 当镇压界面显示时，你可以在将员工投入战斗前记下每名员工装备了哪些E.G.O。将鼠标悬停在员工身上，还可以查看他们的防御。现在，请点击一名员工，开始镇压我们逃逸的异想体。

key: When the assignment was canceled before the ███████ was born, nothing strange occurred to the employee’s body.
value: 当任务在 ███████ 诞生之前被取消时，员工的身体没有出现任何异常。

key: When the beauty is at its peak, the ritual of the end will come.
value: 当美丽达到巅峰之时，终结的仪式将会到来。

key: When the bell struck twelve, the facility was swallowed by a blinding light. It was the light of redemption for His disciples.
value: 当钟声敲响十二下时，设施被一道耀眼的光芒吞没。那是祂的信徒们的救赎之光。

key: When the button is pressed, things that shouldn't happen, happen. Some say an apocalypse will befall, others say rainbow-colored light will shine down and unicorns will descend from the sky, and others still say a bomb buried deep underneath the facility will detonate and reset everything. However, none of these rumors are confirmed.
value: 当按钮被按下时，本不该发生的事情发生了。有人说天启即将降临，有人说彩虹色的光会洒落、独角兽会从天而降，还有人说埋藏在设施深处的炸弹会爆炸并重置一切。然而，这些传闻都未得到证实。

key: When the creature approaches the subject's brain, it accesses and attempts to recreate the purest childhood memory. The countless molecules work to recreate the memory and through that experience, the creature tries to return to its youthful existence.
value: 当这生物接近对象的脑部时，它会读取并试图重现最纯净的童年记忆。那无数的分子协力重现那段记忆，通过那段经历，这生物试图回归它年少时的存在。

key: When the curtain was completely drained at the containment room, a special ability of $0 was activated when a #0 employee was sent to the containment room. We must find a way to make the curtain faint.
value: 当收容室内的帷幕被完全抽空时，一名 #0 员工被派往收容室，触发了 $0 的特殊能力。我们必须找到办法让帷幕变得微弱。

key: When the facility reached Trumpet Level 2, $0 voluntarily helped with Abnormality suppression. However, if 20% of our employees die while help is provided, the state of the Abnormality will change and will need to be suppressed immediately.
value: 当设施达到2级号角事态时，$0 会主动协助镇压异想体。然而，如果在其协助期间有20%的员工死亡，异想体的状态将会改变，需要立即镇压。

key: When the flower of blessing finally blooms from $0, then…
value: 当祝福之花终于从 $0 身上绽放之时，那时……

key: When the game of trust with $0 reaches its maximum, it will gently pet your head with the thorns on its tail.
value: 当与 $0 的信任游戏达到最大值时，它会用尾巴上的刺轻轻抚摸你的头。

key: When the gauge fills completely, a Qliphoth Meltdown will occur throughout the facility. The number on the right part of the gauge indicates the number of Containment Units that will be affected. Affected Containment Units will receive a Meltdown Alarm, and will have an alert around them.
value: 当量表完全充满时，整个设施将发生逆卡巴拉熔毁。量表右侧的数字表示将受到影响的收容单元数量。受影响的收容单元将收到熔毁警报，周围会出现警示。

key: When the heart is lost, the Woodsman will fall to his knees in sorrow, clutching his empty chest. As if begging for the only thing he has left not to be taken.
value: 当心脏遗失时，樵夫会悲伤地跪倒在地，紧抓着空荡荡的胸口。仿佛在乞求不要夺走他仅剩的东西。

key:
When the monk arrived, people from all around the town were gathered in ceremony. They were gazing at the corpse of the old monk, chanting the name of Guanshiyin.

“Guanyin!”
“Guanyin!”
“Guanyin!”

The chant was born more out of desperation for something they yearned for, rather than commemoration.
The funeral pyre started crackling as it was fed with kindling. The sound of wooden percussion echoed, and the chanting grew louder and louder.
Soon, the crowd started buzzing with nervousness.

“...Something’s not right.”

The people were greatly disappointed by the amount of sarira that appeared.
There were no more than two spoonfuls. Shocked, the people soon turned into an angry crowd.

“It makes no sense that such a great monk had such little sarira!”
“Clearly he was lacking in his practice of asceticism!”
“He must not have done many good deeds.”

The visiting monk was himself baffled. He was unfamiliar with such an obsession with sarira at a cremation, and even he was expecting the proper amount of sarira that a great monk would deserve.
value:
当僧侣到达时，镇子四面八方的人都聚集在仪式上。他们凝视着老僧的遗体，齐声念诵着观世音的名号。

“观音！”
“观音！”
“观音！”

这诵念更多是源于对渴望之物的绝望祈求，而非悼念。
火葬的柴堆被添上引火物，开始噼啪作响。木鱼声回荡开来，诵念声越来越响亮。
不久，人群中开始响起紧张不安的骚动。

“……有点不对劲。”

人们因出现的舍利子数量而大失所望。
只有不到两勺。震惊的人群很快变成了愤怒的群众。

“如此伟大的僧人只有这么点舍利子，说不通！”
“显然他的苦修还远远不够！”
“他一定没做过多少善事。”

那位来访的僧侣自己也感到困惑。他对火化时这种对舍利子的痴迷感到陌生，甚至他也期待着一代高僧应有的、体面的舍利子数量。

key: When the rusty sleigh bells are ajingle, Christmas begins.
value: 当生锈的雪橇铃叮当作响时，圣诞节就开始了。

key: When the situation settled down, these beings with hammers, including employee #0, disappeared.
value: 当事态平息后，这些持锤的存在，包括员工 #0，都消失了。

key: When the solitude piled up, it stuck to #0 when they entered the Containment Unit.
value: 当“孤独”堆积起来时，它会在 #0 进入收容单元时粘附在他们身上。

key: When the time comes, the train will chug down the tracks and sound its mighty horn.
value: 当那个时刻到来时，列车将沿着轨道轰隆隆地驶来，鸣响它雄壮的汽笛。

key: When the time comes, the train will chug down the tracks and sound its mighty horn. There is no doubt that it will plunge through the endless tunnel while boarding the employees who have not taken a step back from the tracks.
value: 当那个时刻到来时，列车将沿着轨道轰隆隆地驶来，鸣响它雄壮的汽笛。毫无疑问，它将载上那些没有从轨道旁退后一步的员工，冲入无尽的隧道。

key: When the work process is completed, the PE-Boxes are collected. In addition to PE-Boxes that count toward the daily energy quota, each Abnormality also produces a set of PE-Boxes unique to them. These PE-Boxes are stored and shown in the Abnormality’s Unique PE-Box counter. These can be used to unlock more of an Abnormality’s information, or to extract E.G.O Equipment.
value: 当工作流程完成时，PE-Box会被收集。除了计入每日能量配额的PE-Box之外，每个异想体还会产出一套属于它们独有的PE-Box。这些PE-Box会被储存并显示在异想体的专属PE-Box计数器中。它们可以用来解锁更多关于异想体的信息，或提取E.G.O装备。

key: When the work result was Bad or Normal, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当工作结果为“差”或“普通”时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When the work result was Bad, #0 was attacked and turned into $0’s shell.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，#0 遭到攻击，变成了 $0 的空壳。

key: When the work result was Bad, the Qliphoth Counter decreased.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When the work result was Bad, the Qliphoth Counter decreased. Subsequently, #0 was devoured by $0.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。随后，#0 被 $0 吞噬。

key: When the work result was Bad, the Qliphoth Counter increased.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，逆卡巴拉计数器上升了。

key: When the work result was Bad, the Qliphoth Counter lowered with a high probability.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，逆卡巴拉计数器以高概率下降。

key: When the work result was Bad, the Qliphoth Counter lowered, and F-02-70-4’s appearance changed.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降，且 F-02-70-4 的外貌发生了变化。

key: When the work result was Bad, the Qliphoth Counter lowered.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降了。

key: When the work result was Bad, the Qliphoth Counter lowered; every employee stationed in $0’s department took WHITE damage.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，逆卡巴拉计数器下降；派驻在 $0 部门的每名员工都遭受了白伤。

key: When the work result was Bad, the employee was kissed by $0 with a high probability.
value: 当工作结果为“差”时，员工以高概率被 $0 亲吻。

key: When the work result was Good, the Qliphoth Counter increased.
value: 当工作结果为“优”时，逆卡巴拉计数器上升了。

key: When the work result was Good, the Qliphoth Counter increased. When all E-Boxes were produced as PE-Boxes, the Counter increased by 2.
value: 当工作结果为“优”时，逆卡巴拉计数器上升了。当所有E-Box都以PE-Box的形式产出时，计数器上升2点。

key: When the work result was Good, the Qliphoth Counter increased; the physical and mental health of every employee in the facility was healed.
value: 当工作结果为“优”时，逆卡巴拉计数器上升；设施内每名员工的身心健康都得到了治愈。

key:
Who said a knight never cries? Have you ever seen tears brought out by despair, not sadness? The endless stream of grief has long turned the eye sockets into hollow husks. Inside, black diamonds sometimes fall down like ashes.

The will to protect seems to remain unchanged after all this time; even in containment, it is still obsessed with the act of protection. All that remains is the hollow pride of a weathered knight. The tenacity of the hero who cannot leave the past behind is a pitiful sight.
value:
谁说骑士从不哭泣？你见过因绝望而非悲伤而流下的眼泪吗？无尽的哀伤早已将眼眶蚀成空洞的躯壳。其中，黑色的钻石有时会如灰烬般坠落。

守护的意志似乎历经漫长岁月依然未变；即使在收容之中，它仍痴迷于守护的行为。所剩的，只有一位饱经风霜的骑士那空洞的骄傲。一个无法放下过去的英雄，其执念令人怜悯。

key: Whoops, I sidetracked a little there. Anyway, in normal circumstances, the mountain would have been removed quickly, but it remained in the department for quite a long time. So it decayed, melted, corroded, and broke down following the laws of nature.
value: 哎呀，我有点跑题了。总之，在正常情况下，那座肉山应该很快就会被处理掉，但它却在部门里留了相当长的时间。于是，它遵循自然法则，腐烂、融化、侵蚀、崩解。
